title: Measure of Effectiveness (MOE) Officer, Senior
description:
Company Overview

Orbis Operations is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience, that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Orbis is seeking a Measure of Effectiveness (MOE) Officer, Senior to lead qualitative research and program evaluation activities for a client in the US Intelligence Community. On this multi-year project, the officer will have the opportunity to demonstrate intellectual agility by leading research design, data collection, and data analysis activities to produce and implement recommendations that will support the client in optimizing delivery of specialized projects in support of their mission. This project features the opportunity to interact with a wide range of key stakeholders, including those at senior levels. This is an exciting opportunity for an intellectually curious, energetic MOE officer to work on a project with real impact to help our client develop ways of better meeting the needs of the mission.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement research designs with practical strategies for conducting evaluations of strategic communications for a customer in the US Intelligence Community
  • Apply operational knowledge and tradecraft to enhance the customer's planning, design, and implementation of a variety of projects
  • Design and conduct survey research; includes sample identification, instrument development, survey distribution, and response analysis
  • Analyze both qualitative and quantitative information to provide the customer with comprehensive insights into organizational strengths and challenge areas
  • Prepare reports and presentations for senior leadership based on research plans, activities, findings, and recommendations
  • Brief senior-level customers on research plans, status of activities, findings, and recommendations
  • Generate operational proposals based upon your findings and recommendations

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor’s degree is required for this position.
  • Minimum of 10 years' experience in an advisory role in the IC.
  • Knowledge of the Eastern Asia Region
  • A Master’s degree in business, social science, or behavioral science preferred but not required for this position
  • Active TS/SCI clearance with Poly
  • Ability to extract insights from social media and various open source and proprietary data sources to produce finished intelligence products
  • Experience developing presentations and providing briefings to middle and senior management
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including visual representation of data using charts and graphs
  • Proficiency with MS Excel and PowerPoint
  • Ability to perform in an individual contributor role while also excelling in a team environment

Desired Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience leading program evaluation activities
  • Experience with survey design and analysis
  • Ability to analyze information and identify implications for policy, processes, communications, and training
  • Familiarity with advanced statistical concepts. A master’s degree in business, social science, or behavioral science is a plus
  • Eastern Asia language is helpful but not required

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Routine video conference and/or in-person meetings.
  • Ability to attend planned meetings within the Washington Metro Area region.

Orbis Benefits

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter — the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

Orbis Locations

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work — our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

Orbis Operations is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,

qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

title: Client Advisor, PT
description:
Client Advisor, PT Seasonal
Summary

As the Client Advisor, you are both the face and the driving force on the spa and retail sales floor, delivering gracious and seamless support to guests and staff. You ensure the front-of-house experience consistently reflects our luxury brand standards, demonstrated through exceptional hospitality, meticulous attention to detail, and precise operational execution. You help keep the spa polished, calm, and welcoming, ensuring guests have a world-class experience from arrival to departure.
In addition to these core responsibilities, you are pivotal in achieving sales objectives by actively promoting and selling retail products, maintaining high merchandising standards, and supporting seasonal brand promotions. Your role includes supporting inventory management through monitoring stock levels, receiving shipments, accurately recording product entries, and participating in monthly inventory counts. Operationally, you are responsible for opening and closing procedures, ensuring the spa is secure and prepared for business, and supporting essential daily functions that keep the spa running smoothly. You also assist skin experts by efficiently checking in clients, managing appointment changes, and processing payments after treatments to ensure a seamless guest experience.

Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience & Front Desk Operations

  • Warmly greet all guests and ensure an effortless check-in and check-out process, performed with elegance and discretion.
  • Consistently maintain a professional and polished demeanor while answering calls, managing bookings, and handling guest inquiries.
  • Anticipate guest needs and personalize their spa journey with thoughtful touches and accurate information.
  • Handle appointment changes and scheduling adjustments with efficiency and grace.

Team & Service Coordination

  • Liaise between spa therapists, estheticians, and management to ensure a seamless flow of services and schedule accuracy.
  • Communicate treatment preferences and special requests clearly to the service team.
  • Support service excellence by proactively preparing for each guest’s arrival, such as confirming beverage preferences, ensuring room readiness, or noting VIP status.

Retail & Key Holder Duties

  • Drive retail performance by consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals, improving key performance indicators (KPIs), and supporting the client experience through effective team selling strategies.
  • Perform key holder responsibilities, including overseeing opening and closing procedures, securing the facility, and maintaining business readiness.
  • Maintain high standards of visual merchandising, ensuring retail displays are current and aligned with seasonal promotions and brand guidelines.
  • Oversee inventory levels, receive shipments, and accurately document products within spa software.

Administrative & Operational Support

  • Maintain spa software with up-to-date bookings, precise guest records, and thorough service notes.
  • Process payments, apply discounts or packages as necessary, and ensure all transactions are completed smoothly.
  • Monitor front desk supplies and retail product inventory, assisting with merchandising and product education as needed.
  • Assist in enforcing sanitation, safety, and cleanliness protocols in the reception area and common spaces.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years’ experience in customer service, retail, or administrative positions, with luxury experience strongly preferred
  • Proficiency in various software, programs, & applications, such as Microsoft Office, scheduling software, Mindbody, Booker, Zenoti, etc.
  • High School diploma, higher education and/or certifications in hospitality, wellness, or business preferred
  • Exceptional customer service skills, with an ability to create a warm and client focused experience, high emotional EQ, luxury experience and clienteling skills preferred
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • High attention to detail and strong organization skills
  • Proven track record working in a highly dynamic environment, with the capabilities to multi-task, remain calm and solution-oriented in a fast-paced and occasionally high pressure environment managing multiple priorities
  • Highly collaborative, adaptable, and fully committed to upholding brand standards of luxury service.

title: Military Aircraft Data Analyst
description:
About the Organization
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

About the Role

Redhorse Corporation is seeking a skilled Military Aircraft Data Analyst with a desire to learn and grow to contribute to our Condition-Based Maintenance Plus (CBM+) initiatives. This crucial role leverages cutting-edge data cleansing, interactive data visualization, and understanding of AI/ML technologies to revolutionize aircraft sustainment, optimize maintenance efficiency, and enhance the readiness of our nation’s defense systems.

In this position, you will be instrumental in improving the quality of maintenance data products and building decision-support tools that directly impact mission success. We operate in a collaborative environment and are seeking team members who are eager to learn, adapt, and grow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute program initiatives from inception to deployment, ensuring strict alignment with business and military mission objectives.
  • Design, build, enhance, and maintain intuitive interactive dashboards and web applications using Qlik Sense and Streamlit to support aircraft maintenance analytics.
  • Apply modern UI/UX design principles to transform complex military aircraft dataset outputs into clean, user-friendly, and actionable visual interfaces.
  • Provide domain-specific expert insights on military aircraft maintenance practices to guide and validate AI/ML model development.
  • Conduct Data Discovery and Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on maintenance records and flight logs to identify trends, failure patterns, and operational bottlenecks.
  • Participate in stakeholder engagement meetings, advising military leaders and engineering teams on aircraft maintenance trends and data-driven insights.

Required Qualifications

  • Active U.S. Government Secret Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship required; applicants without an active Secret Clearance will not be considered).
  • 4+ years of relevant aircraft maintenance experience, with experience in data analysis roles (or an equivalent combination of formal education in Data Analytics/Data Science and hands-on military aviation experience).
  • Dashboarding & Business Intelligence: Hands-on experience developing business intelligence dashboards and analytical applications using Tableau, Qlik Sense, Streamlit and the like.
  • UI/UX Design Principles: Practical understanding of user interface and user experience (UI/UX) design principles to create visually engaging, clear, and functional user layouts.
  • Domain Knowledge: In-depth working knowledge of military aircraft maintenance procedures, logistics systems, and aviation industry sustainment trends.
  • Maintenance Information Systems: Deep knowledge of Department of Defense (DoD) maintenance data systems and U.S. Air Force-specific platforms (e.g., REMIS, G081/IMDS, or Advana/CBM+ ecosystems).
  • Data & Statistical Foundations: Experience with data visualization tools (Qlik, Power BI, Tableau, Excel) and a foundational understanding of statistical methods used in data analysis (e.g., Probability, Distributions, Precision/Recall/F1).
  • Adaptability: Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced, evolving technical environment.
  • Growth: Possess a desire to learn and advance skills in the aviation maintenance data space.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher with an emphasis in STEM or analytics.
  • Proficiency with programming languages and analytical data tools, specifically Python and SQL.
  • Hands-on experience working in cloud-based big data platforms such as Databricks.
  • Advanced understanding of AI/ML applications and sensor-based predictive maintenance in military aviation.
  • Experience operating in Agile development frameworks using tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Lucidchart.
The salary range provided for this position represents the anticipated base salary for successful candidates. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, security clearance level, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in Redhorse's comprehensive benefits programs and may be eligible for performance-based or other incentive compensation, where applicable.
Redhorse Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.
If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting Talent Acquisition at Talent-Acquisition@redhorsecorp.com
Redhorse Corporation shall, in its discretion, modify or adjust the position to meet Redhorse’s changing needs. This job description is not a contract and may be adjusted as deemed appropriate in Redhorse’s sole discretion.

title: Logistics Coordinator - Grand Rapids MI
description:
Applied Innovation is seeking a self-motivated, highly energetic, organized, and detail-oriented Logistics Coordinator to join our Distribution Center team. This full-time position is Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM.

The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and supporting the day-to-day logistics operations of Applied Innovation, including customer equipment deliveries, equipment moves, copier and printer pickups, driver scheduling, dispatch coordination, and related invoicing and documentation. This position serves as a key communication link between the Distribution Center, Delivery Manager, delivery drivers, customers, sales, service, warehouse personnel, and other internal departments. The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for maintaining an accurate and efficient delivery schedule, monitoring job progress, proactively addressing scheduling challenges, and ensuring customer commitments are met. The ideal candidate is highly organized, communicates effectively, takes initiative, demonstrates strong problem-solving skills, and can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and customer service.


Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Coordinate customer equipment deliveries in the absence of the Logistics Manager, ensuring deliveries are scheduled and completed accurately and efficiently.
  • Coordinate and invoice equipment moves and copier pickups across all Applied Innovation locations.
  • Schedule, monitor, and track delivery orders to ensure timely completion.
  • Monitor new orders in E Auto and OnBase and ensure information is complete and accurate.
  • Communicate with customers, internal teams, delivery personnel, and other departments regarding delivery schedules, equipment moves, and pickups.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed paperwork, records, and documentation related to deliveries, moves, and pickups.
  • Review orders and supporting documentation for accuracy and follow up on missing or incomplete information.
  • Assist with resolving scheduling issues, delivery changes, and other logistical concerns.
  • Ensure completed deliveries, moves, and pickups are properly documented and invoiced.
  • Maintain awareness of delivery schedules and proactively communicate potential delays or issues.
  • Work collaboratively with the Distribution Center and other departments to ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Provide support to the Logistics Manager and Distribution Center team as needed.
  • Promote a positive, professional, and collaborative work culture.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, communication, and overall delivery coordination.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:
To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong scheduling, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to make sound decisions and adjust priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow through on commitments.
  • Ability to effectively coordinate with drivers, customers, management, and multiple internal departments.
  • Strong customer service skills and a professional demeanor.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with changing schedules, unexpected issues, and time-sensitive requests.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize work and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Ability to learn and effectively utilize E Auto, OnBase, and other business systems and software applications.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive customer, employee, and business information.

Education/License/Experience Requirements:
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record, including no DUI convictions within the past five years.
  • Previous experience in logistics, transportation, dispatching, delivery coordination, scheduling, customer service, administrative support, or a related field preferred.
  • Previous experience with order management, invoicing, dispatch, routing, or business software systems preferred.
  • Experience working with E Auto and OnBase is a plus.
  • Experience in office technology, copier/printer, transportation, warehouse, or distribution industry is a plus.

Why Applied Innovation?
We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:
  • Medical, dental, and life insurance on the 31st day of employment
  • Short-term disability
  • Paid vacation and holidays
  • Paid volunteer time
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match program
  • Onsite fitness center
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement

title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
description:
Belay Technologies has been voted Baltimore Business Journal's (BBJ) Best Places to Work 2026!

Belay Technologies is seeking a Software Engineer (Sustainment) to join our intel team. This position is ideal for a hands-on engineer who enjoys working across multiple technologies and technical disciplines. The selected candidate will support a diverse portfolio of Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS) and Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) enterprise applications utilizing both modern and legacy technology stacks. Responsibilities may include application development, system integration, application configuration and customization, cloud modernization, and production sustainment. Success in this role requires adaptability, strong technical problem-solving skills, and the ability to quickly learn new technologies as mission priorities evolve.

The ideal candidate is a versatile software developer with experience building and supporting enterprise applications. You should be comfortable working with Java, JavaScript, Oracle databases, and SQL, and have the aptitude and willingness to learn additional programming languages, frameworks, and technologies based on the needs of the products and applications you support.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Analyze and implement code changes resulting from dependency, framework, and technology upgrades.
  • Perform application maintenance activities, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, issue identification, and defect resolution.
  • Design and implement code enhancements and technical improvements based on customer, program, and operational requirements.
  • Collaborate with customers, software developers, systems engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver timely and effective solutions.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning, estimation, technical discussions, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Support application deployments, troubleshooting, and operational activities within Linux and Docker-based environments.
  • Contribute to the long-term stability, reliability, security, performance, and modernization of mission-critical enterprise applications.

Technology Stack:

  • Maven
  • SprinGoot
  • Docker
  • Angular
  • Git
  • GitLab

Candidates should have the following qualifications:

  • Experience with Java development.
  • Experience working with Oracle databases, including SQL development.
  • Experience with a JavaScript framework such as Angular.
  • Experience developing in the Linux operating system.
  • Experience with Docker for containerized application deployment and management.
  • Must be able to work between the core hours of 10AM-2PM. Exceptions will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
Candidates are desired to have the following skills:
  • AWS experience
  • Experience in an Agile development environment
  • Experience in an Agile development environment

title: Service Coordinator
description:
Do you believe no challenge is too complex to solve? You’ll fit right in at U.S. Engineering. We deliver award-winning mechanical contracting, construction, service, and maintenance solutions with a focus on performance and innovation. Our team of skilled and collaborative professionals drives every project from preconstruction through final testing, always aligned with our clients’ goals.

Service Coordinator
Responsible for providing efficient and effective coordination of service calls and technician schedules while delivering exceptional customer experience for both internal and external stakeholders. Acting as the communication hub for customers, technicians, and management, this role ensures service requests are scheduled, dispatched, and completed with accuracy, timeliness, and professionalism.

Principal Duties and Accountabilities:
  • Service Coordination
    • Coordinate dispatch, work assignments, and work order processes to ensure timely service delivery and accurate documentation.
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for operational and technician support within the assigned region.
    • Manage scheduling of preventive maintenance and service calls using the Dispatch Board.
    • Ensure accurate client and job setup in operational software; open and close work orders as required.
    • Communicate daily with Operations Management and Technicians to monitor assignments and service statuses.
    • Collaborate with peer Service Coordinators on work that crosses regional boundaries.
    • Answer incoming calls, address customer requests, and provide professional customer support.
    • Demonstrate flexibility to assume other CSST operational and/or financial responsibilities outside this job scope when necessary to maintain continuity of service work.
    • Support the team by assisting with other related duties and tasks as needed.
  • Operational Support
    • Issue purchase orders for equipment, parts, tools, and inventory as requested by Technicians or Supervisors.
    • Verify labor hours, track expenses, and process purchase orders in SAMPro for payroll and billing support.
    • Partner with Customer Support Services Management to maintain alignment in dispatch and billing processes.
    • Coordinate manpower needs with Field Operations Management.
    • Manage and communicate the after-hours on-call schedule for Technicians, ensuring follow-up on overnight service calls.
  • Job Management
    • Audit completed jobs and site visits daily for accuracy and compliance with company standards.
    • Correct discrepancies or inconsistencies in job details to ensure accurate reporting.
    • Ensure completed jobs include all required documentation (labor, materials, notes, photos, etc.).
    • Monitor job progression at every stage, from creation and scheduling through completion.
Management Responsibility:
Individual Contributor – no subordinates.

Education:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; additional coursework in accounting a plus.
Experience:
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a customer service or administrative role (dispatch, operations, or accounting support).
  • Previous experience as a Service Coordinator or Dispatcher preferred but not required.
  • Knowledge of commercial HVAC systems, equipment, and terminology a plus.

Knowledge, skills, and abilities:
  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, multitasking environment, with flexibility to adjust to shifting priorities, emergencies, or unforeseen circumstances.
  • Strong customer service orientation with excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills to effectively engage with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Capacity to analyze complex situations, evaluate options, and make sound judgments and quick decisions while maintaining focus on service quality and customer satisfaction.

title: Data Engineer
description:
As a Database Engineer on the Professional Archive team, you'll operate as a subject-matter expert for the data infrastructure that powers our platform – driving the architecture, scaling, and reliability decisions that keep high-velocity, compliance-critical systems performant and secure. You'll work with SQL Server environments spanning multi-terabyte data volumes, tables with billions of rows, and sustained throughput exceeding 100,000 transactions per second.

You'll work independently through ambiguous and unfamiliar problems, set technical direction for real-time data pipelines and system performance, and act as a go-to resource for engineers across the wider organization. Your work will directly shape how Smarsh clients meet their compliance needs through scalable, dependable data and search capabilities.

You'll partner with leaders across Product Management, Engineering, and Site Reliability, weighing a range of inputs to resolve complex challenges and influence strategy beyond your immediate team. We're looking for someone who brings deep technical judgment, mentors others, and is motivated to make an impact through thoughtful, high-leverage engineering.

How will you contribute?

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert for database architecture and performance, guiding engineers through complex or ambiguous technical problems where established principles don't fully apply
  • Set the technical approach for scalable data solutions, partnering with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Site Reliability to shape direction rather than simply implement it
  • Drive larger, cross-functional projects from design through delivery, proactively identifying and addressing upstream and downstream impacts before they become issues
  • Informally mentor other engineers, modeling sound engineering discipline and raising the technical bar for the wider team
  • Shape how the team adopts modern engineering practices, including Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps principles
  • Review code and database changes with an eye for systemic risk and performance, while also leading efforts to pay down technical debt across systems
  • Track emerging technologies and make the call on which are worth adopting, guiding the team's direction
  • Interpret database health and performance data (Splunk, Datadog, Grafana) to proactively flag and address risk before it surfaces as an incident

What will you bring?

We're looking for a recognized subject-matter expert who operates independently, drives clarity through ambiguity, and raises the bar for those around them.

  • Advanced, wide-ranging experience with database systems, with the judgment to operate independently in unfamiliar or ambiguous situations
  • Deep expertise designing logical and physical data models, including schema design and data relationships, at a level others rely on for direction
  • A demonstrated ability to set database performance strategy by tuning queries and indexes and establishing standards that others follow
  • Strong command of data security practices (encryption, access controls, auditing), with the ability to shape how the team approaches them
  • A track record of independently troubleshooting complex issues in systems that require high availability, serving as an escalation point for others
  • Ability to plan for data growth and scale infrastructure with the full flow of work in mind, not just the immediate ask
  • The credibility and collaborative instinct to influence peers and cross-functional partners, not just execute their requests
  • Strong command of modern development practices and Agile methodologies, with a voice in how the team applies them
  • Ability to communicate technical direction, trade-offs, and risk clearly to stakeholders outside your immediate team
  • Comfort setting a course through evolving, ambiguous requirements rather than waiting for them to be resolved
  • A proactive approach to identifying and solving problems that cross team boundaries

Preferred Qualifications

  • If you don't meet every qualification listed below, we still encourage you to apply. We value diverse experiences and perspectives. Progression to this level reflects demonstrated ability to perform as a subject-matter expert, not years of experience alone.

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in a production environment, with demonstrated impact as a subject-matter expert
  • Deep expertise in schema and data model design, including normalization, partitioning, and indexing strategy for both OLTP workloads
  • Advanced proficiency in performance tuning, including T-SQL and stored procedure optimization, execution plan analysis, and query tuning at scale
  • Proven, hands-on experience managing and troubleshooting SQL Server databases at terabyte scale, including tables with billions of rows, and sustained throughput exceeding 100k transactions per second
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve production capacity and contention issues at this scale, including lock/latch contention, TempDB performance, and transaction management
  • Experience designing for horizontal as well as vertical scalability, anticipating data growth before it becomes a production risk
  • Familiarity with NoSQL technologies (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB) is a plus
  • Experience with cloud database platforms (e.g., AWS RDS/Aurora, MongoDB Atlas) is a plus

What do we offer?

  • Healthcare insurance: We provide medical, dental, and vision insurance, and a flexible spending account that allows you to set aside pre-tax dollars to pay for eligible out-of-pocket expenses.
  • Stock options.
  • Personal time off: A healthy work-life balance is critical to your success at the office. Smarsh offers a “take-what-you-need” time off policy as well as flexible work arrangements.
  • 401K Match: Smarsh provides a 4% 401K match for which employees are fully vested on day one.
  • Sabbatical: The Smarsh sabbatical programme provides a time to recharge, study or simply do something you are passionate about away from the workplace. Employees are eligible after six years of service.
  • Recognition: We’re big on kudos for a job well done. Our employee-recognition programme enables co-workers to nominate their peers who best embody our core values for recognition.
Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway! We value diverse candidates and encourage applications, even if you don't perfectly match the job description. Studies have shown that some strong candidates may self-select out of the interview process prematurely, at Smarsh we encourage an inclusive, high-performing environment.

title: Advanced Technical Animator
description:
Advanced Technical Animator (Contract)


We are seeking a Advanced Technical Animator to drive the development of scalable, high-performance character systems across Unreal Engine productions. You will architect runtime animation systems, build and optimize production pipelines, develop tools, and collaborate across disciplines to support both internal teams and external partners in delivering modern, AAA-quality character experiences.
Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable runtime animation systems in Unreal Engine, including Animation Blueprint architectures that are performant and thread-safe
  • Develop modular, data-driven animation frameworks supporting layered gameplay systems (motion matching, state machines, additive systems, gameplay-driven logic)
  • Build, integrate, and optimize character systems such as IK setups, secondary motion, and simulation workflows (e.g., cloth and hair)
  • Profile, debug, and optimize animation and character systems for performance across multiplayer, large-scale, or live-service environments
  • Own and support the end-to-end facial animation pipeline, including defining model requirements, guiding joint setup and rigging approaches, and ensuring successful integration and performance in-engine
  • Design, build, and maintain robust cross-DCC and engine pipelines to support character and animation workflows
  • Develop and maintain custom tools (Python, MEL, C#, or C++) in Maya and Unreal to improve iteration speed and content quality
  • Identify production bottlenecks, troubleshoot complex pipeline and content issues, and implement scalable solutions across teams
  • Partner with external vendors and internal stakeholders to support and scale outsourcing pipelines
  • Establish best practices, documentation, and onboarding materials to ensure consistency and efficiency across teams
  • Support version control workflows, asset management systems, and studio-wide pipeline standards
  • Mentor team members and contribute to evolving technical and pipeline strategies across projects
Requirements
  • 7+ years of experience in games, film, or real-time interactive production, with a focus on technical animation, technical art, or related disciplines
  • Deep experience with Unreal Engine, including real-time animation systems and performance considerations. Profile animation systems using Unreal Insights and in-engine tools.
  • Strong scripting and programming skills (Python required; experience with MEL, C#, or C++ preferred)
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining production-ready tools, pipelines, and workflows
  • Strong understanding of real-time character systems, including skeletal hierarchies, retargeting, facial rigging techniques, IK/FK blending, pose-space correctives and runtime constraints
  • Experience supporting or building character-related systems such as animation graphs, simulation workflows, or deformation pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major DCC package (Maya preferred)

  • Experience working in collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams with clear communication and documentation skills

title: Junior Software Engineer (Prime)

At Intelliforce, we help mission systems work together the way they are supposed to. In this role, you will support Analytical Application Integration by helping sustain software, maintain system interoperability, support testing, and assist with secure deployment activities.

You will work alongside experienced software and systems engineers to learn how mission applications connect to upstream and downstream systems, how data moves through those environments, and how software is maintained and modernized over time.

This is a strong opportunity for an early-career engineer who wants hands-on exposure to software integration, testing, Information Assurance, sustainment, and deployment in a real mission environment.

What Makes This Opportunity Stand Out

This role gives you exposure to much more than isolated software development. You will see how applications fit into a larger mission ecosystem and learn what it takes to keep those systems interoperable, compliant, and operational.

You will support development and refactoring efforts for the platform, assist with build and deployment activities for systems, and work with teams supporting external mission partners.

At Intelliforce, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced engineers while contributing to meaningful work from the start. Because we are a small business, leadership is accessible, communication is direct, and strong effort gets noticed. Add in long-term stability, strong benefits, and a people-first culture, and this is a strong place to begin building a mission-focused software engineering career.

  • Review and test software components against documented requirements

Required Skills

Desired Skills

title: Field Service Representative
description:
Skyways designs, builds, and operates fully autonomous long-range cargo aircraft. Founded in 2017, the company has spent the last eight years developing and deploying autonomous logistics systems for real-world operations.

Our V2 aircraft carries 30 lbs up to 500 miles, and V3 has a maximum range of well over 1,000 miles, a maximum useful load of 100 lbs, and a maximum endurance of nearly 20 hours. Both use a hybrid-electric architecture that takes off like a helicopter and cruises like a plane, enabling long-range autonomous delivery without traditional runway infrastructure.

Today, Skyways aircraft operate across three continents in controlled national airspace under FAA oversight and in support of U.S. military operations. We are transitioning from prototype development to full-rate production and scaling toward large autonomous cargo fleets.

Backed by Y Combinator and a $37M AFWERX STRATFI award from the U.S. Air Force, Skyways is creating a new form of transportation to advance our civilization from Austin, Texas.

The Opportunity

This is the job that keeps our aircraft flying after the sale. As a Field Service Representative, you're Skyways on the ground at a customer's site: deploying the aircraft, maintaining it, and fixing what breaks so their missions stay on schedule. When an aircraft goes down, you're the one who gets it back up.

Some days you're at our Austin shop or flight test site. Most days you're on the road, often internationally, running a customer site with limited backup and owning the outcome. It's hands-on, it's high-trust, and it moves. If you want a predictable desk job, this isn't it. If you like being the person customers rely on when it matters, you'll do well here.

What You'll Do:

  • Deploy to customer sites as Skyways' on-site rep and keep aircraft available, mission-ready, and flying against a 95%+ readiness bar

  • Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance: multi-fuel power-system service and swaps, batteries, motors, ESCs, and consumables, per the maintenance manual

  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, RF/datalink, and firmware issues in the field, and fix them on the spot when you can

  • Escalate what you can't solve to MRO and Engineering with real context (symptoms, tail number, config, flight data) and drive it to resolution

  • Hit our service commitments: acknowledge issues fast and restore aircraft-down situations first

  • Keep the records honest: daily logbooks, maintenance history, and per-tail configuration control, current every day

  • Stand up new sites and redeployments: setup, systems install, functional check flights, radio/datalink checks, route validation, rehearsals, and handover

  • Manage on-site spares and AOG (aircraft-on-ground) response so a missing part doesn't ground the mission

  • Feed what you learn in the field back to Engineering so the same problem doesn't keep coming back

  • Be the customer's trusted point of contact and represent their needs back inside Skyways

What You'll Bring:

  • 3+ years maintaining and supporting real aircraft or UAS in the field (Group 3 UAS or similar a plus)

  • Strong mechanical foundation, plus electrical, RF/datalink, and basic software/firmware troubleshooting

  • Comfort with small internal-combustion or multi-fuel engines

  • Ability to read, and actually use, technical manuals, schematics, and wiring diagrams

  • Someone who can run a remote site solo: safety-minded, self-directed, and calm when an aircraft is down

  • Willingness to travel up to ~75%, including extended international trips, sometimes on short notice; valid U.S. passport and driver's license

  • Able to lift ~50 lbs and work outdoors in the conditions the mission runs in

  • Disciplined about documentation: logbooks and configuration records don't slip

  • Comfortable with the tools we run support on (Slack, Asana, Airtable, Google Workspace)

  • Able to obtain any customer- or contract-required security clearance

Bonus Points:

  • FAA Part 107 and/or BVLOS operations experience

  • A&P license or an equivalent airframe/powerplant background

  • Prior military UAS, aviation-maintenance, or operations experience (15-series MOS, AV/AT/AE, TACP, or SOF aviation)

  • OCONUS / deployed field experience

  • Autopilot / ground-control-station software and RF/datalink systems (PX4- or ArduPilot-class) and Linux

  • Familiarity with spares, RMA, and field-logistics workflows

  • Prior OEM field-service or customer-facing technical-support experience

  • Experience operating under FAA, SORA, or similar standards

  • Additional language ability for international deployments

In addition to base salary, offers include stock options, so you own part of what you build. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid holidays, a 401k, and life insurance.

Relocation assistance is available for candidates moving to Austin.

Want to join our mission? Apply to learn more!

Due to U.S. government contract requirements, this role is limited to U.S. citizens, U.S. permanent residents, or candidates from specific countries authorized under applicable export control regulations.

Skyways is an Equal Opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other factor protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

title: Enforcement Assistant (Contract)
description:
Engineers and Geoscientists British Columbia is currently searching for an Enforcement Assistant to join our team in Burnaby on a contract until the end of June 2027.

The Enforcement Assistant works under the supervision of the Legal Counsel, Enforcement Manager ("LCEM") to assist the team responsible for enforcing unauthorized practice and misuse of title prohibitions in the Professional Governance Act. Their work will involve taking conduct of, and resolving, low and medium risk enforcement files, investigating concerns, drafting cease and desist correspondence from precedents/templates, and engaging with targets to secure compliance.

Our organization - one of BC's Top Employers – offers a competitive salary, comprehensive and generous benefits, an inclusive culture, and a hybrid work environment. Full details on our compensation and benefits value offering can be found below.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Taking conduct of and resolving low and medium risk enforcement files using strong written and oral (phone) advocacy.
  • Reviewing complaints in detail, analyzing fact patterns, gathering initial information and evidence as required, and conducting email and telephone communications with complainants and enforcement targets.
  • When directed by the LCEM as the need arises, supporting the enforcement team, including through participation in working groups, supporting proactive enforcement campaigns, conducting online research, using internal databases, cross referencing, using other data analysis techniques, and assisting with statistics, trends, and KPI reporting as required.
  • Other duties as assigned by the LCEM and members of the departmental leadership team.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

  • 2-5 years of experience working in a law firm, legal department, professional regulatory body, or equivalent.
  • Education in legal or paralegal studies is an asset.
  • Experience handling incoming complaints or correspondence from third-parties in a professional or customer service environment.
  • Excellent writing skills, including the ability to independently prepare written correspondence that is consistently polished, professional, formal, and free of grammatical errors or colloquialisms.
  • Experience in interpreting and applying legislation.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to independently review, analyze, and keep track of a high volume of materials and matters.
  • Ability to uphold confidentiality and manage sensitive situations.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Each member of our team contributes to public safety in BC and helps us deliver on our vision of "modern regulation for a resilient world." We serve the public as an inclusive, progressive, and future-focused regulator. Our Strategic Plan also places priority on our role to advance climate action, foster equity, diversity and inclusion, and move towards reconciliation with Indigenous peoples. At Engineers and Geoscientists BC, we are committed to demonstrating our values of collaboration, excellence, integrity, and innovation.

This role offers a competitive compensation and benefits program including an annual salary within our hiring range of $55,500 to $62,000 (pro-rated based on the length of contract). For full-time contract employees on this length of contract, we offer:

  • 8% additional pay in lieu of benefits.

  • 10 vacation days per annum (pro-rated based on the length of contract).

  • A flex day program offering additional paid days off (usually alternating Fridays) as a result of a compressed work week.

  • A hybrid work model with an assigned schedule confirming days worked remotely and days worked in-office. This role will be required to work in-office a minimum of 2 days per week during regular business operations.

  • The required tools, equipment, and technology for employees to work remotely are provided.

  • Free parking at the office, or a transit reimbursement offered to employees who take transit to work; we are centrally located near bus and Skytrain stops.

WHO WE ARE

Engineers and Geoscientists BC is proud to be recognized as one of BC's Top Employers.

Engineers and Geoscientists British Columbia is the business name of the Association of Professional Engineers and Geoscientists of the Province of British Columbia. We regulate and govern these professions under the authority of the Professional Governance Act.

We are charged with protecting the public interest by setting and maintaining high academic, experience, and professional practice standards for over 40,000 registrants. Individuals licensed by Engineers and Geoscientists BC are the only persons permitted by law to undertake and assume responsibility for engineering and geoscience projects in BC.

We are a not-for-profit organization governed by a board of elected registrants, licensees, and government appointees. The board is accountable to the public through the Ministry of Post-Secondary Education and Future Skills under the Office of the Superintendent of Professional Governance, for both the governance and management of the organization.

title: MDM Consultant
description:
Responsibilities

  • Facilitate domain definition workshops
  • Design the golden-record model per domain: identity attributes, source trust ranking, survivorship rules by source authority and recency.
  • Design matching logic: deterministic matching on verified identifiers as the primary path, with transliteration-aware probabilistic matching on Arabic and English name and address data as the secondary path.
  • Lead the MDM technology evaluation.
  • Design reference data management: controlled lists, code sets and hierarchies (licence types, minerals/commodities, regions, inspection categories) with versioning.
  • Define the stewardship operating model: review queues, decision rights, SLAs, and the quality measures monitored (match rate, duplicate rate, steward backlog).
  • Define how golden keys are applied at silver and published in gold, and the boundary on write-back to operational systems

Required skills and experience

  • 8+ years in master data management, with at least two full MDM implementations delivered.
  • Deep command of matching and survivorship theory: deterministic vs probabilistic, threshold tuning, precision/recall trade-offs, and how to explain false-match risk to a business owner.
  • Arabic-script name and address matching � transliteration variance, name-order conventions, and the practical limits of fuzzy matching on Arabic data. This materially affects match quality on investor and organisation domains.
  • Hands-on with at least one commercial MDM platform (Semarchy xDM, Informatica MDM, Ataccama ONE, Tamr or equivalent) and the judgement to compare them objectively.
  • Reference data management and hierarchy versioning.
  • Party/customer/organisation domain modelling; experience with citizen, investor or licensee registries is a strong advantage.

Certifications

  • Preferred: Vendor certification on the selected MDM product; DAMA CDMP (Reference & Master Data specialism).

title: French Speaking Front Office IT Support Engineer
description:
French Speaking Front Office IT Support Engineer
Join MARGO in the UK (London)
MARGO is a tech-native consultancy delivering high value-added IT expertise to the financial services industry.
We operate in complex Front Office environments where technology, trading activity and production constraints intersect. Our consultants support and operate mission-critical trading systems used by Front Office, trading and risk teams, in contexts where responsiveness, reliability and technical understanding are essential.
Joining MARGO means working in demanding Front Office environments, while benefiting from a human-sized structure, close follow-up and tailored training paths.

About the Role

We are looking for a French-speaking Front Office IT Support Engineer to join our team in London, supporting live, production-critical trading systems for a Tier-1 Investment Bank.

The team operates in high-pressure Front Office environments where responsiveness, common sense, and clear communication matter most. While technical basics are necessary, we hire primarily for mindset. The team can teach you the rest.

What the Team Can Teach You

You don't need to know everything on day one. If you have strong foundations, the team can teach you:

  • Our specific Front Office trading systems, electronic execution workflows, and market data platforms.

  • Advanced Linux/UNIX commands, internal scripting, and complex production investigation tools.

  • The intricate technical setup of a Tier-1 Investment Bank’s trading infrastructure.

  • Deep-dive financial domain knowledge, asset class mechanics, and trade lifecycle details.

What the Team Is Looking For

We are looking for a candidate who brings the right attitude, communication skills, and problem-solving instinct. The team is looking for:

  • Fluent French & English: Strong communication skills in both languages to interact smoothly across teams.

  • Genuine Financial Curiosity: An eager mindset that looks "beyond the database." You don’t need to be a quant, but you should actually want to understand the real financial products (bonds, swaps, equities) behind the data strings.

  • Pragmatism & Resourcefulness: A smart problem-solver who prioritizes ruthlessly. You secure quick wins for simple issues and avoid falling down one-hour technical rabbit holes over minor glitches while traders are waiting.

  • The "Translator" Ability: Social intelligence to act as a bridge between two different worlds. You know how to talk to a stressed trader without drowning them in server logs, and you can explain issues to developers without confusing them with trading jargon.

  • Solid IT Foundations: Basic-to-intermediate experience with Linux/UNIX command line and SQL for querying databases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide live, real-time IT support for Front Office trading platforms during market hours.

  • Monitor real-time trading activity, investigate system behavior, and resolve production incidents.

  • Manage real-time market data configurations and support electronic execution workflows.

  • Collaborate closely with both Trading Desks and Development/Infrastructure teams.

  • Participate in change management, testing, and system release deployments.

Requirements

  • Languages: Fluent French and English (written and spoken).

  • Technical Baseline: Prior experience in IT support with working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and basic SQL.

Why Join MARGO
· Access to demanding Front Office trading environments
· Exposure to live trading systems and business users
· Progressive technical and functional development paths
· Human-sized consultancy with close support and tailored training
· Long-term career opportunities across support, engineering and development
Please note - We do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.
Interested? Motivated? Apply on our website or at staff.uk@margo.com

title: Socialsekreterare till Mottagningsgrupp barn, unga och vuxna
description:
Vill du vara med på vår utvecklingsresa för att bli en lättillgänglig, synlig och kunskapsbaserad socialtjänst med ett förebyggande arbetssätt? Hos oss på socialförvaltningen får du vara med och bidra till att framtidssäkra socialtjänsten. Vi arbetar utifrån våra målgruppers behov inom individ- och familjeomsorg och funktionshinderomsorg, för att invånarna i Haninge ska kunna leva ett självständigt liv. Vi har fokus på resultat och vad som skapar värde för dem vi är till för. Välkommen till oss!

Haninge kommun anpassar sig inför framtidens socialtjänst och har därför inrättat en första linjens socialtjänst. Här har vi samlat tidiga och förebyggande råd- och stödinsatser med målet att kunna erbjuda kommuninvånarna hjälp i ett tidigt skede så att allvarlig problematik förebyggs. Vi ska finnas nära kommuninvånarna och det ska bli enklare att komma i kontakt med oss. Som ett led i att samla första linjens socialtjänst har vi en gemensam mottagning för barn, unga och vuxna samt ett team av engagerade sabbutredare.

Ditt uppdrag

Som socialsekreterare hos oss är ditt huvudsakliga uppdrag att ta emot och göra bedömningar av inkomna orosanmälningar och ansökningar rörande både barn, unga och vuxna. Uppdraget innebär även att ge trygga råd och erbjuda konsultation till föräldrar, anhöriga och personer som känner en oro för barn och vuxna i sin närhet.

Vi är socialtjänstens ansikte utåt och arbetar aktivt med att alla medborgare ska få rätt stöd i rätt tid. Teamet använder Signs of Safety som arbetssätt och i uppdraget ingår en nära samverkan med både interna och externa samarbetspartners. Det viktigaste för oss är att möta våra medborgare med stor professionalitet, värme och respekt.

Det här söker vi hos dig

Vi söker dig som är utbildad socionom och som har kunskap och erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom barn och unga. För att lyckas och trivas i rollen ser vi att du har erfarenhet och förmåga att göra akuta bedömningar samt att planera och hantera akuta insatser tillsammans med dina kollegor och gruppledare. Du har goda kunskaper om BBIC och Signs of Safety samt förmåga att dokumentera korrekt och rättssäkert. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete med vuxna med beroendeproblematik.

Din personliga kompetens

Det här är en roll för dig som trivs i en dynamisk vardag där akuta situationer varvas med planerade möten. Du är trygg och stabil i stressiga stunder och du har en naturlig förmåga att organisera, avgränsa och prioritera dina arbetsuppgifter när tempot skruvas upp. Eftersom du har många kontaktytor är du en person som kommunicerar på ett lyhört, tydligt och förtroendeingivande sätt. Du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och trivs med att samarbeta tätt med andra, samtidigt som du är helt bekväm med att fatta självständiga beslut utifrån våra rutiner och riktlinjer.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personliga lämplighet och söker dig som vill utvecklas och bidra med ditt kunnande och ditt engagemang till vår grupp.

Det här kan vi erbjuda dig

Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats med en väl fungerande struktur, tydliga rutiner och fantastiska kollegor som är erfarna, trevliga och engagerade. Mottagningen består av 12 socialsekreterare, en gruppledare, två administrativa assistenter och en enhetschef. För att ge dig bästa möjliga stöd i din vardag har teamet även regelbunden handledning.

Vi månar om en bra balans mellan jobb och fritid och det finns möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån någon eller några dagar i veckan när verksamheten tillåter. Vi sitter i ljusa, trevliga kontorslokaler i Handen med närhet till pendeltågsstation, köpcentrum, restauranger och vackra naturområden med bad, skid- och löpspår. Vi vill att våra anställda ska må bra och erbjuder därför fri tillgång till gym i kommunhuset, friskvårdscheckar, förmånligt flextidsavtal, klämdagar och möjlighet till semesterväxling.

En hälsning från mottaget

Vi är en stabil och erfaren grupp med en stark sammanhållning där vi stöttar varandra och vi gillar varandras olikheter. Vi har en bra struktur på arbetet och ett bra stöd från arbetsledare och chef. Vi har roligt tillsammans och tycker om att vara på jobbet!

Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningstiden.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Har du frågor kring tjänsten, kontakta: Malin Richter- Enhetschef malin.richter@haninge.se

Anställning kan ske först efter att ett godtagbart registerutdrag från Polisens erhållits.

Haninge kommun ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar alla sökande. Vår kompetensbaserade rekryteringsmetodik syftar till att fokusera på individens kompetens och därigenom även motverka diskriminering.

Information om anställningsvillkor och förmåner finns samlad på vår hemsida. Där kan du läsa mer om vad det innebär att vara anställd i Haninge kommun.

Vill du veta mer om oss är du varmt välkommen att titta in på haninge.se/karriar

title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
description:
About Fusemachines

Founded in 2013, Fusemachines is a global provider of enterprise AI products and services, on a mission to democratize AI. Leveraging proprietary AI Studio and AI Engines, the company helps drive the clients’ AI Enterprise Transformation, regardless of where they are in their Digital AI journeys. With offices in North America, Asia, and Latin America, Fusemachines provides a suite of enterprise AI offerings and specialty services that allow organizations of any size to implement and scale AI. Fusemachines serves companies in industries such as retail, manufacturing, and government.

Fusemachines continues to actively pursue the mission of democratizing AI for the masses by providing high-quality AI education in underserved communities and helping organizations achieve their full potential with AI.

Type: Remote, Full-time

Key Objective:

The Sr. UX/UI Designer sits on a product team and owns the design of a product area, connecting real user needs with business goals. This designer thinks like a product owner and understands how the product earns its keep. Craft and research fundamentals stay non negotiable, and AI is the working partner that makes it possible to explore more options and prove ideas faster.Key Objective:

Qualifications and Experience:

  • At least 5 years of UX/UI design experience, with a portfolio of products that shipped.

  • Demonstrated use of AI in real design work, with examples of what it changed.

Required skills/competencies:

AI fluency and vibe design

  • Fluent with current AI design, prototyping, and coding tools such as Figma Make, Claude, Cursor, v0, or Lovable, and quick to learn the next ones.

  • Vibe designs with intent, going from rough idea to working prototype in hours by steering AI with a trained eye.

  • Treats a prompt like a design brief, giving AI the context, constraints, and design system rules it needs.

  • Uses AI across the process, from research synthesis and UX copy to edge cases, accessibility checks, and QA.

  • Can tell a fast AI output from a good one, and sets the tool aside when doing it by hand is better.

Designing AI products

  • Designs for systems that do not give the same answer twice, handling uncertainty, wrong answers, and partial results without losing the user's trust.

  • Understands how models and agents behave well enough to set honest expectations and place human review where being wrong is costly.

  • Thinks past the chat box, designing agentic and assisted workflows rather than defaulting to conversation.

Product and business thinking

  • Knows how the product makes money, who it serves, and what the success metrics and constraints are, and designs with that in view.

  • Weighs desirability, feasibility, and viability, and can say no to an idea that is not worth what it costs.

  • Argues design decisions in terms stakeholders care about, such as conversion, retention, or time to ship.

Design fundamentals

  • Strong visual and interaction craft in Figma, and the judgment to run a design system rather than only work inside one.

  • Research and usability testing that ends in decisions, not decks.

  • Enough code literacy to read a component, change it, and steer an AI coding tool.

  • Clear communication in English, able to explain and defend decisions to non designers.

  • Owns the process end to end, scoping, prioritizing, and delivering independently.

Good to have

  • A degree in design, computer science, information technology, or a related field.

  • Production front end experience with HTML, CSS, SASS, or React.

  • Prompt libraries or reusable AI workflows built for a team.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the design of a product area end to end, partnering with product and engineering on the goals and constraints behind the roadmap.

  • Take ideas to clickable prototypes quickly, and use them to drive decisions instead of slides.

  • Run research and usability testing, and bring the findings to the people making the calls.

  • Stay with the work after release, watching how it performs and iterating.

  • Maintain and extend the design system so people and AI tools produce on brand, accessible output by default.

  • Share prompts, workflows, and failed experiments to raise the team's AI fluency.

  • Own the quality of everything you deliver. Nothing ships without a designer's review, AI assisted or not.

title: Software Engineer III, Knowledge Catalog For AI
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Knowledge Catalog is the foundational context engine for the AI era. Designed as an always-on enterprise-wide catalog for AI, it serves as the single reliable source of truth for both human users and AI agents. By bridging the gap between raw data and true business meaning, we power Google's Agentic Data Cloud (demoed at Google Cloud Next ’26 - Agentic Data Cloud), enabling AI agents to reason, act, and execute on complex enterprise data. It provides universal business context and governance for your entire data estate. Data teams and AI developers use Knowledge Catalog to discover data, enforce policies and retrieve rich context for analytics and autonomous applications.

In this role, you'll empower AI agents across industry-leading Google Cloud and third-party data ecosystems, including BigQuery, lakehouses, operational databases, etc. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. description:

title: Skolechef samt Dagtilbuds- og forebyggelseschef til Læring og Trivsel
description:
Holbæk Kommune styrker ledelseskapaciteten på børneområdet markant og søger nu to nye chefer til kerneområdet Læring og Trivsel: en skolechef og en dagtilbuds- og forebyggelseschef. I får et fælles strategisk ansvar for hele børneområdet fra 0 til 18 år – og hver jeres tydelige driftsansvar for henholdsvis skole- og dagtilbudsområdet.

Det er to stillinger for jer, der har lyst til at gå forrest i en vigtig kultur- og kvalitetsopgave – og som kan se værdien i at bygge et tæt og ligeværdigt makkerskab med hinanden. I indgår i et fælles chefteam med ét fælles fagsekretariat, og I skal sammen skabe sammenhæng for børnene på tværs af sundhedspleje, dagtilbud og skole.

Som skolechef får du ansvaret for 11 folkeskoler, 3 specialskoler og 10. klassecentret, og din opgave bliver at omsætte en markant politisk investering til stærkere faglige resultater, lavere fravær og et fornyet samarbejde med forældrene.

Som dagtilbuds- og forebyggelseschef får du ansvaret for 3 dagtilbudsområder med ca. 600 medarbejdere. Ud over at videreudvikle den pædagogiske kvalitet og stærke børnefællesskaber får du en ny og central opgave: Sundhedsplejen flytter til dit ansvarsområde, og du får dermed mulighed for at samle den tidlige og forebyggende indsats, fra barnets første 1.000 dage og frem, i ét sammenhængende ledelsesansvar.

Jeres tilgang til børn, unge, forældre og familier skal afspejle Holbæk Kommunes borgersyn: I møder borgeren med respekt og åbenhed, ser familien og dens netværk som en ressource, og tør gå nye veje for at finde de bedste løsninger sammen.

Holbæk er en af Region Sjællands store vækstkommuner med over 75.000 indbyggere og en ambitiøs politisk dagsorden for børn og unge. I bliver en del af en organisation med et stærkt kollegialt sammenhold i chefgruppen, og hvor alle ledere deltager i en fælles ledelsesuddannelse.

I er begge fagligt forankrede ledere af ledere med solid erfaring fra jeres respektive områder, og I har en naturlig politisk tæft og et stærkt økonomisk overblik. I har blik for, hvordan digitalisering og ny teknologi kan styrke kvaliteten i jeres områder og skabe værdi for børnene. Men frem for alt er I nysgerrige, synlige og opsøgende ledere, der skaber tillid gennem åben kommunikation – og som ser det som en styrke, ikke en begrænsning, at I ikke skal løfte opgaven alene.

Kender I hinanden og vil søge stillingerne sammen, er I meget velkomne til det – men vi forventer, at de fleste søger enkeltvis, og det er naturligvis den mest almindelige og lige så velkomne vej ind.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Autonomy - Behavior and Motion Planning (R6007)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

The Pilot team develops the algorithms and production software that enable intelligent systems to decide what to do and how to do it in uncertain, dynamic environments. Our work spans mission and task planning, motion planning, effects and action planning, and learned planning approaches. Depending on the team, you may work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, robotics, optimization, and real-time autonomous systems.

As a member of Behavior and Motion planning team, you will leverage your expertise in robotics to develop, deploy, and optimize path planning algorithms for autonomous systems that operate in complex, real-world environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, scalable solutions that advance the state of Hivemind SDK. You will also contribute to developing technical requirements, test plans, and validating the performance of algorithms.

We are hiring software engineers across multiple experience levels. The scope of the role will be calibrated to the candidate's experience, from implementing and validating well-defined planning components to owning major technical capabilities, shaping architecture and roadmaps, and mentoring other engineers.

What you'll do:

  • Research, design, and implement state-of-the-art algorithms for autonomous trajectory planning and control for single and multi-agent systems
  • Build reliable, robust, and maintainable software, primarily in modern C++, with Python used for prototyping, analysis, automation, and testing.
  • Develop comprehensive tests and evaluate planning stack performance in simulation and, where applicable, on real hardware.
  • Diagnose complex algorithmic and software failures, including concurrency, performance, and integration issues.
  • Collaborate with teams across the organization to refine requirements and deliver capabilities that meet operational needs.
  • Contribute to the design and architecture of scalable, maintainable autonomy and software architecture
  • Develop analysis tools to allow for rapid iteration
  • Take new product features from ideation to verification, to flight testing, and all the way to maturation
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers
  • Stay current with the latest advancements in robotics, and apply them to solve challenging problems

Projects you might work on:

  • Motion planning that produces safe, dynamically feasible behavior under real-world constraints.
  • Collaborative and distributed motion planning for multi-agent scenarios.
  • Incorporating various types of motion and dynamics models into the planning stack.
  • Write software that allows the customer to interact with payloads safely.
  • Planning approaches that incorporate vision-language models (VLMs), vision-language-action models (VLAs), or other learned components.
  • Validate the planning stack using software-, hardware-, and vehicle-in-the-loop simulation of complex autonomous missions.

Required qualifications:

  • Master's degree in computer science, Robotics, or a related field and 5+ years of relevant professional experience or PhD with 4+ years of relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated experience through professional work, internships, research, or substantial projects building, testing, and debugging nontrivial C++ software for motion planning, robotics, autonomous systems, or a closely related algorithmic domain.
  • Experience writing and debugging modern C++, including safe use of common concurrency patterns and the ability to diagnose issues such as data races, deadlocks, and lifetime errors.
  • Working experience with Python for prototyping, analysis, automation, or testing.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, testing, debugging, version control, CI/CD, and maintainable software design.
  • Practical experience developing and debugging software on Linux.
  • Ability to communicate technical decisions and collaborate effectively across disciplines.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with motion planning for any platform (aerial, maritime, space, or ground), working on decentralized or distributed planning for multi-agent systems, or trajectory optimization.
  • Experience applying VLMs or VLAs to motion planning in safety critical systems.
  • Experience delivering software for fielded, real-time, safety-critical, or resource-constrained autonomous systems.
  • Experience with software-in-the-loop or hardware-in-the-loop simulation, performance profiling, or distributed systems.
  • Evidence of relevant technical depth through fielded systems, applied research, publications, open-source contributions, or robotics and autonomy competitions.

You'll own the infrastructure and reliability story end-to-end: provisioning cloud resources, maintaining Kubernetes deployments, improving CI/CD pipelines, and building the observability that lets engineers move fast with confidence.
