title: Senior Software Engineer (Prime)
description:
Make an Impact Where It Matters Most

At Intelliforce, we build and sustain mission software that has to operate as part of a much larger ecosystem. In this role, you will support Application Integration efforts by helping ensure applications, services, and data flows continue working together as platforms evolve.

What Makes This Opportunity Stand Out

This role puts you at the point where software development meets real-world mission integration. You will not be working on an isolated application. You will help determine how capabilities interact with other systems, how data moves through the environment, and what needs to change as mission platforms modernize.

A major part of the work involves sustaining what already matters while improving it for what comes next. You will refactor software for stronger interoperability, support system integration and testing, maintain policy compliance, and help deliver capabilities to external partners.

At Intelliforce, your work is visible and your technical judgment matters. Because we support prime programs, our engineers stay close to meaningful mission work and the teams relying on what they build. Because we are a small business, leadership is accessible, communication is direct, and strong engineering gets noticed. Add in long-term stability, strong benefits, and a people-first culture, and this is an opportunity to have real influence across the full lifecycle of a mission capability.

Here’s What Your Day-to-Day Could Include

  • Provide software engineering, systems engineering, Information Assurance, and testing support for mission efforts
  • Sustain existing mission software and integrated capabilities
  • Maintain interoperability with upstream and downstream systems
  • Analyze and troubleshoot system data flows across interconnected environments
  • Develop and refactor software to improve interoperability within the platform
  • Support build, integration, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Support external mission partners integrating with or operating supported capabilities
  • Maintain standards and policy compliance across supported systems
  • Investigate software and integration issues and implement technical solutions
  • Modify existing software to improve performance, compatibility, or functionality
  • Participate in software testing, integration testing, and operational validation
  • Develop and maintain technical and system documentation
  • Work with systems engineers, software engineers, security teams, testers, and mission stakeholders to resolve technical issues
  • Evaluate system behavior, data movement, interfaces, and operational dependencies as capabilities evolve

Minimum Qualifications

  • Clearance: Top Secret Clearance with Full Scope Polygraph, must be active. We do not have the ability to sponsor clearances
  • Citizenship: Must be a U.S. Citizen. We cannot sponsor visas
  • 20 years of Software Engineering experience on programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited college or university
  • Four additional years of Software Engineering experience on projects with similar software processes may be substituted for the bachelor’s degree
  • Five years of demonstrated cloud experience supporting distributed scalable data technologies and related processing environments

Required Skills

  • Experience developing, maintaining, and enhancing complex software systems
  • Experience integrating software into new or modified systems and operating environments
  • Experience troubleshooting software, integration, and interoperability issues
  • Experience maintaining interfaces and data flows between upstream and downstream systems
  • Experience refactoring software to improve interoperability, maintainability, or performance
  • Experience supporting software build, integration, testing, and deployment activities
  • Experience working in environments with defined security, IA, and policy requirements
  • Experience analyzing user and system requirements to derive software design and performance requirements
  • Ability to debug existing software and correct defects
  • Experience developing or implementing algorithms that meet functional and performance requirements
  • Experience developing and executing software test procedures
  • Ability to write and review software and system documentation
  • Experience analyzing systems flow, data usage, work processes, and problem areas
  • Experience working with complex data repositories and interfaces
  • Strong collaboration skills across software, systems, security, testing, and operational teams

Desired Skills

  • Experience supporting Analytical Application Integration or similar enterprise integration environments
  • Experience with software modernization or application refactoring efforts
  • Experience integrating software into converged or shared mission platforms
  • Experience supporting deployed or expeditionary mission systems
  • Experience working directly with external mission partners
  • Experience sustaining operational software throughout its lifecycle
  • Experience troubleshooting complex end-to-end data flows
  • Experience serving as a technical lead on software development or integration efforts
  • Experience recommending new technologies and processes for complex software projects
  • Experience overseeing software quality and technical implementation across development teams

Compensation Range: $196,000.00 - $252,000.00
This salary range reflects our current market estimate for the role. Final compensation will depend on your experience, technical background, overall qualifications, and alignment with the position. We evaluate each candidate thoughtfully, so offers are shaped around the value you bring to the team

Why Intelliforce? Because you matter—your work, your growth, and your well-being.
At Intelliforce, we don’t just push the boundaries of technology—we partner with some of the most mission-driven teams in defense and beyond to solve challenges that truly matter. As a Systems Engineer here, you won’t just contribute to projects—you’ll help shape outcomes that make a real-world impact.
We also know that great work starts with a great environment. That’s why we invest in you:
  • Ample PTO to rest and recharge—plus all federal holidays and your birthday off, just because.
  • Multiple medical plan options, including ones with zero deductible or premium for employees.

Location: Claremore, Oklahoma
$20-$30/hr, based on experience | Full-Time

Company Overview

Hadrian Fence, a sister company to AIMRIGHT Testing & Engineering, is a fast-growing, locally owned fencing contractor based in Claremore, Oklahoma. We began by serving residential customers and have since expanded rapidly into commercial and industrial fencing projects across the five-state region. Our reputation is built on quality craftsmanship, responsive service, and long-term relationships.

We operate with a faith-based, family-oriented work culture—marked by flexibility, mutual support, and a close-knit team environment. As our commercial division continues to grow, we’re building a team of professionals who share our values and are passionate about doing excellent work with purpose and integrity.

We’re building an elite specialty crew that installs secure fences, gates, and perimeter systems for high-expectation commercial and industrial projects.

This role is for broad-skilled operators who can work across multiple trades, solve problems in the field, read site plans, and build to spec with a high level of professionalism. The Commercial Fence / Specialty Installer helps install specialty fence and perimeter systems in demanding environments. This person may work across welding, equipment operation, concrete, and mechanical installation depending on project needs.

The right person is mechanically inclined, works hard, adapts quickly, and can help deliver excellent work on secure, custom, and technically demanding projects.

  • Read site plans and build to project specifications

  • Assist with welding, concrete work, equipment operation, and other field tasks based on skill set and job needs

  • Maintain a professional standard of workmanship and job-site conduct
  • Travel to job sites as needed, including periodic overnight travel

Work Conditions

  • Full-time field role

  • Typical schedule around 40 to 50 hours per week, with overtime as needed

What We’re Looking For

  • Ability to work hard and handle variety
  • Willingness to learn and grow across multiple specialty areas

Candidates must have experience in at least 2 of the following 4 areas:

title: Trust Administrator
description:
Job Summary

The Trust Administrator will support a Trust Officer in the administration of trust accounts including Special Needs Trusts and Settlement Protection Trusts. This is an ideal position for someone with an understanding of the unique needs of individuals with disabilities, and a passion for ensuring that all clients receive the highest level of care and attention. The Trust Administrator will assist in the day-to-day administration of trust accounts by supporting a Trust Officer. The Trust Administrator may collaborate on additional tasks, projects, training, and responsibilities as needed.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Administrative Support:
    • Provide day-to-day support to the Trust Officer, ensuring that all tasks and responsibilities are handled in a timely and efficient manner.

    • Assist with processing transactions related to the accounts, including disbursements, movement of funds, and account maintenance requests.

Required Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

title: Healthcare Claims Supervisor
description:
Position: Healthcare Claims Supervisor
Location: Remote, Eastern Standard Time (EST) based in the Continental United States.
Reports To: Program Director


Overview:
J29 is an employee centered health and human service management consulting company that specializes in processing, reviewing, and analyzing claims, records, disputes, and audits. Established in 2017, J29 prides itself on its employee centric culture and high employee retention rates that allow us to ensure that we are creating a working environment that prioritizes employee experience. Our team brings corporate performance where we provide our clinical, healthcare policy, and compliance expertise through our support to health and human service programs.

J29 is seeking an experienced Healthcare Claims Supervisor to support the World Trade Center Health Program Third-Party Administrator contract. Reporting to the Program Director, this position will provide daily supervisory oversight and technical leadership for a growing healthcare claims processing team. The team is expected to begin with at least two direct reports and expand as program operations grow.

The Healthcare Claims Supervisor will be responsible for staff direction, claims quality, productivity, operational readiness, and consistent application of program requirements. The role requires strong knowledge of healthcare claims adjudication, coordination of benefits (COB), claims system workflows, and new program implementation. Experience using the PLEXIS claims system is strongly preferred.

Duties:
Team Supervision and Daily Operations
  • Supervise a growing team of healthcare claims staff, with responsibility expected to expand as claim volumes increase.
  • Provide daily work direction, assign priorities, balance workloads, monitor queues, and ensure timely completion of claims processing activities.
  • Conduct regular individual and team check-ins, provide coaching, communicate expectations, and address operational barriers.
  • Monitor attendance, productivity, quality, accuracy, and adherence to established procedures and performance expectations.
  • Escalate staffing, performance, system, policy, or operational risks to the Program Director with recommended corrective actions.
  • Support employee onboarding, cross-training, knowledge development, and succession planning as the team expands.
Claims Processing and Technical Oversight
  • Provide supervisory and technical oversight for end-to-end healthcare claims intake, review, adjudication, payment, denial or rejection, adjustment, and escalation processes.
  • Serve as an operational subject matter expert for complex claims, claim edits, exceptions, reimbursement questions, and processing issues.
  • Ensure consistent interpretation and application of program requirements, benefit rules, covered conditions, reimbursement guidance, and claims processing procedures.
  • Review and help resolve complex or escalated claims issues using applicable policies, procedures, system information, and supporting documentation.
  • Partner with program leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to address recurring claim issues and improve processing consistency.
Coordination of Benefits
  • Oversee coordination of benefits processing, including primary and secondary payer determination, Medicare coordination, Other Health Insurance (OHI), workers compensation coordination, and related recovery activities.
  • Ensure COB claims are processed in accordance with program rules, payer order requirements, available remittance information, and established procedures.
  • Provide guidance on complex COB scenarios, payment calculations, duplicate coverage, liability considerations, and claims requiring additional information.
  • Identify COB-related trends, errors, and training needs, and recommend procedural or system improvements.
New Program Implementation and Operational Readiness
  • Support the design, implementation, and startup of new healthcare claims operations and major program changes.
  • Participate in business requirements reviews, workflow design, claims scenario development, user acceptance testing, defect triage, operational readiness reviews, and go-live support.
  • Help establish staffing plans, work assignments, escalation paths, quality controls, productivity expectations, and standard operating procedures for new operations.
  • Validate that claims workflows and system configurations support program requirements, business rules, benefit limitations, COB requirements, and operational expectations.
  • Identify implementation gaps, dependencies, and risks and communicate recommended solutions to the Program Director.
PLEXIS System and Workflow Support
  • Use the PLEXIS claims system, or comparable claims administration technology, to support daily claims operations, queue management, issue research, and staff guidance.
  • Assist with system workflow validation, claims testing, edit review, defect documentation, and confirmation that approved fixes operate as intended.
  • Coordinate with technical and operational stakeholders to resolve system issues affecting claims processing, COB, quality, or productivity.
  • Document system workarounds, known issues, and processing guidance until permanent solutions are implemented.
Quality, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement
  • Conduct or oversee claims quality reviews, calibration sessions, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and focused retraining.
  • Monitor operational trends, error patterns, inventory, aging, and recurring issues to identify opportunities for process, training, staffing, or system improvement.
  • Promote compliance with contract requirements, privacy and security obligations, J29 policies, and program-specific procedures.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and support operational reporting requested by the Program Director.
  • Promote a collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement culture within a fully remote team.
Experience:
  • 8+ years of healthcare claims processing, adjudication, reimbursement, payment integrity, claims review, or related healthcare claims operations experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supervising or formally leading claims processors, examiners, analysts, or comparable healthcare operations staff.
  • Demonstrated experience managing team productivity, quality, workload distribution, coaching, accountability, and operational performance.
  • Strong working knowledge of the end-to-end healthcare claims lifecycle, including intake, review, adjudication, reimbursement, adjustments, denials or rejections, and escalation handling.
  • Demonstrated experience with coordination of benefits, including primary and secondary payer rules, Medicare coordination, Other Health Insurance (OHI), workers compensation coordination, and recovery processes.
  • Experience supporting new program implementations, operational startups, claims system implementations or upgrades, process redesign, operational readiness, user acceptance testing, and go-live activities.
  • Experience developing, implementing, or maintaining claims processing SOPs, workflows, desk procedures, job aids, quality controls, and training materials.
  • Ability to analyze complex claims and operational issues, interpret requirements, document decisions, and communicate clear direction to staff and stakeholders.
  • Strong independent problem-solving, organization, leadership, and time management skills in a fully remote environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and other collaboration or reporting tools.
Preferred Experience:
  • Hands-on experience with the PLEXIS claims system, including claims processing, workflow navigation, issue research, testing, or operational support.
  • Experience supporting a limited health benefit, specialty benefit, occupational health, workers compensation, Federal healthcare, or other program in which coverage is tied to defined eligibility and covered conditions.
  • Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, Federal healthcare, or third-party administrator claims operations.
  • Experience with benefit configuration, provider reimbursement, appeals, payment integrity, prior authorization, claims quality, or auditing.
  • Knowledge of healthcare electronic transactions and files, including 834, 835, and 837 transactions, and a general understanding of file transfer processes.
  • Experience with PLEXIS and one or more additional claims payment, adjudication, workflow, or case management systems, such as Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, NASCO, or TriZetto platforms.
  • Working knowledge of medical coding, including ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, revenue codes, modifiers, and the effect of coding on claim payment and authorization decisions.
  • Experience with claims reporting, operational dashboards, service-level agreement tracking, root cause analysis, SQL, Power BI, or comparable reporting tools.
  • Healthcare claims, coding, billing, auditing, health information management, or related industry certification.
Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, public policy, or a related field is required. Relevant additional experience may be considered in accordance with company requirements.
  • Claims-related certifications or training are preferred.

Salary: $62,000-72,000

J29, Inc. is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. J29, Inc. is a proud Veteran friendly employer.

title: Vårdadministratör till ortopedisk verksamhet
description:
Är du vårdadministratör och vill arbeta i en utvecklingsinriktad verksamhet med engagerade kollegor? Hos oss på ortopediska kliniken får du ett varierande uppdrag, goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och en viktig roll i arbetet för patientens bästa.

Vårt erbjudande

Ortopediska kliniken vid Universitetssjukhuset i Linköping är en del av Centrum för kirurgi, ortopedi och cancervård (CKOC) inom Region Östergötland. Kliniken består av en vårdavdelning, en mottagning samt en rehabenhet. Verksamheten omfattar akut och planerad kirurgi samt behandling. Förutom basortopedi är klinikens specialistområden barnortopedi, övre och nedre extremitetskirurgi, ryggkirurgi samt tumörkirurgi. Kliniken arbetar aktivt med produktionsstyrning, utveckling samt god dokumentation. Tillsammans arbetar vi för patientens bästa.

Vi arbetar med att utveckla vårdadministratörens roll och strävar efter rätt använd kompetens.

Läs gärna om dina förmåner hos oss, här hittar du även information om bestämmelser gällande lön och ersättningar.

Arbetsbeskrivning

I rollen som vårdadministratör på ortopediska kliniken samarbetar du med klinikens samtliga yrkesprofessioner inom både sluten- och öppenvård. Du erbjuds ett varierande arbete genom hela vårdkedjan från inkommande remiss till vårdavslut.

Inom vårdnära administration utförs arbetsuppgifter enligt grunduppdraget för vårdadministratörer som journaldokumentation, remisshantering, bokningar av patientbesök, Tele-Q och hantera ärenden i 1177. Börjar du hos oss kommer du att genomgå ett introduktionsprogram för att du så smidigt som möjligt ska komma in i ditt nya arbete. Vi har i samband med produktionsstyrnings- och utvecklingsarbetet arbetat med att förbättra rutiner och manualer för att också göra introduktionen lättare för nya medarbetare.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är utbildad och har examen som vårdadministratör/medicinsk sekreterare. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet och intresse av sjukdomsklassifikation, Cosmic, ROS och övriga IT-stöd.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker dig som har en god förmåga att samarbeta med andra och bidra till ett gott samarbetsklimat i gruppen. Du prioriterar dina arbetsuppgifter efter verksamhetens behov. Som person är du stabil, serviceinriktad, ansvarstagande och är lyhörd för behov som uppstår.

Ansökan och anställning

Detta är ett vikariat för en föräldraledig kollega om 12 månader med goda chanser till förlängning.

Inför anställning i ett patientnära arbete inom Region Östergötland kommer du att få fylla i en hälsodeklaration.

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan! Om du behöver hjälp med att registrera i systemet, kontakta kundtjänst Stöd och service, 010-103 60 00, under kontorstid.

Till bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag samt andra externa aktörer och försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. Region Östergötland har upphandlade avtal.

title: Long Term Analyst
description:
# One Group | One Power

We are Enerwave, member of HELLENiQ ENERGY and a leader in providing outstanding and innovative energy solutions. We operate with passion, being engaged in heart and mind to what we do, and we pride ourselves on offering our employees a place where they can excel, creating value. We are offering now a set of exciting positions across our premises in various locations covering multiple departments and areas of expertise.

We are currently looking for a Long Term Analyst, who will focuses on helping the implementation of the company’s energy long-term strategic business goals and is responsible for analyzing market trends, price movements, and fundamental drivers in the forward markets of South-East Europe. As part of the responsibilities, the Long-Term Energy Analyst will model energy markets providing insights to support trading strategies, risk management decisions, and overall business planning. The candidate should be highly analytical with competency in energy modelling and data analysis.

What will you do:

  • Models energy markets and performs quantitative analysis in order to provide rolling forecasts for electricity prices used in the strategic planning of the Company.
  • Track market fundamentals, including generation capacity, fuel prices, weather, and policy developments in South-East Europe.
  • Analyzes large amounts of information to discover trends and patterns.
  • Develops analytic tools to facilitate operations.
  • Assists the development and creation of medium and long-term strategies that help the Company to achieve power business and development objectives.
  • Participates in process for retail/wholesale hedge portfolio.
  • Analyzes sets of data to quantify profit and supports decision-making related to Company’s portfolio.
  • Regularly interacts with teams internally to discuss strategies, business implications, and market developments, which affect the power business.
  • Monitors weather, load, price behavior, transmission constraints/outages, and generation outages to identify risks to the Company position and takes appropriate actions to mitigate portfolio risk.
  • Identifies opportunities for long term power trading, communicates with counterparties and reviews contractual process.

What you need to be successful:

  • A BSc in Engineering or Mathematics
  • At least 2 years of proven experience in the modelling of energy sector
  • 0-3 years of working experience in similar position in relevant sector/area
  • Good knowledge energy market simulation software (Plexos, EPSI) and R/Python programming strongly preferred
  • Good understanding of energy markets
  • Strong energy modelling, quantitative and analytic skills
  • Interest in applying technology and/or quantitative skills to solve complex trading problems
  • Leadership skills
  • Novelty seeking mind-set
  • Self-driven and motivated
  • Ability to communicate effectively across multiple teams and functions

Our offer to you:

  • Competitive salary
  • Bonus Scheme 💰
  • Ticket restaurant card 💳
  • Transportation reimbursement ⛽
  • Private Health Insurance coverage 🩺
  • Pension Scheme
  • Home electricity and natural gas discount ⚡
  • Continuous learning & upskilling opportunities and access to our premium online training platform 📚
  • Reimbursement for your athletic activities 🥈
  • Wellness initiatives & benefits at the office

Enerwave will keep your personal information for a period of 2 years from the submission date, after which we will delete your personal data. title: Software Engineer - AI Center of Excellence
description:
At Casey's, we're building an AI Center of Excellence to help solve meaningful business problems and accelerate how work gets done across the enterprise. From reducing manual effort and improving operational efficiency to enabling better decisions and creating new capabilities, you'll help turn AI opportunities into measurable business outcomes. The AI COE brings together software engineering, AI, and data. You'll move ideas from rapid prototypes to production-ready solutions while helping develop engineering best practices and reusable patterns for responsible AI solution delivery.

As a Software Engineer, AI Center of Excellence, you'll be responsible for building, testing, deploying, and maintaining AI-enabled solutions in support of Casey's continuous improvement initiatives. This role collaborates with our Enterprise Continuous Improvement team, product owners, business stakeholders, Data & Analytics team, and IT to develop solutions that deliver measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain AI-enabled applications, services, and automation solutions.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, continuous improvement practitioners, and product partners to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Build rapid prototypes and proof-of-concepts to validate ideas and accelerate innovation.
  • Develop and enhance solutions utilizing large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and workflow automation tools where appropriate.
  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated testing and evaluations to ensure solution quality and reliability.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues to maintain stable and effective production solutions.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices, reusable components, and solution patterns that improve quality and accelerate delivery of AI-enabled solutions.
  • Partner with engineering, data, security, and platform teams to ensure solutions meet enterprise requirements for security, governance, and scalability.
  • Research emerging technologies and recommend opportunities to improve platforms, processes, and business outcomes.

What you can expect when you join the Casey's team:

  • A transformative culture putting service first and taking pride in caring for our guests, our communities, and each other.
  • Opportunities to use cutting edge technologies and enterprise-wide collaboration to enable our strategy and drive world class service.
  • We're here for families! Great benefits including choices in medical plans, dental, vision, life insurance, charitable giving programs, parental leave and an onsite Child Development Center.
  • Competitive pay, 401k company match up to 6%, vacation & sick time, paid holidays, volunteer time, and an onsite cafeteria.
  • Dress for your day dress code, jeans are welcomed!
  • The opportunity to work for a big company that has not lost our small company feel. Our senior leadership team is engaged, involved and accessible!

What are you waiting for? Come be a part of a company that is growing, transforming and is here for good!

Compensation: Starting pay range:‏‏‎ $81,500 ‎-‏‏‎ ‎$112,100.‏‏‎ Actual pay may vary based on Casey’s assessment of the candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities (KSAs), related experience, education, and qualifications. Other factors impacting pay include local prevailing wages and internal equity. This position is eligible for an annual cash bonus based on company performance. Our full salary range for this role does extend beyond the hiring range listed, allowing team members the opportunity to continue to grow within the company.

title: Teamkoordinator – Teknisk Service
description:
Kan du bevare overblikket, når dagens plan ændrer sig – og samtidig sikre, at kunder, teknikere og opgaver kommer sikkert i mål?

Dansk Plejeteknik søger en stærk og engageret Teamkoordinator til Teknisk Service, som kan tage ansvar for den daglige drift og koordinering af vores udekørende serviceteam.

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at sikre, at teamets opgaver bliver prioriteret, planlagt, koordineret og fulgt helt til dørs. Det kræver overblik, handlekraft og evnen til at træffe beslutninger, når dagens plan ændrer sig – for det gør den ofte.

Dine primære opgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • planlægge og koordinere årlige serviceeftersyn, ad hoc reparationer og øvrige opgaver for vores udekørende teknikere

  • prioritere opgaver ud fra hastegrad, kundebehov, geografi, kompetencer, reservedele og aftaler

  • have den løbende dialog med vores kunder – fra den første henvendelse til opgaven er afsluttet

  • opbygge og udvikle relationen til vores eksisterende kunder

  • sikre, at opgaver og aftaler bliver registreret, vedligeholdt og fulgt op i vores CRM- og planlægningssystemer

  • følge op på igangværende og afsluttede opgaver og sikre, at dokumentation, genbesøg, reservedele og øvrig efterbehandling bliver håndteret korrekt

  • koordinere tæt med blandt andet værksted, lager, indkøb, salg og virksomhedens øvrige funktioner, når opgaver bevæger sig på tværs af organisationen

  • bidrage til udviklingen af arbejdsgange og den fortsatte udvikling af Teknisk Service i tæt samarbejde med driftslederen

Du får stor frihed til at træffe de beslutninger, der er nødvendige for at få den daglige drift til at lykkes.

Hvem er du?

Du kommer måske fra en stilling som servicekoordinator, disponent, kørselsleder, speditør eller fra logistik – eller fra en anden funktion, hvor du er vant til at håndtere mange kunder, medarbejdere og opgaver samtidig.

Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra en teknisk servicevirksomhed eller en anden organisation med udekørende medarbejdere og mange skiftende opgaver.

Du behøver ikke kende vores produkter på forhånd, men du skal have interesse og forståelse for teknik og være villig til at sætte dig ind i opgaverne. En god plan kræver, at du forstår, hvad der faktisk skal løses.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • har et stærkt overblik og arbejder struktureret

  • kan holde hovedet koldt, når tempoet stiger, og planen ændrer sig

  • tager ansvar og træffer beslutninger

  • følger opgaver helt til dørs og ikke slipper dem undervejs

  • kommunikerer tydeligt og professionelt med både kunder og kolleger

  • har naturligt kundetække og forstår betydningen af en god kundeoplevelse

  • har let ved IT og kan arbejde sikkert i flere systemer

Ved opstart får du en grundig introduktion og oplæring af vores teknisk og fagligt stærke medarbejdere.

Vi tilbyder

Du får en central position i en virksomhed i vækst, hvor du får reel indflydelse på den daglige drift og udviklingen af Teknisk Service.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • en central og ansvarsfuld rolle med stor selvstændighed

  • mulighed for at præge og udvikle arbejdsgange og processer

  • korte beslutningsveje og tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ledelse

  • en varieret hverdag med stor kontaktflade

  • dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger med høj faglighed

  • pension og sundhedsforsikring

  • løn efter kvalifikationer

Om Dansk Plejeteknik

Dansk Plejeteknik leverer teknisk service, reparationer, reservedele og løsninger til hospitaler, kommuner, institutioner og hjælpemiddeldepoter i hele Danmark.

Vi arbejder med tekniske hjælpemidler inden for pleje- og sundhedssektoren, hvor høj faglighed, dokumentation og driftssikkerhed er afgørende.

For os handler god service om at tage ansvar for opgaven og finde den rigtige løsning for kunden – også når den oprindelige plan ændrer sig.

Praktisk information

Stillingen er på fuld tid.

Arbejdsstedet er aktuelt på vores adresse i Høng. Dansk Plejeteknik flytter primo 2027 til nye lokaler i Ringsted.

Stillingen refererer til virksomhedens driftsleder.

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til job@danskplejeteknik.dk.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte driftsleder Casper Steenholdt på telefon 5337 8859.

title: Table Games Dealer
description:

title: Global Operations and Supply Chain Transformation Project Manager

IRCA Group, an Advent portfolio company, was founded in Italy in 1919, and it is a leading international B2B provider of high-quality semi-finished ingredients such as chocolate, decorations, creams, inclusions, nuts and pistachios, pastry mixes, gelato ingredients, and other essential solutions for industrial clients or other independent artisanal producers.

          • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement

    • Proven track record of successfully leading complex cross-functional projects

    • Experience working within international and matrix organizations

            • Strategic and analytical thinking

            • Strong communication and presentation skills
            • Ability to lead cross-functional and multicultural teams without direct authority
            • Results-oriented mindset with strong ownership and accountability
            • High level of resilience and adaptability in fast-changing environments
            • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making capabilities

              • Other Requirements

Why join IRCA Group?

As the Global Operations & Supply Chain Transformation Project Manager, you will play a critical role in accelerating IRCA Group's operational transformation and global growth ambitions. You will lead high-impact projects that improve manufacturing performance, supply chain effectiveness, operational excellence, and organizational capabilities across a rapidly growing international business.

This is a unique opportunity to work alongside senior leadership, influence strategic decision-making, and help build a world-class Operations and Supply Chain organization capable of supporting IRCA Group's next phase of growth and value creation.

title: South East Field Representative
description:
A. SUMMARY

Provides for the effective coordination and implementation of all Farm Bureau programs such as membership acquisition and maintenance, policy development, service-to-member programs, commodity programs, leadership development and training, and county program development through the county Farm Bureau organizations.



B. PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Attend monthly county board meetings and annual county meetings. Critique and advise Board of Directors on improvements for annual meetings.

Serve as coordinator between state and county offices for all Farm Bureau programs and activities.

Motivate/assist/train county voluntary leadership with the appointment and activation of county membership committees and program planning committees.

Assist with training and development of plans and procedures for membership campaigns. Monitor and maintain continuous contact during the campaign, and continually assist in educating proper performance of duties and responsibilities.

Assist and train county Farm Bureau leaders (Officers and county Board of Directors) regarding their duties and responsibilities, and encourage the leaders to be active in county, state and national Farm Bureau affairs.

Schedule and conduct district-wide and assist and provide guidance for county-level informational meetings relating to policy development, current policies and Farm Bureau programs. Organize county support for campaigns on statewide and national issues.

Provide regular progress reports, updates and educational information to county boards regarding member service programs.

As a registered lobbyist, maintain contact with county leaders and OKFB public policy department and encourage grassroots advocacy efforts.

Encourage counties to provide opportunities for school age youth to grow and develop through participation in various agricultural related youth clubs/organizations.

Assist county leadership in the activation of the county Young Farmers & Ranchers (YF&R) program and connecting potential members with the YFR coordinator. Motivating and training YF&R to become leaders within Farm Bureau and YF&R awards program.

Work with county leadership to plan promotional activities for the county Farm Bureau. Supply promotional materials to the counties.

Assist the county with starting and strengthening the Women’s Leadership committee and Young Farmers and Ranchers committee.

Work with the counties to develop a positive public image. Assist counties with training, motivating and promoting agriculture within the county.

Provide assistance, training and direction to county office administrator/ county secretaries regarding Farm Bureau programs, activities, county records, membership.

Other duties as assigned by Management.


C. REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

1. Reports Directly to: Director of Field Staff


2. Also Works with: All Federation Staff
State Leadership
County Leadership
County Secretaries
Insurance District Managers and Agents

3. Directly Supervises: None




D. DIMENSIONS

Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture or related field.

3 to 5+ years closely related agricultural/business related work experience.

Proficient PC skills to include use of various software packages.

Proficient oral/written communication and motivation skills.

Ability to work individually and/or with groups.
Ability to coordinate and complete projects with minimal supervision.

Interpersonal skills to work and relate with a variety of individuals.

Ability to implement, coordinate and manage numerous Farm Bureau activities in addition to organizing action committees of various types (constitutional amendments, commodity referendums, etc.).

Flexible work schedule to include night board meetings, extended hours and overnight travel and some weekends.

Valid Driver’s License with acceptable driving record.

Ability to succeed in gaining cooperation and support of volunteer leaders to effectively carry out policies and programs at the county level.

title: Operator
description:
One Group | One Energy

We are Enerwave, member of HELLENiQ ENERGY and a leader in providing outstanding and innovative energy solutions. We operate with passion, being engaged in heart and mind to what we do, and we pride ourselves on offering our employees a place where they can excel, creating value. We are offering now a set of exciting positions in our headquarters in Athens, across multiple departments and areas of expertise.

We are currently looking for an Operator in our Power Generation division, to be responsible for the performance of the day to day operational activities of the plant, in a rolling, rotating shift schedule.

What you will do:

  • Carry out effective response to operational demands and ensure that safe and efficient generation are undertaken, giving due regard to all plant consents and authorizations.
  • Day to day activity includes “hands on” operational duty in the plant control room and/or in the field (e.g. tracks and measures operating parameters and compares actual parameters against planned as of daily operations’ check).
  • Identify and suggest improvements to plant and operating methods.
  • Ensure that the high standards for health, safety and environmental are met, by constantly and diligently adhering and promoting company HSE standards and ISO requirements and ensuring that compliance to the above, is timely, continuous and strict.
  • Support the STL, as permit issuer, in supervising and ensuring compliance of all people in the plant with company’s policies and procedures (e.g. performs the tasks of the isolation list).
  • Participate in a close and effective working level relationship with external interface organizations such as ADMIE and DEPA/DESFA, whilst preserving commercial confidentiality and ensuring that an auditable trail exists in all dealings.
  • Ensure that at all times the commercial capabilities of the plant and up to date dynamic parameters of the station are updated and recorded.
  • Execute the sampling and chemical analysis program.
  • Handle the Heat Recovery Steam Generator (HRSG) Chemical Analysis process and communicates with interested parties.
  • Acts as the First Line Maintenance in emergencies.
  • Manage the Monitoring & Control of Distributed Control System process by implementing the production schedule (i.e. start-ups, shutdowns etc.) and monitoring equipment’s / Power Plant’s status (i.e. valves, motors etc.) and warnings/alarms.

What you will need in order to succeed:

  • A BSc in EC&I, Mechanical, or Navy, or relevant field.
  • At least 3 years of relevant working experience in industry, preferably in generating unit will be considered positively.
  • At least 1 experience in working in the context of strict Quality and HSE protocols (esp. ISO9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001, etc.) will be considered an asset.
  • Basic written and spoken English.
  • Advanced computer skills.

title: CNC-operatør til drift og overvågning i Kalundborg
description:
Er du CNC-operatør og vil du have fast arbejde i teknisk produktion?

Vi mangler en til drift og overvågning i Kalundborg.

Du lander i en større produktionsvirksomhed i Kalundborg, hvor arbejdet foregår omkring et teknisk anlæg. Virksomheden arbejder med genanvendelse af olieprodukter, så hverdagen handler om drift, sikkerhed og stabil produktion. Anlægget er bygget til høj kapacitet, og sikkerhed for medarbejdere og anlæg er en tydelig del af rammen.

Rollen er til dig, der kan holde hovedet koldt, når maskinerne kører og noget skal fanges i tide. Du følger driften tæt, reagerer på afvigelser og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer. Det er et job, hvor grundighed betyder mere end store armbevægelser.

Det får du

Løn: 180-200 kr. i timen

Arbejdsområde: Kalundborg og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 75 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Drift, overvågning og stabil produktion

Din hverdag

Dagen handler om at holde øje med driften og sikre, at produktionen kører som den skal. Du følger maskiner og anlæg, reagerer når noget afviger, og får meldt videre, før små fejl bliver til større stop.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Overvåger drift og reagerer når noget afviger

  • Betjener CNC-maskiner og følger produktionen tæt

  • Laver emneskift, overvågning og afgratning

  • Måler og kvalitetstjekker emner undervejs

  • Hjælper med opstilling og indkøring når der er behov

Når produktionen kører, handler jobbet om ro, rytme og rettidig handling. Du skal ikke gætte dig frem, men du skal kunne se, hvornår noget ikke lyder, ser eller kører rigtigt.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort

  • Har erfaring som CNC-operatør eller fra teknisk produktion

  • Kan holde overblik når maskiner eller anlæg kører

  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt

  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet drift og overvågning før. Men det vigtigste er, at du tager ansvar og arbejder ordentligt.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, er opstart hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: Anerkendende og relationsstærk pædagog søges til Sirius Hagesholm
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe et trygt hjem og et meningsfuldt hverdagsliv for voksne med særlige behov?

Hos Sirius Hagesholm søger vi en engageret og fagligt stærk pædagog, der brænder for relationsarbejde og for at skabe en tryg og forudsigelig hverdag for vores beboere.

Vi arbejder med ro, struktur og nærvær og tager altid udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers behov og rytme.

Du bliver en del af et lille og fagligt stærkt team, hvor samarbejde, humor og faglig refleksion er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Om Sirius Hagesholm

Sirius Hagesholm ligger i smukke, grønne omgivelser nær Gislinge. Vi er et specialiseret botilbud for voksne med funktionsnedsættelser og komplekse problemstillinger, hvor vi arbejder med struktur, forudsigelighed og faglig omsorg som fundament for trivsel og udvikling.

Hos Sirius Hagesholm tilbyder vi et hjem vores seks beboere, hver beboer har egen lejlighed med gode muligheder for privatliv og ro. Støtten tilrettelægges ud fra den enkeltes behov, forudsætninger og dagsform, så vi sammen kan skabe en tryg, meningsfuld og udviklende hverdag.

Hos Sirius Hagesholm tror vi på, at udvikling sker gennem trivsel. Derfor bygger vores pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige arbejde på nærvær, faglighed og vedholdenhed. Det betyder, at vi er til stede i relationen, arbejder ud fra specialiseret viden og står fast og står sammen, også når opgaverne kræver ekstra tålmodighed og ro.

Din rolle
Som pædagog på Sirius Hagesholm bliver du en central del af beboernes hverdag og udviklingsforløb. Sammen med dine kolleger er du med til at skabe en tryg, forudsigelig og hjemlig hverdag, hvor relationer er omdrejningspunktet for det pædagogiske arbejde.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være at:

  • Støtte og motivere beboerne i deres daglige liv og personlige udvikling.

  • Skabe struktur, ro og tydelighed i hverdagen.

  • Indgå i nære og tillidsfulde relationer med beboerne.

  • Planlægge og deltage i meningsfulde aktiviteter, der styrker trivsel og livskvalitet.

  • Arbejde med individuelle mål og pædagogiske indsatser.

  • Bidrage til dokumentation, statusopfølgning og faglig refleksion.

  • Tage del i både relationelle og praktiske opgaver som en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Du vil fungere som kontaktperson for én eller flere beboere og have ansvar for at følge deres udvikling i tæt samarbejde med kolleger og ledelse.

Om dig
Du er uddannet pædagog eller pædagogisk assistent og har gerne erfaring fra specialområdet, det er dog ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde relationelt og ser trivsel som forudsætningen for udvikling.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på dine personlige og relationelle kompetencer. Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • Arbejder anerkendende, inddragende og respektfuldt i mødet med beboerne.

  • Kan bevare ro, overblik og tydelighed i pressede situationer.

  • Er initiativrig og opsøgende i relationsarbejdet med beboerne.

  • Arbejder reflekteret og selvstændigt med høj faglig integritet.

  • Trives i et miljø, hvor hverdagen ikke altid er forudsigelig.

  • Bidrager aktivt til fællesskabet og ser samarbejde som en forudsætning for kvalitet.

Hvorfor os?
Sirius Hagesholm er en del af Den Socialfaglige Organisation, som er en social ansvarlig og værdidrevet virksomhed, der driver en række specialiserede botilbud, forsorgshjem og kvindekrisecentre.

Vores arbejde bygger på fem stærke kerneværdier: respekt, inddragelse, trivsel, fællesskab og faglighed. Hos os er værdierne ikke blot ord, men noget vi aktivt omsætter i hverdagen – i mødet med beboerne, i samarbejdet med hinanden og i vores faglige tilgang.

Vi tror på, at udvikling sker i trygge rammer, og at relationen er det vigtigste pædagogiske redskab.

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Et fagligt stærkt og engageret team med fokus på samarbejde og refleksion.

  • Supervision, løbende faglig sparring og gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling.

  • Et arbejdsmiljø præget af tillid, respekt og humor.

  • Fokus på trivsel hos både beboere og medarbejdere.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

  • Pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

  • Sociale arrangementer.

Praktisk information
Der er tale om fuldtidsstillinger, som primært indebærer lange vagter, herunder 12-timers vagter og døgnvagter. Der vil også forekomme weekendvagter. Vi planlægger vagter i god tid, så du får en forudsigelig og balanceret arbejdsrytme.

title: Data Center Technician III, Third Party Data Center
description:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
  • Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across teams.
  • Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose somewhat issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and applying the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
  • Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for non-standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) managed in accordance with Google security standards.
  • Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end-of-life via part replacement or maintenance, within one or more teams.
  • Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, on their own.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience with assembly of mechanical or electrical systems, or performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
  • Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware.
  • Experience with networking protocols.
  • Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in server hardware, maintenance/repair and troubleshooting/diagnosing.
  • Advanced networking knowledge, including basic topology and protocol understanding.
  • Advanced level Linux skills, including installation, systems administration and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to communicate in English fluently to engage with clients in the region.

title: Pædagog til Bulderby
description:
Velkommen til Bulderby, vi håber du har lyst til at blive en del af vores fællesskab.

Pædagog til Bulderby.

I Børnehuset Bulderby er børns sansemotoriske udvikling og trivsel vores kerneopgave.
Vil du være med til at skabe de bedste rammer for børnene gennem en struktureret hverdag, hvor leg, sanser og motorik er i fokus, så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

I vores sansemotoriske børnehus ser vi bevægelse og leg som en naturlig vej til udvikling, fællesskab og livsglæde. Hver dag arbejder vi målrettet med at styrke børnenes sanser, motorik, nysgerrighed og selvværd gennem nærværende relationer, inspirerende læringsmiljøer og masser af plads til leg og udfoldelse.

Vi søger en pædagog, der har lyst til at sætte sin faglighed i spil, bidrage med idéer og blive en del af et børnehus, hvor vi udvikler os sammen, hjælper hinanden og har høje faglige ambitioner for os selv og inspirerer hinanden til fortsat udvikling. Om du er erfaren eller nyuddannet pædagog, er ikke afgørende, det vigtigste er, at du kan se dig selv i Bulderby.
Vi venter gerne på dig, hvis du evt. er på vej til at blive færdig uddannet.

Hos os får du ikke blot et job – du får mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel for en masse unikke børn hver eneste dag og blive en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med ledelse tæt på.

Har du lyst til at blive en del af Bulderby? Så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning og CV.
Du er meget velkommen til at komme forbi og se vores dejlige børnehus.

Stillingens timetal er minimum 30 – 37 timer alt efter hvad der giver mening for dig, i dit arbejdsliv.

Vi holder samtaler løbende.

Kontakt.
Leder Ida Maria Høgild
Tlf: 45973920
Mobil:21535599
Mail: idaho@ltk.dk

I Lyngby-Taarbæk bliver du del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med høje ambitioner i en organisation med ca. 4.000 medarbejdere, der alle arbejder med det fælles mål – at skabe værdi for borgere og erhvervsliv. Vi lægger vægt på god ledelse, trivsel, faglige og personlige udviklingsmuligheder, kreativitet og nytænkning samt balance mellem arbejdsliv og fritidsliv. Vi ser mangfoldighed som en ressource og værdsætter, at medarbejdere hver især bidrager med deres særlige baggrund, personlighed og evner.

title: Financial Aid Specialist II
description:
About CT State

Connecticut State Community College (CT State) was launched on July 1, 2023, through the consolidation of Connecticut’s 12 community colleges. With campuses and satellite locations statewide, CT State serves all 169 towns and neighboring states. As the largest community college in New England, CT State is committed to providing high-quality, affordable, and accessible education that supports students’ academic, career, and personal success.

For more information about CT State Community College and the campus please visit Home - CT State

Position Details

Posted: September 16, 2026
Level: Community College Professional 17, 12-month, tenure track position
Employment Type: Standard
Hours: Full-time, 35 hours per week
Anticipated Start Date: December 2026
Work Location: CT State Three Rivers (574 New London Turnpike, Norwich, CT 06360)
Work Modality: On-site; Position is not remote
Closing Date: Open until filled, with priority consideration given to applicants who submit materials by October 14, 2026

Position Summary

The Financial Aid Specialist II assists in the operation of the financial aid programs at the college, while providing guidance to students. The incumbent assists in the management of federal, state, and institutional funding sources, as well as the accurate processing of all financial aid application and student loan materials within a highly automated environment. The Financial Aid Specialist II provides student service in person and utilizing other communication channels to assist with the financial aid process for students and families. A major function of this position is leading collaborative efforts for attracting and retaining students. This position is located on ground at a campus location.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Under the direction of the Campus Supervisor for Financial Aid Services, the Financial Aid Specialist II is responsible for effective performance in these essential duties:

  • Maintains the front counter for all student-facing, in-person activity.
  • Provides excellent service to students, their families, outside agency personnel, and members of the college community.
  • Assists students with the completion of all aspects of the financial aid process, including FAFSA completion, financial literacy, and other associated areas.
  • Counsels and assists prospective and currently enrolled students and their families on the FAFSA application process and eligibility for financial aid, including the facilitation of workshops.
  • Provides information on eligibility requirements, application processes and procedures, status of financial aid application and award, and required additional documentation as needed.
  • Determines if the student’s inquiry requires further follow-up and directs the inquiry to the appropriate source for resolution, as necessary.
  • Responds in a timely manner to student inquiries through a variety of communication techniques.
  • Provides outbound communications to students, as needed.
  • Trains and leads student workers, as needed.

  • Awards and repackages students under the direction of the Campus Supervisor.
  • Resolves C-Flags, Rejects, Verification, and Conflicting Information cases.
  • Reviews student ISIRs for discrepancies in dataload and follows up with students as needed.
  • Responsible for the quality assurance and document linking within the imaging system.
  • Monitors the academic performance of student aid recipients in accordance with Satisfactory Academic Progress regulations, including the enforcement of SAP Appeals and Academic Plans.
  • Maintains current and complete knowledge of federal, state, and institutional financial aid regulations.
  • Reviews and processes student loan requests in accordance with federal law and regulations.
  • Maintains an alpha caseload to ensure necessary documents are received and conflicting information resolved to ensure aid can be disbursed.
  • Runs/creates reports to assist the needs of the campus.
  • Assists in supplying any data needs for campus reporting.
  • Adheres to all office policies and procedures.
  • Interacts favorably with any third-party vendors.
  • Works with grant, loan, and reporting functions within all federal systems, including COD, CPS, and NSLDS, as needed.
  • May participate on campus-based Satisfactory Academic Progress Appeal Committee.
  • May review student files for Professional Judgment requests.
  • Performs other duties and tasks to support the overall success of the division.
  • May involve occasional evening or weekend work.

Additional responsibilities include:

  • Attendance and participation at convocation and commencement ceremonies
  • Service on assigned committees and task forces
  • Attendance and participation at committee, staff, informational and professional meetings which may occur during evenings and weekends.

This posting outlines qualifications, experience, and skills but is not limited to the full specifications in the official job description.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in an appropriately related field together with two (2) or more years of related experience in financial aid in higher education or related field; or a combination of education, training and experience which would lead to the competencies required for successful performance of the position’s essential duties.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • An ability to relate favorably to students, parents, and college staff.
  • Knowledge of state and federal financial aid rules and regulations.
  • Strong organization and analytical skills.
  • The ability to multi-task with complex subject matter in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must possess strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, and ethnic backgrounds, including individuals with disabilities
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using a Student Information System such as Banner (or comparable system).
  • Three (3) or more years of financial aid experience, preferably in a community college setting.
  • Experience using a Student Information System such as Banner (or comparable system).

Salary and Benefits

  • Salary $72,097 approximate annual

CT State offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Generous leave policies
  • Multiple retirement plan options
  • Comprehensive health insurance choices
  • Supplemental benefits for retirement and family protection

For more information, visit: CSCU - Human Resources - Future Employees.

To apply, please submit the following:

In your cover letter, you must clearly address how your experience and skills align with each of the required and preferred qualifications. The cover letter may be entered as text in the application system or uploaded as a single combined file with the resume.

Your resume must include the names of three (3) current professional references, including their titles, email addresses, and telephone numbers.

Important Notes:

  • Links to external resume or profile sites will not be accepted

  • CT State Community College cannot sponsor work visas.

Selection Process

After the closing date, applications will be reviewed by a selection committee. Candidates selected for further consideration will be those who best meet the minimum and preferred qualifications and who submitted all required materials by the deadline.

The selection process may include interviews and practical exercises (e.g., written, technical, or simulation exercises). Finalists will be recommended to the Hiring Manager for final selection.

Background Screening

Employment offers are contingent upon:

Du bliver bindeleddet mellem vores medlemmer, trænere, administration og digitale systemer – og en vigtig del af arbejdet med at få hverdagen i Fysio Camp til at fungere godt.

Det er ikke et klassisk kundeservicejob.

Hos os skal du både være rigtig god til mennesker, kunne bevare overblikket og have lyst til at tage ansvar for de opgaver og udfordringer, der opstår undervejs.

💬 Først og fremmest: Fantastisk service

Når vores medlemmer kontakter Fysio Camp, skal de opleve, at der sidder et menneske i den anden ende, som lytter, tager ansvar og finder en løsning.

Kundeservice bliver en central del af din hverdag, og du kommer blandt andet til at hjælpe medlemmer med:

✅ Tilmelding og booking
✅ Holdskifte og medlemskaber
✅ Betalinger og praktiske spørgsmål
✅ Spørgsmål om vores forløb og træning
✅ Mail- og telefonhenvendelser
✅ Problemer med vores digitale løsninger
✅ At finde den rigtige løsning, når noget ikke går helt som planlagt

Vi tror på, at god kundeservice handler om mere end at besvare en mail.

Det handler om at tage ejerskab for problemet, indtil medlemmet har fået en god løsning.

⚡ En hverdag, hvor du tager fat dér, hvor der er brug for det

Fysio Camp er en organisation i bevægelse, og dagene er ikke altid ens.

Den ene dag sidder du med en kompliceret medlemssag eller forsøger at finde årsagen til et problem i vores system. Den næste skal en masse nyt træningsudstyr organiseres, en træner bliver syg, eller noget helt tredje kræver, at vi hurtigt finder en løsning.

Vi leder derfor efter dig, der ikke er bange for at tage fat, byder dig til og tager ansvar for at få tingene til at lykkes – også når opgaven ikke stod på planen fra morgenstunden.

Som en del af rollen vil du desuden 1–2 eftermiddage om ugen supplere vores teamledere omkring vagttelefon og akut vikardækning. Her er du med til at sikre, at vi finder løsninger, når der eksempelvis opstår sygdom eller ændringer tæt på træningsstart.

Det betyder ikke, at du skal kunne løse alting selv. Men du skal have lyst til at tage ansvar, bevare roen og være med til at finde løsningen.

⚙️ Har du flair for IT og udvikling? Så er det et stort plus

Fysio Camp drives gennem flere digitale systemer, som understøtter alt fra medlemskaber og betalinger til booking, kommunikation og den daglige administration.

Du behøver ikke komme med en særlig IT-uddannelse eller være programmør.

Men du skal have flair for IT, være nysgerrig og have let ved at lære nye systemer.

Hvis du oveni har erfaring med IT, systemudvikling, automatisering eller optimering af administrative arbejdsgange, er det et stort plus.

Når den samme udfordring opstår igen og igen, kan du måske være typen, der begynder at spørge:

Hvorfor opstår den? Kan processen forbedres? Kan noget automatiseres? Kan vores system sættes smartere op?

Afhængigt af dine kompetencer og interesser kan du derfor også blive involveret i:

  • Optimering af vores CRM- og medlemssystem

  • Automatisering af mails, SMS'er og medlemskommunikation

  • Forbedring af booking- og tilmeldingsflows

  • Udvikling af interne arbejdsgange

  • Strukturering og kvalitetssikring af medlemsdata

  • Fejlfinding og problemløsning i vores systemer

  • Opsætning og test af nye digitale funktioner

  • Dokumentation af processer og arbejdsgange

  • Identifikation af manuelle opgaver, som kan automatiseres

🧠 Hvem forestiller vi os, du er?

Din uddannelse er ikke det vigtigste for os.

Det vigtigste er, at du er serviceminded, struktureret, teknisk nysgerrig og god til at få ting til at ske.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

✅ Er rigtig god til mennesker – både på telefon og skrift
✅ Bevarer overblikket, når der er mange henvendelser
✅ Tager ansvar og følger opgaver helt til dørs
✅ Har flair for IT og hurtigt lærer nye systemer
✅ Er nysgerrig på automatisering og smartere arbejdsgange
✅ Kan arbejde struktureret og selvstændigt
✅ Lægger mærke til fejl og uhensigtsmæssige processer
✅ Har lyst til både at løse problemer og forebygge, at de opstår igen
✅ Trives i en virksomhed, hvor tingene udvikler sig hurtigt

Du behøver ikke kende alle vores systemer på forhånd.

Hvis du er typen, der hurtigt finder rundt i nye programmer og synes, det er spændende at finde ud af, hvordan systemerne kan arbejde bedre sammen, skal vi nok lære dig resten.

🚀 Du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på Fysio Camp

Vi leder ikke kun efter en person, der kan overtage en bunke eksisterende opgaver.

Vi leder efter en person, der med tiden kan være med til at forme den måde, vi arbejder med service, drift og teknologi på.

Når Fysio Camp vokser, skal vores administration, systemer og arbejdsgange kunne følge med.

Derfor får du mulighed for både at arbejde hands-on med den daglige drift og samtidig bidrage til at udvikle de løsninger, der gør hverdagen lettere for både vores medlemmer, trænere og administration.

For den rette person er der derfor gode muligheder for at få mere ansvar og større indflydelse, i takt med at både du og Fysio Camp udvikler jer.

📩 Har du lyst til at være med?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV via:

Fortæl os gerne lidt om dig selv, din erfaring med kundeservice, administration eller drift, og hvorfor du tror, at du vil trives i en rolle med mennesker, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor ikke alle dage ser ens ud.

Har du særlige kompetencer eller interesse inden for IT, systemer eller udvikling af arbejdsgange, vil vi også meget gerne høre om dem.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.
