title: Service Coordinator Supervisor
description:
Culinary Depot is a national distributor of foodservice equipment and supplies serving restaurants, institutions, and commercial kitchens. The Service Lead directs the service department and is accountable for the quality, speed, and consistency of the post-sale customer experience.

This role oversees the service coordinators, manages vendor and technician performance, and develops the processes and reporting required to resolve cases efficiently and at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage response and resolution times across all open service cases, with a focus on reducing aging and unresolved cases
  • Establish consistent, proactive customer communication standards and serve as the point of escalation for complex or sensitive cases
  • Hold vendors, technicians, and Authorized Service Agents accountable to agreed service standards and timelines, and strengthen those relationships to accelerate resolutions
  • Monitor vendor performance, warranty claims, and reimbursement
  • Improve tracking and visibility across parts, vendors, technicians, and warranties
  • Develop scalable service processes and identify opportunities to automate workflows and customer status updates
  • Own department reporting and KPIs, including response times, open case volume, vendor delays, and resolution timelines
  • Train, coach, and develop the service coordinators, and establish a departmental culture of urgency, ownership, and accountability

Measures of Success

  • Consistent, reliable service delivery and improved customer satisfaction
  • Measurable reduction in vendor delays and customer escalations
  • Increased automation and reduced manual follow-up
  • A well-organized, accountable service department positioned to scale

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience leading a service, support, or operations team
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with sound judgment under pressure
  • Strong sense of urgency and follow-through across competing priorities
  • Ability to hold vendors accountable while maintaining a professional, empathetic approach with customers, and to develop that capability in others
  • Process-oriented, with a track record of improving operational efficiency
  • Experience in foodservice equipment, warranty and ASA networks, or field service coordination preferred

Compensation and Benefits

Health insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and paid holidays.

title: Analyst
description:
Why You Should Join the E3 Team
When you join the E3 team, you will be working on some of the most important energy issues with some of the top minds in the electricity industry. We help shape energy and climate policy, play vital roles in regulatory proceedings, advise executives, and inform investment and planning selections. At E3, you will be challenged and inspired.
Who We Are
Founded in 1989, Energy + Environmental Economics (E3) is a fast-growing energy consulting firm that helps utilities, regulators, policy makers, developers, and investors make the most educated strategic decisions possible as they implement new public policies, deploy and develop new technologies, and address customers’ shifting expectations. We have offices in San Francisco, New York City, Boston, Denver, and Calgary.
Because E3 works with customers from all sectors of the electricity industry, we provide a 360-degree knowledge of markets, planning, policy, regulation, and environmental factors. Just as important, we are driven to deliver clear, unbiased evaluations that help customers make informed decisions.
E3 works on high-profile, high-impact projects in jurisdictions that spearhead the implementation of clean energy policy. In California, Hawaii, and New York, we are advising state agencies and regulators about how to implement clean energy policies with an emphasis on customer incentives and markets.
About You
We look for people who combine strong analytical dexterity and/or policy experience with integrity with a commitment to the clean energy transition. Our Analysts love to examine, research, and offer creative solutions to some of the most elaborate and important energy issues. We are seeking qualified candidates who bring curiosity, thrive in a rigorous and quantitative solution-finding environment, take a proactive approach to assist the team, and are practiced at clearly presenting information to a variety of stakeholders. Successful applicants will also have proven organizational techniques that help you create and actualize work plans that are efficient while delivering an elevated level of guidance to serve our customers.
The Work
The Analyst is a vital contributor to our team. Any team member may play a significant role in a project, and recent graduates work alongside senior partners. The position conducts research and evaluation to aid the delivery of customer work under the direction of senior-level team members. You will have the opportunity to immediately assist project work to inform customer strategies by contributing to in-house forecasting models, quantifying various market strategies, studying market portfolios and stakeholder needs, benchmarking industry standards, and developing policy and market overviews.
Work Environment
Hybrid and flexible work environment that adapts to changing needs of projects. E3 thrives in a strong collaborative office-based working environment but has also adapted to the safety requirements of our employees. Must be able to work for extended hours in front of a computer screen and conduct meetings on the telephone and virtually.
General
- Hours: Full Time
- Type: Non-Exempt
- Travel: 0-5%
- Office Location: San Francisco, Boston, New York, or Calgary

Typical Responsibilities

  • Assist the delivery of customer work through modeling, developing presentations, writing, and preparing reports and papers, and helping with additional customer requests
  • Conduct research using your ingenuity and curiosity to make reasonable assumptions and produce appropriate solutions, at times with incomplete information. This may include country-level energy market research, delving into standards documents to find specific references or proof points, as well as research on complicated topics such as regulatory proceedings.
  • Translate results of research, reports, and insights into clear visual representations
  • Aid project heads in the creation or editing of spreadsheets to be "client-ready,” including developing tools for stakeholder products
  • Simple modifications to existing tools and models
  • Proactively track actual performance of own work performed against the established plan, with ongoing communication with the Director or Manager
  • Capture project learnings and repeatable products and work samples for future use according to knowledge management processes
  • Assist with internal initiatives as needed

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher with a strong academic record in engineering, economics, computer science, public policy, or related field
  • 0-2 years of prior experience desired specifically addressing energy and climate change issues and/or demonstrated academic related project work
  • Hands-on experience, academic project work, or knowledge base related to Energy Planning and Policy, Transmission, Pricing and Risk, and/or Market Advisory and Valuation.
  • You work collaboratively and assist each member of your team to do their greatest work, aware that each brings different experiences to the table
  • High fluency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
  • Desire to work in a dynamic office environment with other staff

Things that Set You Apart

  • Programming experience in Python
  • You believe it is essential to achieve a transition to a low-carbon economy and love thinking about the future of energy.
  • You enjoy translating technical concepts to a broader audience.
  • You take ownership of your work, actively seeking out answers to questions and enjoy finding creative solutions to issues you encounter.
E3’s Commitment to You
E3 provides abundant opportunities for professional growth and invests significantly in employee development. Right from the start, our team works hard to provide you with a customized multi-week onboarding experience where you will meet with colleagues, Partners, and your own mentor. Every September, all new hires attend E3’s proprietary internally developed 22-course training program which broadens your foundational industry-specific knowledge as well as develops those skills essential to being a great consultant. E3 also provides every employee with an annual professional development stipend, opportunities to attend conferences, and personalized career development at every stage of your employment.
In addition, E3 offers employees a broad, best-in-class range of benefits and supportive perks to support you both personally and professionally. Some benefits include:
- Base and bonus commensurate with experience and performance
- Exceptional benefits such as medical, dental, and vision insurance plans
- 401(k) with corporate match
- Flexible Paid Time Off plus standard company holidays
- Short-term and long-term disability
- Group life insurance
- Health Savings Accounts and Flexible Spending Arrangements
- Fitness and wellness corporate discounts
- Professional Development annual stipend
Hiring Process and Timeline
We take a thoughtful and meticulous approach to recruitment. Finding new team members who are not only highly capable but also a strong fit for our team and culture is very important to us. Qualified candidates can expect a first-round virtual interview, to engage in a live case study and a final panel onsite interview in either our Boston or San Francisco office in mid November.
EEO Non-Discrimination and ADA Reasonable Accommodation Statement
Applicants are considered for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or partnership status, disability, military status, veteran status, pregnancy or predisposing genetic characteristics. Willdan does not discriminate on the basis of physical or mental disability where the essential functions of the job can be reasonably accommodated. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify us.
Willdan Group Inc. participates in E-Verify


Use of AI - Disclaimer

At E3 real people evaluate candidates at every stage of the hiring process. Every application and resume is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team and candidates are evaluated based on their qualifications, experience, and interactions with our team. We do not use AI to screen, record, score, or evaluate candidates at any stage of our recruitment process.

We understand candidates may use AI as a tool when preparing their application, however it should not be used to develop significant portions of your application (e.g. to develop full responses to application questions). Our goal is to get to know you and how you think. For this reason, the use of AI is not permitted during interviews, including using AI to take notes, record or transcribe, or to provide real-time assistance or suggest responses to questions.

title: Vedligeholdelsestekniker Automatiktekniker 4 dags uge - Aarup – Ref. 392
description:
Vores kunde har travlt, og søger nu en automatiktekniker med erfaring fra lignende stillinger, god teknisk indsigt og evnen til selvstændigt at tage ansvar for opgaverne i afdelingen

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Jobbet byder på mange varierede opgaver, hvor dine hovedopgaver blandt andet vil være:

  • Udførelse af reparations- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver i henhold til vores CMMS-system PM5

  • Afvekslende opgaver inden for el, automation, mekanik og produktionsteknik

  • Fejlfinding og reparation af elektriske og mekaniske systemer.

  • Bidrage til løbende optimering og forbedring af produktionsudstyret.

Dine faglige kvalifikationer
Vi forventer, at du

  • Har en el-teknisk, automatikteknisk eller mekanisk baggrund.

  • Har erfaring med service og vedligehold af teknisk udstyr.

  • Har flair for fejlfinding og systematisk problemløsning.

  • Har god teknisk indsigt og procesforståelse.

  • Er engageret i at sikre høj driftssikkerhed og stabil produktion.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

  • Er initiativrig og naturligt går videre til næste opgave, når den foregående er afsluttet.

  • Er effektiv, fleksibel og løsningsorienteret

  • Bidrager positivt til samarbejdet og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Møder kolleger og samarbejdspartnere med respekt, høflighed og imødekommenhed.

  • Er åben over for forandringer og hjælper til, hvor der er behov.

  • Gerne har erfaring fra en lignende stilling.

  • Har epoxykursus, hvilket er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Din nye arbejdsplads tilbyder
Stillingen byder blandt andet på:

  • En stilling i vores tekniske afdeling, som har ansvaret for reparation, vedligehold og optimering af virksomhedens produktionsudstyr.

  • Grundig oplæring og efterfølgende deltagelse i en turnusvagtordning sammen med virksomhedens øvrige serviceteknikere.

  • Et stærkt fagligt miljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger.

  • Et spændende og selvstændigt job med gode muligheder for faglige udfordringer og personlig udvikling.

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø præget af en uformel omgangstone, åbenhed, ærlighed og gensidig tillid.

  • Gode muligheder for efteruddannelse og kompetenceudvikling.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og gældende overenskomst.

  • Arbejdstid mandag til fredag 22.20 – 07.10

  • Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

Om din nye arbejdsplads
Dan-Foam ApS er en del af Tempur Sealy International, Inc., som er verdens største sengeleverandør. Virksomheden producerer og distribuerer madrasser og puder i det anerkendte TEMPUR-materiale, som sælges i mere end 90 lande.
Du bliver en del af en moderne produktionsvirksomhed i udvikling, hvor kvalitet, innovation og medarbejdertrivsel er i højsædet. Arbejdsmiljøet er præget af samarbejde, stabilitet og fokus på både faglig og personlig udvikling.

title: Surveyor-in-Training (S.I.T.)
description:
Sherwood Surveying & S.U.E is seeking a qualified Surveyor-in-Training (S.I.T.) at our Fort Worth, Texas location. This position will be responsible for assisting a RPLS in a variety of surveying services.

Responsibilities

  • Process data collected via Global Positioning System (GPS) technology to obtain necessary results
  • Perform calculations to establish coordinates for survey control and survey measurements
  • Prepare tentative and final tract maps, parcel maps, Record of Survey maps, ALTA maps, corner records, right-of-way maps, and similar documents from a variety of source documents and data
  • Perform field checks, correct, and supplement maps prior to delivery to a client
  • Physical tasks such as pounding stakes, setting monuments, clearing line, etc.
  • Read and understand title commitments, engineering and architectural plans
  • Processes and reviews survey data for completeness and accuracy
  • Maintains close communications with the RPLS to report survey progress, problems with and possible resolution to pertinent issues hampering project survey completion

Qualifications

  • Associates in land surveying or equivalent experience, required
  • B.S. Degree in land surveying is a plus
  • S.I.T. registered in Texas
  • 3 years minimum surveying experience
  • Must be knowledgeable in the methods and techniques of cross-country utility surveying
  • Must have knowledge in Global Positioning Systems (GPS) survey methods, electronic data collection, the processes and computer programs necessary for survey data review and transfer to mapping
  • Physical requirements including walking over uneven terrain and lifting up to 50 lbs.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record required. (NO EXCEPTIONS)

Benefits:

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Employer paid health/dental/vision insurance
  • Employer paid STD/LTD
  • Life Insurance
  • Candidate referral bonus
  • 401k retirement plan with employer match
  • Paid holidays
  • Earned vacation time

title: Tømrer til service og renovering i Køge
description:
Er du tømrer og vil du have firmabil, frihed under ansvar og godt sammenhold?

Vi mangler en tømrer til renovering, service og spjæld i Køge.

Du bliver en del af et tømrerhold på cirka 15 ansatte, hvor hverdagen spænder fra renovering til service og spjæld. Opgaverne ligger især omkring Køge, og afhængigt af opgaven arbejder du både alene, med makker og i sjak. Det er en arbejdsplads hvor frihed under ansvar betyder, at du får plads til at løse tingene ordentligt, men stadig har folk omkring dig.

Rollen passer til dig, der gerne vil have variation uden at hoppe fra kort forløb til kort forløb. Firmabil er en del af pakken, og lønnen ligger på 200-225 kr. i timen. Til gengæld skal du kunne tage fat, møde som aftalt og sige til, hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Det får du

Løn: 200-225 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Køge og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 15 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Renovering, service og spjæld

Din hverdag

På renoveringsopgaver handler dagen om at få styr på rækkefølgen, så arbejdet glider og de næste opgaver kan komme videre. Service og spjæld kræver, at du kan vurdere opgaven, løse det praktiske og melde klart tilbage, når noget ændrer sig. Nogle dage er der mest småting, andre dage står den på mere sammenhængende tømrerarbejde.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Arbejder med renovering og ombygning
  • Løser serviceopgaver og spjæld
  • Monterer vinduer og døre efter mål
  • Udfører tagarbejde og almindeligt tømrerarbejde
  • Hjælper på opgaver hvor der både arbejdes alene, med makker og i sjak

Mottoet her er enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde. Det kræver, at du møder stabilt, tager ansvar for dine aftaler og er ordentlig over for dem, du arbejder sammen med.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring som tømrer
  • Kan arbejde alene, med makker og i sjak
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet både renovering, service og spjæld før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan lide en hverdag, hvor du selv tager ansvar.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en tømrer mere i Køge, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

title: Maintenance Officer (Mechanical)
description:
One Group | One Energy

We are Enerwave, member of HELLENiQ ENERGY and a leader in providing outstanding and innovative energy solutions. We operate with passion, being engaged in heart and mind to what we do, and we pride ourselves on offering our employees a place where they can excel, creating value. We are offering now a set of exciting positions ,across our premises in various locations, covering multiple departments and areas of expertise.

We are offering now an exciting position at our, 421 MW, Natural Gas fired Combined Cycle Power Plant in Thisvi, Boeotia (Biotia).

We are looking for a Maintenance Officer, Mechanical, to join the Maintenance Section of the Power Plant and contribute to its safe, reliable, and efficient operation.

In this role, you will manage mechanical maintenance activities throughout their full lifecycle, from identifying and planning the required work to coordinating resources, supervising execution, accepting the completed work, and returning equipment safely to operation.

You will combine mechanical expertise with maintenance planning, contractor coordination, troubleshooting, contract management, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with Operations, Contractors, Technical Services, and Original Equipment Manufacturers.

What you will do:

  • Identify, define, and plan preventive, predictive, corrective, and project-related mechanical maintenance activities during daily plant operation and planned outages.
  • Ensure the effective implementation of the annual maintenance plan and propose improvements to maintenance scope, frequency, methods, and spare-parts requirements.
  • Plan and secure all resources required for execution, including drawings, manuals, spare parts, materials, contractors, OEM support, and engineering services.
  • Develop and agree on appropriate work methods in collaboration with Contractors, OEMs, Technical Services, Operations, and other stakeholders.
  • Manage the complete maintenance workflow, including work orders, material reservations, permit requests, technical completion, contractor reports, and invoice processing.
  • Coordinate and supervise contractors from work preparation through completion, ensuring compliance with Health, Safety and Environment requirements, agreed schedules, technical specifications, and quality standards.
  • Inspect and formally accept completed work and coordinate the safe return of equipment to Operations.
  • Lead or participate in equipment troubleshooting, independently or with support from Operations, Technical Services, Contractors, Engineering Specialists, and OEMs.
  • Act as owner for assigned maintenance contracts, ensuring that scopes, terms, financial limits, and renewal requirements remain up to date and aligned with plant needs.
  • Coordinate mechanical maintenance activities during daily work and planned outages, managing interfaces between Operations, Contractors, OEMs, and other maintenance disciplines.
  • Maintain accurate equipment histories, maintenance records, technical documentation, and KPIs within the plant’s maintenance management system.
  • Contribute to maintenance budget monitoring, spare-parts optimization, audits, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Participate in the on-call schedule and provide technical and coordination support during plant emergencies when required.

What you will need in order to succeed:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, with Technical Chamber of Greece membership.
  • Relevant experience in an industrial, energy, manufacturing, or process environment will be considered an advantage.
  • Understanding of mechanical engineering principles and enthusiasm for developing expertise in maintenance planning, troubleshooting, contractor coordination, and contract management.
  • Familiarity with preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance practices will be considered an advantage.
  • Ability to understand technical drawings, equipment manuals, operating data, and engineering documentation.
  • Strong planning, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication, teamwork, and stakeholder-coordination skills.
  • Awareness of quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety standards.
  • Very good written and spoken English and strong digital skills.
  • A proactive, safety-focused, and quality-oriented approach, with a willingness to learn, take ownership, and work effectively in a demanding operational environment.

Our offer to you:

  • Competitive salary
  • Bonus scheme💰
  • Ticket restaurant card 💳
  • Company car or transportation reimbursement ⛽
  • Private Health Insurance coverage 🩺
  • Pension Scheme
  • Home electricity and natural gas discount ⚡
  • Continuous learning & upskilling opportunities and access to our premium online training platform 📚
  • One extra day of paid time off
  • Reimbursement for your athletic activities 🥈
  • Unlimited fruits and snacks at the office 🥜

Enerwave S.A. will keep your personal information for a period of 2 years from the submission date, after which we will delete your personal data. Elpedison S.A. has the right to transfer your personal information to third parties to whom it has assigned services, which require the collection and processing of such personal data for candidate evaluation in the process of personnel selection.

For more information regarding the processing of your personal information and exercising your rights, please read the Notice to Candidate Employees.

title: Supervisor- Fulfillment Technicians (TN)
description:
7,000 Diseases - 500 Treatments - 1 Rare Pharmacy

PANTHERx is the nation’s largest rare disease pharmacy, and we put the patient experience at the top of everything that we do.

If you are looking for a career in the healthcare field that embraces authentic dedication to patient care, you don’t need to look beyond PANTHERx. In every line of service, in every position and area of expertise, PANTHERx associates are driven to provide the highest quality outcomes for our patients.

We are seeking team members who:

Are inspired and compassionate problem solvers;

Produce high quality work;

Thrive in the excitement of the ever-challenging environment of modern medicine; and

Are committed to achieving superior health outcomes for people living with rare and devastating diseases.

At PANTHERx, we know our employees are the driving force in what we do. We cultivate talent and encourage growth within PANTHERx so that our associates can continue to explore their interests and expand their careers. Guided by our mission to provide uncompromising quality every day, we continue our strategic growth to further reach those affected by rare diseases.

Join the PANTHERx team, and define your own RxARE future in healthcare!

Supervisor- Fulfillment Technicians

Location: PANTHERx Rare Fulfillment Center; Onsite

Classification: Exempt

Status: Full-Time

Purpose

The Supervisor, Pharmacy Technicians - Fulfillment is responsible for leading the daily operations, performance, compliance, and development of the fulfillment technician team. This role ensures timely, accurate, and compliant prescription fulfillment while optimizing workflow, productivity, quality, and patient experience. The supervisor provides direct leadership to pharmacy technicians, drives operational excellence, supports continuous improvement initiatives, and partners closely with pharmacists, inventory, patient services, and organizational leadership to achieve departmental goals.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the daily operations of the fulfillment technician team, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant prescription processing and medication distribution.
  • Manage workflow, staffing, scheduling, and workload prioritization to achieve service, quality, and productivity goals.
  • Supervise, coach, develop, and evaluate pharmacy technicians, including hiring, onboarding, training (in coordinator with the fulfillment trainer), and performance management.
  • Monitor operational and quality metrics, identify performance trends, and implement solutions to improve efficiency, accuracy, and patient service.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable pharmacy regulations, accreditation standards, company policies, and quality assurance requirements.
  • Serve as a key partner to pharmacists, inventory, patient services, and leadership teams to support seamless fulfillment operations and positive patient outcomes.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives, support operational projects, and drive continuous improvement across fulfillment operations.
  • Investigate operational issues, quality events, and escalations, implementing corrective actions as appropriate.
  • Ensure required licensure, certifications, training, and competency requirements are maintained for all team members.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of three (3) years of pharmacy technician experience.
  • Minimum of one (1) year experience holding leadership responsibility within a team.
  • Prior experience with common MS Office applications (Word, Excel, Teams) and common pharmacy software such as CPR+, CareTend or similar systems.
  • Registration as a pharmacy technician with the Board of Pharmacy in the state of the position, unless holding a current Pharmacist license in that state.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Specialty pharmacy experience.
  • Experience in mail-order or central-fill pharmacy operations.
  • Minimum of one (1) year prior supervisory experience.

Work Environment:

This job operates in a well-lit, mail order distribution pharmacy environment. This role routinely uses standard pharmaceutical equipment, computers and safety supplies.

Physical Demands:

Must be able to stand for extended periods of time, lift up to 30 pounds, and utilize the computer and bar code scanner. Must be able to use proper personal protective equipment including but not limited to gloves, eye protection, and face masks when needed. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, and reach with hands and arms. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential function of the job.

Benefits:

Hybrid, remote and flexible on-site work schedules are available, based on the position. PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy also affords an excellent benefit package, including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, health savings and flexible spending accounts, 401K with employer matching, employer-paid life insurance and short/long term disability coverage, and an Employee Assistance Program! Generous paid time off is also available to all full-time employees, as well as limited paid time off for part-time employees. Of course we offer paid holidays too!

Equal Opportunity:

PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer, and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotions or any term or condition of employment based on race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran's status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Afdelingsleder inden for efter- og videreuddannelse på sundheds- og socialområdet
description:
Vil du arbejde med ledelse af efter- og videreuddannelsesaktiviteter på det social- og sundhedsfaglige område?

Trives du med driftsmæssige og økonomiske såvel som strategiske og uddannelsespolitiske opgaver?

Kan du lide at udvikle uddannelser og kompetenceudvikling i tæt samspil med praksis og i samarbejde med erfarne medarbejdere? Så er det måske hos os, du finder dit kommende job.

Vi søger en afdelingsleder, der har lyst og evne til at være daglig leder for vores to uddannelsesenheder:

  • Den sundhedsfaglige enhed
  • Den socialfaglige enhed

Det er to relativt små enheder med en stor og varieret portefølje.

Vi udbyder en række formelle uddannelser på akademi- og diplomniveau. Derudover tilbyder vi konsulentydelser, workshops, temadage, webinarer m.m. Du skal trives med, at vores forskellige uddannelser og ydelser finder sted under markedslignende vilkår, hvor en tæt kontakt og dialog med aftagere og kunder er helt afgørende.

Om os

Du bliver ansat i den afdeling, der hedder Sundhed, Socialt arbejde og Anvendt Velfærdsforskning, som også omfatter forskningsenheden Anvendt Velfærdsforskning. Afdelingen er en del af Kompetence- og Organisationsudvikling hos UCL Erhvervsakademi og Professionshøjskole (UCL).

Vi samarbejder med blandt andet regioner, kommuner, ministerier, styrelser og institutioner om at udbyde formel efter- og videreuddannelse, samt at tilrettelægge og gennemføre skræddersyede forløb, der kan understøtte organisatorisk forandring og individuel kompetenceudvikling.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med chefen for afdelingen, som har det overordnede faglige, økonomiske og personalemæssige ansvar for afdelingen. Du bliver daglig leder for 11 medarbejdere, hvoraf næsten alle har en professionsuddannelse samt en master-, kandidat- eller ph.d.-grad.

Din profil:

Vi søger en afdelingsleder, der:

  • Forstår, at ledelse handler om at skabe resultater sammen med andre
  • Har interesse for at arbejde med praksisnær kompetenceudvikling i tæt samspil og dialog med aftagere og kunder
  • Har kendskab til det socialfaglige og/eller sundhedsfaglige efter- og videreuddannelsesområde
  • Har lyst til at udvikle afdelingen, arbejdsprocesserne, uddannelserne og uddannelsesformaterne
  • Ser nytten i at forbinde uddannelse, konsulentydelser og forskning
  • Er lyttende, dialogorienteret og involverende og samtidig formår at sætte retning og uddelegere ansvar.

Din rolle som afdelingsleder

Din rolle bliver strategisk og faglig ledelse samt personaleledelse. Du bliver blandt andet ansvarlig for at:

  • Lede driften og udviklingen af afdelingens uddannelses- og konsulentaktiviteter
  • Afdelingens uddannelsesudbud lever op til gældende lovgivning samt nationale og lokale bestemmelser
  • Opretholde et tæt samarbejde med de social- og sundhedsfaglige grunduddannelser på UCL om udvikling og drift af uddannelser og kompetenceudviklingsaktiviteter, der ligger inden for dit ansvarsområde
  • Medarbejdernes opgavesammensætning
  • Bidrage til at skabe et inspirerende og samarbejdsorienteret miljø, der understøtter medarbejdernes faglige udvikling og kompetenceudvikling

Vi kan tilbyde

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på udviklingen af efter- og videreuddannelsesområdet i tæt samarbejde med engagerede medarbejdere og stærke samarbejdspartnere inden for vigtige velfærdsområder
  • Tæt samarbejde med dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere
  • Mulighed for at lede og udvikle to faglige enheder med høj ekspertise og stærke relationer til praksisfeltet
  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder og indflydelse på stillings indhold
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med en uformel og humoristisk stemning
  • Mulighed for at blive en del af en stor uddannelsesinstitution, hvor der er gode rammer for samarbejde på tværs af professioner, uddannelser og forskning

Ansættelsesvilkår

Du bliver ansat den 1. januar 2027. Der er tale om en lederstilling uden højeste arbejdstid.

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til Cirkulære om aftale om ansættelse af chefer ved institutioner indenfor undervisning, uddannelse og forskning på Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriets område samt den relevante faglige organisation.

Du kommer til at referere til chef for Sundhed, Socialt Arbejde og Anvendt Velfærdsforskning, Niels Ejersbo.

Dit primære arbejdssted vil være ved UCL Erhvervsakademi og Professionshøjskole, Niels Bohrs Allé 1, 5230 Odense M, men du skal forvente, at der vil være mødeaktivitet på UCL's øvrige lokationer i Jelling, Vejle, Odense og Svendborg.

Yderligere oplysninger

  • Om UCL
  • UCL's ledelse

Vi holder første samtaler i uge 46 og eventuelt anden samtaler i uge 47.

Hvis du ønsker at vide mere om stillingen inden du søger, er du velkommen til at kontakte chef for Sundhed, Socialt Arbejde og Anvendt Velfærdsforskning, Niels Ejersbo, på mobil 60 11 31 93 eller niej@ucl.dk.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning via ucl.dk/job senest den 27. oktober 2026.

title: Clinicial Intern - Family & Youth Success Program
description:
Internship Overview

DePelchin Children’s Center is dedicated to strengthening the well-being of children and families. Our Family and Youth Success (FAYS) Program offers a clinical internship designed to provide graduate students with meaningful, hands-on experience while developing foundational clinical skills in a supportive learning environment.

Clinical interns maintain a small caseload and provide individual and family therapy services to youth and families. Because the program accepts a limited number of interns, students receive individualized clinical supervision, hands-on learning, and high-quality training in evidence-based practices.

Internship Responsibilities

Clinical interns will:

  • Provide individual and family therapy services under clinical supervision.
  • Maintain a small caseload appropriate to the intern’s level of experience and training.
  • Participate in real-time observation and supervision of therapy sessions.
  • Complete required clinical documentation accurately and timely.
  • Participate in training, supervision, case consultation, and other professional development activities.
  • Apply evidence-based and strengths-based approaches when working with youth and families.
  • Maintain professional, ethical, and confidential practices in accordance with agency and university requirements.

Training & Professional Development

Interns receive training and practical exposure to evidence-based practices, which may include:

  • Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (TF-CBT)
  • Motivational Interviewing (MI)
  • Solution-Focused Brief Therapy (SFBT)
  • Additional clinical modalities and approaches, as applicable

Internship Requirements

  • Unpaid clinical internship
  • Minimum 9-month commitment
  • Availability Monday through Friday during standard business hours
  • Ability to provide services primarily onsite and in person
  • Reliable transportation; interns are responsible for their own transportation
  • Professional liability insurance prior to the internship start date
  • Ability to meet applicable university or academic program internship requirements
  • Commitment to working professionally and compassionately with children, youth, and families

Supervision

Interns receive structured clinical supervision throughout the internship. Therapy sessions may be observed or shadowed in real time by a supervisor to support skill development, provide feedback, and promote high-quality clinical practice.

Pre-Internship & Onboarding Requirements

Selected interns must successfully complete all applicable onboarding requirements prior to beginning the internship, including:

  • Background check and fingerprinting
  • Drug screening
  • In-person orientation
  • Other required agency, program, or university documentation

Why Intern with DePelchin?

The FAYS clinical internship provides an opportunity to gain direct clinical experience while learning from experienced professionals serving children and families. Interns benefit from a structured learning environment, individualized supervision, evidence-based training, and practical experience that supports continued professional and clinical development.

Join DePelchin Children’s Center and gain meaningful clinical experience while helping strengthen children, youth, and families.

DePelchin is Proud to be an Equal Opportunity Workplace.

DePelchin is committed to selecting and employing the best and most qualified person available for each job opening without unlawful discrimination of any kind. Additionally, DePelchin is committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation and gender identity), marital or parental status, veteran status, religion, national origin, age, disability, family medical history, genetic information, or political affiliation.

title: Project Manager
description:
Cuningham is seeking a Project Manager to join our Phoenix office. Project types may vary, but healthcare experience is preferred. We're looking for someone with a diverse project background, strong client relationship skills, and a proven ability to manage budgets, schedules, and multidisciplinary teams. The ideal candidate is responsive, organized, and committed to delivering exceptional project outcomes while contributing to Cuningham's collaborative culture.

At Cuningham, everything comes back to one idea: design a better world with deep respect for the real one people live in. As our next Project Manager, you're the one who turns that into reality on the ground, keeping the people, the details, and the budget all moving in the same direction.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Leading small and mid-size project teams, and keeping everyone focused on what success actually looks like for each project.
  • Helping build strong teams alongside your Project Executive and other project leaders, matching people to the right work and helping them grow.
  • Shaping scope, deliverables, schedules, and fees into solid proposals, working closely with your Project Executive and project leaders.
  • Supporting your design and technical leads as they pull together coordinated packages across multi-discipline, multi-phase projects.
  • Keeping work plans, labor plans, and schedules current, and keeping the team motivated, communicating openly, and flagging issues to your Project Executive before they turn into bigger problems.
  • Owning the project budget and financial performance (tracked in Vantagepoint and other tools), and spotting opportunities for additional services before costs are incurred.
  • Planning and running (or delegating) internal and external meetings and communications.
  • Watching for risk throughout the project and looping in your Project Executive early.
  • Handling day-to-day client relationships, including conversations on budget, schedule, and scope, and supporting project leadership as needed.
  • Administering Owner and Consultant contracts, and keeping responsible oversight of any technical submissions that need your signature and seal.
  • Supporting Sector Leaders with staffing decisions and revenue projections.
  • Jumping into project pursuits, helping prepare and review proposal and interview content.
  • Using tools like MS Office, Bluebeam, AIA Contracts, MS Project (or similar), and Deltek Vantagepoint day to day, and staying comfortable with Revit/BIM 360, Miro, and Microsoft Teams.

What We Look For:

  • 8+ years of project management experience in architecture, engineering, or construction, managing projects from proposal through delivery.
  • Healthcare project experience preferred; open to strong backgrounds in other markets such as hospitality and gaming, themed entertainment, or general architecture and interior design.
  • Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering, construction management, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Professional licensure (architect or PE) or NCARB registration is required; PMP certification also welcome but not required.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, scope, and contracts across multi-discipline teams.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills and comfort leading conversations on scope, schedule, and budget.
  • Proficiency with MS Office, Bluebeam, AIA Contracts, and MS Project (or similar); working knowledge of Deltek Vantagepoint.
  • Familiarity with Revit/BIM 360 and digital collaboration tools such as Miro and Microsoft Teams.
  • A collaborative, team-first mindset and genuine curiosity about doing good work.

Why Cuningham?

At Cuningham, we believe the best work happens when people are supported, challenged, and connected. Whether collaborating across teams, engaging with our communities, or shaping meaningful design solutions, we bring pragmatic creativity and disciplined execution to every project — and we support each other through it all.

We nurture an equitable work environment where curiosity is celebrated, craft is valued, and growth is prioritized. Alongside a team that brings low-ego expertise and active leadership day-to-day, you’ll work on complex, high-stakes projects that demand bold thinking and disciplined delivery.

title: SAP Basis Team Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP Basis Team Lead based in Mexico.

This role leads the technical administration and operational governance of a complex, global SAP landscape.
You’ll be responsible for keeping SAP environments secure, reliable, scalable, and ready to support critical business operations.
The position spans SAP S/4HANA Cloud, BTP, Cloud Identity Services, Commerce Cloud, Cloud ALM, and related enterprise applications.
You’ll work closely with cybersecurity, infrastructure, architecture, application, and business teams to deliver resilient platform services.
The role also provides technical leadership across integrations, identity, monitoring, releases, transformations, and production operations.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the SAP Basis function, including internal team members, contractors, and service providers, with responsibility for technical operations, governance, priorities, and support.

  • Oversee administration and operational support for SAP S/4HANA Cloud, SAP BTP, SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Signavio, SAP GRC, and related SAP technologies.

  • Coordinate cloud tenant provisioning, system refreshes, maintenance activities, release schedules, patching, upgrades, and operational readiness with SAP and external service providers.

  • Establish and govern SAP transport, release, and change management processes, including sequencing, deployment controls, cutover planning, and production release support.

  • Oversee SAP integrations and connectivity, including APIs, middleware, certificates, RFC, OData, REST, SOAP, IDoc interfaces, and troubleshooting across SAP and non-SAP environments.

  • Lead monitoring and operational readiness using SAP Cloud ALM and related tools, covering job and interface monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis.

  • Support SAP Commerce Cloud technical operations, including environment management, deployments, configuration coordination, monitoring, integrations, and release readiness.

  • Provide technical leadership throughout SAP implementation and transformation initiatives, including environment preparation, testing, data migration support, cutover execution, and hypercare.

  • Collaborate with infrastructure, networking, security, applications, and business teams to design and operate secure and scalable SAP platform services.

  • Manage work delivered by internal resources, implementation partners, and managed service providers, including priorities, deliverables, service levels, and escalations.

  • Develop and maintain technical standards, operational procedures, runbooks, support models, and knowledge-transfer documentation.

  • When assigned, support IT engineering and service delivery for manufacturing locations, helping maintain reliable connectivity, data flows, and technology services during organizational transitions.

  • Participate in designing and implementing technology solutions that support manufacturing operations, supply chain processes, enterprise systems, and broader digital transformation initiatives.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

    • 8+ years of experience in SAP Basis, SAP technical administration, or SAP platform operations within enterprise environments.

    • 3+ years of experience in team leadership, technical leadership, or workstream leadership.

    • Hands-on experience supporting SAP S/4HANA; experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition or RISE with SAP is preferred.

    • Strong understanding of SAP system landscapes, client and tenant management, transport management, release coordination, and production support.

    • Experience with SAP cloud technologies such as BTP, Cloud ALM, Cloud Identity Services, Signavio, GRC, Business AI, and Commerce Cloud is preferred.

    • Experience integrating SAP environments with Microsoft Entra ID, SSO solutions, identity provisioning, and enterprise IAM platforms.

    • Strong knowledge of SAP security concepts, technical users, authorization dependencies, certificates, connectivity, and segregation-of-duties considerations.

    • Experience supporting SAP integrations through middleware, APIs, RFC, OData, REST, SOAP, IDocs, and related connectivity technologies.

    • Experience with SAP monitoring, job scheduling, interface monitoring, incident management, root-cause analysis, and performance troubleshooting.

    • Familiarity with cloud operations, managed services, vendor governance, and coordination with SAP support organizations.

    • Experience with large-scale ERP transformations, acquisitions, carve-outs, or transition service agreement exits is advantageous.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate independently in complex, fast-paced environments.

    • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and guide cross-functional teams involving business leaders, IT professionals, implementation partners, and vendors.

    • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to translate technical risks, issues, and decisions into clear business outcomes.

    • Ability to support global operations, including occasional travel to U.S. locations and international manufacturing facilities.

    • Flexibility to work additional hours when required by project timelines, global coordination, SAP maintenance windows, production incidents, or go-live activities.

title: Pen Rider - Friona, TX
description:
Friona Industries Pen Rider’s priority is to ensure and maintain the health and welfare of the cattle in the feedyard. An effective Pen Rider serves as the first line of detection and communication regarding the health and welfare of the entire feedyard. A Pen Rider will work closely with all feedyard departments both as an individual and as a member of a team to establish the highest quality care and maintenance of the feedyard to ensure the welfare of livestock while contributing to the overall success of the feedyard team.

Roles and Tasks
• Adhere to Beef Quality Assurance standards and procedures
• Observe livestock daily to recognize and report sick cattle and various feedyard problems
• Immediately report any unusual or excessive sickness to the cattle manager
• Inspect water and watering system every time a pen is entered and report any issues or maintenance necessary to the Cattle Manager
• Segregate and remove sick cattle from pens and transfer them to hospital area containment
• Place all stray cattle in proper pens and be constantly alert for cattle requiring additional attention
• Assists in shipment and movement of cattle by opening gates, driving cattle to required areas for weighing and counting, and handling strays
• Care and maintenance of horses, tack, and facilities
• Sort and return hospital cattle back to pens as required
• Rides and handles horses safely with awareness of surroundings and potential harmful situations
• Observe and record all stiff and prolapsed cattle and pull if necessary
• Continual observance and adherence of all safety policies and procedures
• Promote, support, and participate in all company policies, procedures and programs

Specific Knowledge:
• Basic Knowledge of livestock health and habits
• Knowledge of fundamental animal health programs
• Understand and apply human handling policies and procedure of cattle and horse livestock
• Understand the consulting veterinarian’s requirements regarding cattle to be pulled
• Experienced in safe horse riding, handling, and maintenance

Special Conditions / Requirements:
• Physical Requirements Include: standing, walking, lifting, bending, kneeling, shoveling, working equipment, and handling livestock, mounting, dismounting and riding
• Considerable exposure to weather such as: rain, sleet, snow, hail, heat, cold, wind, and dust
• Daily close proximity to livestock
• Occasional physical exertion during administration of medical attention

title: Senior Typescript (Node/React) Developer (BRL 18-24K/month CLT + benefits + bonus)
description:
With modern, cloud-native technologies (including Typescript, AWS, GraphQL) and the freedom to approach problems with fresh thinking, you’ll be building greenfield systems from the ground up. Expect to embed AI, automation, and best-in-class engineering practices into everything you develop.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the Design & Development - Architect, build, and deploy scalable, high-performance software solutions, covering both client-side and server-side applications.

  • Full Stack Development - Build any necessary user-interfaces in collaboration with our UX team, and develop well-functioning APIs, and services.
  • Mentorship & Coaching - Support and mentor engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure - Deploy and manage applications on AWS using Terraform, Kubernetes, and containerized workloads.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Tech stack - We use TypeScript (Node.js & React), AWS (EKS, Lambda, Aurora RDS), Kubernetes, GraphQL, Kafka, Mongo. You’re comfortable with all of these, and have extensive knowledge of JavaScript more generally, the AWS ecosystem, and running containerised applications.
  • Past Experience - You are currently a Lead Engineer or Tech Lead, leading a small team of software engineers.
  • API & Database Development - You have experience building and running robust, always-on APIs (both RESTful and GraphQL-based) and underlying services/apps including the databases that underpin them.
  • Test-Driven Development - You're very familiar with testing frameworks such as Jest and Pact.
  • Cloud & DevOps - You can build, deploy and run your systems end-to-end, with no manual configuration or intervention. We use Terraform and Helm.
  • CI/CD - You have plenty experience managing and configuring CI/CD pipelines (we use GitHub Actions) for deployments.
  • Observability Mindset - You believe in measuring everything. You’ve worked with DataDog (or similar) to ensure your team has the necessary visibility into system health.
  • Tooling & Collaboration - Comfortable working with Git, Confluence, Jira, and modern engineering workflows.
  • Mentorship & Leadership - You’ve mentored engineers at all levels, providing guidance, reviewing designs, and ensuring your team stays on the right track.
  • Self-Starter & Problem-Solver - Ability to take a product challenge and develop a working technical solution, balancing pragmatism with engineering excellence.

title: IT Analyst
description:
Company Overview

Nulogy is a manufacturing technology company driven by a vision to make life better for the people who plan, produce, and deliver the products we use every day.

Nulogy’s Manufacturing Operating System helps manufacturers and packagers automate every stage of the production process—from inventory to quality—which reduces operating costs, increases efficiency, and boosts customer satisfaction. Hundreds of manufacturing sites around the world are powered by Nulogy, and our software also runs in the networks of world-leading brands such as Colgate-Palmolive, L’Oréal, and Procter & Gamble.

Nulogy has grown rapidly over the last decade, and we are proud to be recognized with several awards including Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers, Food Logistics Top 100 Software Provider, and Canada's Most Admired Corporate Culture. Nulogy has also received multiple awards for company culture, the most recent being one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for 2024, Great Place to Work 2025 & Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2025.

By joining Nulogy, you’ll become part of a fantastic culture of capable and motivated individuals. You’ll also join a team that is solving challenging problems every day with the potential to make a global impact.

We're looking for an IT Analyst to join our Information Security team, based out of our Belfast office. This is a great opportunity for someone with a couple of years of IT experience (new grads are also welcome to apply) who wants hands-on experience across access management, equipment lifecycle management, and foundational security operations. You'll be a key part of keeping our systems secure, our employees equipped, and our access controls tight, while working closely with our Security Analyst to build a strong security skill set.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based out of our Belfast office. You'll work with both in-office and distributed colleagues, so clear written communication and reliable self-management are important.

What You’ll do

Access Management

  • Provision and deprovision user accounts and access across core systems (e.g., Google Workspace, Slack, identity management platforms such as Okta, and internal applications)
  • Process access requests following least-privilege and approval workflows
  • Perform periodic access reviews and audits to ensure permissions stay accurate and up to date
  • Maintain accurate documentation of who has access to what, and why
  • Support onboarding and offboarding checklists related to system and account access

Equipment & Inventory Management

  • Maintain an accurate inventory of company hardware (laptops, tablets, mobile devices)
  • Image, configure, and ship equipment for new hires; manage returns and reallocation for departures
  • Track asset assignments, warranty status, and lifecycle (procurement through retirement/disposal)
  • Troubleshoot basic hardware and software issues and coordinate repairs or replacements
  • Manage relationships with equipment vendors and shipping logistics as needed
Security Support (Backup to Security Analyst)
  • Act as backup support for routine security tasks when the Security Analyst is unavailable
  • Assist with monitoring security alerts and escalating issues appropriately
  • Help maintain security tooling configurations (e.g., endpoint protection, MDM policies)
  • Support basic security hygiene tasks: patch management tracking, MFA enforcement checks, password policy compliance
  • Help document security procedures and contribute to incident response support when needed
  • Participate in security awareness efforts (e.g., phishing simulation follow-up, employee reminders)
General IT Support
  • Respond to and resolve IT helpdesk tickets in a timely manner
  • Maintain internal documentation and knowledge base articles
  • Identify opportunities to automate or streamline repetitive access and inventory tasks
  • Support security audits, compliance initiatives, risk assessments, and remediation activities.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of professional IT experience preferred (strong new grads also encouraged to apply)
  • Experience supporting Windows, macOS, and cloud-first environments.
  • Strong experience administering Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and related SaaS platforms.
  • Experience with identity and access management, endpoint management, device compliance, and security best practices.

title: Mobil IT-servicetekniker Anstalten Halmstad
company: IT-avdelningen, Enheten för IT servicecenter, Sektionen för IT serviceteam
description:
Om Kriminalvården

Kriminalvården växer – vi bygger nytt, bygger om och bygger till och söker nu fler medarbetare. Vårt viktigaste mål är att minska återfall i brott – att bryta den onda cirkeln. Lyckas vi med det blir samhället tryggare och säkrare för alla. Vi är den myndighet som ansvarar för anstalter, frivård, häkten och klienttransporter.

Vill du vara med och bidra till ett tryggare samhälle? Vår IT-avdelning genomför en stor satsning med fokus på en digital Kriminalvård. Tillsammans jobbar vi för att skapa förutsättningar och lösningar som gör skillnad i vår verksamhet. IT-avdelningen är under stark tillväxt. Vi söker dig som har ett stort IT-intresse, kunskaper och erfarenheter som kan berika vår digitaliseringsresa och som vill vara med och göra skillnad i samhället inom just din profession.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vi söker dig som vill vara med och bidra till att öka IT-avdelningens lokala stöd ute i kärnverksamheten och som brinner för att hjälpa och utbilda andra människor med digitala hjälpmedel. Du har ett stort intresse av att förstå medarbetarnas behov och krav.

Din serviceroll kommer att utgöra ett viktigt gränssnitt mellan IT-avdelningen och kärnverksamheten. Du kommer vara med om en fortsatt unik satsning för Kriminalvården som innebär att forma en ny typ av lokalt IT-stöd för kärnverksamheten.

Du kommer att vara placerad på IT-avdelningen under Enheten för IT Servicecenter och spendera mycket tid ute i kärnverksamheten i klientnära arbete. I ditt geografiska upptagningsområde kommer du att utföra IT-Serviceärenden i vår kärnverksamhet, anstalt, häkte och frivård. Vår verksamhet bedrivs på olika platser i landet, vilket innebär resor inom ditt regionala område i stor utsträckning, även övernattning förekommer i mindre utsträckning. Kriminalvården tillhandahåller poolbilar för dessa tjänster som används under arbetstid.

I din serviceroll kommer du på ett kreativt sätt bidra till ökad digital mognad i verksamheten genom att t.ex. agera rådgivande, guida och stötta personal gällande IT-avdelningens tjänster, och bidra till att utveckla det lokala IT-säkerhetsarbetet. Du kommer även stödja verksamheten med IT-serviceärenden, stötta IT-supporten med problemlösning, medverka till tjänsteutveckling genom att löpande inhämta förbättringsförslag och synpunkter på IT:s tjänster och applikationer och hjälpa IT-avdelningen med specifika uppdrag, t.ex. implementeringar och livscykelhantering av hårdvara.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad och lojal, med förmåga att arbeta både självgående och strukturerat. Du har en pedagogisk insikt som gör att du kan anpassa din kommunikation efter mottagaren och du bidrar konstruktivt till gruppens samarbete.

För att trivas och lyckas i ditt uppdrag är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen och tron på att människan är utvecklingsbar. Du är även medveten om och har förståelse för hur bakgrund, kultur och grupptillhörighet påverkar dig själv och andra. Vidare förväntas du med ditt förhållningssätt bidra till att alla blir likvärdigt bemötta. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vi söker dig som har:

• Fullständig gymnasiekompetens i form av slutbetyg eller gymnasieexamen

alternativt annan utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet som Kriminalvården bedömer som relevant

• Erfarenhet av service med inriktning mot IT eller teknik

• Erfarenhet av arbete i Kriminalvårdens kärnverksamhet

• Förmåga att uttrycka sig väl i tal och skrift på svenska

• B-körkort

Det är även meriterande med:

• Utbildning med inriktning mot IT

• Erfarenhet av support till slutanvändare

• Erfarenhet av arbete som on-site tekniker eller liknande

• Kunskap och förståelse av tjänstehantering och dess support

• Kunskap om hårdvara gällande PC, tunna terminaler, bärbara datorer, skrivare, videoutrustning

• Förståelse för komplexiteten med att arbeta i större organisationer

Övrigt

Kriminalvården har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet och ersatt det med urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Svaren i urvalsfrågorna och CV ligger till grund för om du är kvalificerad att gå vidare i processen.

För att bli aktuell för anställning inom Kriminalvården krävs att du motsvarar högt ställda krav gällande lämplighet, omdöme, säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetande och att du följer gällande lagar. Det innebär att du står upp för demokratiska värderingar och den statliga värdegrund som gäller för Kriminalvårdens verksamhet.

Vissa befattningar är placerade i säkerhetsklass och då kommer en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas. För vissa säkerhetsklassade tjänster krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Kriminalvården välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Läs mer om säkerhetsprövning här: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/sakerhetsprovning-vid-rekrytering/

Befattningen kan innebära krigsplacering vid Kriminalvården. Läs mer om krigsplacering här: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/krigsplacering/

Individuell lönesättning tillämpas.

Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.

Kriminalvården strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ökad mångfald.

För att skicka in din ansökan, klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen. Frågor om hur du ansöker och lägger in ditt CV ställer du direkt till Varbi. Frågor om specifika jobb besvaras av den kontaktperson som anges i annonsen.

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av rekryteringsannonser. Kriminalvården har upphandlade avtal.

title: Senior Benefit Specialist - GA - On Site
description:
About Us

Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer SolutionΓÇ¥ headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visiting .

Position Summary

The Senior Benefits Specialist supports the oversight and administration of compliance functions related to the company's PEO Master Benefit Plans. This role serves as a key subject matter resource for internal teams — including Benefits Administration and other departments that engage directly with clients — on complex regulatory and compliance matters, including the Affordable Care Act (ACA), Form 5500 filings, Medicare Part D Creditable Coverage reporting, state-level filings such as Massachusetts HIRD, ERISA, and other federal and state benefit compliance requirements. This position is not clientfacing and does not handle direct client phone calls; instead, it provides research, guidance, and documentation support to the teams that speak with clients on these topics. The Senior Compliance Specialist brings a positive, energetic, and collaborative approach to their work, along with a genuine passion for compliance excellence and helping internal partners deliver accurate, confident guidance to clients.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Monitor and ensure ongoing compliance with the Affordable Care Act (ACA), including employer shared responsibility provisions and annual 1094-C/1095-C reporting, for the company's PEO Master Plans.
  • Prepare, review, and file Form 5500 annual reports for master benefit plans, coordinating with third-party administrators, auditors, and internal stakeholders as needed.
  • Track and interpret federal and state benefit compliance requirements, including ERISA, COBRA, and HIPAA, and communicate necessary plan or process updates to relevant teams.
  • Complete Medicare Part D Creditable Coverage disclosures and related CMS reporting requirements.
  • Manage state-specific compliance filings, including Massachusetts HIRD (Health Insurance Responsibility Disclosure) reporting and similar requirements in other applicable jurisdictions.
  • Serve as the primary compliance subject matter expert supporting Benefits Administration and other departments that communicate directly with clients on compliance-related topics.
  • Research and respond to internal escalations involving complex compliance questions, providing guidance and documentation to client-facing teams rather than handling client calls directly.
  • Assist with developing, maintaining, and updating compliance-related documentation, including SOPs, FAQs, compliance calendars, and process guides. • Train and mentor team members on compliance requirements, processes, and best practices to support consistency and audit readiness.
  • Participate in special projects and initiatives related to benefits compliance as assigned by leadership, contributing subject matter expertise and operational support.
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting PEO Master Plans and proactively communicate potential impacts to leadership and relevant departments.
  • Liaise directly with insurance carriers, vendors, and legal counsel to resolve plan-specific compliance questions and support issue resolution.
  • Perform periodic audits of benefit plan compliance data and documentation to identify and correct discrepancies.
  • Generate compliance-related reports from Prism and respond to internal or external audit requests.
  • Support open enrollment and plan renewal processes by reviewing plan documents, Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs), and amendments for compliance accuracy.
  • Regular, on-site attendance is an essential job function due to the need for secure access to systems, collaboration on sensitive compliance matters, participation in operational meetings, and hands-on involvement in activities that cannot be performed remotely without compromising security, efficiency, or effectiveness.

Marginal Functions

  • Build, maintain, and promote relationships with team members, peers across disciplines, and other company team members, ensuring effective coordination of communications and services affecting clients and internal partners.
  • Attend webinars and training sessions to stay current on regulatory changes and best practices related to benefits compliance.
  • Perform additional duties and special projects assigned in support of the Benefits function.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong working knowledge of ACA, ERISA, HIRD, Medicare Part D, and Form 5500 filing requirements.
  • Analytical and regulatory research skills, with the ability to translate complex requirements into practical guidance.
  • A positive, energetic, and collaborative style that brings genuine passion and enthusiasm to compliance work and cross-team partnerships.
  • Ability to communicate complex compliance information clearly and professionally through polished written materials and effective internal presentations.
  • Customer-service mindset in a non-client-facing capacity, supporting internal teams who serve clients directly.
  • Management Skills, Organizational Skills, Teamwork, Enthusiasm, Willingness to Learn, Flexibility, Proactive, Decisive.

Required Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of 2-4 years of benefits compliance experience (e.g., ACA reporting, Form 5500 filings, ERISA, or related regulatory work), skills, education (including other relevant non-traditional degree programs, certifications, or job training programs) preferred.

Physical, Mental, & Communication Demands

Physical Demands:

  • Sedentary Work: Occasionally involves sitting for extended periods, often at a desk or computer.
  • Manual Dexterity: Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment.
  • Mobility: Occasionally walking or traversing throughout the office to meet with leaders and other employees.
  • Visual Acuity: Ability to read and analyze data on a computer screen (or to read and analyze data with reasonable accommodation) and in printed materials.
  • Lifting & Carrying: Minimal physical lifting required, but may involve handling documents and lifting light office supplies.

Mental Demands:

  • Strategic Thinking: Applies strong analytical and regulatory knowledge to support the development, evaluation, and improvement of benefits compliance processes, ensuring alignment with organizational needs and legal requirements.
  • Decision Making: Makes well-informed decisions by analyzing compliance data, regulatory requirements, and filing deadlines to support accurate and timely plan administration.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintains a high level of accuracy when interpreting regulations, processing compliance filings, and preparing reports.
  • Problem-Solving: Proactively identifies and resolves compliance-related issues, ensuring accurate plan administration and support for internal partners.
  • Multitasking: Manages multiple compliance filings, deadlines, and projects simultaneously, often under tight regulatory timelines.
  • Stress Management: Ability to handle high-pressure, deadline-driven situations calmly and effectively, especially around regulatory filing periods.

Communication Demands:

  • Interpersonal Skills: Strong ability to build relationships and communicate effectively with internal teams, managers, and external vendors, bringing a positive and collaborative energy to every interaction.
  • Cultural Sensitivity: Communicate with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds, demonstrating cultural awareness and sensitivity.
  • Written Communication: Prepare clear, accurate, and concise compliance documentation, including emails, filings, and notes.
  • Verbal Communication: Provide clear guidance and support to Benefits Administration and other internal teams; this role is not client-facing on phone calls but regularly communicates with internal partners who are.
  • Presentation Skills: Effectively presents compliance requirements, regulatory updates, and analytical findings to internal teams, HR partners, and organizational leadership in a clear and professional manner.

Environmental Conditions

This position is performed in a professional office environment and requires regular use of computers and standard office equipment. The work setting is climate-controlled with typical office lighting and low to moderate noise levels. The role involves extended periods of screen time, in-person collaboration and meetings, and minimal exposure to physical hazards.

Disclaimer

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee filling this position. Employee will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by management. Management has the right to add to, revise, or delete information in this job description. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an "at will " employment relationship.

This position is eligible for the following benefits:

  • Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Retirement Plan: 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Time Off: PTO, Holidays, Parental leave and Sick Leave provided as required by applicable state law
  • Other Benefits: Life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, employee assistance program (EAP), flexible spending account (FSA), health savings account (HSA), Identity theft protection, critical illness, accident, cancer, hospital protection, legal and pet insurance.

  • No matter what size your business is, VensureHR offers comprehensive HR and technology services such as payroll, employee benefits, compliance, and recruiting.

title: Senior Interim Ekonomichef  Malmö
description:
Vi söker en senior och verksamhetsnära ekonomichef för ett interimsuppdrag hos ett bolag i Malmö. Uppdraget passar dig som har en bred bakgrund inom ekonomi och som är trygg i både accounting och business controlling.

Om uppdraget


I rollen får du en central position inom ekonomifunktionen och arbetar nära såväl verksamheten som ledningen. Du förväntas snabbt kunna sätta dig in i verksamheten och bidra både operativt och analytiskt.

Rollen är bred och omfattar såväl redovisningsrelaterade frågor som affärsnära controlling, analys och uppföljning.

Dina ansvarsområden kan bland annat innefatta:

  • Redovisning, bokslut och finansiell rapportering

  • Business controlling och verksamhetsuppföljning

  • Budget- och prognosarbete

  • Analys av resultat, avvikelser och nyckeltal

  • Framtagande av finansiella beslutsunderlag till ledning och verksamhet

  • Utveckling och effektivisering av ekonomiprocesser och rutiner

  • Nära samarbete med verksamheten i ekonomiska och kommersiella frågor

Vem söker vi?


Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet inom finance och som har arbetat brett med både redovisning och business controlling.

Du är trygg i siffrorna och har samtidigt ett tydligt affärsperspektiv. Du kan gå från detaljer i redovisning och rapportering till analys, uppföljning och dialog med verksamheten.

Som person är du självgående, analytisk, strukturerad och prestigelös. Du är van vid att komma in i nya organisationer, snabbt skapa dig en förståelse för verksamheten och identifiera var du kan bidra.

Du har sannolikt tidigare arbetat som exempelvis Finance Manager, Ekonomichef, Head of Financial or/end Business Controller eller i en liknande bred senior financeroll.

Placering: Malmö

Omfattning: Heltid

Anställningsform: Interim/konsultuppdrag

Start: Snarast eller enligt överenskommelse

Är du tillgänglig för ett nytt interimsuppdrag och känner igen dig i profilen? Välkommen att höra av dig för mer information om uppdraget.
