title: Lector Cybersecurity
description:
Als Lector Cybersecurity binnen het Linux- en Cloud-domein word jij een spilfiguur op onze hoogtechnologische Campus Brugge. In deze voltijdse rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opleiden van de cybersecurity-specialisten van morgen, waarbij je de brug slaat tussen open-source fundamenten en geavanceerde cloud-architecturen. Je brengt complexe theorieën tot leven door middel van interactieve presentaties en live demo's, om de studenten vervolgens te begeleiden in onze praktijkgerichte labo’s. Jouw expertise focust zich op Linux-systeembeheer en robuuste security-architectuur. Je leert studenten hoe ze infrastructuren niet alleen bouwen, maar ook fundamenteel harden en beveiligen. Hierbij navigeer je vlot tussen on-premise virtualisatie via Proxmox VE en moderne publieke multi-cloud platformen zoals AWS en GCP. Daarnaast dompel je de studenten onder in de wereld van containerisatie met Docker en Kubernetes, en leer je hen omgevingen schaalbaar en veilig automatiseren via Infrastructure as Code-tools zoals Ansible en Terraform. We zoeken voor deze functie bij voorkeur een professional die al wat stappen in het werkveld heeft gezet, al sluiten we de deuren zeker niet voor beloftevolle juniors met een uitzonderlijk sterke Linux-basis en de juiste drive. Aanvullende kennis van Linux-forensics of malware-analyse is een mooie troef, maar de absolute prioriteit ligt bij jouw passie om systeem- en cloudbeveiliging op een inspirerende manier over te dragen.

Vereist diploma en kennis:

Diploma bachelor of master

Je bezit goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

C1 attest Engels of bereid om dit te behalen

Indien je over een buitenlands diploma beschikt, met uitzondering van Nederland, dient een gelijkwaardigheidsattest van NARIC (www.naric.be) toegevoegd te worden.


Howest competentieprofiel:

Je neemt je professionele rol op een geëngageerde wijze op.

Je bent openminded.

Je bent een teamplayer.

Je speelt adequaat en wendbaar in op verandering en innovatie.

Je bent overtuigd van het belang van maatschappelijk engagement.

Je bent een brede netwerker en je brengt je professioneel netwerk binnen Howest.

Je bouwt mee verder aan de internationale dimensie van Howest.

Je hebt een attitude van levenslang leren.

Functiespecifiek competentieprofiel:

Je verzorgt presentaties en demo's over Linux-systeembeheer, virtualisatie en security-architectuur.

Je coacht studenten bij het bouwen, harden en beveiligen van private en publieke cloud-omgevingen.

Je brengt studenten de knepen van het vak bij rond containerisatie (Docker, Kubernetes) en Infrastructure as Code (Ansible, Terraform).

Je slaat de brug tussen on-premise virtualisatie (Proxmox VE) en publieke multi-cloud platformen (AWS en GCP).

Je volgt de trends in cloud security op de voet en implementeert deze in het curriculum.

title: Orthodontic Assistant
description:

title: 2027 Meetings & Events Summer Internship Program
description:
The work we do has an impact on millions of lives, and you can be a part of it.
We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.

Are you passionate about creating exceptional experiences and making people feel welcome? Protective is seeking a highly motivated and service-oriented Meeting & Events Summer 2027 Intern to join our team. This internship is ideal for someone who has a heart for hospitality, enjoys building relationships, and is eager to learn the ins and outs of corporate event planning. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, ambitious, adaptable, and excited to gain hands-on experience coordinating events from initial planning through on-site execution while working with professionals across the organization.

Location: Corporate Office in Birmingham, AL.

Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors while maintaining strong professional relationships and ensuring a high level of customer service throughout the planning process. Gain hands-on experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, utilizing event planning software and business systems, and contributing to the successful delivery of engaging and memorable events.

Topics may include resume building, interview techniques, leadership development, and industry-specific knowledge. These sessions aim to prepare interns for successful careers post-graduation.

Additionally, interns will collaborate with peers from different departments, fostering a sense of community and shared learning.

title: Instructor of History
description:
About CT State

Connecticut State Community College (CT State) was launched on July 1, 2023, through the consolidation of Connecticut’s 12 community colleges. With campuses and satellite locations statewide, CT State serves all 169 towns and neighboring states. As the largest community college in New England, CT State is committed to providing high-quality, affordable, and accessible education that supports students’ academic, career, and personal success.

For more information about CT State Community College and the campus please visit Home - CT State

Position Details

Posted: September 16, 2026
Level: Instructor
Employment Type: Standard, tenure track position
Hours: Full-time, 10-month (30 credit hours per academic year)
Anticipated Start Date: Spring 2027 Semester
Work Location: CT State Quinebaug Valley (742 Upper Maple Street, Danielson, CT 06239)
Work Modality: On site; Position is not remote
Closing Date: Applications must be submitted by 5:00pm (EST) on Wednesday, October 14, 2026.

Position Summary

All Teaching Faculty members shall: Prepare and teach college-approved courses in accordance with approved course descriptions and class schedules, including developing syllabi and reading lists and keeping each course taught complete and up to date; respond to and work with multiple constituencies, including students, peers (faculty and staff), and external agencies (business, community, educational, etc.); perform divisional departmental responsibilities in the selection of texts and related teaching resources; and other teaching and related duties as outlined on the Collective Bargaining Agreement.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Under the direction of the Dean, Department Chair, or other administrator, the Assistant Professor is responsible for teaching thirty (30) credit hours per academic year and delivering a range of courses within the assigned discipline. Courses may be offered in lecture, hybrid, and/or online formats, and teaching schedules may include both day and evening classes.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Teaching courses within the assigned discipline area in accordance with institutional standards
  • Evaluating and assessing student learning outcomes
  • Providing student support, mentoring, and academic advising
  • Developing curriculum and periodically reviewing and updating instructional materials
  • Assisting with program reviews and accreditation-related activities
  • Planning and executing program-related events
  • Attending workshops, trainings, and/or professional conferences to maintain currency in the field

Additional responsibilities include:

  • Attendance and participation at convocation and commencement ceremonies
  • Service on assigned committees and task forces
  • Attendance and participation at committee, staff, informational, and professional meetings, which may occur during evenings and weekends

This posting outlines qualifications, experience, and skills but is not limited to the full specifications and responsibilities that is stated within the Collective Bargaining Agreement.

Minimum Qualifications

Master’s degree in History or a related discipline.

Successful Candidate must have or must possess:

  • Ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, and ethnic backgrounds, including individuals with disabilities
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Two (2) or more years teaching history at the college-level (48+ credits).
  • Experience of course development and teaching History (e.g., Western History, US History, World History, US Civil War, Vietnam War, Cold War, and/or History of Religion) at the college level
  • Experience using technology to enhance the learning environment, e.g., Blackboard, online instruction or other modalities/software.
  • CT State recognizes the imperative to effectively serve diverse students, faculty and staff. As such, the ability to communicate additional languages beyond English (e.g., ASL, Spanish, Arabic, Bosnian) is considered a preferred qualification for all student and community facing positions.

Salary and Benefits

  • Salary $69,035 approximate annual
  • Because the start date for this position falls within the second semester of the academic year, bi-weekly pay will be prorated across the remaining pay periods. At the conclusion of this period, (start of the Fall semester) bi-weekly earnings will be adjusted to reflect the full annual salary applicable at that time.

CT State offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Generous leave policies
  • Multiple retirement plan options
  • Comprehensive health insurance choices
  • Supplemental benefits for retirement and family protection
  • Tuition reimbursement (if applicable)

For more information, visit: CSCU - Human Resources - Future Employees.

Application Instructions

To apply, please submit the following:

  • A cover letter
  • A current resume

In your cover letter, you must clearly address how your experience and skills align with each of the required and preferred qualifications. The cover letter may be entered as text in the application system or uploaded as a single combined file with the resume.

Your resume must include the names of three (3) current professional references, including their titles, email addresses, and telephone numbers.

Important Notes:

Selection Process

After the closing date, applications will be reviewed by a selection committee. Candidates selected for further consideration will be those who best meet the minimum and preferred qualifications and who submitted all required materials by the deadline.

The selection process may include interviews and practical exercises (e.g., written, technical, or simulation exercises). Finalists will be recommended to the Hiring Manager for final selection.

Background Screening

Employment offers are contingent upon:

title: Senior Systems Engineer (R5981)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:
As a Senior Systems Engineer on Shield AI’s next gen UAS program, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and integrating cutting-edge autonomous aircraft systems for national defense. You will lead the technical execution of system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission-critical systems.
This position requires a deep understanding of aerospace systems engineering, autonomy, and complex system integration. You will work cross-functionally with teams in hardware, software, autonomy, flight operations, and manufacturing to develop a scalable, mission-ready platform capable of operating in contested environments.
Your expertise will be critical in defining system requirements and architectures through model-based systems engineering, conducting trade studies, ensuring compliance with military and aviation standards, and supporting the aircraft through flight testing and operational deployment.

What You'll Do:

  • Perform System Architecture & Design: Develop and refine the system architecture for the next gen UAS, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission systems.
  • Define and document system-level behavior, including modes, states, transitions, and fault responses
  • Support safety analyses (FHA, FMEA, FTA) by defining behavior under fault conditions
  • Define and Manage System Requirements: Establish top-level requirements, decompose them into subsystems, and maintain traceability across the development lifecycle.
  • Autonomy & AI Integration: Work closely with autonomy and software teams to integrate AI-driven flight control, decision-making, and mission execution capabilities.
  • Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE): Utilize SysML, DOORS, or other MBSE tools to create digital system models, conduct trade studies, and optimize system performance.
  • Risk Management & Trade Studies: Conduct trade studies to evaluate design alternatives, assess technical risks, and ensure the best engineering solutions for mission effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement: Work closely with DoD stakeholders, industry partners, and government agencies to align system capabilities with operational requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, autonomy, software, propulsion, and flight operations teams to drive seamless system integration and rapid development cycles.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering for aerospace, defense, or autonomous aircraft systems.
  • Demonstrated experience defining system behavior logic and operational modes
  • Deep expertise in system architecture, avionics integration, and autonomy-driven flight systems.
  • Proficiency in MBSE, DOORS, SysML, CAMEO, or similar system modeling tools for complex systems design and analysis.
  • Experience with Group 4 or Group 5 UAS, military aircraft, or autonomous airborne platforms.
  • Strong background in flight testing, system integration, and performance validation.
  • Knowledge of DoD acquisition processes, MIL-STDs, FAA airworthiness certification, and airborne system safety standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex projects to successful completion.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with shifting priorities.
  • Worked on developmental program from clean sheet to first flight
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing AI-driven autonomy for unmanned aircraft.
  • Expertise in ISR, EW, and advanced sensor integration for airborne platforms.
  • Familiarity with modular open system architectures (MOSA) and Government Reference Architectures (GRA) for defense applications.
  • Prior experience working with defense primes, DoD stakeholders, or government R&D programs.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

title: US Site Head and VP, Manufacturing
description:
Summary

The Site Head & Vice President, Manufacturing is responsible for the operational leadership, performance, and scalability of the company’s radiopharmaceutical manufacturing operations at the Andover, Massachusetts site. The role oversees the manufacture and supply of Pb-212 radiopharmaceuticals, ensuring reliable clinical supply, regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and readiness for future commercialization.

Working within the company’s global technical and manufacturing strategy, the Site Head & Vice President, Manufacturing translates strategic objectives into scalable manufacturing capabilities and delivers operational alignment, supply reliability, and continuous improvement across site operations.

The role provides leadership for all site functions, including Manufacturing, Facilities, Supply Chain & Logistics, Radiation, Health & Safety, and Technical Services. Responsible for overall site performance, the position drives compliance, resource optimization, and organizational effectiveness to support sustained growth and business objectives.

The Site Head & Vice President, Manufacturing balances day-to-day operational oversight with strategic site leadership, partnering closely with Quality, R&D, Regulatory, CMC, and Clinical teams to advance the site’s technical agenda and support the successful execution of the company’s development and commercialization goals.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

  • Provide overall leadership and accountability for site operations, manufacturing performance, and organizational effectiveness at the Andover manufacturing facility.
  • Lead the development and execution of site strategy, operating systems, policies, and objectives to support clinical development, commercial readiness, and corporate goals.
  • Oversee all site functions, including Manufacturing, Technical Services, Manufacturing Sciences, Facilities, Supply Chain & Logistics, Radiation Safety, Health, Safety & Environment (HSE), and associated support functions.
  • Ensure the safe, compliant, and reliable manufacture and supply of Pb-212 radiopharmaceutical products to support clinical trials, pipeline development, and future commercial demand.
  • Drive operational excellence through performance management, KPIs, risk management, resource optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, reliability, and process robustness.
  • Develop manufacturing capacity, infrastructure, and operational readiness plans to support pipeline growth, technology transfers, scale-up activities, facility expansion, and commercialization.
  • Lead clinical supply planning and execution, including production scheduling, isotope availability, inventory management, and distribution logistics to ensure uninterrupted product supply.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Quality, Regulatory, R&D, CMC, Clinical, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to deliver site objectives, technical initiatives, and manufacturing strategies aligned with business priorities.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with cGMP, FDA, NRC and other applicable regulatory requirements, maintaining inspection readiness and serving as the senior site representative during regulatory inspections and audits.
  • Foster a strong culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement, ensuring adherence to all corporate and site HSE and quality standards.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing leadership team and workforce through effective talent management, coaching, succession planning, and organizational development.
  • Establish and maintain effective communication, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing practices across the site and broader manufacturing network.
  • Contribute to corporate strategy, budgeting, forecasting, and business planning activities to ensure alignment between site operations and organizational objectives.
  • Champion the company’s mission, values, and culture, creating an engaged, high-performing workplace that supports innovation, growth, and operational excellence.

Essential Skills, Qualifications, Industry and Educational Requirements

  • PhD, MSc, or equivalent degree in engineering, pharmaceutical sciences or relevant discipline.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in cross-functional leadership roles within pharmaceutical manufacturing organisations.
  • Sound understanding of regulatory requirements and guidelines governing cGMP manufacture of parenteral pharmaceuticals (e.g. PIC/S, ICH).
  • Experience scaling site operations from clinical to commercial environments.
  • Strong leadership, operational strategy and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills and strong analytical problem-solving skills.
  • Working in a team environment and adhering to principals of diversity and inclusion.

Desirable Skills, Qualifications, Industry and Educational Requirements

  • Experience in GMP manufacture of radiopharmaceuticals.
  • Experience with just-in-time delivery of medicines.
  • Experience establishing new sites and implementing phase-appropriate operations aligned to the lifecycle of pipeline programs.

Founded in 2019, and headquartered in Australia, AdvanCell is a clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company developing a revolutionary cancer treatment called Targeted Alpha Therapy, providing new hope for patients with untreatable cancers. AdvanCell’s pipeline is powered by innovative technology and a novel approach that ensures a reliable and scalable supply of alpha therapies to drive clinical development and guarantee commercial-scale supply. title: 3rd Shift Part-Time Med Tech
description:
TerraBella Senior Living proudly serves thousands of residents and families offering a full range of lifestyle and care options including Active Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and short-term Respite. With a foundation rooted in purpose, hospitality, and connection, TerraBella fosters communities where both residents and Team Members thrive.

At TerraBella, culture, growth, and heart define who we are. We continually aspire and invest in learning and development opportunities that support our team members’ professional growth, ensuring every team member has the tools to build a meaningful and rewarding career.

TerraBella Senior Living is looking for a Care/Medication Technician to join our community HeartFields at Cary

3rd Shift Hours: 11P-7A with a 30-minute meal break

Weekend rotation will be 1st and 3rd weekend of the month (9/19 and 9/20, 10/3 and 10/4, 10/17 and 10/18, 10/31 and 11/1, etc, etc)


The Care Giver/Med Tech role includes providing hands-on care, physical and emotional support to each resident while maintaining a safe and comfortable home-like environment.

Responsibilities:

Care Giver:

  • Responsible for a designated group of residents during the shift; knows where their residents are and physically checks on them throughout the shift.
  • Observes, reports and documents symptoms and conditions of residents for changes in condition such as skin, behavior, alertness, weight, dietary and participation in activities.
  • Responds to security system and resident call bells promptly.

title: Commodity Specialist
description:
General Fasteners located in Livonia, MI is looking to hire a Commodity Specialist. Would you like to join a stable and growing local company where there is potential for career growth? If so, please read on!

This Commodity Specialist position earns a competitive starting wage, and we also offer great benefits and perks, such as 10 paid holidays, generous paid time off (PTO), a 401(k) option, flexible spending accounts (FSAs), life insurance, a down-to-earth casual environment, and a positive team-oriented culture. Our full-time employees also have access to medical, dental, vision, and other insurance options.


A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A COMMODITY SPECIALIST

Commodity Specialists are responsible for creating and maintaining relationships with new and existing strategic suppliers. This position plays a pivotal role in the company ensuring the stability of our supply chain and competitiveness. Coordination with colleagues & utilization of resources from the Engineering, Quality, Accounting, Operations and Sales teams to fulfill client needs is critical to the success of Commodity Management.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Managing the company's supply chain by sourcing, negotiating, and purchasing commodities
  • Maintain/Implement pricing strategy to establish the best price market wide
  • Evaluate market conditions to mitigate risks
  • Understand product offerings provided by suppliers
  • Maintain/Implement inventory strategies to decrease cost, increase inventory turns, and increase profitability
  • Maintain/Implement supplier rebate programs
  • Negotiate competitive payment terms / Assist Accounting with invoice concerns
  • Build and maintain good relationships with both new and existing suppliers
  • Conduct quarterly business reviews with strategic suppliers to review performance and establish continuous improvement strategies
  • Assist on identifying suppliers for gap purchases
  • Assist Quality with customer / supplier concerns
THE MOST QUALIFIED CANDIDATES POSSESS THE FOLLOWING:
  • Experience with Microsoft Office applications: Outlook, Excel, Word, Access
  • Experience using Epicor Prophet 21 and IQS (Enterprise Quality Management) Software
  • Purchasing experience with both domestic and international suppliers
  • Experience in the Fastener Industry
  • Resolve problems where precedent may not exist
  • Driven, have sense of urgency, take ownership
  • Preferred: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
  • Ability to cooperate with people of different levels inside/ outside the company and to interact with team to reach team goals and business objectives
  • Ability to gather information, analyze data, prepare, and lead negotiations as well as suggest recommendations
Do you have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal? Are you comfortable talking on the phone? Do you enjoy building relationships with people? Are you team-oriented? Do you have creative problem-solving skills? If so, you might just be perfect for this position!

WORK SCHEDULE
This position requires working Monday – Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm
This position will have some travel to suppliers, less than 15%.

ABOUT GENERAL FASTENERS COMPANY

Founded in 1952, General Fasteners Company is a full-service distributor of Fasteners and Assembly Components. We excel at providing great products, superior customer service, customized Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) programs, product testing, and engineering solutions for our valued customers. Our company culture plays a large part in our success. With 15 locations in North America, General Fasteners Company continues to provide these services to numerous companies throughout North America.
General Fasteners Company continues to find new and innovative ways to service our customers as we carry on the traditional values on which our company was founded. After 70 years, we continue to be a privately held Michigan corporation dedicated to helping our customers reach their strategic goals through inventory solutions.
We believe that happy, talented employees add value to our company. We do our best to hire friendly, down-to-earth people who make good team members. We also promote a healthy work-life balance and personal development.

READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM?
We understand your time is valuable and that is why we have a very quick and easy application process. If you feel that you would be right for this customer service job, please fill out our initial mobile-friendly application. We look forward to meeting you!

title: Partner Bemanning till Capio
description:
Kompetensförsörjning är en av vårdens viktigaste framtidsfrågor. För att möta verksamheternas behov utvecklar Capio nya sätt att attrahera, rekrytera och bemanna våra verksamheter. Nu söker vi en Verksamhetspartner inom bemanning som vill vara med och utveckla vår bemanningsverksamhet och skapa träffsäkra lösningar för våra verksamheter.

Rollen ger möjlighet att arbeta nära verksamheten och bidra till hur framtidens bemanning och kompetensförsörjning ska fungera inom en av Sveriges ledande vårdgivare.

Om oss

Capios funktion för rekrytering och bemanning stöttar verksamheter inom hela Capio med kompetensförsörjning. Vi arbetar nära verksamheten för att förstå behov, utveckla samarbeten och skapa lösningar som stärker vår förmåga att attrahera, rekrytera och bemanna rätt kompetens över tid.

Som Verksamhetspartner inom bemanning blir du en viktig del av detta arbete. Du arbetar nära både verksamheter och kandidater och har en central roll i att omsätta verksamheternas behov till konkreta bemanningslösningar.

Din roll

I din roll ansvarar du för att självständigt driva bemanningsuppdrag från behov och matchning till tillsättning och uppföljning. Du arbetar verksamhetsnära och bygger förtroendefulla relationer med chefer och andra nyckelpersoner för att förstå deras behov och utveckla långsiktiga samarbeten.

Rollen kombinerar operativt bemanningsarbete med utveckling av arbetssätt och samarbeten. Du behöver därför trivas med att växla mellan att hantera konkreta bemanningsbehov här och nu och att samtidigt se möjligheter till förbättring och utveckling. I rollen ingår även personalansvar för våra anställda konsulter, där du arbetar nära både konsulterna och våra verksamheter för att skapa en välfungerande och långsiktig bemanning.

Du kommer att arbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå deras kompetensbehov, identifiera rätt lösningar och säkerställa en kvalitativ och effektiv leverans.

I rollen kommer du att:

  • Driva bemanningsprocesser från behov och matchning till tillsättning och uppföljning

  • Vara verksamhetens partner i bemanningsfrågor och bygga långsiktiga relationer

  • Förstå verksamheternas kompetensbehov och omsätta dem till relevanta lösningar

  • Identifiera, attrahera och matcha kandidater utifrån verksamhetens behov

  • Säkerställa en kvalitativ, effektiv och verksamhetsnära leverans

  • Utveckla samarbeten, arbetssätt och processer inom bemanning

  • Bidra med kunskap och perspektiv till teamets gemensamma utveckling och leverans

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är verksamhetsorienterad och relationsskapande och som trivs i en roll där du får ta eget ansvar för hela bemanningsprocessen. Du har ett starkt driv, är strukturerad och uppskattar att arbeta i en miljö där tempot kan vara högt och behoven förändras.

Du är nyfiken på verksamhetens behov och har lätt för att förstå olika perspektiv. Samtidigt är du trygg i att ta initiativ, prioritera och driva dina uppdrag framåt.

För att lyckas i rollen har du:

  • Flerårig operativ erfarenhet av bemanning eller rekrytering av kvalificerad arbetskraft

  • Erfarenhet av att självständigt driva bemannings- eller rekryteringsprocesser från behov och matchning till tillsättning och uppföljning

  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta nära verksamheter, förstå kompetensbehov och utveckla samarbeten utifrån dessa

  • Förmåga att skapa förtroende och bygga långsiktiga relationer

  • God struktur och förmåga att prioritera och driva flera parallella uppdrag med kvalitet och tempo

  • Ett lösningsorienterat och verksamhetsnära förhållningssätt

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av bemanning eller rekrytering inom vården, särskilt av klinisk vårdpersonal och läkare. Det är också meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att utveckla erbjudanden eller arbetssätt inom bemanning och rekrytering, samt erfarenhet av RecMan eller andra CRM- och bemanningssystem. Relevant akademisk utbildning är också meriterande.

Vi erbjuder dig

Du får möjlighet att vara med och utveckla ett viktigt område inom Capio och bidra till hur vi arbetar med bemanning och kompetensförsörjning framåt.

Vi erbjuder balans mellan arbete och privatliv, flexibla arbetssätt, kollektivavtal och friskvårdsbidrag.

Kontoret är beläget vid Capio S Görans Sjukhus i Stockholm. Rollen innebär även regelbunden närvaro ute i Capios verksamheter runt om i Storstockholm.

Ansökan

Rekryteringsarbetet sker löpande och vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Som ett första steg i processen kommer du som kandidat att bjudas in till en kort digital intervju. Syftet är att komplettera ansökan och skapa en rättvis och likvärdig bedömning inför det fortsatta urvalet.

I samband med anställning kan bakgrundskontroll och utdrag ur belastningsregistret komma att begäras.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Publicerat: 2026-09-16

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-09-30

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt all direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av jobbannonser.

title: Director of Engineering & Facilities
description:
About Heath

Heath Ceramics is a California company making dinnerware and architectural tiles of good and enduring design for 75 years. We are design-led, with the mission of creating products of beauty and integrity, while designing, manufacturing, and running our business in a way that's better for society and our planet. Our products are designed, manufactured, and sold in our two California factories and five showrooms, ensuring accountability in our process, from beginning to end. As a Certified B Corp, we maintain high standards of social responsibility, environmental performance, and transparency. We believe in the benefits of local manufacturing and support a community of people committed to and inspired by the process of designing, making, and sharing. We believe in pay equity, full health and welfare benefits, and a place for meaningful work.

Position Summary

The Director of Engineering & Facilities leads Heath’s engineering and facilities functions across multiple locations. This role ensures reliable systems, regulatory compliance, and continuous process improvement in support of our manufacturing operations. They are accountable for developing a high-performing team, directing complex projects, and aligning engineering resources to meet production, innovation, and safety goals. With oversight of building systems, industrial equipment, and process automation, the Director partners cross-functionally with Production, EH&S, Design, Operations, Sales and IT to drive long-term infrastructure planning and ensure business continuity.

Position Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Engineering and Facilities teams by assigning work, monitoring performance, and supporting career growth. Utilize managers, supervisors and individual contributors to manage daily execution.
  • Accountable for strategic direction for engineering and facilities functions aligning long-term infrastructure planning and team capacity with Heath’s business goals.
  • Oversee operations including capital projects, budgeting, expense reporting, and resource allocation, to ensure effective and efficient use of resources.
  • Drive process engineering improvements by optimizing workflows, equipment performance, and automation to increase efficiency, reliability, and safety in production.
  • Ensure system reliability and advancement including electrical systems, control systems (PLC programming, fluid systems), and industrial automation projects.
  • Lead equipment innovation, including the design, prototyping, and testing of new or modified equipment to enhance production capabilities and support innovation.
  • Partner with EH&S and other stakeholders to ensure compliance with fire safety protocols, environmental regulations, and hazardous materials handling, while fostering a culture of safety and accountability.
  • Lead emergency response planning for infrastructure issues, systems failures, and weather-related incidents ensuring operational readiness and business continuity.
  • Own and optimize engineering tools and systems, including CMMS platforms and technical documentation to support proactive maintenance and process visibility.
  • Oversees and directs security related infrastructure, handling alarm calls and various other related security issues.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Engineering, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Manufacturing or similar core engineering discipline
  • 10+ years leading and managing teams in an engineering/facilities environment
  • Strong leadership and people management skills
  • Technical engineering expertise including knowledge of industrial equipment, mechanical and electrical systems, and automation controls.
  • Ability to assess issues, prioritize tasks, and make informed decisions.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical failures and manage urgent facility issues.
  • Experience managing budgets, expenses, capital projects, timelines, and engineering resources.
  • Familiarity with OSHA, fire safety, environmental regulations, and hazardous material handling.

Work Environment, Hours & Compensation

This is a full-time, exempt position based out of our Sausalito location, with regular onsite work required in Sausalito and San Francisco. The role is typically expected to be onsite in San Francisco two days per week, with flexibility to adjust based on business needs. The salary range for this position is $160,000–$170,000, based on experience.

Benefits

We are committed to your health and well-being. Heath offers a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees that includes a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as life insurance. An annual 401(k) contribution that grows with job tenure. We offer a generous time-off allocation and a great discount on all Heath Ceramics products.

Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

At Heath, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate it, we support it. Heath is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Our goal is to be a diverse workforce at all job levels. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, transgender status, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

How to Apply

If you would like to be considered for this position apply through this application form. Thank you for your interest!

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
About Fusemachines

Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services provider. Founded by Sameer Maskey Ph.D., Adjunct Associate Professor at Columbia University, Fusemachines has a core mission of democratizing AI. With a presence in 4 countries (Nepal, the United States, Canada, and the Dominican Republic) and more than 450 full-time employees, Fusemachines brings global AI expertise to transform companies worldwide. Founded in 2013, Fusemachines is a global provider of enterprise AI products and services, on a mission to democratize AI. Leveraging proprietary AI Studio and AI Engines, the company helps drive the clients’ AI Enterprise Transformation, regardless of where they are in their Digital AI journeys. With offices in North America, Asia, and Latin America, Fusemachines provides a suite of enterprise AI offerings and specialty services that allow organizations of any size to implement and scale AI. Fusemachines serves companies in industries such as retail, manufacturing, and government.

Fusemachines continues to actively pursue the mission of democratizing AI for the masses by providing high-quality AI education in underserved communities and helping organizations achieve their full potential with AI.

Type: Full-time

Role Summary
We are hiring a Senior MLOps Engineer to design, automate, deploy, monitor, and govern production machine learning systems on Azure. The role requires deep expertise in Azure Databricks, MLflow, Databricks Feature Engineering, Azure Machine Learning, PySpark, CI/CD, containerization, and cloud-native software engineering.
The successful candidate will partner with Data Scientists and Data Engineers teams to operationalize machine learning solutions, establish MLOps standards, and build scalable, reliable, secure, and compliant ML platforms. This role focuses on productionization, deployment automation, model lifecycle management, observability, governance, and platform engineering, rather than model development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end MLOps workflows for model training, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and retirement.
  • Productionize data science assets by converting notebooks and prototypes into modular, testable, deployable Python packages and services.
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for machine learning models, feature pipelines, and data products.
  • Implement model lifecycle management using MLflow, including experiment tracking, model registry, approval workflows, versioning, and rollback.
  • Develop and maintain feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature assets using Databricks Feature Engineering and Delta Lake.
  • Deploy and operate batch, streaming, and real-time inference workloads using Databricks Model Serving, Azure Machine Learning, and Kubernetes-based platforms.
  • Establish automated testing, validation, and release processes for ML code, data, features, and models.
  • Implement model monitoring and observability for service health, latency, model performance, drift detection, and operational reliability.
  • Ensure governance, security, lineage, auditability, and access controls through Unity Catalog and Azure security services.
  • Optimize ML platforms and workloads for scalability, reliability, performance, and cloud cost efficiency.
  • Define and promote MLOps best practices, engineering standards, and platform architecture across teams.


Fusemachines is an Equal Opportunities Employer, committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

title: Vagtplanlægger
description:
Vagtplanlægger

Har du erfaring med at ligge medarbejder vagtplaner - kender overenskomsten for FOA og DSR, og trives med at både langtidsplanlægge og korttidreperer, så kig med her.

Indhold:

Vi søger endnu en vagtplanlægger til Spjald pleje - og aktivitetscenter. Vi har nuværende ansat en vagtplanlægger på 30 timer og ønsker at tilføje yderligere ressorucer til denne opgave. Vi har 70 medarbejdere, og vi arbejder i KMD opus vagtplan.

Kort intro / Teaser

Formål:

Du skal indgå i et samarbejdet med nuværende planlægger, så vi sikrer en god dækning til at løse opgaven. I skal supporter hinanden med sparring på hvordan vi løser opgaverne, og du skal også kunne arbejde selvstændigt.

Indhold:

Arbejdet er fra mandag til fredag - 30 timer om ugen. I starten vil alle timerne være til vagtplanlægningen, jeg har et ønske om at vi på sigt kan bruge op til 10 timer pr uge, på nexus tilpasninger i samarbejdet med sygeplejen og assitentgruppen. Vagtplanlæggeren møder kl. 06.45 og arbejdet til kl. 13 eller kl. 15. 06.45 forholder man sig til de sygemeldinger der er og løser det efter vores instrukser. Ellers sikrer at vagtplanen frigives efter reglerne, at normperioden overholdes, og at vi så vidt det er muligt, sikrer at medarbejdernes ønsker tilgodeses, samtidigt med at vi sikre en fagligt og økonomisk bæredygtigt drift.


Indhold: Vi søger en vagtplanlægger

  • der har erfaring med at arbejde med vagtplanlægning.
  • der ser værdien af at samarbejdet er vigtigt for det gode arbejdsmiljø.

Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads hvor tillid, samarbejde og retfærdighed er vigtigt. Spjald pleje - og aktivitetscenter har både almene boligere, ældreboliger, boliger for mennersker med sen hjerneskade, samt skærmede pladser til mennesker med demenssygdom.

Du kommer på en arbejdsplads, hvor hjemmelighed og omsorg er vigtigt og hvor der er mange frivillige som er med til at skabe et godt hverdagsliv sammen med personalet. Du får en leder, som er tydelige og nærværende og som inviterer til dialog og hvor du får ansvar og bliver set og mødt med tillid.




Indhold:

  • 30 timer stilling.
  • 1.11 2026
  • Spjald pleje og aktivitetscenter.
  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst
  • Glem alt om madpakker, vi tilbyder en fordelagtig frivillig madordning mod et mindre beløb

Om Danske Diakonhjem

Danske Diakonhjem er en selvejende, nonprofitorganisation med mere end 65 års erfaring i at opføre og drive plejehjem. Vi er landets største private aktør inden for plejehjem og friplejehjem med 41 hjem og knapt 3.000 medarbejdere.

Derudover administrerer vi en række selvejende institutioner inden for løn, regnskab, bolig, IT og rådgivning — i alt omkring 80 plejehjem, hospices og bofællesskaber.

Vores arbejde bygger på et kristent livs- og menneskesyn, hvor hvert menneske betragtes som unikt og værdifuldt. Vi forventer, at du kan se dig selv i en organisation, hvor respekt, ordentlighed og rummelighed er centrale værdier.

title: Specialist inom verksamhetsnära kravställning (Business Analyst)
description:
Om Kriminalvården

Kriminalvården växer – vi bygger nytt, bygger om och bygger till och söker nu fler medarbetare. Vårt viktigaste mål är att minska återfall i brott – att bryta den onda cirkeln. Lyckas vi med det blir samhället tryggare och säkrare för alla. Vi är den myndighet som ansvarar för anstalter, frivård, häkten och klienttransporter.

Transportavdelningens (TA) uppgift är att transportera frihetsberövade personer. Transporterna rör huvudsakligen kriminalvårdsklienter, mellan häkten och anstalter samt till t.ex. domstolsförhandlingar och läkarbesök, men också frihetsberövade personer åt exempelvis Polisen, Statens institutionsstyrelse, Migrationsverket och psykiatrin.

Enheten för verksamhetsstöd är i första hand ett stöd till avdelningschefen men även till övriga enheter inom avdelningen. Stödet ges i form av t.ex. framtagande av analyser, strategier och planer för avdelningschefens hela planeringshorisont, ärendeberedning, underhåll av samverkanspunkter samt uppföljning och utveckling av transportverksamheten

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vi söker en kravställare / Business Analyst som vill bidra till att utveckla och digitalisera vår kärnverksamhet inom logistik. I rollen blir du en viktig länk mellan verksamheten och IT och ansvarar för att vara verksamhetens språkrör gentemot olika IT-projekt genom att förstå, strukturera och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tydliga och användbara krav.

Som specialist inom verksamhetsnära kravställning / Business Analyst kommer du att arbeta nära verksamheten för att kartlägga och analysera befintliga processer, identifiera behov och problemområden samt vid behov omsätta dessa till krav på nya eller vidareutvecklade IT-system.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Analysera nuläge och önskat läge samt identifiera effektiviserings- och digitaliseringsmöjligheter
  • Identifiera och strukturera verksamhetens behov, krav och prioriteringar
  • Säkerställa spårbarhet mellan verksamhetsmål, processer, behov och systemkrav
  • Bidra i framtagning av processmodeller, kravspecifikationer och andra relevanta analysunderlag
  • Vara dialogpartner mellan verksamhet, IT, arkitektur och andra berörda funktioner
  • Bidra till att identifiera hur automation, AI, data och digitala arbetssätt kan skapa nytta i verksamheten

Kvalifikationer

Till rollen som specialist söker vi dig som är duktig på att arbeta med svåra problem samt har förmågan att bryta ner och lösa komplicerade problem. Vidare tar du initiativ, sätter igång aktiviteter, uppnår resultat och själv ansvar för att lösa dina arbetsuppgifter. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med olika typer av personer samt kommunicerar och löser problem på ett konstruktivt sätt.

För att trivas och lyckas i ditt uppdrag är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen och tron på att människan är utvecklingsbar. Du är även medveten om och har förståelse för hur bakgrund, kultur och grupptillhörighet påverkar dig själv och andra. Vidare förväntas du med ditt förhållningssätt bidra till att alla blir likvärdigt bemötta. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom ett för tjänsten relevant område alternativt annan utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet som Kriminalvården bedömer relevant
  • Erfarenhet som Business Analyst, kravanalytiker, kravställare eller verksamhetsutvecklare
  • Erfarenhet av att kartlägga och analysera verksamhetsprocesser
  • Erfarenhet av att formulera och dokumentera krav för IT-system
  • Erfarenhet av att analysera komplexa informations- och processflöden och göra dem begripliga för olika målgrupper
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta nära både verksamhet och IT
  • God förståelse för hur verksamhetsprocesser omsätts till digitalt stöd
  • God kommunikativ förmåga i svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt

Det är även meriterande med:

  • Erfarenhet av att leda workshops och fånga behov från olika verksamhetsintressenter
  • Erfarenhet av logistik, försörjningskedjor, lager, transport eller annan komplex operativ verksamhet.
  • Erfarenhet av arbete inom myndighet eller annan offentlig verksamhet
  • Erfarenhet av arbete i större IT-transformations- eller digitaliseringsinitiativ
  • Erfarenhet av processmodellering
  • Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt
  • Erfarenhet av verksamhetsutveckling inom automation eller AI

Övrigt

Kriminalvården har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet och ersatt det med urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Svaren i urvalsfrågorna och CV ligger till grund för om du är kvalificerad att gå vidare i processen.

För att bli aktuell för anställning inom Kriminalvården krävs att du motsvarar högt ställda krav gällande lämplighet, omdöme, säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetande och att du följer gällande lagar. Det innebär att du står upp för demokratiska värderingar och den statliga värdegrund som gäller för Kriminalvårdens verksamhet.

Vissa befattningar är placerade i säkerhetsklass och då kommer en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas. För vissa säkerhetsklassade tjänster krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Kriminalvården välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Läs mer om säkerhetsprövning här: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/sakerhetsprovning-vid-rekrytering/

Befattningen kan innebära krigsplacering vid Kriminalvården. Läs mer om krigsplacering här: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/krigsplacering/

Individuell lönesättning tillämpas.

Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.

Kriminalvården strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ökad mångfald.

För att skicka in din ansökan, klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen. Frågor om hur du ansöker och lägger in ditt CV ställer du direkt till Varbi. Frågor om specifika jobb besvaras av den kontaktperson som anges i annonsen.

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av rekryteringsannonser. Kriminalvården har upphandlade avtal.

title: Software Engineer
description:
One Group | One Energy

We are Enerwave, member of HELLENiQ ENERGY and a leader in providing outstanding and innovative energy solutions. We operate with passion, being engaged in heart and mind to what we do, and we pride ourselves on offering our employees a place where they can excel, creating value. We are offering now a set of exciting positions ,across our premises in various locations, covering multiple departments and areas of expertise.

We are looking for a Software Engineer who will design, develop, maintain, and test reliable, secure, and scalable applications built on .NET Core/C# with RESTful Web APIs and a React front end. They leverage cloud-native technologies—including serverless architecture where appropriate—as well as on-premises resources, and adopt DevOps/CI/CD practices throughout the SDLC. The role consistently applies SOLID and Clean Code principles, collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, and ensures solutions align with business objectives and security best practices.

What will you do:

  • Act with professionalism, ethics and a high sense of responsibility and collegiality, at all times.
  • Design, code, and test full-stack applications using .NET Core/C# (RESTful Web APIs) for back end and React JS or Blazor for front end, including the integration of external APIs, automation services, and managed AI capabilities where required, ensuring performance, security, and scalability.
  • Participate in technical analysis and solution design, collaborating with cross-functional teams and external partners to translate business requirements and functional specifications into software solutions, including AI-enabled capabilities where appropriate.
  • Design and implement database schemas and optimize data access primarily on SQL Server.
  • Leverage cloud-native technologies (e.g., containers, orchestration, serverless patterns, and managed cloud or AI services) alongside on-premises resources to build and deploy secure, reliable, and scalable applications.
  • Incorporate DevOps practices in day-to-day activities—CI/CD pipelines and automated testing—to improve operational efficiency and delivery quality.
  • Apply SDLC discipline, SOLID principles, and Clean Code practices; maintain high-quality technical documentation (designs/ADRs) and perform thorough code reviews.
  • Implement security best practices, including appropriate data protection and access controls when integrating external or AI-enabled services, and designs for scalability to ensure systems remain resilient as business needs evolve.
  • Implement unit and integration tests and collaborate with QA/QA Automation to expand test coverage and integrate automated tests into CI/CD.
  • Use Git effectively with established branching strategies (e.g., GitFlow or trunk-based) and actively participate in pull-request reviews.
  • Participate as 2nd or 3rd Level support in incident or problem management activities with regard to applications developed in-house.
  • Continuously learn and evaluate technologies, including emerging AI-assisted and AI-enabled development capabilities; propose improvements and develops/enhances solutions to support core business, automation, and digitalization needs, participating in proofs of concept where appropriate.

What you need to be successful:

  • A BSc in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 3–6 years of relevant working experience as a software developer in Microsoft .NET (full framework and/or .NET Core). Proven experience in both front-end and back-end development, working across the complete software development lifecycle.
  • Ability to build scalable and responsive web applications using .NET and modern front-end frameworks, with hands-on experience in C#, LINQ, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, Entity Framework, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL Server.
  • 3+ years of experience with at least one modern front-end framework such as React (preferred), Angular, or Vue; familiarity with Blazor is considered a plus.
  • Experience with relational databases (such as SQL Server), including schema design, querying, query optimization και integration in enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with DevOps principles, including continuous integration, automated testing, and deployment pipelines. Familiarity with tools like Git, GitHub Actions
  • Experience with cloud-native technologies, including serverless patterns, containers such as Docker, external APIs, and managed cloud services, and working knowledge of both cloud and on-premises architectures. Exposure to the integration of AI-enabled services would be considered an advantage.
  • AI-assisted and AI-enabled development: Familiarity with GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools for code generation, refactoring, test authoring, and documentation, including effective prompting and safe and compliant usage. Basic understanding of how pre-trained AI models and managed AI services can be consumed through APIs and integrated into software applications would be considered an advantage.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Core: C#, .NET Core, Web API/REST/JSON, React JS, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, Entity Framework, SQL Server, cloud-native (including serverless), containers (Docker), Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, SOLID and Clean Code principles, SDLC discipline, code reviews, and documentation.
  • AI-assisted development: GitHub Copilot (Visual Studio/VS Code), effective prompt design for code generation, refactoring, and test authoring; safe and compliant usage.
  • Nice-to-have / Legacy exposure: ASP.NET MVC, Blazor, Angular, Vue, SOAP, XAML, DevExpress.
  • Exposure to Azure AI services, intelligent document processing, generative AI APIs, workflow automation, or similar technologies would be considered an advantage.
  • At least one of the following Certifications: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Microsoft Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204),Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify and address complex technical issues.
  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to adapt to changing technologies, including emerging AI-assisted and AI-enabled capabilities, business requirements, and project scopes, and to collaborate effectively with external specialists when additional expertise is required.
  • Willingness to stay updated with emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in the software development field.

Our offer to you:

  • Bonus scheme 💰

title: Director, Client Onboarding & Implementation
description:
We're seeking a Director, Client Onboarding & Implementation to lead the team that will work with internal and external stakeholders to onboard and launch Included Health clients. You will lead a team of managers that support implementation & operations team members to bring our client contracts to reality. You will collaborate with leaders in sales, client success, operations, product, marketing, legal and finance to evolve processes and infrastructure, including optimization of implementation workflows, playbooks and other related systems. Your data-driven insights and leadership on strategic & operational initiatives will help influence the growth trajectory of Included Health and allow us to resolve the most important strategic and operational issues facing the business.The right individual must be able to manage multiple competing priorities and adapt to change in a fast-paced and continually evolving environment.

We’re seeking a Director, Implementation to lead the people, operating model, and portfolio delivery disciplines that bring Included Health client commitments to life. This leader will manage and develop Implementation Consultants and Implementation Project Managers, oversee complex client launches, and create the governance, and cross-functional operating practices needed to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes. The role partners closely with Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other leaders to improve launch readiness, resolve critical issues, and scale implementation capabilities as the business evolves.

The ideal candidate combines strong team leadership with deep implementation judgment. They can move between executive-level client and internal conversations, portfolio-level risks and tradeoffs, and the operating mechanisms that help implementation teams execute effectively. They should be comfortable using implementation and client-performance metrics to identify patterns and prioritize action, without needing to be an advanced data analyst.

People Leadership & Organizational Capacity

  • Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing organization of implementation leaders, consultants, project managers, and related client-facing professionals.

  • Set clear expectations for delivery quality, client experience, collaboration, and accountability; provide coaching, performance management, and career development.

  • Build leadership capacity through succession planning, mentoring, and development of future people leaders.

  • Partner with leadership on staffing, capacity planning, workload distribution, and seasonal readiness across the implementation portfolio.

Portfolio Delivery & Launch Outcomes

  • Oversee end-to-end implementation delivery across the your team’s portfolio, ensuring appropriate strategy, resourcing, governance, and execution for standard, complex, and transformational launches.

  • Establish clear expectations for launch readiness, quality, on-time delivery, post-launch stability, and client transition.

  • Ensure teams identify dependencies, manage scope and timelines, and maintain clear ownership of critical deliverables and decisions.

  • Review portfolio health and intervene early when risks, capacity constraints, or execution issues threaten client or business outcomes.

Client Governance & Executive Escalations

  • Establish effective governance models, operating rhythms, escalation paths, and decision-making practices for complex implementations.

  • Serve as the escalation point for implementation risks and client issues with strategic, commercial, operational, or reputational implications.

  • Build trust through transparent communication, sound judgment, clear recommendations, and consistent follow-through.

Implementation Methodology, Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Use retrospectives, implementation learnings, client feedback, and performance trends to identify systemic gaps and prioritize improvements.

  • Establish quality controls and adoption mechanisms that improve consistency, reduce avoidable escalations, and increase team efficiency.

  • Ensure improvements are translated into practical guidance, enablement, and repeatable ways of working for implementation teams.

Cross-Functional Operating Model

  • Align Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other partners around implementation priorities, dependencies, decisions, and client outcomes.

  • Surface recurring themes and implementation constraints to inform product, process, staffing, and business decisions.

  • Clarify ownership and drive resolution when work crosses organizational boundaries or existing processes are insufficient.

Product, Technical & Operational Readiness

  • Maintain sufficient product, systems, integration, and operational fluency to guide implementation strategy and challenge assumptions effectively.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering/Systems, Care, Clinical, and Support leaders to ensure technology feeds, integrations, claims readiness, operational processes, and member-support pathways are prepared for launch.

  • Ensure client requirements are translated into feasible implementation approaches while balancing client needs, operational sustainability, and scalable delivery.

  • Support the development of tools and reporting that improve visibility into readiness, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance without taking on day-to-day project administration.

Client Transition & Post-Launch Partnership

  • Partner with Client Success and operational leaders to ensure a clear transition from implementation to ongoing client ownership.

  • Monitor early post-launch performance and ensure material issues have clear owners, communication plans, and durable resolutions.

  • Use implementation outcomes and client feedback to strengthen retention, advocacy, and future growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in SaaS implementation, client onboarding, implementation consulting, program management, or project management; 10+ years preferred.

  • 3+ years of experience leading and developing client-facing implementation or project management professionals, including managers where applicable.

  • Proven experience leading complex, multi-workstream implementations involving significant cross-functional dependencies, technical integrations, operational readiness, and executive stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead both strategic implementation consulting and disciplined project/program execution, either directly or through a blended team of consultants and project managers.

  • Proven experience managing risks and escalations, improving quality, and delivering predictable, high-quality launches.

  • Demonstrated executive presence and client leadership skills, including the ability to facilitate senior-level governance forums, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment across competing priorities.

  • Track record of building scalable implementation methodologies, playbooks, standards, and operating processes that improve consistency, quality, client experience, and team efficiency.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and experience influencing Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other partners toward shared client and business outcomes.

  • Experience in healthcare, employee benefits, health technology, or a closely related ecosystem, with the ability to understand client, carrier, partner, and operational requirements.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with healthcare benefits administration, claims operations, carrier ecosystems, or related healthcare data/integration environments.

  • Experience leading organizational change management or operating-model changes.

  • PMP, CSM, or another relevant project/program management certification.

  • Experience using Salesforce, Cloud Coach, Jira, or similar systems to manage implementation portfolios, capacity, risks, and delivery performance.

  • Working fluency with operational and client-performance metrics, dashboards, and trend analysis to identify risks, prioritize improvements, and support decisions; advanced data analytics experience is not required.

  • Experience mentoring leaders, building succession pipelines, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $163,830 – $250,668 per year in the United States. This posted range reflects the portion of our internal salary band that is currently funded for new hires in this role across our standard labor markets (Zones A–C).

For context, these markets include Zone A (e.g., Phoenix AZ, San Antonio TX, Columbus OH, Charlotte NC), Zone B (e.g., Chicago IL, Denver CO, San Diego CA, Houston TX), and Zone C (e.g., Los Angeles CA, Seattle WA, Washington, D.C., Boston MA). Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location, skills, experience, and internal equity. We use structured salary bands and geographic zones based on cost of labor to keep pay fair and consistent.

Benefits & Perks:

In addition to receiving a great compensation package, the compensation package may include, depending on the role, the following and more:

Bonus

Equity

Remote-first culture

401(k) savings plan through Fidelity

Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage through multiple medical plan options (including disability insurance)

Paid Time Off ("PTO") and Discretionary Time Off (“DTO")

12 weeks of 100% Paid Parental leave

Family Building & Compassionate Leave: Fertility coverage, $25,000 for surrogacy/adoption, and paid leave for failed treatments, adoption or pregnancies.

Work-From-Home reimbursement to support team collaboration home office work

About Included Health

Included Health is a new kind of healthcare company, delivering integrated virtual care and navigation. We’re on a mission to raise the standard of healthcare for everyone. We break down barriers to provide high-quality care for every person in every community — no matter where they are in their health journey or what type of care they need, from acute to chronic, behavioral to physical. We offer our members care guidance, advocacy, and access to personalized virtual and in-person care for everyday and urgent care, primary care, behavioral health, and specialty care. title: T24 Application Specialist, Software Engineering, Core Banking
description:
Join a Challenger

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving? The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.

We can’t wait to get to know you!


The EQ Bank Engineering Team
EQ Bank Engineering Team has been advocating building best-in-class branchless digital banking experience to advance millions of Canadians’ personal financial goals since its inception. The team believes that the more agile and seamless banking features we build, the more wealth opportunities Canadians can unlock. Engineers in EQ Bank adopt the agile mindset to continually create, test, deploy, improve, and scale banking digital services. Our partnership with Wise, Nesto, Ratehub, Flinks, Borrowell, and Neo Financial has given us top-notch banking consumer insights, and therefore, these insights allow the Engineering Team to build a differentiated and unique digital banking platform. The team is on an 18-to-24-month transformational journey and ready to expand more banking features by growing double-digit team size to triple-digit. Join us to lead engineers on a transformational journey!
Purpose of Job
The Technical Lead, Software Engineering, Digital Banking ( Core Banking ) is part of the team that will enable EQ Bank’s Challenger Bank aspiration: A banking platform to put the power in customers’ hands. Every feature we build is designed to give our customers an edge over their money to maximize their potential. You will use cloud-native technologies and product-centric agile methodologies to manage multiple cross-functional pods dedicated to launching new products, features, and ongoing business value for our digital bank apps.
Reporting to the Associate Director, Engineering, you will help drive forwards the evolution our core banking platform to support our modern, API-driven micro-services architecture using foundational Azure Cloud, DevOps, API, and PaaS services to deliver dozens of production releases per month. You will lead a cross-functional team through all areas of Agile Software Development and will partner closely with Digital Banking Business and Product teams to prioritize and deliver outcome driven solutions. This will include enabling MVP approaches and faster learning towards our customer goals and objectives.
The Technical Lead, Engineering will focus on ensuring feasibility of sprint stories and tasks, code quality and sprint velocity. The incumbent will work closely with the team members to ensure the pod is following agile development principles, including backlog grooming and estimation, sprint planning, code reviews and test automation. The Technical Lead will also be responsible for issue tracking, unblocking engineers and driving forward sprint progress.
As the T24 Application Specialist, Digital Banking, you’ll be expected to collaborate with our Products and existing pods by providing technical support in the form of assessment/analysis, integration, development and troubleshoot for our T24 platformassignment types.
Accountability
The T24 Application Specialist, Digital Banking works under direct management and their work is reviewed by the Associate Director, Core Banking.
The incumbent should be internally motivated, and constantly strive to find innovative ways to enhance capability, methodology and practice; always be looking to maximize business value by balancing strategic technology plans with speed of delivery.
T24 system under your care is a core banking system with multi-million $ value and the recipient of serious funding investments ongoing by Equitable. The projects that you will be involved in delivering will involve significant dollar values so you will use your experience to make sure everything app related is managed with great diligence, and that Temenos vendor gaps are addressed in a way that does not impeded progress of Equitable’s objectives or day to day work. This role has been specifically created to enable us to deliver with pace and clarity.
Job Complexities / Thinking Challenges
The position requires the ability to work with a wide range of computer technologies and thus a good understanding of each of our technology elements is important. T24 Application Specialist, Digital Banking is expected to be able to perform initial analysis on technical problems, apply fixes based on their technical knowledge, and exercise their judgement to escalate the issue to the Manager of IT and/or the vendor appropriately and promptly.
The objectives provided for project tasks and other technical tasks will be clear and exact but will not be down to step-by-step instructions. The T24 Application Specialist, Digital Banking is expected to be able to complete the objectives with self-initiative or go back to the requestor to get more details.
The incumbent is expected to understand and observe IT policies and procedures and work under the direction of the Manager of IT to ensure that they are followed by all staff. The incumbent is expected to think independently, understand the business needs, critically review the business requirements and make design and implementation decisions.
You will ensure work and projects are completed promptly and thoroughly. Support the vision of the business needs for success now and in the future. Set your own goals and hold yourself self and others accountable for achieving goals aligned with current and future business strategy.
The incumbent will directly contribute to assessing business needs, designing solutions, and implementing secure and scalable solutions to serve the Bank’s customers and grow the business. They must assist in the identification of opportunities and develop recommendations to minimize risk, improve service capability and reduce costs. They will be required to evaluate problems within their domain to provide expert advice and recommendations for course of action to senior leadership.

The Work

  • Assess business requirements for enhancements or new functions/modules under a technical and functional lens and provide relevant feedback
  • Interact with Temenos by reviewing technical and integration requirement documents as well as functional/technical specification documents
  • Communication across all levels of the Temenos organization from executive to system administrator
  • Control and Manage the life cycle of project bugs and minor enhancements/improvements
  • Assess, plan and estimate application changes in coordination with tech and business teams
  • Administration and setup of Development and Test environments of Temenos Core Banking Application.
  • Configuration, Administration & Troubleshooting of T24 multi-server high available architecture.
  • COB (Close of Business issues) troubleshooting includes Year End, Month End & Daily COB Support & COB Optimization.
  • Deploy and generate BCON packages requested by the environment manager.
  • Interface and coordinate with Temenos for technical support and any issue reported during project lifecycle
  • Project Execution – perform tasks under the directions of the Manager of IT and/or according to a project plan in a way such that the timeline of the project is observed, and the requirements of the task are satisfied.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a technical reference point for T24 with existing Agile PODs
  • Manage and communicate issues.
  • Work with internal partners (PODs) + vendors to triage and resolve issues
  • Design and develop L3 level features for T24 transact, the candidate is responsible of writing code that complies with enterprise guiding principles (i.e. performance, scalability, security) and TEMENOS coding standards.
  • Can propose, document, and align solutions through high level and detail design for various temenos layers
  • Support application rollout and upgrade initiatives and document as needed
  • Follow change control processes soup to nuts

  • Ensure solutions and delivery will meet the Bank’s needs, this includes performance, scalability and security
  • Plan and manage the technology delivery of one or more projects/ products
  • Measure, analyze, and improve delivery metrics (ex: velocities, burn downs, trends, quality, etc.), with a goal to establish continuous flow
  • Solve technical problems; remove impediments

Let's talk about you

  • Have a Bachelor or Master Degree in Computer Science
  • Have 5+ years of Temenos T24 experience
  • Have 3+ years of TAFJ

  • Have extensive knowledge and expertise of SAFe, retail modules (especially, Account Arrangement), and web service modules (including TWS, TCIB, & IRIS)
  • Preferred experience with T24 Canadian Mobile Banking
  • Preferred experience working in a Canadian banking or regulated financial services environment
  • Preferred experience in Database administration.

  • Robust understanding of Cloud deployments type and service models.
  • Good problem-solving skills.
  • The incumbent is expected to interact with everyone including executives and thus good verbal and written skills are important. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skill
  • Hands-on problem-solving skills to remove technical issues

  • Experience with Atlassian cloud (Confluence and JIRA)
What we offer [For full-time permanent roles]

✨ Market leading RRSP match program

💛 A fulfilling opportunity to join one of the top FinTechs and help create a new kind of banking experience
The incumbent will be working hybrid and in office time will be spent working from EQ Bank’s additional office space located at 2200-25 Ontario Street, Toronto, ON.
