title: Head of Information Technology
description:
The Head of Information Technology is a hands-on, business-aligned technology leader responsible for the security, reliability, and effective operation of the bank’s technology environment. The role requires strong technical depth in networking, infrastructure, and cybersecurity, together with proven supervisory experience and the ability to lead a capable team through the bank’s next stage of growth.


The Head of Information Technology will preserve the department’s strong operating foundation while strengthening resilience, cross-training, succession depth, and career development. The position will develop and execute a practical technology roadmap in partnership with the EVP – Senior IT/Operations Officer and business leaders. The Head of Technology provides practical technology leadership, sound technical advice, and disciplined execution while developing the internal team and effectively coordinating external providers to meet the bank’s evolving needs.


In addition to maintaining a secure and reliable operating environment, the Head of Information Technology will lead the practical evolution of the bank’s technology capabilities, architecture, delivery practices, and staff capacity to support organizational growth and increasing operational complexity. Modernization must be deliberate, affordable, secure, supportable, and aligned with business priorities.


Why work with us?

You can enjoy the following perks:

· Generous Paid Time Off

· Health, Dental, and Life Insurance

· Partially paid Short and Long-Term Disability

· Company-matched 401K retirement account

· Bankers’ hours

· Paid Federal Holidays


Salary: $130k - $170k / annually

title: Commercial Project Manager
description:
Commercial Project Manager

Cleveland Construction is looking to add a Commercial Project Manager to its Mentor, OH location, to serve as the primary project planner for high profile commercial construction projects across the US. This role requires minimal travel to the job sites to drive productivity and accuracy throughout the project.

Why Cleveland Construction?

Cleveland Construction is a family owned and operated National construction company specializing in general contracting, construction management, design-build, and self-performing walls and ceilings services. We operate everything through our 4 pillars: Thoroughness, Respect, Accountability, Communication.

What We Offer

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance + add-ons
  • 401k
  • Employee Discount Program
  • PTO
  • 8 Paid Holidays
  • Competitive Pay + other packages

Key Job Functions

  • Create realistic project timelines, track milestones, and manage the critical path from pre-construction to closeout.
  • Oversee project costs, manage subcontractor bids, process pay applications, and prevent budget overages.
  • Negotiate and draft contracts with general contractors, architects, engineers, and suppliers.
  • Secure necessary local building licenses and ensure strict adherence to safety regulations and building codes.
  • Act as the primary contact for clients, reporting progress updates and resolving site issues immediately.

What You Need

title: Cloud-Native Software Architect .NET
description:
Een internationale Belgische softwareontwikkelaar bouwt hun eigen innovatieve SaaS-oplossingen voor de productie industrie. Hun software helpt productiebedrijven wereldwijd om slimmer, efficiënter en meer geautomatiseerd te werken. Binnen hun Cloud development team werken ze aan een moderne, cloud-native oplossing die vanaf de basis verder wordt uitgebouwd met technologieën zoals .NET & Azure.
Daarnaast wordt er actief gewerkt met AI-tooling zoals Claude Code binnen een agentic engineering-context.
Puur ter uitbreiding en om wille van hun succes zoeken ze vandaag sterke profielen.


Jobomschrijving

Ze hebben een sterk IT-departement en jij komt terecht in een agile development subteam dat in korte sprints werkt aan moderne cloud-native software. Je neemt ownership op binnen het team en bouwt samen met software engineers, UX-designers, product managers en DevOps-profielen aan schaalbare oplossingen.
Naast hands-on development in .NET, denk je actief mee over architectuur, technische keuzes, kwaliteit en verdere productontwikkeling. Je gebruikt AI-tools om je eigen productiviteit en die van het team te verhogen, maar blijft zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en uitkomst van het werk.
Je onderzoekt nieuwe technologieën en AI-toepassingen om zowel het ontwikkelproces als de performantie van het product te verbeteren. Daarnaast werk je mee aan concrete AI-use cases binnen de software en help je het team groeien door technische richting, feedback en kennisdeling.

  • Masterdiploma in Computer Sciences, IT, Toegepaste Informatica, of gelijkaardig
  • Je hebt sterke werkervaring in .NET-ontwikkeling
  • Je bent geïnteresseerd in AI-tools
  • Je werkt in het Nederlands en het Engels

title: Maintenance Lead - Hamlin Hotel
description:
Job Summary: The Maintenance Lead ensures a well-maintained environment for residents through performing maintenance repairs and custodial care in areas including but not limited to plumbing, carpentry, and mechanical systems. This position involves extensive interaction with on-site staff and residents, as well as vendors and contractors. S/he provides direction, support, and training to maintenance and custodial staff, including assisting on the completion of work orders.

Status: Full-time, Nonexempt

Location: San Francisco

Hours: Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.; on-call for emergencies

Salary: $31.00 - 33.00 per hour; Comprehensive benefit

Schedule: Weekly Schedule. Onsite

The Organization: A private non-profit founded in 1977, Chinatown Community Development Center believes in a comprehensive vision of community. We own and/or manage approximately 30 affordable housing buildings serving over 3,800 low-income seniors, single adults, formerly homeless adults, and families of diverse ethnic and cultural backgrounds in San Francisco’s Chinatown, Tenderloin, Western Addition, and Polk Gulch neighborhoods. We also build housing, develop grassroots leadership, and engage low-income residents and youth. Our employees are passionate about the mission; thrive in a family organizational culture; and embody values of empowerment, teamwork, and compassion. Chinatown CDC serves a diverse population and is committed to hiring practices that provide culturally competent services. We encourage people of color to apply.

General Job Responsibilities:

  • Meet with Property Manager to coordinate work schedules and assignments
  • Review all work orders for completeness and accuracy
  • Perform all building repairs by responding to problems such as, but not limited to: boiler malfunctions, water leaks, sprinkler set-offs, clogged drains or pipes, broken light fixtures, floor damage, etc.
  • Assess and assign work orders to appropriate staff, including offering training or assistance to complete the task if necessary
  • Determine the scope of all maintenance projects and evaluate the need for outside vendors
  • Secure bids for rehab and maintenance work in compliance with regulatory procedures
  • Respond to exigent regulatory health and safety inspection violations
  • Responsible for planning, preparing, and executing your buildings’ Preventative Maintenance Plan
  • Set-up key and lock systems
  • Assist Property Manager with daily/weekly inspection of the common areas for safety hazards or code violations
  • Responsible for keeping accurate inventory of all tools and equipment
  • Record all serial numbers of tenant appliances according to appropriate regulatory procedures
  • Participate in rehab meeting and capital needs assessment project
  • Assist Property Managers in compiling the Maintenance budgets for the property
  • Keep maintenance work area in a safe and neat condition
  • Turn around resident units in compliance with Property Management procedures
  • Order maintenance and janitorial supplies
  • Report incident/injury that occur on or around the property
  • Accompany vendors, inspectors, and monthly pest control inspector to ensure units are in safe and clean conditions
  • Help with custodian work if needed
  • Assist in overseeing and training other Maintenance and Custodial staff
  • Supervise third party contractors/employees (e.g. custodians, landscapers, elevator service company, etc.)
  • Ensure staff knows and follows safe work practices and policies

Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

  • Ability to troubleshoot and prioritize work
  • Capacity to work independently and exercise own judgment
  • Knowledge of OSHA and CAL/OSHA and other safety and health code violations
  • Knowledge of all applicable building codes and ability to recognize building code violations
  • Basic computer skills
  • Good problem-solving skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to changing situations and work conditions
  • Ability to work with people of diverse economic, social and ethnic backgrounds
  • Good verbal and written communication skills

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Four (4) years of prior experience in maintenance/construction field
  • Experience in plumbing, carpentry, and electrical systems
  • Basic computer skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Sensitivity to issues facing homeless, disabled, elderly, family and other diverse populations
  • Prior experience in residential affordable housing
  • Familiarity with the neighborhood of the work site
  • Ability to read blue prints
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
Chinatown Community Development Center (CCDC) is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race (includes hairstyle and hair texture), color, religion (includes dress and grooming practices), age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical condition and reproductive health decision making), national origin (includes language restrictions), ancestry, citizenship, disability, medical condition (cancer or genetic characteristic), genetic information or characteristic, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or participation in an EEO protected activity or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

SAN FRANCISCO FAIR CHANCE ORDINANCE
All final candidates will undergo a background check. For certain positions this will include a fingerprint check. Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Roskilde Kommune søger 5 elever til pædagogisk assistentuddannelsen med uddannelsesstart på hovedforløbet 18. januar 2027
description:
Pædagogisk assistentelev i Roskilde Kommune

En elevplads og uddannelse hvor din faglige og personlige udvikling er i centrum Er du den elev vi søger?

Som pædagogisk assistent spiller du en vigtig rolle i børns liv og udvikling.

I Roskilde Kommune er vi på jagt efter relationstalenter, som med engagement og interesse inden for det pædagogiske felt, kan se sig selv arbejde i dagtilbud eller SFO hele deres elevtid, med børns læring, udvikling, trivsel og dannelse som omdrejningspunkt.

I Roskilde Kommune er vi optaget af stærke fællesskaber, både dem vi skaber for og med børnene, og dem som du som elev bliver en del af, ude i vores dagtilbud eller SFO’er.

Du vil efter din uddannelse kunne arbejde indenfor dagtilbud og SFO, samt med andre pædagogiske målgrupper som klub og voksen-specialområdet. Din pædagogisk assistentuddannelse vil også give dig adgang til professionsbacheloruddannelsen som pædagog.

Det får du hos os
  • Løn under uddannelse (både under oplærings - og i skoleperioden)
  • Elevforløb med en klar struktur, og med engagerede oplæringsvejledere
  • Introduktionsdag for pædagogiske assistentelever
  • I oplæringsperioden modtager du ugentligt en times vejledning med din oplæringsvejleder
  • I oplæringsperioden har du ugentligt fire fordybelsestimer
  • Faglig og administrativ support af både dagtilbud og forvaltning
De formelle krav
Du skal være i gang med og/ eller have gennemført Grundforløb 2 på ZBC rettet mod den pædagogiske assistentuddannelse, for at kunne blive ansat som elev. Det er et krav at du, når du ansættes som elev i Roskilde Kommune, tager dine skoleforløb på ZBC i Roskilde.

Du er som PA-elev omfattet af FOA´s overenskomst for pædagogmedhjælpere og pædagogiske assistenter, samt arbejdstidsaftalen for ansatte i de kommunale dagtilbud.

Du kan læse mere om uddannelsens indhold på ZBC Sjællands hjemmeside



Forventninger til dig som elev For at blive ansat som elev på den pædagogiske assistentuddannelse i Roskilde Kommune, forventer vi følgende:

  • At du er mødestabil og parat til at fokusere tid og energi på din uddannelse
  • At du både under skole og praktikforløb er indstillet på faglig og personlig udvikling
  • At du har mod på udfordringer, og er motiveret for at tage imod støtte, vejledning og nødvendige skub, når noget er svært.
  • At du er motiveret for at lære at samarbejde med mange forskellige mennesker
  • At du er nysgerrig, åben og interesseret i andre mennesker og forskellige kulturer.
  • At du har mod og lyst til at være aktiv deltager i både faglige drøftelser, såvel som leg og pædagogiske aktiviteter.
Øvrige oplysninger
Pædagogisk assistentelever ansættes med 37 timer pr. uge.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst. Der indhentes straffe- og børneattest samt (hvis muligt) referencer i forbindelse med ansættelse.
Du kan læse mere om uddannelsen til pædagogisk assistent, ansøgningsfrister og krav til optagelse her: Den pædagogiske assistentuddannelse | UddannelsesGuiden (ug.dk)

I din ansøgning vil vi bede dig begrunde, hvorfor du ønsker at uddanne dig til pædagogisk assistent.

Du bedes vedhæfte uddannelsesbeviser, udtalelser fra tidligere ansættelser, dokumentation for realkompetencevurdering hvis du er over 25 år, samt anden relevant dokumentation til din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist Vi skal modtage din ansøgning senest den 14. oktober 2026 kl.12.

Alle ansøgere får svar om, at ansøgningen er modtaget, og udvalgte ansøgere indkaldes via mail til ansættelsessamtale.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes d. 28 - 30. oktober

Yderligere oplysninger
Hvis du har behov for studievejledning, f.eks. vedr. merit og kompetenceafklaring i forbindelse med uddannelsen, skal du kontakte studievejledningen på ZBC Roskilde. Du kan læse mere om uddannelsen og optagelseskravene på ZBC´s hjemmeside

Du kan læse mere om Roskilde Kommunes dagtilbud på Roskilde Kommunes hjemmeside.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til elevstillingerne, kan du få mere information ved at kontakte dagtilbudskonsulent Anne Brun på mail: anneba@roskilde.dk eller telefon 21726823. Bemærk, at Roskilde Kommune ikke kan give studievejledning.

title: O2 - Transit System Based Outreach Specialist - Transit - Sunday-Thursday 11pm-7:30am

Outreach Specialist – Transit Homeless Outreach

Full-Time | 37.5 hours/week | Field-Based | 24/7 Program

Do Work That Actually Changes Lives

Every night, hundreds of New Yorkers sleep in the subway system. BRC’s Transit Homeless Outreach team meets them where they are—building trust and helping individuals transition into housing and stability.

As an Outreach Specialist, you’ll engage directly with individuals experiencing chronic homelessness, providing hands-on support and guidance. This role is ideal for early-career professionals pursuing social work, public health, or human services.

What You’ll Do

  • Connect clients to housing, medical, mental health, and substance use services
  • Complete brief assessments, provide escorts, and make referrals
  • Document outreach activity and client interactions
  • Work primarily at high-need areas, including end-of-line stations
  • Collaborate with partner agencies and outreach teams

What You’ll Gain

  • Hands-on experience in outreach, assessment, and housing navigation within NYC’s homeless services system
  • Training in harm reduction, trauma-informed care, and Housing First
  • Supervision, mentorship, and clear internal growth pathways
  • Tuition assistance and professional development support

Who We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Strong communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to build trust and work effectively in the field
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel across boroughs
  • Basic computer skills

Preferred:

  • Experience in outreach, social services, or behavioral health
  • Interest in working with individuals experiencing homelessness, mental illness, or substance use
  • Bilingual (Spanish, Polish, Russian, Chinese, or Korean)

Internal candidates (e.g., Community Technicians with 6+ months experience) are encouraged to apply.

Working Environment

This is a highly active, field-based role. You must be comfortable:

  • Working in transit stations, public spaces, and outdoor environments in all weather
  • Engaging individuals in crisis or with complex behavioral health needs
  • Working closely with individuals who may have limited access to hygiene and personal care and may present with unmet self-care needs
  • Standing, walking, and traveling for extended periods

Schedule

  • Full-time, 37.5 hours/week
  • Day, evening, and overnight shifts available

What We Offer

  • Medical benefits and paid sick time starting Day One
  • 3+ weeks vacation, 12 holidays, plus personal time
  • 403(b) with employer match
  • Tuition assistance and career advancement opportunities
  • A mission-driven team committed to staff wellbeing

title: Staff Optical Engineer
description:
Nova Biomedical: One Global Brand. One Vision. Together under one name.

Advanced Instruments and Nova Biomedical are now united under one brand, Nova Biomedical, marking a major milestone in our journey to deliver greater value to our customers. By combining our strengths, we're accelerating innovation, supporting critical workflows, and delivering world-class service across the biopharmaceutical and clinical markets.

Job Summary:

Nova Biomedical is seeking a Staff Optical Engineer to lead the design, development, integration, verification, and validation of optical and optical-sensing subsystems used in biomedical and diagnostic devices.

This role will provide advanced technical expertise and project-level leadership across optical imaging, spectroscopy, sensor architecture, and opto-mechanical design. The Staff Optical Engineer will collaborate across related mechanical, electrical, software, fluidic, analytical, quality, and manufacturing interfaces to support new and next-generation instrument platforms.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience developing optical subsystems from design input through prototype testing, verification, and product-development support. This individual must be able to solve complex technical problems independently while guiding cross-functional engineering contributors and less-experienced engineers.

Responsibilities:

  • Collect design inputs and translate product and system requirements into clear optical subsystem requirements.
  • Create and maintain design-output documentation for optical subsystems used in new and next-generation instrument platforms.
  • Lead or support optical subsystem architecture for imaging, spectroscopy, illumination, detection, and optical-sensing applications.
  • Define optical interfaces with mechanical, electrical, fluidic, software, disposable sensor, and analytical subsystems.
  • Design, model, prototype, characterize, and optimize optical paths, illumination and detection methods, opto-mechanical assemblies, imaging systems, and spectroscopic measurement approaches.
  • Select and evaluate optical components based on system performance, reliability, manufacturability, and product requirements.
  • Plan and execute optical testing, characterization studies, tolerance evaluations, Design of Experiments, verification protocols, and performance investigations.
  • Demonstrate through testing and analysis that optical subsystems meet established design and performance requirements.
  • Support feasibility studies, proof-of-concept builds, prototype development, and technical risk-reduction activities.

title: Overlæge til G3-sektionen for benign øvre kirurgi, Kirurgisk Afdeling A, OUH, Svendborg Sygehus
description:
En overlægestilling i G3-sektionen for benign øvre kirurgi ved Kirurgisk Afdeling A, OUH, er ledig til besættelse den 1. oktober eller efter aftale. Vi søger en speciallæge i kirurgi med brede kompetencer og erfaring inden for både åben og laparoskopisk herniekirurgi. Du skal desuden have interesse for galdekirurgi og endoskopi samt interesse og vilje til at sætte patienten først.

Kirurgisk Afdeling A er opdelt i en børnesektion G0, en øvre sektion G1, en nedre sektion G2 og en sektion for benign øvre kirurgi G3. G3-sektionen er placeret i Svendborg og består af et hernieteam og et galdevejsteam.

Svendborg Sygehus er inde i en positiv udvikling som specialsygehus, hvor Kirurgisk Afdeling A bidrager med stærke satsningsområder. I G3-sektionen satses der på robotassisteret herniekirurgi inden for afdelingens regionsfunktion samt elektiv galdevejskirurgi og ERCP.

G3-sektionen råder ugentligt over 24 anæstesibetjente lejeflader, heraf to robotlejer på den centrale operationsgang i Svendborg og seks lejer på sygehusets dagkirurgiske center. Sektionens faste speciallægebemanding består af seks overlæger og seks afdelingslæger.

Sektionen er en af Danmarks største kirurgiske enheder inden for benign galdevejs- og herniekirurgi med over 1.000 indgreb om året. Hernieteamet deltager desuden i synkronkirurgi i tæt samarbejde med de øvrige kirurgiske specialer på Odense-matriklen.

Vi søger Vi søger en overlæge med ambitioner, initiativ, høj faglighed og gode samarbejdsevner. Du er en teamplayer, som bidrager aktivt til samarbejdet med kolleger på tværs af faggrupper.

Du har fokus på at skabe flow i operationsprogrammer og patientforløb og har blik for, hvordan arbejdsgange og kapacitet kan udnyttes bedst muligt. Samtidig prioriterer du kvalitet i arbejdet og gode, sammenhængende patientforløb.

Vi vil være blandt de bedste, når det gælder uddannelse af yngre læger, efteruddannelse af kolleger og udvikling inden for det kirurgiske område. Derfor forventer vi også, at du bidrager aktivt til den faglige udvikling i sektionen og afdelingen.

I det daglige får du et tæt samarbejde med sektionslederen. Du får hovedansættelse på Svendborg Sygehus, hvor der er fire vagtlag: beredskabsvagt, bagvagt, FAM-vagt og forvagt. Stillingen er som udgangspunkt med vagt uden for tjenestedet.

Undervisning og forskning Kirurgisk Afdeling A i Svendborg deltager i studenterundervisningen ved Syddansk Universitet og modtager hvert semester medicin- og farmacistuderende, som deltager i både dagtjeneste og vagtarbejde.

Til Svendborg-matriklen er knyttet et undervisningslektorat, et klinisk forskningslektorat og to professorater ved Syddansk Universitet. Forskningsaktiviteten i afdelingen er i vækst, og der er gode muligheder for at blive involveret i klinisk forskning.

Som ansat på en universitetsafdeling forventer vi, at du tager initiativ til forskning og udvikling inden for herniekirurgien og aktivt søger deltagelse i relevante nationale og internationale herniestudier. Afdelingens forskningsenhed, FEK, tilbyder råd og vejledning i forbindelse med disse aktiviteter.

Stillingen er noget for dig, hvis du er interesseret i:
  • At få indflydelse på den fortsatte udvikling af det herniekirurgiske område
  • At arbejde med både åben og laparoskopisk herniekirurgi
  • At bidrage inden for galdekirurgi og endoskopi
  • At igangsætte herniekirurgiske forskningsprojekter
  • At få mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling gennem deltagelse i relevante kurser, møder og kongresser
  • At blive en del af en ambitiøs kirurgisk afdeling, hvor udvikling, høj faglig kvalitet, uddannelse, samarbejde og arbejdsmiljø prioriteres højt
Løn- og ansættelsesforhold Løn- og ansættelsesforhold følger gældende overenskomst mellem Regionernes Lønnings- og Takstnævn og Foreningen af Speciallæger. Stillingen er omfattet af ”Aftale om udmøntningsgaranti af nye midler til lokal løndannelse”.

Oplysninger om startlønnen for stillingen, herunder grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension, fremgår af Overlæger – overenskomst 33.04.1 – løn pr. 1.4.2026.

Ud over startlønnen kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen samt dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer. Læs mere her: Startløn for stillinger i Region Syddanmark.

Ved fastansættelse indhentes børneattest og reference efter aftale.

Ansøgningsfrist og samtaler Ansøgningsfristen er 30.september 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt i uge 41.

Ansøgeren bedes i ansøgningen forholde sig til de syv kompetenceområder: medicinsk ekspertise, kommunikation, samarbejde, ledelse/administration, sundhedsfremme, akademiker og professionel. Kvalifikationerne inden for områderne skal så vidt muligt dokumenteres.

Overlægebedømmelsen sker på baggrund af en vurdering af dine kompetencer inden for hver af de syv roller. Du skal udfylde skemaet til bedømmelse og vedhæfte det til din ansøgning.

Skemaet findes her: Lægefaglig bedømmelse af overlæger.

title: Junior Linux Administrator
description:
Job ID: 9477
Date Posted: September 15, 2026

Space Dynamics Laboratory (SDL) is seeking a Linux Systems Administrator to support the operation, maintenance, and provisioning of Linux systems across the organization. This position will initially focus heavily on on-premises Linux administration, including system patching, user and group management, system provisioning, and general troubleshooting. The selected candidate may also provide application and end-user support as needed.
This is a growth-oriented position intended to develop broader Linux administration skills over time, including increased ownership of Linux infrastructure and eventual support of Linux workloads in Azure Government/GCC High environments. This position is on-site in North Logan, UT and may support both connected and air-gapped environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Performs routine patching, updates, and maintenance of Linux systems
  • Provisions and configures new Linux servers and virtual machines
  • Manages Linux user accounts, groups, permissions, and access
  • Monitors system health and troubleshoots operating system, service, storage, and performance issues
  • Supports RHEL, Rocky Linux, and Ubuntu systems
  • Assists with Linux application installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and ongoing support
  • Performs routine system administration tasks including service management, log review, filesystem management, and configuration changes
  • Assists with vulnerability remediation and system hardening activities
  • Maintains accurate system configurations and technical documentation
  • Provides support for virtualized Linux systems
  • Works with senior administrators and engineers to troubleshoot issues and implement infrastructure changes
  • Participates in scheduled after-hours maintenance windows and responds to occasional after-hours system issues or call-ins
  • Develops skills supporting Linux workloads in Azure Government/GCC High environments
Required Qualifications
  • Must have 1+ years of professional Linux administration, IT infrastructure, technical support, or closely related experience and a bachelor’s degree or an additional 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree
  • Working knowledge of Linux system administration fundamentals
  • Experience or demonstrated ability with Linux patching, software/package management, and system maintenance
  • Experience managing Linux users, groups, permissions, and access
  • Familiarity with provisioning and configuring Linux systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot Linux operating system and application issues
  • Ability to work in both connected and air-gapped environments
  • Must be a U.S. citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance
  • Valid CompTIA Security+ certification (or equivalent) is required or must be obtained within 30 days of hire
  • Must be able to support scheduled after-hours maintenance and occasional call-ins
  • Must be able to travel as needed (not a normal expectation)
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field
  • Experience with RHEL, Rocky Linux, and/or Ubuntu
  • Linux+, RHCSA, or other relevant Linux certification
  • Experience with Bash, Python, Ansible, or other scripting and automation tools
  • Familiarity with Azure and Linux workloads hosted in Azure Government/GCC High
  • Familiarity with VMware or other virtualization platforms
  • Understanding of basic networking concepts including DNS, TCP/IP, routing, ports, and firewall rules
  • Experience with Linux security hardening, vulnerability remediation, or DoW security requirements
  • Familiarity with Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, or other container technologies
  • Experience supporting applications or end users in a Linux environment
  • Background supporting CMMC, NIST 800-53, or similar compliance frameworks
*Salary Range
  • $68,000 - $97,000
    • Salary commensurate on education and relevant experience


This range serves as a general guideline and may vary based on factors such as role, level, location, market conditions, and individual qualifications, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The range displayed in the job advertisement reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries across all U.S. locations. Specific salary details for a candidate’s preferred location can be provided by the recruiter or HR manager during the hiring process.

Why Join SDL?
*SDL offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. Visit our Benefits Page to learn more about what we offer.

SDL delivers advanced multi-domain solutions to protect national security and enable scientific discovery. Our expertise in satellites, sensors and instruments, ground systems and data processing, and autonomous systems plays a critical role in missions supporting NASA and the Department of Defense. Join our team of engineers, scientists, technicians, and business professionals in our seventh decade of delivering mission success.

At SDL, we strive to uphold a culture of respect, collaboration, empowerment, and accountability. We listen with open minds, seek to understand diverse perspectives, and engage in thoughtful dialogue. We work together by sharing knowledge, involving others, and offering support. We trust and empower our team members to take ownership, act with integrity, and be accountable. Above all, we deliver on our commitments to each other and to our mission partners.

The application window for this position is expected to remain open for approximately 7 days; however, it may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. We encourage interested candidates to submit their applications promptly.

For questions, assistance, or accommodation with the application process or the DoD SkillBridge program, please contact employment@sdl.usu.edu.

title: Servicetekniker - Lantmännen Maskin AB i Bollnäs
description:
Om tjänsten

Den här tjänsten är en direktrekrytering vilket innebär att rekryteringsprocessen sker genom Bravura och du anställs direkt hos Lantmännen Maskin.

Om företaget

Lantmännen är ett lantbrukskooperativ och norra Europas ledande aktör inom lantbruk, maskin, bioenergi och livsmedel. De ägs av 18 000 svenska lantbrukare, har 10 000 anställda, har verksamheter i ett 20-tal länder och omsätter 60 miljarder SEK på årsbasis. Med basen i spannmål förädlar de åkermarkens resurser för ett livskraftigt lantbruk. Några av deras mest kända varumärken inom livsmedel är AXA, Bonjour, Kungsörnen, GoGreen, Gooh, FINN CRISP, Korvbrödsbagarn och Hatting. Företaget är grundat på kunskap och värderingar som har funnits i generationer hos deras ägare. Genom forskning, utveckling och verksamhet i hela värdekedjan tar de tillsammans ansvar från jord till bord. Läs gärna mer på www.lantmannen.se.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som servicetekniker hos Lantmännen Maskin får du ett omväxlande arbete där ingen dag är den andra lik. Du ansvarar för service och felsökning av entreprenad- och lantbruksmaskiner – både i verkstaden och ute hos kund. Här erbjuds du stor variation och möjligheten att arbeta med starka, välkända varumärken, vilket innebär auktoriserad service och support.

Du blir en del av ett mindre, sammansvetsat team med hög kompetens och ett genuint engagemang för maskiner, service och nöjda kunder. Våra uppdragsgivare är allt från stora entreprenadföretag till lantbrukare, kommuner och privatpersoner – och du blir en viktig del i att skapa värde för dem.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

  • Utföra grundläggande service enligt protokoll (olja, filter, växellådor m.m.)

  • Felsökning med dator och tolkning av felkoder

  • Reparation och underhåll av lantbruksmaskiner som traktorer, skördetröskor och redskap

  • Användning av datorbaserade diagnosverktyg och dokumentation

  • Kundkontakt och samarbete med verkmästare, platschef och teknisk support

Utbildning, erfarenhet och personliga egenskaper

  • Erfarenhet av liknande arbete, exempelvis mekaniker. Meriterande inom jordbruk/lantbruk

  • Har grundläggande datorkunskaper

  • B-körkort

Du erbjuds ett öppet och prestigelöst arbetsklimat där du har kul på jobbet. Initialt får du en gedigen introduktion och utbildningar via bland annat Volvo där du får möjlighet att utvecklas inom avancerad felsökning. Dina personliga egenskaper är viktigast!

🔧 Tekniskt intresserad – Du gillar att förstå hur saker fungerar och tycker om att skruva, felsöka och hitta lösningar.

✅ Noggrann och ansvarsfull – Du arbetar metodiskt och dokumenterar ditt arbete på ett tydligt sätt. Du tar ansvar för din arbetstid och står för det du gör – kunderna betalar för din tid och ska känna förtroende.

🧠 Lärvillig – Du vill utvecklas och är inte rädd för att fråga när du stöter på något nytt. Du får kontinuerlig utbildning och stöttning.

🗣️ Social och serviceinriktad – Du kommer att ha kontakt med både kunder och kollegor, så det är viktigt att du är lyhörd, trevlig och har god kommunikationsförmåga.

🧹 Ordningsam – Du håller rent omkring dig och ser till att arbetsbil och arbetsplats är i gott skick. Det ger ett proffsigt intryck – både internt och externt.

👥 Lagspelare – I ett litet men sammansvetsat team där alla hjälper varandra. Det är högt i tak och en god stämning, vilket alla behöver bidrar till.

🚗 Självständig – Du förväntas kunna utföra servicearbeten självständigt. Samtidigt vet du när det är dags att be om hjälp.

Övrig information

Start: Omgående Plats: Bollnäs eller närliggande ort Lön: Enligt överenskommelse

Vi använder en kompetensbaserad metodik i alla rekryteringsprocesser för att säkerställa fördomsfria urval. Vi jobbar också med löpande urval, vilket innebär att vi tar ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har ansökt. Om du blir aktuell för tjänsten kommer vi att kontakta dig för en första telefonintervju. Oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte så kommer du att få återkoppling på din ansökan.

Har du frågor? Hör gärna av dig!

📧 info@bravura.se

📞 010-171 47 10

Vi rekommenderar att du skickar in din ansökan omgående då vi gör ett löpande urval.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Københavns Kommunes Musikskole søger underviser til Kildevældsskolen
description:
Københavns Kommunes Musikskole har indgået en aftale med Kildevældsskolen om at starte musiktilbud op på skolen og være med til at styrke skolens musikprofil.

I første omgang starter vi efter efterårsferien med tilbud til 0. og 1. klasse samt spirekor.

Derfor søger vi en underviser til

  • Musik og Bevægelse – 0. klasse
  • Musikalsk Værksted – 1. klasse
  • Spirekor – 2. og 3. klasse
Efter sommerferien forventer vi desuden, at kunne oprette et juniorkor fra 4. klasse, hvilket også vil kunne indgå i stillingen. Efter aftale og med eventuelle tilmeldinger nok vil juniorkoret kunne opstartes eventuelt før. Juniorkoret vil ligge samme dag i forlængelse af de øvrige tre hold.

Vær med til at bygge noget nyt op
Det er en god mulighed for at være med til at styrke den stærke musikkultur på skole, og være med til at bygge et stærkt fællesskab op.

Kildevældsskolen har allerede OrkesterMester på specialsporet og AKS – Alle Kan Synge fra 0. til 4. klasse som en del af skemaet og deres musikprofil. Senere på skoleåret starter vi også op med instrumentundervisningstilbud.

Der er derfor gode muligheder for at være med fra begyndelsen og skabe sammenhæng mellem musikskolens tilbud og de musikaktiviteter, der allerede findes på skolen.

I forhold til dine kompetencer og erfaring forventer vi, at du har

  • Relevant musikfaglig uddannelse helst fra musikkonservatorium eller anden uddannelsesinstitution på tilsvarende niveau.
  • Undervisningserfaring fra musikskole eller lignende.
  • Lyst til at indgå i et forpligtende samarbejde med skolens ledelse, lærere og øvrigt personale.
Tid og timetal
Undervisningen ligger tirsdage ca. kl. 13.00-16.15. Når juniorkoret kommer til, vil dagen være frem til ca. kl. 17.10.

Stillingen udgør resten af dette skoleår: 209 timer – svarende til 5,9/37 (når juniorkoret oprettes er det tilsvarende: 271 timer - 7,7/37).

Ansættelsesvilkår
Tiltrædelse den 20. oktober 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst for musikskolelærere og indenfor rammerne af lokal løndannelse.

I forbindelse med ansættelsen indhenter vi børne- og straffeattest og tager referencer.

Yderligere oplysninger
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte musikskoleleder Jens Seneberg Nielsen på 24 88 98 86 eller mail:U35X@kk.dk.

Send gerne en kortfattet motiveret ansøgning, når du søger stillingen.

Søg via linket senest onsdag den 30. september 2026

title: Stonecroft Group Mobilizer
description:
Primary Position Responsibilities: The Group Mobilizer strengthens and expands Stonecroft’s Gospel-sharing ministry by helping launch and support volunteer-led groups, coordinating the rollout of Outreach programs and resources, and serving as a key connection between group leaders, volunteers, and Home Office. This role provides guidance, communication, field support, and collaboration to ensure groups are equipped, aligned with Stonecroft’s strategic plan, and effective in advancing the mission of evangelism. This position requires a minimum of 4 nationwide trips per year to work with Outreach groups and at least 8 days per year for bi-annual All Staff Gatherings.

Reports to: Director of Outreach

Classification: Exempt, Full time Remote

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Mobilizes the opening of new group initiatives in alignment with Stonecroft’s Strategic plan.
  • Oversees the effective coordination and national rollout of Outreach programs, projects, and resources for the advancement of the ministry. Leads the planning and implementation of specific outreach programs/projects with key volunteers.
  • Uses discernment and ministry tools to support the start of a new group through discussion around community needs, leader capacity, and prayer in collaboration with the Stonecroft volunteer structure.
  • Sets reasonable expectations for Stonecroft groups regarding National Office support and serves as a liaison for questions, concerns, and ideas between volunteers and National Office as necessary.
  • Collaborates with the MarCom team to provide groups with streamlined, nationally branded content and resources.
  • Arranges regular communication of programmatic updates, policies, and procedures to appropriate groups and key leaders.
  • Travels to work with groups in the field to ensure new programs are rolled out effectively.
  • Works alongside the Director of Outreach to develop and execute annual goals and budgets that support the ministry’s strategic plan.
  • Analyzes, monitors, and evaluates the effectiveness of the current Stonecroft Group mission alignment. Adjust approaches and process to scale appropriately.
  • Collaborates with the Outreach Team in circumstances where additional training and/or mentoring needs to occur.
  • Serves as a representative of Stonecroft at events as needed, including but not limited to speaking at key events as approved by supervisor.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Passion for seeing others begin a relationship with God through Jesus Christ and grow in that relationship
  • Demonstrated commitment to evangelism
  • Bachelor's degree or higher preferred
  • Experience galvanizing a group of people towards an established mission and vision.
  • 2+ years of experience in a non-profit setting
  • 2+ years of experience working with volunteers
  • Intermediate knowledge of Word, Excel, Teams, and Outlook, and ability to quickly learn new computer software
  • Committed to delegation and teamwork.
  • Takes initiative to be self-directed and self-motivated in job related tasks.
  • Strong team-building skills
  • Follows policies and procedures stated in the Stonecroft Staff Handbook.

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Employee will be at a computer up to 10 hours per workday.

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
About Fusemachines

Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services provider. Founded by Sameer Maskey Ph.D., Adjunct Associate Professor at Columbia University, Fusemachines has a core mission of democratizing AI. With a presence in 4 countries (Nepal, the United States, Canada, and the Dominican Republic) and more than 450 full-time employees, Fusemachines brings global AI expertise to transform companies worldwide. Founded in 2013, Fusemachines is a global provider of enterprise AI products and services, on a mission to democratize AI. Leveraging proprietary AI Studio and AI Engines, the company helps drive the clients’ AI Enterprise Transformation, regardless of where they are in their Digital AI journeys. With offices in North America, Asia, and Latin America, Fusemachines provides a suite of enterprise AI offerings and specialty services that allow organizations of any size to implement and scale AI. Fusemachines serves companies in industries such as retail, manufacturing, and government.

Fusemachines continues to actively pursue the mission of democratizing AI for the masses by providing high-quality AI education in underserved communities and helping organizations achieve their full potential with AI.

Type: Remote, Full-time

Role Summary
We are hiring a Senior MLOps Engineer to design, automate, deploy, monitor, and govern production machine learning systems on Azure. The role requires deep expertise in Azure Databricks, MLflow, Databricks Feature Engineering, Azure Machine Learning, PySpark, CI/CD, containerization, and cloud-native software engineering.
The successful candidate will partner with Data Scientists and Data Engineers teams to operationalize machine learning solutions, establish MLOps standards, and build scalable, reliable, secure, and compliant ML platforms. This role focuses on productionization, deployment automation, model lifecycle management, observability, governance, and platform engineering, rather than model development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end MLOps workflows for model training, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and retirement.
  • Productionize data science assets by converting notebooks and prototypes into modular, testable, deployable Python packages and services.
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for machine learning models, feature pipelines, and data products.
  • Implement model lifecycle management using MLflow, including experiment tracking, model registry, approval workflows, versioning, and rollback.
  • Develop and maintain feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature assets using Databricks Feature Engineering and Delta Lake.
  • Deploy and operate batch, streaming, and real-time inference workloads using Databricks Model Serving, Azure Machine Learning, and Kubernetes-based platforms.
  • Establish automated testing, validation, and release processes for ML code, data, features, and models.
  • Implement model monitoring and observability for service health, latency, model performance, drift detection, and operational reliability.
  • Ensure governance, security, lineage, auditability, and access controls through Unity Catalog and Azure security services.
  • Optimize ML platforms and workloads for scalability, reliability, performance, and cloud cost efficiency.
  • Define and promote MLOps best practices, engineering standards, and platform architecture across teams.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the Organization
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

About the Role

Redhorse Corporation is seeking a Data Scientist to support Condition-Based Maintenance Plus (CBM+) initiatives to enhance aircraft sustainment and optimize maintenance and logistics efficiency. The Data Scientist will help provide quality data and develop predictive maintenance and logistics forecasting models to support decision-making tools for program-wide initiatives serving U.S. Air Force (USAF) stakeholders.

This role involves working within cross-functional teams in an Agile development environment. We operate in a fast-paced, evolving domain, and are seeking creative, motivated, and talented individuals who are eager to learn, grow, and deliver effective, high-impact solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support CBM+ program initiatives from inception to deployment, ensuring alignment with overarching business and mission objectives.
  • Oversee end-to-end data collection and processing, including the implementation, sustainment, and optimization of ETL pipelines.
  • Perform Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), statistical analysis, and data visualization to identify trends, correlations, and actionable insights that drive product development.
  • Build and maintain knowledge graph capabilities.
  • Collaborate with multi-functional engineering teams to integrate trained models into production applications and APIs.
  • Continuously monitor data quality and model performance to detect and mitigate drift and degradation.

Required Qualifications

  • Active U.S. Government Secret Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship required; applicants without an active Secret Clearance cannot be considered).
  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) field or proven equivalent professional experience.
  • NLP Experience: 2+ years of experience incorporating applied Natural Language Processing (NLP), data labeling, and entity or keyword extraction.
  • Analytics & Data Engineering: Proven proficiency with Databricks, PySpark, SQL, data governance frameworks, and technical documentation standards.
  • Statistical Foundations: Deep understanding and practical application of statistical distributions for data assessment, data analysis, and predictive modeling.
  • Collaboration & Self-Direction: Demonstrated self-starter capabilities with strong interpersonal skills to foster positive stakeholder relationships and execute tasks independently.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical findings for non-technical and executive audiences.
  • Tools: Experience with project management and productivity platforms including Jira, Confluence, Lucidchart, and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Experience with data end products such as Qlik Sense, Streamlit and other visualization or dashboard tools.
  • Travel: Ability to travel, minimal, as needed to engage with government customers and project stakeholders.
  • Growth: Possess a desire to learn and advance skills in the aviation data space.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a STEM field, with a preference for Data Science, Data Analytics, or Computer Science.
  • Advanced expertise in applying artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) to predictive maintenance and defense logistics challenges.
  • Direct experience developing sensor-based failure prediction models and equipment health indicators.
  • Practical experience conducting Monte Carlo simulations and calculating statistical confidence intervals.
  • Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end data pipeline engineering including customer-facing UI/UX integration.
The salary range provided for this position represents the anticipated base salary for successful candidates. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, security clearance level, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in Redhorse's comprehensive benefits programs and may be eligible for performance-based or other incentive compensation, where applicable.

title: Brænder du for ledelse af medarbejdere, og har du lyst til at sætte retning på børne- og familieområdet, så har du muligheden for at blive teamleder for et fantastisk team.
description:
Vi søger en teamleder, der har lyst til at indgå i et tæt samarbejde med vores dedikerede medarbejdere og ledere på børne- og familieområdet i Børneteam Nord, hvor målgruppen er børn på 3-14 år samt deres familier. Stillingen er på 37 timer og ønskes besat fra 1. december 2026.

Vores afdeling består af følgende teams:

  • Handicap- og underretningsteamet
  • Familieplejespecialet
  • Tværgående Team
  • Spæd- og småbørnsteamet (0-3 år)
  • Børneteam Syd (3-14 år)
  • Børneteam Nord (3-14 år)
  • Ungeteamet (15-22 år).

Børneteam Nords primære opgave er, med baggrund i Barnets Lov, at udarbejde screeninger, afdækninger, børnefaglige undersøgelser og Barnets planer. Teamet iværksætter forebyggende og støttende indsatser, sikrer opfølgning og har et stort fokus på inddragelse af barnet og familien samt familiens private og professionelle netværk. Vi anvender DUBU som IT- fagsystem, og dermed også ICS som socialfaglig systematik i sagsbehandlingen.

I Børneteam Nord er du aldrig alene med opgaverne. Vi har en kultur, hvor vi ser hinanden, og hvor omsorg for kollegaerne er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Hvis din dag er presset, står der altid en klar til at hjælpe, og vi gør meget ud af at give hinanden rygstøtte. Som team tror vi på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når der er højt til loftet og plads til det hele menneske. Vores faglige fællesskab er stærkt, og vi sparrer flittigt på tværs for at spille hinanden gode. Men vi vægter det sociale mindst lige så højt. Kort sagt kan du se frem til et team med stor tillid til hinanden og oprigtig hjælpsomhed.

Vi søger en teamleder med en grunduddannelse som socialrådgiver/socialformidler og en stærk socialfaglighed fra myndighedsarbejdet med børnesager, idet du skal kunne sætte tydelig faglig retning - også når det er svært og komplekst. Du skal dermed kunne understøtte medarbejderne, når de arbejder med de mest indgribende indsatser – herunder tvangsmæssige anbringelser og den skriftlige og faglige kvalitet dette kalder på.

Afdelingens lederteam arbejder tæt sammen, og består af 5 teamledere og en afdelingsleder. Lederteamets fornemmeste opgave er at sikre udviklingen og driften af afdelingen som helhed samt at være rollemodel ift. at lykkes med et tæt, tværgående samarbejde med alle relevante aktører omkring os.

Vores kerneopgave lyder: ”Sammen skaber vi trivsel, udvikling og læring for børn og unge med funktionsnedsættelser samt for børn og unge, der er socialt udsatte samt for deres familier”.

I Hjørring kommune er vi meget optaget af, at vi kun kan lykkes med kerneopgaveløsningen i et samarbejde mellem de fagprofessionelle, børnene, de unge, familierne og civilsamfundet. Så dette prioriterer vi meget højt, og vi har i særdeleshed et tæt og kontinuerligt tværgående samarbejde med vores udfører-område mhp. at sikre progression i indsatserne, eller alternativt at vælge andre løsninger, så vi i videst muligt omfang overholder vores serviceniveau. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du som teamleder går foran i disse tværgående samarbejder.


Vi søger en teamleder, som kan nikke ja til en god del af disse forhold:

  • Du har ikke nødvendigvis formel ledelseserfaring, men er optaget af ledelse som fag, og du kan lide at gå foran og lede processer på individ- og gruppe-niveau.
  • Du værdsætter personaleledelse, er optaget af at udvikle dine medarbejdere, og har løbende fokus på at videreudvikle og løfte teamet som helhed.
  • Du har altid kerneopgaven for øje, og sætter en tydelig og faglig ambitiøs retning i arbejdet med børn, unge og familier, og støtter medarbejderne gennem faglig sparring og vejledning.
  • Du kan analysere, vurdere og sætte retning for de mest komplekse sager.
  • Du er en teamplayer, og kan bidrage til et stærkt organisatorisk og fagligt fællesskab – både internt i afdelingen og på tværs af afdelinger, sektorer mv.
  • Du sikrer lovmedholdelighed, har overblik og er systematisk i dit daglige arbejde.

Som teamleder er din rolle derudover, at:

  • Understøtte, at medarbejderne lykkes med deres opgaver.
  • Sikre sammenhæng mellem høj faglighed i sagerne og ansvarlig økonomisk drift.
  • Følge op på lovmedholdelighed og faglig kvalitet i sagerne gennem hyppige sagsgennemgange og ledelsestilsyn.
  • Gennemføre MUS og andre samtaler, der bidrager til medarbejdernes faglige udvikling.
  • Afholde teammøder, der engagerer og motiverer medarbejderne til følgeskab og faglig udvikling.
  • Tage ansvar for trivslen og det gode arbejdsmiljø.
  • Bidrage til at sikre sammenhængskraft på tværs af teams og opgaver i den samlede afdeling og være konstruktiv samarbejdspartner for eget og andre teams.
  • Deltage åbent og nysgerrigt i lederudvikling og tværgående samarbejder.

Hos os kan du forvente:

  • At vi tager godt imod dig og introducerer dig grundigt til teamlederstillingen – bl.a. ved at få en mentor fra lederteamet.
  • At vi er fagligt engagerede, og har fokus på tillid, dialog og arbejdsglæde.
  • Faglig og ledelsesmæssig sparring og evt. lederuddannelse på diplomniveau samt ledelses-aktiviteter og -udvikling på tværs af fagområder/sektorer.
  • En kultur, hvor arbejdsmiljø og trivsel tages alvorligt på både medarbejder- og lederniveau.
  • At få et godt indblik i lederkollegers personprofiler, som vi bruger konstruktivt i tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdet og udviklingen af lederteamet.
  • Gode rammer for faglig og personlig udvikling.
  • Høj grad af frihed under ansvar - fx i forhold til fleksibel arbejdstilrettelæggelse under hensyntagen til kerneopgaven.
Værdier og retning for et fællesskabende børne- og familieområde

title: Senior Visual Brand Designer
description:
About Tala
Tala is AI-native credit infrastructure for the global majority, combining proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. Backed by more than $500 million in funding, Tala has distributed more than $7 billion in capital to more than 13 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia—building one of the most robust datasets on thin-file borrowers anywhere in the world. We are looking for daring, data-driven leaders passionate about building the trust and credit infrastructure for the global majority.
Our pioneering work and proven impact have earned us consistent recognition, including being named to:
CNBC’s Disruptor 50 for five years.
CNBC’s World's Top Fintech Companies for two consecutive years.
Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for nine consecutive years.
Visionary investors, persuaded by the economic power of the global majority, have committed half a billion dollars in equity and debt to Tala's success.
Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.
Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

About the Role

We're looking for a Visual Brand Designer with strong creative flair to help shape how Tala looks, feels, and shows up in the world. You'll translate business strategy and brand attributes into a cohesive, compelling brand identity and systems, owning everything from logo, color, and typography to photographic and illustration style. This role is pivotal to maintaining brand integrity across our organization and ensuring every touchpoint reflects a consistent, intentional visual identity.

Working closely with our Marketing and Strategy teams, you'll bring creative concepts to life by translating brand guidelines into pixel-perfect, engaging visual assets across digital marketing, campaign creative, and social channels.

Please also include a link to your portfolio when you apply.

What You'll Do

  • Manage an established global brand identity by continually elevating our visual design systems, standards and guidelines plus incorporating new sub brand architectures.

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to produce visual design creative, including icons, animated GIFs/videos, and illustrations, or digital marketing campaigns across all channels: ads, social media, email, and more.

  • Serve as a steward of brand integrity, ensuring consistency and quality across every team and touchpoint that represents Tala.

  • Design and deliver a wide range of creative assets while maintaining consistency with brand and style guidelines.

  • Use data and performance learnings to inform the creative process and sharpen final designs.

  • Generate fresh creative ideas, inspire your teammates, and give and receive feedback with respect and openness.

  • Self-manage across multiple deadlines and priorities, keeping projects moving forward independently.

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design, animation, or illustration.

  • Proven command of design principles, typography, color theory, and conceptual thinking.

  • Track record of managing brand identity and designing visual systems, experience with technology brands highly favored.

  • International experience preferred, either working on a US brand or regional multinational brands where you have translated ideas and design across cultures.

  • Strong skills in graphic design, plus either 2D animation or illustration.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator.

  • An exceptional portfolio showcasing refined design and typographic sensibility.

  • Experience working with consumer brands, and business to business, either in-house or at an advertising agency.

  • Deep customer empathy and a strong sense of how design decisions impact people.

  • Comfortable with Slack, Jira, and Google Workspace, across timezones managing key relationships in the Americas.

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience. We hire talented people regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Overlæger ved Afdeling for Transplantation og Sygdomme i Fordøjelsessystemet, C i fagområdet Hepato-, pancreato-, billiær Kirurgi (HPB) med specialist område i organtransplantation eller ekspertkompetencer i HPB kirurgi
description:
Ved Afdeling for Transplantation og Sygdomme i Fordøjelsessystemet, C, Center for Kræft Organsygdomme Rigshospitalet, Inge Lehmannsvej, 2100 København Ø er 1-2 stillinger som overlæge ledig til besættelse snarest.

Stillingerne er overlægestillinger i fagområdet hepato-pancreato-billiær kirurgi (HPB-kirurgi) i specialistområdet levertransplantation. For at være kvalificeret til stillingen skal man kunne foretage multiorganudtagning og indsætning af lever, samt kunne forestå det samlede behandlingsforløb i dets initiale faser fra beslutning om transplantation til recipienten er i stabil fase. Ansøgere der er certificeret i HPB kirurgi og selvstændigt er i stand til at varetage avanceret lever-, pancreas og galdevejskirurgi kan også komme i betragtning. International certificering i transplantation og HPB vil blive vægtet som kvalificerende.

Der gennemføres årligt multidisciplinær vurdering af ca. 5000 HPB-Patienter og udføres årligt ca. 50 levertransplantationer, ca. 150 leverresektioner og 200 pancreasresektioner. Hertil kommer, at ca. 50 patienter vurderes for hilært kolangiokarcinom, hvoraf ca. 20 opereres. Der udføres desuden et varierende antal operationer efter iatrogene galdevejslæsioner, ca. 10 årligt. En stigende andel af afdelingens operationer udføres robot-assisteret (ca. 25% af HPB-indgrebene), og færdigheder på dette område kan tilegnes i afdelingen og er også under overvejelse i forbindelse med en øget brug af levende relaterede donorer som led i levertransplantation.

Ca. 1000 cancerpatienter med svulster i spiserør, overgangszone og mavesæk vurderes og ca. 150 multiopererede patienter med følger efter abdominale katastrofer. Sarkomer, GIST og NET-tumorer tilhører nogle af de mere sjældne tumorformer, som også varetages af afdelingen. Hertil kommer deltagelse i den kirurgiske behandling af traume patienter.

Samarbejdet er ikke alene tværfagligt men også betydeligt mellem de lægefaglige specialer, hvorfor gode samarbejdsevner vægtes meget højt. Som et permanent led i dette skal ansøger bidrage til optimering og kvalitetssikring af Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) forløb i samarbejde med HPB-team, anæstesiologer, samt både medicinske og kirurgiske sygeplejersker.

Du vil blive tilknyttet et sengeafsnit for organsvigt, hvor patienterne overvejende vil være patienter i transplantationsforløb eller med akutte og kroniske organsvigt i fordøjelsessystemet. Ved overvejende kvalifikationer i HPB-området vil der være en initial tilknytning til vores afsnit for organkirurgi. Det tværfaglige samarbejde, ikke kun mellem specialer og fagligheder, tillægges stor vægt og er af afgørende betydning for behandling, uddannelse, forskning og innovationen i afdelingen.

Klinikken råder også over en avanceret endoskopifunktion, hvor færdigheder i ERCP og EUL er et kvalifikationsparameter.

Stillingen er forbundet med vagtforpligtigelse indenfor transplantationsområdet, overvejende i forbindelse med levertransplantation og multiorgan-udtagelse. Foreligger kvalifikationer overvejende indenfor HPB vil oplæring i transplantation med fokus på organudtagning kunne finde sted. Sidstnævnte finder sted lidt hyppigere end transplantationerne. Herunder vil du skulle medvirke til at udbrede DCD-forløb på andre hospitaler i DK.

Vi tilbyder et spændende job, hvor du kommer til at fungere på lige fod med afdelingens øvrige overlæger og kan bidrage til udviklingen indenfor alle aspekter af transplantationsområdet og HPB-kirurgien herunder evt. i opbygningen af den minimalt invasive robotassisterede kirurgi indenfor de øvre cancere.

Afdelingen har initieret et nationalt samarbejde gennem UNI-5 og internationalt gennem Nordic University Hospital Alliance for langsigtet at imødegå uddannelses- og kvalitetsudvikling på højrisiko- lav-volumen områder.

Hovedansvarsområdet vil i sagens natur være indenfor transplantationer og HPB, men den pågældende overlæge skal sammen med afdelingens øvrige speciallæger bidrage til undersøgelse og behandling af patienter, som i øvrigt henvises til afdelingen.

Ansøgeren skal være speciallæge i kirurgi eller kirurgisk gastroenterologi og ved bedømmelse af ansøgeren vil der udover bred klinisk erfaring blive lagt vægt på forskningserfaring samt nyligt publicerede artikler indenfor transplantations- og HPB-området.

Afdelingen har en præ- og postgraduat uddannelsesforpligtigelse for læger og andre personalegrupper, og ansøgeren skal derfor være villig til at deltage i både præ- og postgraduat undervisning af såvel læger som sygeplejersker.

Stillings- og funktionsbeskrivelse samt nærmere afdelingsbeskrivelse kan fås ved henvendelse til cheflæge, Jens Hillingsø, telefon: 35 45 87 80 eller Chefsygeplejerske, Trine Toft Lundbye, telefon: 35 45 10 46. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelsen, at der kan dokumenteres kompetencer indenfor de 7 lægeroller. Stillingen (erne) er ledige til besættelse snarest. Ansøgningsfrist er den 20.10.2026.

title: Director, Access Enablement
description:
Director, Access Enablement

General Job Summary:

The Director, Access Enablement is responsible for building and governing the systems, capabilities, standards, and partnerships that enable Tryon Medical Partners to deliver scalable patient access. This role translates enterprise access priorities into an integrated enablement roadmap spanning access technology, digital access, automation, workforce enablement, clinician ramp and capacity, and performance infrastructure.

The Director leads through others and is accountable for the enablement ecosystem rather than day-to-day Access Operations or day-to-day technology configuration. The role owns strategic vendor relationships, roadmap and investment priorities, governance, implementation accountability, and cross-functional alignment across Patient Access, Clinical Access, Operations, IT/Infrastructure, and external partners.

This role is not eligible for full-time remote work. Candidates must be onsite 100% during onboarding to ensure a strong start. The potential to transition to a hybrid schedule may be considered.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

Strategy, Roadmap & Governance
  • Own the Patient Access enablement strategy, roadmap, priorities, and outcomes, ensuring alignment with enterprise access goals.
  • Establish standards, governance, decision rights, and operating frameworks for access technology, digital access, automation, workforce enablement, clinician ramp, and related capabilities.
  • Identify structural barriers to access and prioritize scalable solutions based on patient impact, operational value, clinical implications, cost, and scalability.
  • Advise the VP, Patient Access and executive leadership on access capabilities, technology investments, vendor performance, and system-level opportunities.

Access Technology & Strategic Vendor Leadership
  • Own the business and functional strategy, roadmap, and strategic vendor relationships for Patient Access technology and enabling platforms, in partnership with IT/Infrastructure.
  • Set Patient Access business and functional direction for telephony, UCaaS/CCaaS, self-service, digital access, automation, reporting, workforce management, and related capabilities, while partnering with IT/Infrastructure on enterprise architecture, infrastructure, security, integration, technical standards, and technology risk.
  • Hold vendors accountable for delivery, performance, implementation commitments, service levels, and roadmap alignment.
  • Prioritize technology investments and ensure implementation plans have clear owners, requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.


Transformation, Product & Access Capability Enablement
  • Own the transformation portfolio, priorities, and outcomes, providing direction and executive support to the leaders responsible for product ownership, workflow transformation, adoption, AI, automation, digital access, and self-service initiatives.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives have clear requirements, accountable owners, adoption plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Establish frameworks for clinician ramp, access capacity, template optimization, and other enablement capabilities in partnership with Operations and Clinical Access.
  • Ensure access technology and workflow changes support a consistent patient experience across channels and service lines.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution
  • Partner with the Director, Access Operations to understand operational demand, performance gaps, and required capabilities without assuming day-to-day operational ownership.
  • Partner with the Director, Clinical Access & Triage to incorporate clinical access and VBM implications into access strategy, capacity, workflow, and technology decisions.
  • Lead cross-functional implementation and resolve complex or structural barriers that span Operations, Clinical Access, Technology, IT/Infrastructure, and vendors.
  • Ensure enablement work moves from concept through implementation, stabilization, measurement, and continuous improvement.

People Leadership & Organizational Accountability
  • Lead and develop the Access Enablement function, establishing clear priorities, accountability, decision rights, and coordinated execution across the team.
  • Ensure clear accountability across enablement strategy, product and transformation, technology engineering, platform administration, and enterprise IT responsibilities.
  • Build organizational capability, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement.


Financial Stewardship
  • Own enablement budget planning, resource allocation, business cases, and investment prioritization.
  • Evaluate vendor and technology investments based on organizational impact, cost, scalability, and measurable return.


Education and Experience

Required
  • Significant experience in healthcare operations, patient access, healthcare technology, digital transformation, or related leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technology-enabled transformation and organizational change.
  • Experience with access technology, digital access, automation, telephony/contact center, workforce management, scheduling, or related healthcare platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience managing strategic vendors, implementation partners, roadmaps, and complex stakeholder environments.
  • Strong strategic thinking, decision-making, communication, and executive influence.
  • Experience leading leaders and/or multiple workstreams with accountability for outcomes through others.
Preferred
  • Experience with patient access operations, contact centers, referrals, clinician scheduling, or access optimization.
  • Experience with AI, automation, self-service, digital scheduling, or healthcare access product development.
  • Experience operating at the intersection of clinical, operational, and technology teams.

Physical Requirements
  • Work consistently requires walking, standing, sitting, lifting, reaching, stooping, bending, pushing, and pulling.
  • Must be able to lift and support weight of 35 pounds.
  • Ability to concentrate on details.
  • Use of computers for long periods of time.

title: Design Planner - 1st Shift - Springfield, OH
description:
Job purpose

Works with customers, the Customer Account Specialist, engineering, and installers; creates functional & attractive layout designs for Fire & Emergency Vehicle compartments to safely mount various types of industry specific equipment while generating designs to maximize storage capacity. Work begins with a customer pre-construction meeting to identify vehicle layout, equipment to be mounted, and specific customer wants and requirements. Preliminary layout/design sketches will be used by the Customer Account Specialist to generate a cost estimate and build time and will be communicated with the customer for review and approval. Develops and maintains strong working relationships with external customers and multiple internal disciplines which include, but are not limited to the Customer Account Specialist, engineering, fabrication, assembly, and sales.

Duties and responsibilities
Strong interpersonal and communication (written & verbal) skills
  • Participate in:
    • customer pre-construction meetings
    • initial design and layout walkaround with customer

  • Knowledge of industry trends and Fire & Emergency vehicle body styles
  • Working knowledge of one note, Adobe, Microsoft applications, and/or other design software to create customer facing three-dimensional digital mockups
  • Work directly with the customer making recommendations based upon industry experience for; specific mounting solutions, i.e. tool boards, FMI Suzans, tip down trays, oil dry hoppers, shelving and storage
  • Ability to analyze specifications, drawings, and other information to prepare accurate and time sensitive compartment management solution drawings
  • Ability to solve complex organizational/tool placement issues when designing compartment layouts
  • Communicate design/build issues with the sales & contract administrator so that necessary changes can be discussed with the customer
  • Work with the installation supervisor to ensure design is being followed by installers
  • Communicate changes in design/layout with installation supervisor

  • Attend industry events in support of role

Qualifications
  • Minimum of a relevant associate degree and/or 3-5 years of Fire & Emergency service compartment layout/design; bachelor’s degree or relevant experience required
  • Fire and Emergency service background and/or manufacturing experience is a plus
  • Ability to establish and maintain professional and courteous relationships with customers and co-workers

Working conditions
