title: Facilities and Datacenter Coordinator
description:
The Role
Pathway Communications is a leading Managed IT Services, Cybersecurity, Cloud, and Data Centre provider based in Markham, Ontario. Since 1995, Pathway has delivered enterprise-grade technology solutions to organizations across Canada. The company owns and operates a Tier III Data Centre facility and provides colocation, cloud, managed infrastructure, and business continuity services.

The Data Centre Coordinator is responsible for supporting the day-to-day operations of Pathway's data centre facilities, ensuring the reliability, security, and efficiency of critical infrastructure and client environments. The incumbent will coordinate operational activities, support customer installations, maintain facility documentation, assist with compliance requirements, and act as a liaison between clients, vendors, facilities teams, and internal stakeholders. The role requires strong organizational skills, technical aptitude, and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer service in a mission-critical environment.

Responsibilities
Operations & Monitoring
  • Monitor data centre infrastructure and operational performance to ensure service availability and reliability.
  • Respond to alarms, incidents, and operational alerts, escalating issues as required.
  • Coordinate troubleshooting activities involving electrical, mechanical, environmental, and infrastructure systems.
  • Support backup and disaster recovery processes.
  • Assist in implementing and maintaining IT security, privacy, and risk management controls.
  • Identify opportunities for operational improvements and infrastructure enhancements.

Client & Vendor Support
  • Assist clients with power, cooling, rack space, and environmental requirements for new and existing deployments.
  • Coordinate and support customer equipment installations, relocations, and decommissioning activities.
  • Perform Ethernet and fiber patching for customer and internal infrastructure.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between clients, vendors, facilities teams, and internal technical staff.
  • Ensure timely communication and resolution of operational requests.
Compliance & Security
  • Monitor physical security controls, access management processes, and site security procedures.
  • Support compliance initiatives related to ISO 27001, SOC 2, and other applicable frameworks.
  • Participate in quarterly and annual inventory audits.
  • Ensure adherence to company security, privacy, and governance requirements.
  • Maintain accurate access logs and compliance documentation.
Asset & Documentation Management
  • Maintain accurate asset inventory records and equipment tracking systems.
  • Coordinate asset tagging and lifecycle management activities.
  • Maintain site layouts, rack elevations, and infrastructure documentation.
  • Create, review, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and operational documentation.
  • Ensure all records remain current, accurate, and audit-ready.
Project Coordination
  • Assist with planning, scheduling, and coordinating customer and infrastructure projects.
  • Organize project meetings, prepare agendas, distribute minutes, and track action items.
  • Support project reporting and documentation activities.
  • Coordinate communication across multiple departments to ensure timely project delivery.
  • Monitor deliverables and milestones to ensure deadlines are achieved.
Required Qualifications and Experience
  • Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Two (2) to four (4) years of experience in data centre operations, IT infrastructure support, facilities coordination, or related technical environments.
  • Experience working with mission-critical infrastructure and operational procedures.
  • Strong organizational, documentation, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
  • Eligible to work full-time in Canada and located within reasonable commuting distance of Markham.
Technical Knowledge
Working knowledge of:
  • Data centre infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators, HVAC/CRAC systems, PDUs, and environmental monitoring.
  • Ethernet and fiber cabling practices.
  • IT infrastructure, servers, networking, storage, and backup systems.
  • ITIL processes, including Incident, Change, and Problem Management.
  • Physical security systems, access management, and compliance requirements.
  • Microsoft Office applications and technical documentation tools.
Preferred
  • Experience working in a managed services, telecommunications, cloud, or colocation environment.
  • Exposure to data centre compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
  • Experience with project coordination and project management tools.
  • Familiarity with inventory management and asset tracking systems.
  • Knowledge of business continuity and disaster recovery practices.

Work Location
This is a full-time on-site position based in Markham, Ontario. The successful candidate will work from Pathway's Data Centre and office facilities. Occasional after-hours, weekend, or emergency support may be required to support critical infrastructure activities, maintenance windows, or customer requirements.

How To Apply

Please submit your resume with sub: “Facilities and Datacenter Coordinator", with details of relevant work experience and why you feel you are a good candidate for this position.

We thank all candidates, but only those selected for an interview will be contacted. We are not accepting calls from Recruiters at this time.

title: Kloakrørlægger til no-dig og kloakservice i Vejen
description:
Er du kloakrørlægger og klar på no-dig, renovering og service?

Her får du fast arbejde i Vejen med ordnede forhold.

Du lander i en større entreprenørhverdag, hvor kloak, boring og skånsomme løsninger fylder meget. Arbejdet handler ikke kun om at grave op og lægge rør på den klassiske måde. Der bruges blandt andet styret underboring, jordraketter og burstning, når opgaven skal løses med mindre opgravning. Opgaverne kan ligge forskellige steder, men Vejen er byen for jobbet.

Det her er for dig, der kan lide kloakarbejde med lidt mere teknik i hverdagen. Du skal kunne tage fat, møde stabilt og være tryg ved, at arbejdet kræver præcision. Kørekort er nødvendigt, fordi jobbet indebærer arbejde ude på pladserne.

Det får du

Løn: 190-210 kr. i timen

Arbejdsområde: Vejen og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: No-dig, kloakservice og renovering

Din hverdag

Dagen bliver styret af den konkrete plads og den opgave, der er planlagt. Nogle opgaver handler om renovering og service, mens andre kræver no-dig metoder, hvor kloakledninger etableres eller fornyes med mindre opgravning. Du skal kunne arbejde præcist, sige til hvis noget ikke stemmer, og holde styr på de aftaler der er lavet.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Renoverer kloakledninger med no-dig som en del af opgaven
  • Løser serviceopgaver på kloak og afløb
  • Lægger kloakrør og afløbsledninger
  • Arbejder med brøndsætning og opbygning af fald
  • Reparerer og omlægger kloak efter behov

Når opgaven kræver en skånsom løsning, er det vigtigt, at arbejdet bliver gjort rigtigt første gang. Her tæller både erfaring, ro i hænderne og evnen til at samarbejde ordentligt med folkene omkring pladsen.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Vi forventer ikke at du har lavet det hele før. Men du skal kunne se en opgave og tage fat.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring som kloakrørlægger eller med kloakarbejde
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Kan arbejde præcist, også når pladsen driller
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet no-dig, renovering eller service før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan lide kloakarbejde og tager dit fag alvorligt.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om Hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: IT Systems Analyst V (AFCAT) ACAS Assessor
description:

These assessments will help strengthen the posture and resiliency of the DoW Information Network (DOWIN) by supporting commanders and directors in their efforts to harden their information systems, reduce the attack surface of their cyber terrain, and enhance a more proactive defense.

Team members will specialize in Cyber Operational Risk Assessments (CORA), focusing on areas such as endpoint security, network vulnerability, insider threat, and more. This role helps ensure Air Force compliance and effectiveness in cyber defense strategies.

  • Complete other duties as assigned.

    • Train others in ACAS operations and assessments.

Certifications

title: Communications Specialist
description:
COMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST

Highland Community College seeks a Communications Specialist to join our Marketing & Community Relations team. This full-time position develops and executes strategic communications that promote the College's mission, programs, achievements, and initiatives. The Communications Specialist creates compelling content across multiple platforms, supports marketing and public relations efforts, strengthens Highland's brand, and engages both internal and external audiences. If you are a skilled communicator who enjoys storytelling, content creation, public relations, and building meaningful connections within a college community, we encourage you to apply!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Write and edit news releases, promotional publications, and marketing materials for all College divisions and departments.
  • Capture, edit, and maintain a library of photography that supports College communications and marketing efforts.
  • Assist with the development, maintenance, and monitoring of the College's social media presence.
  • Create, update, and maintain content for the College website.
  • Support public relations activities and special events that promote the College and its programs.
  • Develop promotional materials, scripts, media packets, and other informational content.
  • Assist with writing, updating, and training staff on maintaining employee and student portal content.
  • Promote employee recognition programs, student engagement initiatives, and institutional culture.
  • Assist the Director of Marketing & Community Relations with emergency closure notifications and crisis communications.
  • Coordinate responses to Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant disclosure of public records.
  • Assist with departmental budget tracking, invoice processing, expenditure monitoring, and payment coordination.
  • Maintain effective relationships with faculty, staff, students, community partners, and media representatives.
  • Occasionally work evening and/or weekend hours to support events and special projects.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For:

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Public Relations, Communications, Marketing, English, or a related field; AND two (2) years of professional experience in writing, marketing, communications, or public relations; OR an equivalent combination of education and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities.
  • Experience working in higher education, public relations, marketing, communications, journalism, or a related field is preferred.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Knowledge of communication principles, public relations practices, and marketing strategies.
  • Knowledge of higher education operations, programs, and emerging trends affecting colleges and universities.
  • Knowledge of English usage, grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and professional writing standards.
  • Knowledge of interviewing techniques and information gathering methods.
  • Knowledge of utilizing data to support informed decision-making.
  • Knowledge of customer service principles and best practices.
  • Skill in writing and editing press releases, marketing materials, publications, website content, and other communications.
  • Skill in promoting programs, initiatives, and institutional accomplishments through various communication channels.
  • Skill in organizing and coordinating events, projects, and outreach activities.
  • Skill in photography, including composition, framing, lighting, color, and attention to detail.
  • Skill in working effectively with diverse groups of individuals.
  • Skill in maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive information appropriately.
  • Skill in developing and maintaining positive working relationships with employees, students, media representatives, and community members.
  • Skill in operating computers and common software applications.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and project management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

Why Join Highland Community College?

  • Help tell the story of Highland Community College and the impact it has on students and the community.
  • Contribute to meaningful marketing, communications, and public relations initiatives.

title: Global Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence Director
description:
Who we are:

IRCA Group, an Advent portfolio company, was founded in Italy in 1919, and it is a leading international B2B provider of high-quality semi-finished ingredients such as chocolate, decorations, creams, inclusions, nuts and pistachios, pastry mixes, gelato ingredients, and other essential solutions for industrial clients or other independent artisanal producers.

With more than 2.400 employees, 19 production facilities worldwide, and €1.4 billion in revenues, IRCA Group has a solid track record of growth and international expansion.

What do we offer:

  • A dynamic, multicultural, and inclusive environment with exposure to global projects and stakeholders
  • The opportunity to shape and lead a transformational Continuous Improvement journey at a global scale
  • International career development opportunities
  • Exposure to senior leadership and the possibility to influence strategic business decisions

The role:

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Global Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence Director to lead the design, deployment, and sustainability of IRCA Group's global Continuous Improvement (CI) strategy.

Reporting to the Global COO, the successful candidate will define and drive the Group's CI roadmap, embedding a culture of operational excellence across manufacturing sites and supply chain operations. The role will be instrumental in delivering productivity improvements, cost savings, capability building, and cultural transformation throughout the organization.

We are seeking a highly motivated CI leader with proven experience in implementing global Continuous Improvement programs within international manufacturing environments, ideally through TPM, IWS, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies.

The selected candidate will lead the development and execution of the company's mid-to-long-term CI strategy across the end-to-end supply chain, while supporting the delivery of current performance improvement and savings initiatives. They will be accountable for the overall success of the CI program, ensuring that a continuous improvement mindset and culture become embedded in the daily operations of the organization.

Working closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, R&D, HR, Finance, and Plant Leadership teams, the Global Continuous Improvement Director will drive sustainable performance improvement and support the achievement of IRCA Group's strategic objectives.

The position is preferably based in Italy, at IRCA Group's Headquarters, with regular interaction and collaboration across the Group's international operations.

What will you do:

Continuous Improvement Strategy & Governance:

  • Establish governance, standards, methodologies, and KPIs to ensure a consistent CI approach across all regions and manufacturing sites

        • Support regional and local teams during implementation, ensuring alignment with global standards
        • Act as a key change agent, influencing stakeholders and driving organizational transformation

          • Cross-Functional Collaboration:

          • Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, R&D, HR, Finance, Quality, and Procurement teams to drive end-to-end performance improvements

Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Industrial Management, or a related field
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt and/or TPM certification is considered a strong advantage

    • Experience:

    • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in manufacturing and operations leadership roles
    • Minimum 3-5 years in a global or regional Continuous Improvement leadership position within an international manufacturing environment
    • Proven experience implementing TPM, IWS, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or similar operational excellence frameworks
    • Demonstrated success in leading large-scale transformation and cultural change programs across multiple sites and countries

      • Professional Skills:

title: Contract Specialist
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and commercial-minded Contract Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in managing the contracting process, reviewing commercial agreements, and safeguarding GoGoX against operational and commercial risks. You will act as a key bridge between legal standards and business objectives, supporting various internal teams while helping drive our legal technology initiatives.

What You Will Deliver

  • Review inbound customer, vendor and partner contracts, quotations, tender terms and NDAs; identify deviations from GoGoX standard terms and flag commercial and operational risks (liability caps, indemnities, insurance, payment terms, termination rights, exclusivity, service levels, IP and confidentiality).
  • Prepare first drafts of agreements, addenda, extension letters, undertakings and consumer T&Cs from GoGoX templates; tailor terms to the deal while keeping to approved positions.
  • Review tender and RFQ documents for onerous terms, compliance requirements and required supporting documents; coordinate supplier registration, due-diligence questionnaires, anti-corruption declarations and codes of conduct.
  • Coordinate execution by wet-ink signature, company chop and e-signature; check signing authority and entity details; maintain the contract register, retrieve signed copies on request and track renewal and expiry dates.
  • Help maintain and improve GoGoX templates, standard clauses, playbook positions and FAQs; identify recurring requests that can be standardised or self-served by the business.
  • Support the team's legal technology and AI initiatives, for example using AI tools for first-pass review and summaries, and helping to build structured contract data.

Who You Are

  • Collaborative Partner: You work directly with Sales, Operations, Marketing and Country teams to understand the commercial deal, explain proposed changes in practical terms, and support negotiation calls or email exchanges with counterparties.
  • Meticulous & Organized: You possess meticulous attention to detail with the ability to handle a high volume of requests, prioritise, and meet business deadlines without losing accuracy.
  • Independent & Discerning: You are confident working independently and remotely from the Hong Kong team. You have good judgement about when to ask, when to escalate, and can recognise when a matter needs a lawyer (e.g., personal data, employment, litigation or demand letters, regulatory correspondence, related-party or listed-company issues, non-standard liability).

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: Around 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience reviewing, drafting and negotiating commercial contracts in an in-house legal, contracts, procurement, commercial or paralegal role. Logistics, transport, e-commerce, technology platform or other B2B services experience is an advantage.
  • Education: A degree or diploma in law, business, or a related field, or an equivalent professional qualification (for example a paralegal or contract management certification). Admission as a lawyer is not required.
  • Commercial Acumen: Solid working knowledge of standard commercial clauses and how they allocate risk, and the ability to explain them to non-legal colleagues.
  • Communication & Tools: Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable drafting clear, professional emails and mark-ups in Microsoft Word with tracked changes.

title: Solar Site Assessor
description:
About Us
Solar Landscape is the leading commercial rooftop solar developer in the U.S. Only 4% of commercial rooftops host solar today — we’re changing that, fast. Commercial rooftop solar is the fastest, smartest way to build new clean power — delivering megawatts of generation in months, not years, and powering America’s energy and future right where it’s needed most. By turning rooftops into local power plants, we’re reshaping how — and how fast — energy gets built in the U.S.
Recognized as the #1 Distributed Generation Developer by New Project Media, the #1 National Commercial Rooftop Solar Developer by Solar Power World, and winner of the U.S. Department of Energy’s Grand Prize for Clean Energy, Solar Landscape is defining the future of energy generation in America.
Headquartered in Asbury Park, New Jersey, Solar Landscape has offices in Chicago, Baltimore, and New York City and operates in over a dozen states nationwide.
We move fast, solve hard problems, and take our work seriously — but never ourselves. We value clear thinking, accountability, and execution. At the same time, we’re collaborative by default, and believe the best work happens when people enjoy working together. Our team is made up of smart, grounded people who show up for each other — whether that’s troubleshooting a system design or catching up over lunch.
If you’re looking to do meaningful work in a high-performance environment — and be part of the team reshaping how energy gets built in the U.S. — we’d love to meet you.
About The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Solar Site Assessor to support the planning and execution of solar energy projects through accurate, on-site evaluations of commercial and industrial properties. The ideal candidate will perform both rooftop and ground-level assessments, collecting critical structural, spatial, and electrical data to inform solar system design and installation.
This role requires a strong understanding of construction principles, field safety practices, and site documentation tools, including GIS software and Microsoft Dynamics 365. The Solar Site Assessor plays a key role in ensuring project feasibility, accuracy, and compliance from initial evaluation through to permit submission, working closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, and project management.

Responsibilities

  • Perform preliminary rooftop assessments by documenting roof conditions and unit locations, identifying shading and access points, and measuring the roof, units, and seam clamp sizes.
  • Perform preliminary ground assessments by documenting existing and proposed electrical equipment, analyzing traffic patterns, and identifying locations for solar storage, parking, and stair towers.
  • Collect and document detailed structural and dimensional building data, including framing types, load capacities, roof materials, overall dimensions, and required clearances to support accurate solar feasibility analysis and system design.
  • Coordinate and support permit submission logistics, including travel arrangements and permit delivery as needed.
  • Conduct Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) surveys to identify subsurface conditions and potential obstructions.
  • Proficient with ERP software (Microsoft Dynamics 365, etc.), GIS tools (Google Earth, Nearmap), and Microsoft Office Suite.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED (Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management preferred).
  • Some experience in construction or renewable energy, or a strong interest in starting a career in the field.
  • Ability to climb ladders and access building roofs.
  • Knowledge of construction safety requirements; OSHA 10 or 30 certification.
  • Valid Driver’s License; must be willing to travel to various job sites.
  • Authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail across multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to address challenges and provide solutions efficiently.
  • Capacity to work collaboratively with sales team and other departments.
  • Familiarity with solar energy and construction.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks effectively, meeting deadlines and maintaining quality standards.
Benefits and Perks
We offer competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work:
· Training / Professional development opportunities
· 401(k) with 4% company match
· Summer Fridays
· Flexible remote/hybrid work options
· Paid parental leave
· Team lunches, events, and stocked kitchens
· Modern, collaborative office spaces in Asbury Park, New York City, Boston, Chicago, and Baltimore
· Medical, dental, and vision coverage
· Company-paid life and long-term disability insurance
ADA Accommodation Statement
Solar Landscape is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us at hr@solarlandscape.com.

title: Undersköterska till K-sektionen på centraloperation
description:
Är du intresserad av att arbeta med avancerad buk-, urologisk- och gynekologisk kirurgi i en högteknologisk och teambaserad miljö? Då ska du söka dig till kirurgiska sektionen (K-sektionen) på anestesi, operation och intensivvård (ANOPIVA) vid ett av landets bästa sjukhus, universitetssjukhuset i Linköping.

På vår operationsavdelning erbjuds anestesi- och operationsservice till olika kirurgiska inriktningar. Här bedrivs högteknologisk avancerad operationssjukvård och akut omhändertagande av traumapatienter. ANOPIVA är Region Östergötlands största klinik och bedriver operationssjukvård inom alla opererande specialiteter exklusive thorax/kärl kirurgi. Våra enheter bedriver både elektiv- och akutkirurgi med arbetet förlagt dygnet runt.

Sektionsspecifikt på K-sektionen arbetar du med operationer inom övre- och nedre abdominell kirurgi, urologi och gynekologi. Operationerna genomförs öppet, laparoskopiskt eller i robot. Du arbetar i team med anestesisjuksköterskor, operationssjuksköterskor och läkare. Arbetet varieras med elektivt och akut flöde där du i teamet får fatta snabba beslut i en högteknologisk miljö.

Vårt erbjudande

Vill du vara en del av ett tvärprofessionellt team runt patienten där allas kompetens tas tillvara?

Som undersköterska på operation har du en viktig roll runt patienten i att bland annat hålla ihop operationsteamet under salsarbetet och har hela tiden överblick över det som sker.

Vi erbjuder en trivsam arbetsplats med teamarbete som präglas av engagemang, nyfikenhet, ansvar och med stor respekt för patienten och varandra. Hos oss får du möjlighet att fördjupa dig inom olika ansvarsområden. Vi utgår från patienten och arbetar för att varje medarbetare ska få rätt kompetens för att kunna upprätthålla en hög kvalitet och hög patientsäkerhet. Vi finns på plats för våra patienter dygnet runt.

Vi erbjuder en individanpassad introduktion och tillsammans med din chef utformar du en plan för din framtida fortbildning och kompetensutveckling. Goda möjligheter finns till rotationstjänst inom våra olika enheter. Du får en handledare och en individanpassad inskolning på din enhet. För oss är det viktigt att du känner dig trygg i dina arbetsuppgifter. Vidare prioriterar vi din personliga kompetensutveckling och därmed erbjuder vi bland annat två studiedagar per år och vi har varje år tillfällen för simuleringar av akuta situationer. Vi ingår i ett hälsobefrämjande projekt vilket innebär 34 timmars arbetsvecka med heltidslön när man ingår i 24/7 verksamhet med jourarbete.

Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss så är du välkommen att hospitera en dag!

Läs gärna om vår karriärstege för undersköterskor/omvårdnadsassistenter och om dina förmåner hos oss. här hittar du även information om bestämmelser gällande lön och ersättningar.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vår operationsenhet erbjuder ett omväxlande och stimulerande arbete. Avdelningen är indelad i sex sektioner ortopedi-, hand-och plastikkirurgi med brännskadevård, specialenheten med öron- och käkkirurgi och sjukhusövergripande anestesiverksamhet, allmänkirurgi, urologi, gynekologi/obstetrik samt neurokirurgi.

Som undersköterska kommer du att ha en sektionstillhörighet på K-sektionen med allmänkirurgi, urologi samt gynekologi/obstetrik men med viss introduktion på alla sektioner. Detta innebär att du arbetar i din sektion men behöver även ha beredskap för akuta ingrepp i andra sektioner.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är undersköterska, meriterande om du har utbildning som specialist-undersköterska inom anestesi- och operationssjukvård. Du har arbetslivserfarenhet av sjukhusvård och vana att arbeta med medicinskteknisk utrustning. Då du i ditt arbete kommunicerar med dina kollegor runt patienten och även med andra kliniker på sjukhuset, krävs det att du har goda kunskaper i svenska språket både i tal och skrift.

Du vill ha ett arbete som präglas av spänning och variation där du får använda din flexibilitet och problemlösningsförmåga. Som person är du trygg och stabil och har självinsikt, förmåga att kunna skilja på det personliga och det professionella. Du trivs med teamarbete och är en engagerad person som vill vara med och bidra till en positiv arbetsplats där alla tar ansvar, samarbetar och respekterar varandra. Vidare är du uppmärksam och tillmötesgående i ditt bemötande samt ett intresse, vilja och förmåga att hjälpa andra.

Ansökan och anställning

Inför anställning i ett patientnära arbete inom Region Östergötland kommer du att få fylla i en hälsodeklaration.

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan! Om du behöver hjälp med att registrera i systemet, kontakta kundtjänst Stöd och service, 010-103 60 00, under kontorstid.

Till bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag samt andra externa aktörer och försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. Region Östergötland har upphandlade avtal.

title: Product Manager - Loyalty, Partnerships

title: 2027 Internal Audit Summer Internship Program
description:
The work we do has an impact on millions of lives, and you can be a part of it.
We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.

Are you driven to succeed and eager to grow? Do you want to apply your classroom knowledge in a real-world business setting? Are you looking for opportunities to develop new skills and gain valuable experience? If your answer is “yes,” then Protective’s Summer Internship Program is perfect for you!
Our Internship Program is an annual 8-week program that provides high-performing college students with hands-on experience working with an organization that has been recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Midsize Employers in 2025. This program will include the opportunity to participate in personal mentoring and insight into our business operations. Interns will have the opportunity to collaborate with business leaders to develop and execute solutions to real business problems. In addition to gaining meaningful work experience, interns will have the opportunity to participate in various community and professional development events.
Program Details:
Duration: May 31st- July 30th, 2027
Location: Corporate Office in Birmingham, AL.

Student Criteria:

  • Education: Undergraduate (Juniors and Seniors preferred) or Graduate students. Students must be actively enrolled in either an Undergraduate or Graduate degree program as of May 31st, 2027 to be eligible.
  • Majors: IT, Data Analytics, Math, Accounting, or similar degrees.

Skills:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Analytical skills
  • Comfort with Technology
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Positive attitude and the ability to learn quickly.

Activities:

  • Relevant Work Projects: Interns will be assigned to projects that align with our Internal Audit team's goals. These projects will provide hands-on experience in compliance and risk auditing and the chance to apply academic knowledge to real-world business challenges. This intern's projects will include participating in audit discussions with business areas, testing controls, as well as analyzing the documentation of existing controls. Interns will work closely with their teams to deliver impactful results.
  • Professional Development Training: Interns will attend workshops and training sessions focused on enhancing their professional skills. Topics may include resume building, interview techniques, leadership development, and industry-specific knowledge. These sessions aim to prepare interns for successful careers post-graduation.
  • Networking with Leadership and Fellow Interns: Protective Life values the importance of building professional networks. Interns will have multiple opportunities to interact with company leaders through formal and informal events. Additionally, interns will collaborate with peers from different departments, fostering a sense of community and shared learning.
  • Mentoring: Mentors will provide guidance, support, and feedback throughout the internship. Interns will have regular one-on-one meetings with their mentors to discuss progress, challenges, and career aspirations. This mentorship aims to foster professional growth, enhance skills, and build a strong foundation for future career success.

Selection Process:

  • Application: Students apply to this posting and indicate their preferences through provided questions. Please provide an updated resume, including your anticipated graduation date.
  • Qualification: Qualified candidates will be invited to interview.
  • Selection Process: Our program receives a lot of interest, and our process starts early. Please be patient as it may take us several weeks to make initial contact with you
  • Interviews: Candidates will be scheduled for an initial 15-minute interview with a recruiter, followed by 1-2 additional interviews with hiring managers.

We aim to protect the wellbeing of our employees and their families with a broad benefits offering. In addition to offering comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, we support emotional wellbeing through mental health benefits and an employee assistance program. Work/life balance is important and Protective offers a variety of paid time away benefits (e.g., paid time off, paid parental leave, short-term disability, and a cultural observance day). The financial health of our employees is just as important as physical and emotional health. Some of the financial wellbeing benefits include contributions to healthcare accounts, a pension plan, and a 401(k) plan with Company matching. title: Network & Security Engineer
description:
EAM-Mosca Corp.
Title: – Network & Security Engineer
Job Type: Full Time, Salaried
Reporting Structure: Reports to IT Manager

EAM-Mosca Corp., Hazle Township PA, a dynamic market leader in the area of end-of-line automated packaging machinery and consumable strapping solutions, is seeking a skilled and versatile Network & Security Engineer to join our growing team.

EAM-Mosca is privately held and retains a unique, focused, entrepreneurial culture. EAM-Mosca also enjoys a blue-chip client base of highly successful North and South American manufacturing companies and has a portfolio of products applicable to a variety of end-use markets. The key to the ongoing success of the business is a system-based product portfolio featuring standard as well as custom engineered packaging machinery solutions and a superior consumable packaging product, complimented by quality technical service and readily available aftersales parts support.

Job Summary :
In this dual-focused role, you will be the backbone of our IT infrastructure, ensuring our network is fast, reliable, and highly secure. You will split your time between administering daily network operations and designing, implementing, and monitoring our cybersecurity defenses.
This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive professional who thrives in a business environment, takes full ownership of projects, and enjoys balancing infrastructure management with proactive threat defense. The position requires you to be on site at our Hazle Township office.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Network Administration & Infrastructure
  • Manage and maintain the company’s infrastructure consisting of LAN, WAN, WLAN, switches, firewalls, and routers
  • Monitor network performance and uptime, proactively troubleshooting connectivity, latency, and hardware issues
  • Configure and support secure remote access solutions, including VPNs for remote offices and staff
  • Handle network provisioning, including user access controls, VLAN segmentation, and IP address management (DHCP & DNS)
  • Perform routine maintenance, firmware updates, patches, and backup/disaster recovery protocols
Information Security & Threat Defense
  • Design and enforce corporate security policies, access controls, and data protection strategies
  • Monitor security alerts from firewalls and endpoint detection software to investigate and neutralize potential threats
  • Conduct regular audits, vulnerability scans, and risk assessments to identify and patch system weaknesses
  • Lead incident response efforts in the event of a security breach, malware infection, or unauthorized access attempt
  • Promote security awareness by helping to educate internal staff on phishing and safe digital practices

Profile and Background:
  • A minimum of an Associate’s degree. Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 3-5+ years working in Network Administration, System Engineering, or Network Security
  • Certifications Preferred but not required: Comptia Security+, Comptia Network+, CCNA
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
  • Must be a team player
  • Clear communication skills and able to explain technical risks to non-technical teams
  • Ability to multi-task and work under strict deadlines
  • Deep understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing protocols, DHCP, DNS, and VLANS)
  • Expertise in configuring firewalls, routers, and switches, intrusion detection/preventions systems (IDS/IPS), and endpoint security
  • Familiar with securing cloud or hybrid environments is a strong plus
  • Familiar with virtual machine technology and topologies
  • Sophos XDR and Crowdstrike experience preferred
  • Sonicwall and Aruba experience preferred
  • Juniper Mist administration experience helpful


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Technical Customer Support Specialist - Mobile Games
description:
We are looking for a Technical Customer Support Specialist - Mobile Games to manage end-to-end player support across multiple channels. The role involves investigating and resolving player issues, troubleshooting technical problems, handling purchase and account-related concerns, and collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and LiveOps teams.

The ideal candidate should have strong problem-solving and communication skills, attention to detail, and an interest in mobile games. You will play an important role in ensuring a smooth player experience while helping internal teams identify and resolve recurring product issues.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide timely, professional, and high-quality support to players across multiple channels.
  • Investigate and resolve technical and gameplay-related issues, :
  • Troubleshoot issues and identify possible root causes before escalating them to relevant teams.
  • Escalate complex or critical issues to Product, Engineering, QA, and LiveOps with clear reproduction steps, screenshots/videos, logs, and other supporting evidence.
  • Follow up on escalated cases and ensure issues are resolved within agreed timelines.
  • Identify recurring player complaints and technical issues and share trends with relevant stakeholders.
  • Provide actionable feedback to improve product quality, player experience, monetization, and technical performance.
  • Maintain and improve support workflows, SOPs, macros, FAQs, and knowledge base documentation.
  • Monitor support metrics including ticket volume, response time, resolution time, and issue categories.
  • Prepare regular reports highlighting key support trends, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Handle sensitive cases involving refunds, compensation requests, payment disputes, and account-related concerns professionally and according to company guidelines.
  • Maintain clear and accurate records of player interactions and issue resolutions.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve support processes and the overall player experience.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in Technical Customer Support, Customer Support, Player Support, Game Support, or a similar role.
  • Strong interest in mobile games and the gaming industry.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to investigate issues and communicate technical problems clearly.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing receipts, purchase records, account information, and player claims.
  • Ability to manage multiple support cases and prioritize urgent issues.
  • Comfortable working with ticketing/support systems, spreadsheets, and documentation tools.
  • Strong ownership and ability to work independently as well as with cross-functional teams.

title: Police Officer
description:
Police Officer
Department: Campus Police
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $38,000–$40,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications
Reports To: Chief of Police

Who We Are?
Ferrum College Campus Police is committed to maintaining a safe, secure, and welcoming campus environment for students, faculty, staff, visitors, and the broader College community.
The Campus Police Department provides law enforcement, emergency response, crime prevention, safety education, and security services throughout the Ferrum College campus. Our officers work collaboratively with the campus community to promote safety, preserve peace, and support the College's mission.

What We're Looking For
Ferrum College is seeking a professional, dependable, and community-focused Police Officer to join the Campus Police Department. This is a non-supervisory position responsible for performing general law enforcement duties necessary to maintain the safety, security, and good order of the College community.
The Police Officer works an assigned shift under the general guidance of the Chief of Police and designated supervisors. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound judgment, professionalism, strong communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with students, employees, parents, College officials, fellow officers, and members of the public.
Key Responsibilities

  • Identify criminal offenders and criminal activity and, when appropriate, apprehend offenders and participate in subsequent court proceedings.
  • Conduct preventive patrols and other crime prevention activities to reduce opportunities for criminal activity.
  • Respond to individuals who may be at risk of physical harm and provide appropriate emergency assistance.
  • Promote and preserve peace throughout the campus community.
  • Facilitate the safe movement of vehicular and pedestrian traffic.
  • Identify potentially serious law enforcement or governmental concerns and report them through appropriate channels.
  • Enforce institutional rules and regulations related to student conduct as established by the Student Handbook.
  • Enforce parking regulations, including violations involving blocking or impeding traffic.
  • Issue traffic tickets, summonses, warrants, and arrest warrants as authorized.
  • Enforce institutional vehicle identification and parking permit requirements.
  • Enforce applicable criminal and traffic laws of the Commonwealth of Virginia within the officer's jurisdiction of authority.
  • Conduct investigations and prepare clear, concise, and accurate reports.
  • Conduct foot patrols in and around academic buildings to identify and address safety and security concerns.
  • Conduct foot patrols in occupied and unoccupied residence halls to identify and address safety and security concerns.
  • Maintain knowledge of campus security systems, including security cameras and alarm systems, and follow established operating procedures.
  • Maintain a professional law enforcement presence and respond consistently and appropriately to incidents.
  • File required patrol reports at the conclusion of each shift.
  • Engage the campus community in crime prevention, safety awareness, and other community policing initiatives.
  • Pursue additional police training and professional development as required.
  • Work collaboratively with the Student Affairs Office and other College departments to support campus safety and institutional objectives.
  • Assume special responsibilities and assignments as directed by the Chief of Police or designee, Vice President of Operations, or President.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Who You Are?
You are a professional law enforcement officer who understands the unique responsibilities of serving a college community. You are committed to community policing, crime prevention, safety, and maintaining positive relationships with students and members of the Ferrum community.
You exercise sound judgment, remain calm under pressure, and communicate effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds. You are physically capable of performing the essential duties of the position and committed to maintaining your professional knowledge and skills through ongoing training.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Current Virginia certification as a Police Officer.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Responsible work experience.
  • Knowledge of community policing techniques.
  • General knowledge of rules of evidence and laws governing search and seizure.
  • Ability to work effectively with young adults.
  • Ability to analyze evidence and conduct appropriate questioning and interviews.
  • Ability to prepare clear and concise oral and written reports.
  • Skilled in the use of firearms and police equipment.
  • Physical ability and endurance necessary to perform law enforcement duties.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with students, parents, College officials, coworkers, and the public.
  • Successful completion of required criminal history and credit checks.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Certified Community Police Specialist.
  • DCJS Certified Basic Instructor.
What We Offer
At Ferrum College, you'll have the opportunity to contribute directly to the safety and well-being of a close-knit college community while working as part of a professional campus police team.
We offer:
  • Comprehensive benefits package in accordance with College policies.
  • Professional development and continuing law enforcement training opportunities.
  • A collaborative campus environment.
  • The opportunity to engage directly with students and the College community through crime prevention, safety education, and community policing.
  • The opportunity to support a safe and welcoming environment where students can learn, live, and thrive.
Ready to Join Our Team?
Interested applicants should submit:
  • Letter of Interest
  • Resume
  • Completed Employment Application

Applications will be accepted immediately and the position will remain open until filled.
Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of required background and credit checks.

title: Senior Credit Analyst
description:
SUMMARY

Commercial and Agribusiness Senior Credit Analyst is responsible to analyze various historical and projected financial statements of individuals and businesses to identify the degree of risk involved in extending credit. The findings are presented into a detailed report for approval or denial by executive management and/or loan committees. The report includes cash flow analysis, ratio analysis, thorough industry and market analysis, well defined sensitivity analysis, and determination of credit risk in accordance with bank policy and direction of the Chief Credit Officer. Work is closely managed and the individual gains exposure to other complex tasks within the job function. Will liaison with other departments regarding lending activities and other duties as directed by management.

Assures compliance with all Bank policies and procedures, as well as all applicable state and federal banking regulations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  • Exposure to complex analysis and tasks related to credit analysis and portfolio management.

  • Prepare portfolio analysis reporting as directed by CCO or Senior Credit Officer for the Board of Directors and Compliance Management.

  • Exposure to watch list assets, problem loan status reports, and portfolio management.

  • Obtains loan request information from lender or borrower to analyze credit information, financial statements and other related information pertaining to the loan request.

  • Research background documentation and reviews personal and business financial statements and tax returns.

  • Analyzes financial information and prepares the primary analysis for the lender.

  • Communicates with Lenders to obtain financial statements on existing borrowers to ensure proper analysis is complete.

  • Review financials and analyze customer information.

  • Prepare a clear and concise loan memorandum for approval/denial of credit requests.

  • Analyzes loan data on new, renewal and existing loans, including data provided by credit bureaus, other financial institutions, and bank files.

  • Provides technical advice and assistance to loan officers as needed.

  • Prepares spreadsheets, reports, summaries, and opinions for financial institution officers on new, renewal and existing loans.

  • Conduct thorough financial, cash flow, and collateral analysis of credit requests.

  • Reconcile financial statements and identify discrepancies and variances.

  • Assign risk rating outlining strengths and weaknesses of each credit.

  • Perform recommendations based on analysis and assessment of risk within the framework of the Banks credit culture, current economic condition, and industry trends.

  • Clear and concise technical writing with understanding of accounting, various financial statements, ratios, forecasting, and concepts.

  • Work closely and effectively communicate with the lenders and/or accountants (both in writing and orally) with respect to questions regarding financial information and customers operations.

  • Efficiently manage deadlines in high-pressure work environment.

  • Effectively answer all relevant questions with regards to presentations regarding the loan presentation and review for loan committee or executive management.

  • Co-present when requested with the loan officer regarding the loan presentation and review for loan committee or executive management. Effectively answer all relevant questions with regards to presentations.

  • Represents Sauk Valley Bank in various community, civic, and community reinvestment functions to further enhance the Bank’s image and develop additional business.

SECONDARY DUTIES

The Senior Credit Analyst position performs duties specific for the position and other functions as designated by management.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY

The position of Senior Credit Analyst is not responsible for the supervision of any employee(s).

ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL ACTIVITY

The environment for this position is an open office that is mostly clean and comfortable, where exposure to the outside weather elements and some minor annoyances such as noise, odors, drafts, etc. may occur. The incumbent is in a non-confined office-type setting in which he or she is free to move about at will.

The incumbent in the course of performing this position spends time writing, typing, speaking, listening, lifting (up to 25 pounds), driving, seeing (such as close, color and peripheral vision, depth perception and adjusted focus), sitting, pulling, walking, standing, and reaching.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

MENTAL DEMANDS

The incumbent in this position must be able to accommodate to reading documents or instruments, detailed work, problem solving, customer contact, reasoning, math, language, presentations, verbal and written communication, analytical reasoning, stress, multiple concurrent tasks and constant interruptions.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

These specifications are general guidelines based on the minimum experience normally considered essential to the satisfactory performance of this position. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required to perform the position in a satisfactory manner. Individual abilities may result in some deviation from these guidelines.

  • Bachelor’s degree in agribusiness, finance or accounting preferred.
  • Preferred minimum of five years’ experience and/or training; or the equivalent combination of education and experience. Work related experience should consist of credit analysis or underwriting.
  • Developed experience, knowledge, and training in commercial and agriculture lending activities, terminology, products, and services.
  • Knowledge of related state and federal banking compliance regulations and other Bank operational policies
  • Advanced computer skills to meet production needs of the position, especially proficient in Excel and Word
  • Advanced knowledge of accounting/finance concepts, ability to consolidate and interpret financial statement.
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to solve difficult problems involving multiple facets and variables in non-standardized situations
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
  • Effective oral, written and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to independently carry out specific instructions, interpret documents, understand procedures, write reports and correspondence, and speak clearly to customers and employees
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision while performing duties
  • Current driver’s license and a vehicle with appropriate insurance coverage if required to drive in the course of performing assigned duties and responsibilities.

The incumbent must be able to perform this position safely, without endangering the health or safety to him/herself or others.

title: Projektleder med digital profil – vær med til at udvikle fremtidens databaserede busdrift
description:
Er du i starten af din karriere, og motiveres du af at arbejde med projektledelse, digitalisering og udvikling - og har du lyst til at stå i spidsen for et vigtigt samarbejde om fremtidens busdrift?

Hos Movia søger vi en engageret og handlekraftig projektleder med digital profil, som kan omsætte forretningsbehov til konkrete digitale løsninger og skabe tydelig retning i samarbejdet mellem forretning, data, IT og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Du får samtidig en central rolle i arbejdet med den fortsatte digitalisering, effektivisering og udvikling af busdriften.

Datasamarbejdet med busoperatørerne spiller en vigtig rolle i at sikre en stabil og veldokumenteret busdrift samt en korrekt og rettidig trafikinformation. Som projektleder har du ansvaret for at samle behov, skabe fremdrift og understøtte udviklingen af løsninger og arbejdsgange, der gør data mere anvendelig i arbejdet med at skabe en bedre busdrift for passagererne. Rollen kræver, at du kan balancere konkrete leverancer med et langsigtet fokus på implementering, forankring og værdiskabelse.

Dine opgaver
Du får blandt andet ansvar for at:
  • Lede projekter og udviklingsforløb fra behovsafdækning til implementering og organisatorisk forankring.
  • Kortlægge forretningsbehov, datakilder, dataflows og afhængigheder samt omsætte dem til tydelige krav, leverancer og arbejdsgange.
  • Drive digitalisering og automatisering og bidrage til udvikling af digitale værktøjer, datadelingsmodeller og en mere datadrevet driftsopfølgning.
  • Skabe stærke samarbejder med interne og eksterne interessenter, herunder operatører, dataejere og bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling af organisationen.

Du trives derfor med en alsidig hverdag, hvor du både skal være tæt på forretningens behov og samtidig tænke strategisk om fremtidens digitale understøttelse af busdriften.

Om Driftsudvikling
Stillingen er organisatorisk placeret i Driftsudvikling i Busdrift.

Områdets vigtigste mål er at udvikle en mere effektiv, transparent og anvendelig opfølgning på busdriften som kommer passagererne til gode. Vi arbejder i et komplekst felt, hvor samarbejde, ansvarlighed og en tydelig kobling mellem drift, data og digitale løsninger er og vil blive endnu mere afgørende.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og arbejder sammen om at skabe værdi for passagerer, operatører og Movia. Som projektleder får du derfor både opbakning, sparring og handlefrihed. Det forventes, at du tager ansvar for dine projekter, skaber fremdrift og bidrager aktivt til den fortsatte udvikling af busdriften, men du vil samtidig blive mødt med tillid og en oprigtig interesse for både dine resultater og din trivsel.

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Har cirka 1-3 års relevant erfaring med projektledelse, digitale udviklingsforløb eller implementeringsopgaver.
  • Har arbejdet med projektstyring, interessenthåndtering samt digitalisering og optimering af arbejdsgange.
  • Kan omsætte forretningsbehov til konkrete krav og navigere i en kompleks hverdag med mange interne og eksterne interessenter.
  • Er struktureret, undersøgende og troværdig og formår at skabe stærke relationer og fælles retning.
  • Arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar og motiveres af at udvikle både løsninger, samarbejder og forretning.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til IT-arkitektur, dataflows, backend-processer, AI eller automatisering, men det er ikke et krav.

Interesseret?
Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Mads Hultén Degel på tlf.: +45 31 21 98 54.

Ansøgningsfrist er den 5. oktober 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes gennemført i uge 41 og 43.

Stillingen er på fuld tid med tiltrædelse den 1. december 2026 eller tidligere.

Lønnen fastsættes på baggrund af gældende overenskomst og en konkret vurdering af din uddannelse, din dokumenterede erhvervserfaring samt dine faglige og personlige kvalifikationer. Movia anvender objektive og kønsneutrale kriterier for lønfastsættelse i overensstemmelse med reglerne om lige løn for samme arbejde eller arbejde af samme værdi.

Du kommer til at referere til Driftschef Bus, Mads Hultén Degel, eller til den kommende digitale lead.

Mads' ledelsesstil er kendetegnet ved høj tillid, stor rummelighed og et stærkt fokus på, at medarbejderne både trives og har de bedste forudsætninger for at lykkes.

"Jeg tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når mennesker trives. Derfor er det vigtigt for mig at skabe et arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til både faglig udvikling, sparring og forskellige perspektiver. Jeg sætter tydelige hjørneflag og forventninger til, hvor vi skal hen som team, men inden for de rammer skal der være frihed til at tage ansvar, tænke nyt og finde de løsninger, der giver mest værdi. Jeg tror ikke på detailstyring - jeg tror på tillid, nærværende ledelse og på at skabe de bedste muligheder for, at medarbejdere kan performe og lykkes." Mads Hultén Degel.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: IT Systems Analyst V (AFCAT) Traditional Security
description:
This position supports the Air Force Cyber Assessment Team (AFCAT) in the 688th Cyberspace Wing and conducts Cyber Operational Readiness Assessments (CORA) at Air Force locations around the world. These assessments will help strengthen the posture and resiliency of the DoW Information Network (DOWIN) by supporting commanders and directors in their efforts to harden their information systems, reduce the attack surface of their cyber terrain, and enhance a more proactive defense.

Team members will specialize in Cyber Operational Risk Assessments (CORA), focusing on areas such as endpoint security, network vulnerability, insider threat, and more. This role helps ensure Air Force compliance and effectiveness in cyber defense strategies.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Determine, in conjunction with supervisor, the technology areas to focus personal training on and when to enter the program for required training.

  • Contractor shall obtain DOD Cyber Defense Command (DCDC) certification in assigned technology areas (Traditional Security: Security Fundamentals Professional Certification (SFPC)) and complete required assessments and evaluations. Training must be completed no more than six months prior to the On-the-Job Training (OJT), check ride, and assessments.

  • Ensure all certification requirements are up to date, including a minimum of 4 assessments per technology area each fiscal year.

  • Contractor shall utilize appropriate tools and methodologies based on DCDC standard processes and procedures.

  • Stay informed on 688 CW/CC, AFCYBER/CC, and larger Air Force strategic priorities to inform base selection for CORAs.

  • Advocate with wing organizations for access to enterprise assets and capabilities to prepare for CORA.

  • Support daily assessment meetings to track progress and provide summaries to base leadership and 688 CW leadership.

  • Prepare, assess, and report on DOW assets concentrated towards physical, personal, industrial, and communications security.

  • Communicate and advocate effectively to information systems owners, FDOs, Security Managers, COMSEC managers and other personnel to efficiently uphold their security posture IAW US regulations.

  • Must be well versed with the risk management framework process and have knowledge with contingency plans and continuity of operations.

  • Inspect and validate artifacts against the Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIG) and other governing documents such as DoDM 5200.01 Vol 1-4 (Information Security Program), NISPOM and related items.

  • Complete assessment checklists as required.

    • Participate in regular teleconferences with base comm squadron leadership to identify issues and inform commanders on risk.

    • Provide written feedback on process update recommendations.

    • Coordinate travel arrangements with fellow assessment team members.

    • Complete supervisory and administrative tasks as required.

    • Complete other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience

  • Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Must have excellent critical thinking skills

Certifications

Required:

Desired:

Desired: Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

title: Director of Assessing
description:
The Town of Barnstable (population 49,000) is seeking a qualified applicant to fill the full-time position of the Director of Assessing to work under the administrative supervision of the Town Finance Director. The Director of Assessing is responsible for the professional, administrative, technical and supervisory work related to the valuation and re-valuation of all real and personal property within the Town in accordance with Department of Revenue regulations and related Massachusetts General Laws.

The salary range, depending on experience, is $132,334 - $158,151, annually based upon forty (40) hours a week, fifty-two (52) weeks a year. There is also a very generous benefits package, including paid time off, professional development and health insurance (paid at 70% of the premiums) in accordance with current Collective Bargaining Agreement. Other benefits include dental insurance, Employee assistance program, Flexible spending account, Health savings account, Life insurance, Paid time off, Professional development assistance, Retirement plan, Deferred compensation, and Disability insurance. This position is eligible for overtime.

Applicants must have thorough knowledge of assessing procedures, real estate appraisal and VISION CAMA software. Must have the ability to solve complex deed and subdivision issues. Comprehensive knowledge of computers and various computer applications related to assessing/appraisal services. Ability to prepare and present testimony and defense of values on appeal from taxpayers. Must have the ability to supervise personnel. Must have excellent interpersonal and verbal/written communications skills.

Administers CAMA system and determines valuations of real estate and personal property for assessment purposes. An outside service is used to assist with personal property and commercial valuations. Develops, prepares and submits valuations, statistical and new growth reports to the Massachusetts Department of Revenue (DOR), including participating in the annual tax rate recapitulation process. Makes recommendations regarding abatements to Board of Assessors. Prepares defense of valuation cases and represents interest of Town at Appellate Tax Board. Develops and maintains strategies necessary to adapt to changing regulatory requirements and valuation landscapes. Directs all operations in the Assessor’s Department including operation’s budget preparation and management oversight. Performs similar or other related work as required.

Bachelor’s degree with courses in business administration, finance & property assessment, more than 7 years of progressively responsible experience in the valuation of property for tax purposes in accordance with modern assessment principles including 5 years of supervisory experience; or any equivalent combination of education & experience. Certification as a MA Accredited Assessor or as a Certified MA Assessor required or the ability to obtain. Class D driver’s license.

The Town of Barnstable is made up of seven distinct villages, each with their own unique character: Barnstable, Centerville, Cotuit, Hyannis, Marstons Mills, Osterville and West Barnstable. title: Kultur- og idrætsmedarbejder til det gode værtskab i Grøndal MultiCenter
description:
Vi søger dig, som trives med at byde vores kunder velkommen i centret, yder god service og er klar til at sikre de praktiske opgaver i den daglige drift. Vi arbejder i teams og hjælper hinanden i en ofte travl hverdag på Københavns største idrætsfacilitet.

Vi tilbyder

  • en spændende og udfordrende arbejdsplads
  • et godt arbejdsmiljø med en uformel tone
  • teamsamarbejde og god kollegial sparring
Om jobbet
Vi har ca. 30 medarbejdere, som varetager den daglige drift af Grøndal MultiCenter. Vi arbejder med administrative og praktiske opgaver omkring idrætten i Vanløse bydel i tæt samarbejde med foreninger, brugere og udøvere i et aktivt miljø.

Dine primære arbejdsområder vil sammen med værtskabsteamet være

  • opsyn/tilrettevisning/rundering/vejledning
  • faste og ad hoc-opgaver som fx rengøring, oprydning/soigneringsopgaver og opstilling af borde, stole etc.
  • service af husets brugere, lejere, foreninger og samarbejdspartnere
  • salg af baner og sportsartikler
  • lettere mail- og telefonkommunikation.
Om dig
Vi arbejder målrettet på at møde borgerne og hinanden med et smil på læben samt en hjælpende hånd, når situationen kræver det. Vi forventer, at du værdsætter god service, er en god kollega og kan repræsentere et godt værtskab. Samtidig forventer vi, at du

  • er ansvarsfuld, stabil og kan arbejde selvstændigt
  • er servicemindet og tager initiativ
  • trives i en skiftende hverdag, med både rutine- og akutte opgaver
  • er en god holdspiller og kollega
  • behersker godt dansk og engelsk i både skrift og tale
  • har kendskab til IT på brugerniveau.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesforhold er i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem Københavns Kommune og 3F. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen med mulighed for merarbejde. Du vil indgå i en seks ugers turnus med blandede vagter, og der vil både være dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde. Weekendarbejde finder normalt sted hver 2. weekend. Vi ønsker tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt og indhenter børneattest og reference i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Mere information
Hvis du er interesseret og gerne vil høre mere, så er du meget velkommen til at ringe til koordinator Lotte Christensen på 21 30 69 85.

Søg via linket senest søndag den 11. oktober 2026
Ansættelsessamtalerne vil finde sted i uge 43.

Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen
I Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe gode rammer for kultur- og fritidslivet i byen, og for at give københavnerne samt byens gæster en professionel og nærværende service. Fra biblioteker, kulturhuse og museer til idrætsfaciliteter, borgerservice og byens grønne rum – skaber vi rammer for fællesskaber, hvor københavnerne kan mødes og udfolde sig. Vores fælles mål er at gøre København til et godt sted at leve, mødes og engagere sig.

title: Athletic Trainer
description:
Why UMP?
UMP is a physician-led organization focused on transforming musculoskeletal care through innovation, collaboration, and operational support. This role allows you to be part of that mission—delivering high-quality spine care in a thriving clinical environment.

About OrthoTexas
OrthoTexas is recognized for its advanced treatment options, multidisciplinary approach, and dedication to improving patients’ quality of life. As part of this team, you’ll work alongside top spine specialists in a supportive and forward-thinking practice.

If you're an APP looking to make a meaningful impact in specialized care, we invite you to explore this opportunity. Help us bring exceptional orthopedic care to communities of the Metroplex—where your expertise can truly make a difference.

    • Up to 2 weeks of PTO starting out. (Increases with tenure)
    • 7 paid holidays + 2 floating holidays


Athletic training is the care and service provided by or under the direction or supervision of a certified athletic trainer. It entails evaluation, treatment and management of musculoskeletal injuries and disorders for the purpose of promoting and enhancing human functional performance.


  • Provide services directed toward achieving increased functional independence, decreasing functional limitations, and prevention of injuries to the physically active individual/athlete.
  • Upon the advice and consent of a physician, carry out the practice of prevention, recognition, evaluation, management, disposition, treatment, and/or rehabilitation of injuries.
  • Use physical modalities, such as heat, light, sound, cold, electricity, or mechanical devices related to treatment of the injured individual.
  • Provide education in the prevention of injuries, conditioning, and rehabilitation of injuries is an integral part of their scope of practice.
  • Direct and supervise athletic training services under the direction of physicians and in accordance with individual state practice acts.
  • Interact and practice in collaboration with a variety of professionals, including physicians, nurses, occupational therapists, and physical therapists.
  • Consult, educate, engage in research, and administrate.
  • Document evaluative findings, treatments administered, the assessment of patient response to treatment and treatment plan.
  • Communicate with the referring physician regarding patient progress.
  • Attend required meetings and participate as requested.
  • Clean and maintain treatment area and workspace.
  • Participate in professional development activities and maintain professional affiliations.
  • Other duties as assigned.

SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Maintains a professional manner while effectively working with others.
  • Knowledge and skills in athletic training and orthopedic rehabilitation.
  • Knowledge and skills in rehab equipment and safety regulations.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology.
  • Customer Service Skills
  • Patient Care skills
  • Knowledge of computer systems and Microsoft Office programs.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely in all written and oral communications, including email.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to speak effectively before patients and groups of customers or employees of the organization.
  • A self-starter with the ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
