title: Senior Environmental Project Manager
description:
About Atlas

Atlas is a trusted leader in environmental and infrastructure consulting services; we provide services that enable communities to flourish and thrive. With a team of 3,500 employees and offices throughout the US, we combine local expertise and a network of relationships to deliver solutions to both public and private clients. Our services help improve the quality of life in the communities where we live and work. We always aim for smart, safe, and sustainable results. At Atlas we understand that our future is everyone’s responsibility, and we create a better experience at every stage of a project.

Job Description

Atlas Technical Consultants is seeking an experienced Senior Environmental Project Manager to support and grow our environmental consulting practice throughout New England. This leadership role is responsible for managing complex environmental projects, maintaining strong client relationships, providing technical expertise, and supporting business development initiatives across a broad range of environmental consulting services.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in contaminated site assessment and remediation, environmental compliance, project management, and client service, along with the ability to successfully manage multiple projects and foster long-term client partnerships.

Location: Remote within New England or Hybrid from our Woburn, MA office.

Core Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Project Delivery

  • Lead and manage environmental assessment, remediation, and regulatory compliance projects throughout New England.
  • Manage site assessment and remediation projects under New Hampshire Department of Environmental Services (NHDES) programs and applicable state environmental regulations.
  • Oversee Underground Storage Tank (UST) assessment, remediation, and closure projects.
  • Manage Environmental Due Diligence projects, including Phase I and Phase II Environmental Site Assessments.
  • Provide senior-level technical guidance and support to project teams across the region.
  • Review technical reports, work plans, remedial designs, proposals, and regulatory submissions to ensure quality and regulatory compliance.
  • Ensure projects are executed in accordance with applicable environmental regulations, industry standards, and Atlas quality requirements.

Project & Financial Management

  • Serve as Project Manager for environmental consulting projects from proposal through completion.
  • Develop project scopes, budgets, schedules, cost estimates, and work plans.
  • Monitor project performance to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery and achievement of financial objectives.
  • Manage project risks, client expectations, and regulatory requirements throughout project execution.
  • Support revenue growth and profitability through effective project management and client service.

Business Development & Client Management

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with commercial, industrial, municipal, and state agency clients.
  • Identify and pursue new project opportunities with existing and prospective clients.
  • Prepare proposals and participate in business development and client presentation activities.
  • Collaborate with Atlas professionals across service lines to support cross-selling opportunities and integrated client solutions.
  • Support strategic growth initiatives throughout New England.

Mentorship & Team Support

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to environmental scientists, engineers, and project staff.
  • Support staff development through training, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
  • Foster a collaborative culture focused on technical excellence, safety, and client satisfaction.

You'll Thrive Here If You Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Geology, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of environmental consulting experience, including project management responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated experience managing environmental assessment, remediation, due diligence, and regulatory compliance projects.
  • Strong working knowledge of New Hampshire and Eastern New England (NH, MA, ME, RI) site assessment and remediation environmental regulations.
  • New Hampshire Site Remediation Program (SRP) experience strongly preferred.
  • Professional Engineer (PE), Professional Geologist (PG), or Licensed Site Professional (LSP) registration preferred.
  • Experience managing project budgets, schedules, client communications, and multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain client relationships and contribute to business development efforts.
  • OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER certification.
  • Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record.
  • Willingness to travel periodically throughout New England as well as providing spill response technical support.

What you can expect from us

The A-Team Experience is our employee program focused on helping our people thrive professionally, personally and as part of a community. We trust our people to do great work and live fulfilling lives, and we provide resources that care for our people, both at work and in life:

  • Health & Wellness: We offer medical, dental and vision coverage with multiple plan options, including no-cost employee-only medical coverage.

  • Time Off & Family Support: We offer vacation time, paid holidays, sick & safety leave (SSL) and paid parental leave

  • Retirement: We help employees plan for the future with a 401(k) and company match.

  • Insurance: To provide protection and peace of mind, we offer Life, AD&D (Accidental Death & Dismemberment) and Disability insurance.

  • Safety Program: We are committed to safety as part of our ‘quality of life’ core value, and we provide approved PPE at no cost and reimbursement for prescription safety glasses and protective footwear.

  • Learning & Development: We provide clear career paths, learning resources and development programs allowing you to see how you can grow and advance within the company. We offer internal certifications on specific skills and support external credentials through tuition reimbursement.

  • Belonging: We support Employee Communities (ECs), voluntary, employee-led groups that create connections, belonging and shared purposes.

  • Flexibility: May vary by project demands and regional workloads, but we are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to help employees manage their personal and professional responsibilities.

Our people and our culture are central to our work. Our values bring us together, create a sense of belonging and give us purpose. They guide how we make decisions, how we work as a team and how we serve our clients.

  • Life: We enhance the quality of life. We value people and safety above all else.

  • Heart: As our hallmark, we act with compassion, empathy, and respect.

  • Trust: We work together as partners, doing what we say with full accountability.

  • Mastery: Always striving for the highest quality, greatness inspires our work.

About the Job

  • Career Level: Senior
  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: $115,000 - $140,000 annual salary
    The expected salary range for the position is displayed in accordance with the state’s law. Final agreed upon compensation is based upon individual qualifications and experience.

title: Administratör - Konsultuppdrag
description:
Är du en noggrann administratör med god systemvana och ett öga för detaljer? Då kan det här vara ditt nästa jobb.

Vi söker en administrativ konsult till ett kortare heltidsuppdrag hos ett etablerat bolag inom certifiering och kvalitet. Du kommer in i ett pågående projekt där information ska kvalitetssäkras och föras över till ett nytt system som används för planering av kunduppdrag.

Rollen passar dig som är strukturerad, ansvarstagande och noggrann och som har lätt för att sätta dig in i olika system. Du tycker om att arbeta metodiskt med information, är lösningsorienterad och tar självständigt reda på det du behöver för att komma vidare. Du har ett öga för detaljer och reagerar när något inte stämmer, söker information från flera källor och säkerställer att rätt uppgifter hamnar på rätt plats. Intresse för AI och hur digitala verktyg kan effektivisera administrativa processer är ett stort plus.

Tjänsten är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer vara anställd av Futuria People och arbeta som konsult hos kund. Alla frågor kring tjänsten och rekryteringen hänvisas till ansvarig rekryteringskonsult på Futuria.

Om företaget

Företaget är en etablerad aktör inom certifiering, kvalitet och kontroll med verksamhet på flera orter i Sverige. Organisationen arbetar med att hjälpa företag att säkerställa kvalitet, säkerhet och efterlevnad av olika standarder och regelverk.

Den aktuella verksamheten arbetar inom livsmedel och lantbruk med både nationella och internationella certifieringsstandarder. En viktig del av arbetet är att planera och genomföra revisioner ute hos företagets kunder.

Du blir en del av en verksamhet där kvalitet, noggrannhet och struktur är centralt. Arbetet sker nära kollegor med specialistkompetens inom sina respektive områden och du får en tydlig introduktion till arbetsuppgifterna och systemen.

Om tjänsten

Du kommer framför allt att stötta verksamheten i överföringen och kvalitetssäkringen av information till ett nytt planeringssystem. Arbetet utförs huvudsakligen på företagets kontor där du har tillgång till en modern arbetsmiljö och de verktyg som behövs för att arbeta effektivt. Det finns en flexibel inställning till arbetstider, samtidigt som arbetet med fördel sker under ordinarie kontorstid när teamet finns tillgängligt.

Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:

• Föra över och registrera information i företagets system

• Kontrollera uppgifter mot Excel, dokument, kundmappar och andra interna system

• Säkerställa att adresser, kontaktuppgifter och annan information är korrekt

• Kontrollera olika parametrar inför planering av kunduppdrag

• Identifiera avvikelser och uppgifter som behöver kompletteras eller korrigeras

• Arbeta i Microsoft CRM system

• Samla frågor och oklarheter för löpande avstämning med ansvariga kollegor

• Hitta effektiva arbetssätt med hjälp av AI-verktyg

Du får en praktisk introduktion tillsammans med en erfaren kollega. Målsättningen är att du efter den första tiden ska kunna driva stora delar av arbetet självständigt.

Vi söker dig som

• Har tidigare erfarenhet av administrativa arbetsuppgifter där du arbetat digitalt med större mängder information

• Behärskar svenska flytande i tal och skrift

• Har god datorvana och lätt för att sätta dig in i nya system

• Har erfarenhet av att arbeta i ett eller flera verksamhets-, register-, CRM- eller affärssystem

• Är noggrann och van att kontrollera information från flera olika källor

• Kan arbeta strukturerat och hålla ordning på flera informationsflöden samtidigt

• Kan arbeta heltid under uppdragsperioden

• Kan arbeta på plats på kundens kontor i Stockholm, Solna

Meriterande

• Erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics eller liknande CRM-system

• Erfarenhet av administration inom kvalitet, certifiering, livsmedel eller annan verksamhet med tydliga regelverk och processer

• Erfarenhet av AI-verktyg som Microsoft Copilot eller liknande

• Intresse för att identifiera hur administrativa arbetsmoment kan effektiviseras med AI och digitala verktyg

Du erbjuds

title: VP of Land Acquisition and Development
description:
About the role

We are seeking an experienced Vice President of Land Acquisition & Development to lead the division’s land strategy and support continued growth.

This leader will oversee the full lifecycle of land opportunities — from identifying and evaluating potential sites through acquisition, entitlement, development, and delivery of finished lots. The VP will work closely with division leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure we have the right land pipeline to support future communities, sales goals, and long-term profitability.

This is a highly visible leadership position requiring a strong understanding of residential land acquisition, development, financial analysis, local market conditions, and relationship building.

What You'll Lead

Land Acquisition & Growth Strategy

  • Develop and execute a land strategy that supports the division's short- and long-term growth plans.
  • Source and evaluate new land opportunities within targeted markets and submarkets.
  • Build relationships with landowners, brokers, developers, and other industry partners to uncover both marketed and off-market opportunities.
  • Evaluate potential acquisitions based on location, market demand, development costs, risk, timing, and expected financial returns.
  • Negotiate purchase agreements, option contracts, pricing, and other key deal terms.
  • Explore creative opportunities including assemblages, joint ventures, land banking, option structures, and strategic land purchases.
  • Identify land that may offer value through resale or other investment opportunities.

Due Diligence & Entitlements

  • Direct the due diligence process for prospective acquisitions and identify potential development risks early in the process.
  • Oversee zoning, entitlement, permitting, and governmental approval activities.
  • Partner with attorneys, engineers, consultants, municipalities, and regulatory agencies throughout the approval process.
  • Evaluate density, site constraints, infrastructure requirements, topography, and other factors that could impact the feasibility or profitability of a project.
  • Provide reliable development cost assumptions to support acquisition underwriting and investment decisions.

Land Development & Lot Delivery

  • Lead projects from acquisition through development and delivery of finished lots to the homebuilding team.
  • Oversee development schedules, budgets, contractors, engineers, and consultants.
  • Ensure communities and building pads are designed with both quality and construction efficiency in mind.
  • Monitor project costs and schedules and proactively address issues that could impact lot delivery or financial performance.
  • Coordinate infrastructure, community entrances, amenities, landscaping, and other development components.
  • Work closely with Construction, Purchasing, Sales, Marketing, and Finance to ensure lot delivery aligns with the division's business plan.
  • Leverage established relationships with master-planned community developers and other industry partners to identify and secure finished-lot opportunities throughout the Austin metro area.
  • Proactively pursue lot positions in high-quality master-planned communities, including opportunities that may not be broadly marketed, to support near-term growth and maintain a balanced pipeline of finished lots and self-developed communities.

Leadership & Partnerships

  • Lead and develop the division's Land Acquisition and Land Development teams.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Division President and leadership team.
  • Maintain strong relationships throughout the local real estate and development community.
  • Provide leadership with clear recommendations regarding land opportunities, risks, costs, and potential returns.
  • Help build and maintain a sustainable pipeline of future communities and finished lots.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Significant progressive experience in residential land acquisition and/or land development, preferably within the production homebuilding industry.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating, negotiating, and closing land transactions.
  • Strong understanding of residential development, zoning, entitlements, permitting, and construction.
  • Experience managing development budgets, schedules, consultants, and contractors.
  • Ability to analyze land opportunities and understand development pro formas, costs, margins, and financial returns.
  • Established relationships within the land, development, brokerage, or residential real estate community are highly valued.
  • Previous leadership experience managing teams and multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, financial, and relationship-building skills.

Ideal Background

The ideal candidate understands both the deal side and the development side of residential land. They can identify a strong opportunity, understand what it will take to entitle and develop it, accurately assess the financial implications, negotiate the transaction, and ultimately ensure finished lots are delivered to the homebuilding operation.

We're looking for a strategic leader who can balance growth, risk, cost, timing, and profitability while building strong relationships both inside the organization and throughout the local market.

About Us

Since 1988, Coventry Homes has built more than 55,000 homes across Texas and is consistently recognized among the nation’s top homebuilders. Known for quality craftsmanship, innovative design, and exceptional customer service, Coventry serves the Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin, and San Antonio markets.

Coventry Homes is proud to be part of the Dream Finders Homes (DFH) family of builders, one of the nation’s leading homebuilders with a growing presence across the U.S.

title: Senior Healthcare Claims Analyst
description:
Position: Senior Healthcare Claims Processor
Location: Remote, Eastern Standard Time (EST) based in the Continental United States.
Reports To: Program Director

Overview:
J29 is an employee centered health and human service management consulting company that specializes in processing, reviewing, and analyzing claims, records, disputes, and audits. Established in 2017, J29 prides itself on its employee centric culture and high employee retention rates that allow us to ensure that we are creating a working environment that prioritizes the employee experience. Our team brings corporate performance where we provide our clinical, healthcare policy, and compliance expertise through our support to health and human service programs.

J29 is seeking an experienced Claims Operations Lead to support the World Trade Center Health Program Third-Party Administrator contract. Reporting to the J29 Project Manager, this position serves as a senior operational and technical subject matter expert for healthcare claims processing.

The Senior Claims Operations Lead will help establish standard operating procedures, define and document claims processes, support operational implementation and readiness, and provide lead-level claims expertise to healthcare claims processors. The role will translate program requirements and claims policies into practical workflows, training materials, quality controls, and daily operating procedures. This position is one level below the Healthcare Claims Project Manager and does not own overall project budget, client management, or contract delivery.

Duties:
Claims Implementation and Operational Readiness
  • Support the J29 Project Manager with the implementation and startup of healthcare claims operations.
  • Help define end-to-end claims workflows, operating procedures, handoffs, escalation paths, and controls.
  • Participate in requirements reviews, workflow design sessions, operational readiness reviews, user acceptance testing, claims scenario testing, and go-live support.
  • Validate that documented claims processes align with applicable program requirements, business rules, benefit limitations, and operational expectations.
  • Identify implementation gaps, operational risks, and process dependencies and elevate them to the Project Manager with recommended solutions.
SOP and Process Development
  • Develop, document, implement, and maintain claims processing standard operating procedures, workflows, desk guides, job aids, and reference materials.
  • Translate claims policies, reimbursement requirements, system rules, and client direction into clear and repeatable processor instructions.
  • Define procedures for claims intake, review, adjudication, pend and reject handling, adjustments, escalations, and quality review, as applicable to the program.
  • Assess existing workflows and recommend practical improvements that strengthen accuracy, timeliness, consistency, and compliance.
  • Maintain version control and support timely updates to procedures when program or system requirements change.
Lead Claims Subject Matter Expertise
  • Serve as an additional lead-level claims SME for healthcare claims processors and other operational team members.
  • Provide day-to-day technical guidance on complex claims, exceptions, edits, payment questions, and processing requirements.
  • Research and help resolve escalated claims issues using applicable procedures, benefit rules, reimbursement guidance, and system information.
  • Support consistent interpretation and application of claims processing requirements across the team.
  • Partner with the Project Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve recurring operational issues.
Training and Processor Support
  • Support onboarding, training, mentoring, and ongoing knowledge development for healthcare claims processors.
  • Create or refine training content, claims examples, knowledge checks, job aids, and refresher materials.
  • Provide individual and group coaching on procedures, claims quality, system use, and complex processing scenarios.
  • Identify knowledge gaps or recurring errors and recommend targeted training or procedural clarification.
Quality, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement
  • Support claims quality reviews, calibration activities, root cause analysis, and corrective action efforts.
  • Monitor claims trends and recurring issues to identify opportunities for procedural, training, system, or workflow improvement.
  • Promote compliance with contract requirements, privacy and security obligations, J29 policies, and program-specific procedures.
  • Assist with audit readiness, operational reporting, and documentation requested by the Project Manager.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement culture within a fully remote team.

Experience:
  • 8+ years of healthcare claims processing, adjudication, reimbursement, payment integrity, claims review, or related healthcare claims operations experience.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or implementing SOPs, workflows, desk procedures, job aids, or training materials.
  • Experience supporting claims operations implementation, process design, operational readiness, system conversion, or major workflow change.
  • Experience serving as a senior claims processor, lead, trainer, mentor, analyst, or subject matter expert for other claims staff.
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end healthcare claims lifecycle, including claims intake, review, adjudication, reimbursement, adjustments, denials or rejections, and escalation handling.
  • Ability to analyze complex claims issues, interpret requirements, document decisions, and communicate clear operational guidance.
  • Strong independent problem-solving, organization, and time management skills in a fully remote environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and other collaboration or reporting tools.
  • 3-5+ years of experience leading claims supervisors, examiners, analysts, operational teams, or claims quality programs, including responsibility for productivity, performance, and accountability initiatives.
  • 3-5+ years of direct involvement in claims system implementations, upgrades, process redesign, operational readiness, business requirements gathering, user acceptance testing, and defect triage, resolution, and validation.
  • 3+ years of client-facing experience participating in operational review meetings, resolving issues, managing stakeholder expectations, and presenting performance results, risks, and recommendations.
  • Strong working knowledge of provider reimbursement methodologies, claims quality review, auditing, appeals, reconsiderations, operational metrics, reporting, workflow management, and payment accuracy programs.
  • Working knowledge of claims reporting, operational dashboards, service-level agreement tracking, root cause analysis, and Microsoft Excel.

Preferred Experience
  • Experience supporting a limited health benefit program, specialty benefit program, occupational health program, workers compensation program, or other program in which coverage is tied to defined eligibility and covered conditions.
  • Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, Federal healthcare, or third-party administrator claims operations.
  • Experience with benefit configuration, coordination of benefits, provider reimbursement, appeals, payment integrity, or claims quality.
  • Knowledge of healthcare electronic transactions and files, including 834, 835, and 837 transactions, and a general understanding of file transfer processes.
  • Experience with more than one claims payment, adjudication, workflow, or case management system.
  • Healthcare claims, coding, billing, auditing, health information management, or related industry certification.
  • 3-5+ years of medical coding knowledge preferred, including ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, revenue codes, modifiers, medical necessity concepts, and the effect of coding on claim payment and authorization decisions. Professional coding certification is a plus but is not required.
  • Strong understanding of prior authorization workflows, referral management, medical necessity review, clinical documentation requirements, and authorization-related claim edits.
  • Experience with coordination of benefits, including primary and secondary payer rules, Medicare coordination, Other Health Insurance (OHI), workers compensation coordination, and recovery processes.
  • Experience with PLEXIS, Facets, QNXT, HealthRules, NASCO, TriZetto platforms, or other healthcare claims processing systems.
  • Experience with SQL, Power BI, or comparable data analysis and reporting tools.

Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, public policy, communications, technical writing, or a related field is required.
    • Claims related certifications or trainings, preferred

Salary: $32,000-42,000

J29, Inc. is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. J29, Inc. is a proud Veteran friendly employer.

The purpose of this position is to provide senior-level financial administration and leadership for Rock Region METRO, with executive oversight of the Authority's grants and procurement programs. Under the direction of the Chief Financial Officer, the position leads procurement and contracting activities, provides high-level oversight of federal, state, and local grants, supports capital and financial planning, strengthens internal controls and compliance, and performs major financial, policy, and cross-departmental initiatives. The position serves as a senior resource to the Chief Financial Officer and may act on the CFO's behalf as assigned.

3SDevelops, implements, reviews, and enforces procurement policies and procedures and provides guidance and training to staff regarding local, state, federal, and other applicable procurement requirements.
4SPrepares and reviews Invitations for Bids, Requests for Proposals, qualifications-based procurements, specifications, contract documents, award recommendations, and Board materials; negotiates contract terms and resolves complex procurement and contract issues.

7SCoordinates with the CFO, department directors, project managers, and funding agencies to align capital and operating funding needs with available grant resources and the Authority's financial and capital plans.
8SProvides leadership for Finance-related portions of Federal Transit Administration reviews, including the Triennial Review, and coordinates corrective actions and supporting documentation related to grants and procurement.
9SMonitors grant and procurement compliance, internal controls, contract and grant risks, funding limitations, and performance; recommends corrective actions and process improvements.
10SCoordinates cross-functional activities involving grants, procurement, finance, capital projects, and contract compliance to ensure appropriate segregation of duties and accountability.

title: Hepatologist
description:
At Sahlgrenska University Hospital, we work together to provide the highest quality of care with the patient at the center. Our great commitment and continuous learning make us one of the country's leading university hospitals. We provide everything from county healthcare to national highly specialized care. We focus on the future of healthcare through exciting research. We care about digital skills and everyone's contribution to the digital development. Our work is about using our collected knowledge and experiences together with you – to create value for our patients.

We are transforming healthcare with the ambition of becoming Europe’s leading university hospital by 2032. In partnership with our patients, we work to ensure quality, accessibility, patient safety, research, education, and innovation within an integrated healthcare system across the Västra Götaland Region in Sweden.

Sahlgrenska University Hospital is one of Northern Europe's largest hospitals with over 17,000 colleagues who have different experience and backgrounds.

About us

The Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Sahlgrenska University Hospital (SU) is one of the largest in the Nordic region. We provide emergency and scheduled outpatient care, and have close collaboration with other departments including upper and lower GI surgery, and transplantation surgery.

The department is organized into teams focusing on hepatologic outpatient care, gastroenterologic outpatient care, endoscopy, intestinal failure unit, and an inpatient ward. The department is actively involved in ongoing research across several fields and has a strong emphasis on education, continuing professional development, and the ongoing advancement of clinical services.

What can we offer?

As a Specialist Physician/Senior Consultant at the Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatolgy at Sahlgrenska university Hospital, you will have excellent opportunities for professional development and research. You will work within our subspecialty teams alongside ambitious and friendly colleagues, with close collaboration with the transplantation unit.

The department has a high patient volume, providing extensive opportunities for both clinical practice and research.

Our goal is to provide the highest possible standard of care for our patients. We place great importance on supporting each individual's professional development according to their interests, strengths, and career goals, while also enabling them to influence their working environment.

About the Role

You will work with the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of patients requiring specialized care in hepatology in both emergency and elective settings. Your duties will include working in the outpatient clinic, inpatient ward, and at the liver transplant unit, as well as participation during office hours and on-call duties.

Teaching and supervising less experienced colleagues, medical students, and healthcare professionals is an integral part of the role. You will also be expected to take an active part in the department’s quality improvement, development, and change initiatives, as well as in research activities.

About You

We are looking for a board-certified senior consultant in Gastroenterology and Hepatology with a high level of expertise in hepatology. You should be interested in both your own professional development and contributing to the advancement of care at one of the largest university hospitals in the Nordic region. You work well within a team and have a strong interest in liver disease.

We value strong communication and collaboration skills. You are able to apply newly acquired knowledge in your clinical practice, make sound clinical judgments, and thrive in a fast-paced work environment. We are seeking a motivated and independent individual with the ability and interest to take overall responsibility and place the patient's needs at the center of care.

Ongoing research activities and/or a doctoral degree (PhD) are considered meritorious.

Great emphasis will be placed on personal suitability.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis throughout the recruitment period.

We warmly welcome your application!

Together for the patient - Sahlgrenska Universitetssjukhuset

In the event of recruiting a physician or nurse with a foreign medical license and/or specialist certification, the appointment will be preceded by the necessary process to fulfill the requirements for Swedish licensure and/or specialist recognition.

About Region Västra Götaland

Region Västra Götaland is there for the people of Västra Götaland. We ensure good quality healthcare for everyone. We work towards a sustainable development and growth, a clean environment, an improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland.

Region Västra Götaland is actively working to digitize more ways of working. To be part of the digital transformation, you need to have basic skills and be able to use digital tools and services. You know how to search for information, how to communicate and interact digitally, you are also risk-aware and motivated to be part of the development to learn new things.

If you want to know more about Region Västra Götaland, you can visit our introduction to new employees at www.vgregion.se/introduction. You can also read more in the presentation on Salary, remuneration and benefits – what you will receive as an employee in VGR.

All permanent employees of Region Västra Götaland are assigned wartime postings.

Application

Region Västra Götaland would like you to register your application through the recruitment system. If you have any questions about the advertised job, or if you are unable to register your information in a public system for any reason, please contact the person who advertised the job.

For employment agencies, intermediaries, recruitment agencies and salespeople:

We kindly refrain from direct contact with employment agencies, intermediaries, recruitment agencies and other external actors and sellers of additional job advertisements. Region Västra Götaland has tendered contracts.

title: Employee Experience Coordinator
description:
Belvedere Trading is a leading proprietary trading firm proudly headquartered in downtown Chicago. Our traders work hard to provide liquidity to the market through their market-making activities and are the masters of a diverse set of commodities, interest rates, exchange-traded funds (ETF), and equity index options. From the beginning, we began iteratively investing in our proprietary technology and committing to building our systems from the ground up. Our trading models and software systems are continually re-engineered, optimized, and maintained to stay on top of the industry.
Our People Team department focuses on delivering employee-first solutions to the business. We go all-out to understand and support our team member's needs, leverage data to gain insights and trends, and advance our human-capital-related applications for efficiency and consistency. We look for passionate team members that excel and their contribution is critical to our continued success. The People Team is comprised of Employee Experience, People Operations, Talent, and People & Development. These groups work closely together to bring in the best talent for Team Belvedere and from day one, make sure that all team members have all the tools they need to succeed and develop through their tenure.

Belvedere Trading is seeking an Employee Experience Coordinator to join our People Team. The Employee Experience team helps shape what it feels like to work at Belvedere by creating meaningful programs, experiences, and traditions that foster connection, engagement, and a strong sense of community. title: 1 - 2 pædagoger søges til Fjordskolen Hedevang
description:
Fjordskolen Hedevang er en af Roskilde Kommunes specialskoler til børn med særlige behov. Hedevang ligger placeret i Gundsømagle lidt nord for Roskilde i natur omgivelser og med bus 600S – 358 næsten lige til døren.

Skolen har 0. - 10. klasse, 2 SFO/klub, en juniorklub og en aftenklub. Pædagoger, pædagogiske assistenter, pædagogmedhjælpere, og lærere har et tæt samarbejde.

Med eleven i centrum arbejdes der målrettet og specialpædagogisk med faglighed, sociale kompetencer og personlig udvikling. Skolen har gode forhold til aktiviteter både inde og ude, som kan understøtte og fremme elevernes læringsmuligheder.

Hedevang er målrettet elever, hvis primære udfordringer er autismespektrumforstyrrelser og/eller opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser. Flere af skolens elever er derudover udfordret af tilknytningsforstyrrelser/socio-emotionelle vanskeligheder, OCD, generelle og/eller specifikke indlæringsvanskeligheder samt skolevægring.

Vi søger en til to uddannede pædagoger min. 33 timer pr. uge med opstart 1.12.2026 eller snarest derefter, gerne med erfaring inden for målgruppen og med aldersgruppen 5 – 12 år.
Arbejdet som pædagog på Hedevang består af mange vekslende opgaver i hele huset, i samarbejde med en stor gruppe stabile, engagerede og dygtige kolleger.

Vi lægger vægt på, at ansøgeren kan arbejde struktureret og har stor lyst til at lære – særligt i forhold til specialpædagogisk arbejde. Jobbet kræver tillige gode samarbejdsevner, da arbejdet foregår i og på tværs af teams.

Vi forventer, at ansøgeren har gode kommunikative kompetencer, da jobbet indebærer en høj grad af forældresamarbejde bl.a. i form af samtaler og skriftlig dokumentation fx elevbeskrivelser.



Vi ønsker en ansøgning og et CV, der afspejler hvordan ansøgerens kompetencer passer til den ledige stilling. Vi modtager meget gerne ansøgninger fra nyuddannede, der er fagligt nysgerrige og som har lyst til at lære. Vi tilbyder mentorordning til alle nyansatte.

title: Socialrådgiver søges til nyt børnepsykiatrisk ambulatorium – vær med til at udvikle indsatsen for børn, unge og familier på Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center (BUC)
description:
Har du myndighedserfaring med børn, unge og familier og har du lyst til et arbejde, hvor du hver dag gør en forskel for børn, unge og familier? I denne stilling får du mulighed for både at indgå i et stærkt tværfagligt miljø og være med til at forme og udvikle den socialfaglige indsats i et nyt børnepsykiatrisk ambulatorium.

Børne- og ungdomspsykiatrien vokser, og næste skud på stammen er et nyt børnepsykiatrisk ambulatorium for børn i alderen 8-13 år. Ambulatoriet skal i første omgang varetage behandling af ADHD, men ambitionen er på sigt at udvikle tilbuddet til også at omfatte udredning og behandling af en bred vifte af børne- og ungdomspsykiatriske lidelser. Som socialrådgiver får du derfor en unik mulighed for at være med til at opbygge og udvikle den socialfaglige indsats i et nyt tilbud, hvor tværfagligt samarbejde, inddragelse, faglig udvikling og nytænkning er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Afsnittet befinder sig geografisk på Herlev hospital, Borgmester Ib Juuls vej.


Jobbet
Du kommer til at fungere som afsnittets specialist i det tværsektorielle samarbejde. Du bidrager med din viden om sociallovgivning i konferencer og ved daglig sparring og undervisning af dine kollegaer. Derudover vil du få en væsentlig funktion ift. afsnittets forældre- og familiesamarbejde.

Dine nærmeste kollegaer bliver de tværfaglige kollegaer, sygeplejersker og læger, og på sigt også psykologer.

Monofagligt kommer du til at indgå i fagligt og socialt fællesskab med centerets erfarne, dygtige og engagerede socialrådgivergruppe på i alt 40 socialrådgivere.


Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Koordinere samarbejde i forhold til socialforvaltning, PPR, UU-vejledere samt andre institutioner herunder i døgninstitutioner/anbringelsessteder, hvis patienten er anbragt.
  • Administrativt arbejde herunder at bidrage til udarbejdelse af underretninger og erklæringer til de sociale myndigheder i samarbejde med læger og psykologer.
  • Vejledning af forældre og patienter i socialfaglige spørgsmål.
  • Støttende samtaler med forældre/familier.
  • Psykoedukation i gruppe og individuelt.
Du vil komme til at have en bred vifte af arbejdsopgaver, som vil stille krav til dine evner til at veksle mellem tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og selvstændigt monofagligt arbejde.

I løbet af en dag, vil du kunne opleve at skulle bidrage med det socialfaglige perspektiv ved en tværfaglig konference, være mødeleder og referent ved et netværksmøde, tale med kommunale sagsbehandlere mhp. at koordinere indsatser, udarbejde en underretning og have støttende samtale med forældre.

Uanset arbejdsopgavens art, så vil du komme til at trække på din viden og erfaring fra det kommunale myndighedsarbejde herunder samarbejde med familier i svære situationer og den viden du opbygger om børne- og ungdomspsykiatri.


Vi tilbyder:

  • En alsidig stilling med stor indflydelse, hvor du både understøtter børn og familier i deres hverdag og bidrager aktivt til udviklingen af et ambulatorium i rivende udvikling.
  • Et spændende speciale hvor du har en central rolle i forhold til at skabe kontakt til patientens hjemkommune og koordinere samarbejdet med kommunen samt i at støtte familier i en ofte svær situation.
  • En afsnitsledelse som lægger stor vægt på tværfaglig sparring og tæt samarbejde for at skabe sammenhængende patientforløb med barnet og familien i centrum.
  • En afsnitsledelse der prioriterer høj faglighed, godt kollegaskab og stor respekt for hinandens kompetencer.
  • Et grundigt introduktions- og oplæringsforløb- både monofagligt og tværfagligt samt nem adgang til sparring gennem din ansættelse.
  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde 1 dag om ugen.

Vi forventer

  • Uddannelse som socialrådgiver (ufravigeligt krav).
  • Praksiserfaring som socialrådgiver på myndighedsområdet med børn/unge.
  • Gode samarbejdsevner både ift. dine daglige kollegaer, vores tværsektorielle samarbejdspartnere og familierne.
  • Gode kommunikative evner såvel mundtligt som skriftligt.
Du skal være selvstændig og have en god portion faglig selvtillid. Du skal være lydhør ift. familiernes og afsnittets behov, samtidig med du også selv skal være opsøgende ift. hvor du kan bidrage med din socialfaglighed.

Klinisk erfaring fra børne- og ungdomspsykiatri og /eller voksenpsykiatri vil være en fordel.


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt og vi ønsker at du starter d. 1/12 2026 ellers snarest derefter.

Du ansættes i henhold til overenskomst for socialrådgivere - 32.32.1

I henhold til lovkrav skal der ved eventuel ansættelse på Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center forevises ren børneattest. Centret indhenter attesten hos Rigspolitiet med samtykke fra ansøger, der indstilles til ansættelse.


Vil du vide mere?
Ønsker du yderligere oplysninger om stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte ledende socialrådgiver Bettina Skovmand på 23 47 86 77 eller socialfaglig koordinator Mette Mertz på 51 71 08 24.

Oversygeplejerske Louise S. Andersen på 21 72 62 79 eller Oversygeplejerske Johanne Lysholdt-Hjarding 22 88 14 23


Søg stillingen
Send din motiverede ansøgning, cv og uddannelsesbevis via linket her på siden, senest den 5. oktober 2026.

Vi ser gerne, at du i din ansøgning beskriver din motivation for arbejdet som socialrådgiver i BUC, og hvorfor lige netop du, er den socialrådgiver vi mangler.

Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler d. 23. oktober og/eller d. 26. oktober.


Om Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center
Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center (BUC) er en del af Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospital og dækker hele Region Hovedstaden. Centeret foretager udredning og behandling af børn og unge med alle former for alvorlige psykiske lidelser, der kræver en tværfaglig indsats i hospitalsregi. Centeret har to kliniske afdelinger Afdeling Ambulant og Afdeling Døgn fordelt på flere matrikler i regionen, samt en stor forskningsenhed.

Herudover har centeret en række støttefunktioner, herunder en administration og en kvalitets- og forbedringsenhed. Samlet er vi ca. 1.000 ansatte, der indgår i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde om de ca. 18.000 børn og unge i alderen 0-17 år, der årligt ses i centeret (2025). Nærmere information om Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center kan findes på BUC hjemmeside www.buc-regionh.dk.

title: OCI DevOps Engineer
description:

URL: http://leidos.com

The Leidos Partnership for Defense Health is seeking an OCI DevOps Engineer to work remotely in support of its single-award DHMSM IDIQ contract, for the system known as MHS GENESIS. This highly visible program modernized Electronic Health Record (EHR) capabilities for the Department of War (DoW), supporting nearly 10 million service members and their families worldwide. While healthcare systems everywhere are challenged to improve quality, user experience, and cost, MHS GENESIS operates at DoW global scale and within a highly secure environment, all while supporting the Defense Health Agency (DHA)’s vision of a medically ready force—critical to our national defense.

As an OCI DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for deploying and managing networking segments, virtual machines, and associated block storage using Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services such as Resource Manager, Compute, Virtual Cloud Network, Block Volumes, and others. You will work closely with our application engineering and operations teams to ensure seamless integration and continuous delivery of our software products. Your expertise in DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud environments will be crucial in automating and optimizing our infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and Ansible, OCI Resource Manager.

  • Develop and maintain IaC scripts to automate the provisioning, configuration, and deployment of cloud environments.

  • Provision and secure micro-segmented virtual cloud networks in “hub and spoke” topologies.

  • Deploy and manage virtual machines, applications, and databases in OCI using services like Compute and Block Storage.

  • Secure application traffic flow using OCI Security Lists and Network Security Groups (NSG).

  • Secure access to cloud objects using OCI compartments and Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies.

  • Collaborate with application engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of cloud infrastructure with application development and deployment pipelines.

  • Monitor and optimize cloud infrastructure performance, security, and cost-efficiency.

  • Monitor and manage operating systems within the OCI environment.

  • Implement CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment processes.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud infrastructure and IaC scripts.

  • Stay up to date with the latest cloud technologies and best practices.

  • Ensure security and compliance standards are met across all deployments.

REQUIRED Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and 8 – 12 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 6 – 10 years of prior relevant experience.

  • US Citizen with an ACTIVE ADP1/IT1 Public Trust (or higher) clearance and completed Tier 5 background investigation. Contract requirement.

  • Proven experience in deploying and managing cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools.

  • Strong knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD methodologies.

  • Proficiency in Terraform and Ansible for infrastructure as code and configuration management.

  • Experience deploying and managing operating systems in a cloud environment.

  • Strong knowledge and administration skills of Linux and Windows operating systems.

  • General familiarity with virtual cloud networking concepts and topologies specifically “hub and spoke” networks.

  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools to ensure system reliability and performance.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform

  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Ruby, or Bash.

  • Experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, Github or OCI DevOps.

  • Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Experience in applying Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) to harden systems and cloud environments, ensuring compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) security protocols and reducing vulnerability exposure.

  • Designed, deployed, and managed secure cloud infrastructures while adhering to DoD cloud security requirements, including the integration of STIGs for IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS solutions.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, or Chef.

  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments.

Benefits

title: Customer Engineer, Advanced Technology, Google Cloud, Startup
description:

På Almi möter vi entreprenörer och företag med driv, ambitioner och vilja att utvecklas. Genom affärsutveckling, finansiering och ett starkt regionalt nätverk hjälper vi företag att ta nästa steg. Nu söker vi en rådgivare med placering i Karlskrona och uppdrag i hela Blekinge. Om rollen Som rådgivare på Almi arbetar du nära företag med ambitioner att utvecklas, växa och stärka sin konkurrenskraft. Du coachar och utmanar företagare i strategiska frågor och hjälper dem att omsätta idéer och ambitioner till konkreta aktiviteter och resultat. Rollen innebär även att du arbetar som projektledare för EU- och region-finansierade projekt. Du möter företag i olika branscher och faser, från tidiga tillväxtbolag till etablerade företag som står inför nya möjligheter eller utmaningar. Arbetet är utåtriktat och innebär många möten med företag, samarbetspartners och andra aktörer i det regionala företagsfrämjande systemet. I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Arbeta uppsökande för att skapa nya kundrelationer och utveckla Almis närvaro i Blekinge.
  • Genomföra affärsutvecklingsinsatser för företag med tillväxtambitioner.
  • Identifiera företagens behov och vägleda dem inom exempelvis tillväxt, lönsamhet, hållbarhet, finansiering och affärsmodellsutveckling.
  • Leda, samordna och genomföra projekt riktade till företag i Blekinge, gärna inom ramen för EU- och regionalt finansierade satsningar.
  • Skapa och utveckla relationer med banker, kommuner, science parks, näringslivsorganisationer och andra samarbetspartners.
  • Planera och genomföra seminarier, workshops och nätverksaktiviteter för företag.
  • Delta i och bidra till regionala utvecklingsinsatser som stärker näringslivets konkurrenskraft.

Vem är du? Vi söker dig som har ett starkt intresse för företagande och näringslivsutveckling. Du tycker om att skapa förtroende, bygga relationer och utveckla människor och företag. Du har förmåga att kombinera strategiskt tänkande med ett praktiskt och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt. Du är självgående, affärsmässig och trivs med att arbeta i en roll där du själv planerar och driver ditt arbete framåt. Du drivs av att göra skillnad för företag och människor. Du är nyfiken, lyhörd och vågar ställa de frågor som hjälper företagaren att tänka nytt. Vi söker dig som har:

  • Erfarenhet av affärsutveckling, företagsrådgivning, entreprenörskap eller annat likvärdigt arbete.
  • God förståelse för företags tillväxtfrågor och affärsmässiga utmaningar.
  • Erfarenhet av att leda, samordna eller driva projekt.
  • Erfarenhet av eller god förståelse för företagsfinansiering samt förmåga att vägleda företag kring finansieringslösningar och utvecklingsmöjligheter.
  • God kommunikativ förmåga och kan uttrycka dig väl på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
  • B-körkort.

Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av att leda eller samordna EU-finansierade projekt.
  • Etablerat nätverk inom näringsliv och/eller offentlig sektor.
  • Erfarenhet av att utveckla och bygga strategiska samarbeten mellan företag, offentliga aktörer och andra organisationer.

Därför ska du välja Almi På Almi får du möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad för företag och samhälle. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team som brinner för entreprenörskap, tillväxt och hållbar utveckling. Vi erbjuder:

  • Stor frihet under ansvar.

  • Möjlighet att arbeta nära företag i många olika branscher.
  • En arbetsplats där samarbete, utveckling och affärsmässighet står i fokus.

Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig om du vill veta mer om rollen. Urval sker löpande - så vänta inte, sista ansökningsdag är den 4/10 2026. Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvariga rekryterare Carina Berg på mobil: 070 377 07 47. Om Almi Almi investerar i hållbar tillväxt. Vi erbjuder lån, riskkapital och affärsutveckling till företag som vill utvecklas och växa. Almi ägs av staten tillsammans med regionala ägare och finns nära företagen över hela landet. På Almi får du kombinera affärsutveckling, finansiering, projektledning och nätverksbyggande i en roll där du gör konkret skillnad för företag varje dag.

På Manpower, Experis och Jefferson Wells värnar vi om en trygg och transparent rekryteringsprocess. title: Lead Platform Engineer - On-Site (Irvine)
description:
Eggs Unlimited is one of the world’s largest suppliers of eggs, servicing the biggest retail and food manufacturing companies around the globe. Every day, we find homes for millions of eggs by tapping into our vast supply chain and customer networks. Bringing sellers and buyers together in fair market negotiations, we open up a world of possibilities for expanding their knowledge, reach, and access. With dedicated service teams and a mission to uphold transparency and trustworthiness, we create quick and creative solutions to help manage the ever-evolving demands of the global egg industry.

Job Summary:

The Role
We leverage AI to bring food to every table.
You are a hands-on platform engineer embedded with operations. You define the platform the business runs on and build every layer of it: the product a desk uses, the infrastructure under it, and the harness the team ships through. You own the outcome, not the component. AI-assisted development is how the work gets done. Human judgment, controls, and production quality are not negotiable.

The Problem We Are Solving
We are building the intelligent operating platform behind a global food supply chain, combining leading models, our own operational data and business rules, and the judgment of the people who trade for a living.
Extracting an order from an email is no longer the hard part. The loop is. Forecast where the market is going, project demand forward by customer and by product, and know what we are long and short on any given day. Then decide what to buy and what to sell, build the load, and book the freight against a computed view of what that lane is actually worth. Trading, supply, freight, and the ledger stop being separate systems stitched together by a spreadsheet and become one connected flow, with a named person accountable at every point where money moves.

The product layer is largely greenfield. You will be building it, not maintaining someone else's version of it, though it has to work with the operational systems the business already runs on. We move quickly and we build practical solutions that scale, not demos.
None of that loop works in pieces: a forecast is only as good as the data under it, and a booked load has to reach the ledger intact. Somebody has to design the platform that makes it one flow, and build it. That is you.

The Orchestrator

The person in this seat does not draw a diagram and wait. They take an idea, direct a fleet of agents at it, and produce the working system themselves, at a volume of output that would not have been possible from one person two years ago. If your monthly token consumption would look alarming to a traditional engineering manager, you are probably working the way we work. What we measure is not the volume: it is whether you decompose work well, keep context under control, catch the plausible and wrong answer, and stand behind what ships.

You do not need prior experience in our exact stack. What matters is whether you can build things, whether you take ownership, and whether you can hold the big picture while you do it. Think like a customer, act like an owner.

This seat pairs that with a solution architecture background. You sit with the traders, the purchasing coordinators, and the logistics desks to see how the work actually crosses systems, then build every layer of the answer yourself. The architect builds here. We are not looking for someone who produces a design and hands it to somebody else to implement.

What You Will Own

The Shape of the Platform: Start from the loop, not the ticket. Decide what the platform has to become three capabilities from now, and build today's piece so nobody has to tear it out. Think big, and ship the first slice this month.
Building the Product: Take a validated need to monitored production yourself: the data model, the services, the integrations, and the screen or channel an operator actually works in.
Building What It Runs On: Environments, pipelines, data stores, event flows, identity, and the contracts with the ERP core, partners, and customers, built as code. You decide what the platform is and build it; the engineering lead decides what it has to meet, and reviews it against that.
Building the Harness: The substrate the team and its agents ship on: fixtures, replay of real operating history, test data, and the CI scaffolding that lets everyone move fast without shipping blind.
When a Dependency Is Slow, Wrong, or Down: Decide what happens at every seam before it happens: retries, fallbacks, reconciliation, and the handback to a person. Money moves through these seams, so the numbers have to tie out to the ledger.
Closing What Let It Happen: When something goes wrong where a desk meets it, fix it, whichever service, system, or vendor it passed through, and then close the gap that let it happen so it does not come back. "That is the other system" is not an answer here.
Agent Orchestration: Decompose a problem into work that can run in parallel, direct agents at it, control context, reconcile conflicting output, test what comes back, and remain responsible for the final system. This is an operating capability, not a tool preference.
Engineering Standards: Ship maintainable, tested, observable, secure systems, with explicit evaluations, audit trails, rollback paths, and safe failure modes. Agent-generated work is held to the same production standard as anything you type.

What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days:

  • You can show how work crosses the systems at two desks, from sitting with them rather than from a document.
  • Something in production you built end to end, from data model to deployment, that an operator uses.
  • Fixtures or replay over real operating history running in CI, already used by someone else's work as well as yours.
In your first six months:
  • One capability live across every system it touches, with its contracts, failure behavior, and reconciliation written down and holding at the desk.
  • The platform under it defined as code, so a desk's workflow can be rebuilt, rolled back, or moved without a weekend of manual work.
  • A change to a desk's workflow tested against what actually happened last month, on replay you built.
In your first year:
  • Production systems live across more than one operational function, each with a named owner, monitoring, rollback, an audit trail, and a stop path the desk itself controls.
  • A second capability shipped on the first one's platform without rebuilding it.
The clearest sign that you are succeeding: the next capability takes weeks instead of months, because what you built last time is still standing underneath it.

What You Bring
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building systems that span more than one application: data models, integration contracts, infrastructure, and the failure behavior between them, in real operating environments.
  • You ship production code. You are accountable for what it does in production, however it was produced. Product features, infrastructure, and harnesses are all real software, and all of it is held to that standard.
  • Serious agentic development practice. Show us real parallel-agent work: how you decompose tasks, manage context, review and reconcile output, design tests and evaluations, an example of a failure you caught, and a case where you decided not to use an agent. Anonymize anything confidential.
  • Ownership. You have carried something end to end and been accountable for whether it worked, not for whether it shipped.
  • Enough backend, data, cloud, and deployment competence to stand up services and the environments they run in, integrate systems, and debug production independently.
  • Judgment about correctness in nondeterministic systems: evaluations, observability, failure-mode thinking, guardrails, human escalation, and rollback.
  • You can make technical decisions and tradeoffs understandable to people who are not engineers, and write them down so they outlast the conversation.
  • Experience building within messy operational reality, email, spreadsheets, chat threads, and phone calls, rather than replacing it with something tidier that operators will not adopt.
We do not screen on years of experience, and we do not screen on which technologies you have used. Seniority here is calibrated by scope, judgment, autonomy, and outcomes. Show us what you have built.

Helpful Experience
  • Food distribution, logistics, retail and CPG, trading, ERP or EDI, financial operations, or other trading-partner ecosystems.
  • Ambiguous, high-ownership environments where designing, building, and running the system were the same job: founder, early employee, solution architect who stayed hands-on, forward-deployed engineer.
Team, Environment, and How Decisions Get Made

You report to the Director of Technology and join a small, senior engineering team. This is a lead role in scope and judgment, not in headcount: it does not manage people. The engineering lead sets the engineering and evaluation bar, owns the guardrails, and is the second reviewer on your work. Infrastructure, identity, and access control are part of what this seat builds, and the work here does not come in lanes: infrastructure, business logic, or the harness, you pick up whatever the week needs. Priorities are agreed with the Director of Technology and the business leaders who own the affected desks.
Our environment spans cloud services on Azure, relational and event-sourced data stores, services in Go and Python, a TypeScript front end, an enterprise ERP core, and a retrieval layer over the company's own operating history. You will not be expected to have used all of it.

Why Eggs Unlimited
  • Join at the "second floor" of a hyper-growth company rapidly becoming a skyscraper – help build what comes next.
  • Outsized impact opportunity – building people, leadership, culture, & support continued expansion.
  • Access meaningful advancement opportunities as the company continues to expand.
  • Modern hardware and access to leading models and development tools, with clear security and data-handling guardrails rather than blanket tool bans.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base Salary: $180,000 - $210,000+ annually
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Generous PTO accruals, increasing each year.
  • Free daily lunch.
  • Unlimited snacks and refreshments.
  • Join a hyper-growth company with meaningful opportunities for advancement and expanded responsibility.

title: Shop Lead *Sign-on Bonus

The Shop Lead works closely with technicians to keep operations running smoothly while maintaining clear communication and a strong safety culture.

Safety

  • Immediately stop any unsafe work or behavior

title: Water Quality Specialist
description:
Pay: $21.29 to $25.54 per hour

Under general supervision, performs water quality testing to ensure the City is in compliance with federal, state, and local regulations. This is accomplished by collecting and testing samples; analyzing data; testing backflow; and maintaining testing equipment.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs water quality monitoring, sampling, testing, and related activities to ensure compliance with TCEQ, EPA, Safe Drinking Water Act, and applicable City requirements.
  • Performs dead-end main flushing, targeted water-quality flushing, and other distribution-system flushing necessary to maintain water quality.
  • Collects drinking water samples throughout the distribution system in accordance with regulatory requirements and the City's approved monitoring and sampling plans.
  • Performs field testing for chlorine residual, monochloramine, free ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, pH, temperature, and other water quality parameters as required.
  • Analyzes water-quality data, customer complaints, system information, and field observations to identify trends, recurring issues, and distribution-system conditions requiring operational attention or corrective action.
  • Reviews laboratory and field-testing results for completeness and compliance and immediately reports results outside established regulatory or operational parameters to the appropriate supervisor.
  • Performs bacteriological sampling throughout the distribution system and coordinates delivery of samples to approved laboratories within required holding times.
  • Identifies recurring water-quality problem areas and recommends long-term corrective measures for consideration by Utility Operations, Engineering, and management.
  • Maintains compliance documentation such as chain-of-custody sheets, compliance logs, and/or internal tracking forms.
  • Collects or coordinates regulatory samples including bacteriological, disinfectant residual, lead and copper, disinfection byproducts, and other samples required by TCEQ, EPA, or the City's monitoring programs.
  • Performs water quality monitoring, sampling, testing, and related activities to ensure compliance with TCEQ, EPA, Safe Drinking Water Act, and applicable City requirements.
  • Performs calibrations of analyzers, document results and provides reports to immediate Supervisor.
  • Performs field testing for chlorine residual, monochloramine, free ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, pH, temperature, and other water quality parameters as required.
  • Maintains adequate inventory of sampling supplies, testing reagents, calibration standards, bottles, equipment, and other materials necessary to conduct the City's water-quality program.
  • Assesses and records customer complaints and collects samples from homes in a professional and tactful manner in order to enhance customer relations and water quality.
  • Interprets and understands all relevant required ordinances, rules, and regulations governing sampling and protection of water distribution system.
  • Uses GIS, Cityworks, laboratory results, and other available system data to evaluate geographic and historical patterns in water quality.
  • Utilizes proper safety precautions in all work performed; recognizes, avoids, and reports unsafe acts, conditions, accidents, and injuries.
  • Assures that work assignments are completed according to specified work orders.
  • Performs maintenance, repair, inspection, and operational activities on the City’s water and wastewater utility systems as assigned, including assisting utility crews with routine, emergency, and preventative maintenance activities.
  • Responds to water-quality emergencies, main breaks, loss-of-pressure events, contamination concerns, and other events requiring sampling or investigation.
  • Cross-trains work crews in proper work methods and safety procedures.
  • Participates in an after-hours or on-call response when necessary for water-quality or regulatory compliance activities.
  • Maintains the integrity, professionalism, values, and goals of the City by assuring that all rules and regulations are followed, and that accountability and public trust are preserved.
  • Cooperates with co-workers professionally to accomplish work efficiently and effectively.
  • Has regular, predictable attendance; attendance is a factor in continued employment with the City.
  • Performs other duties as assigned or required.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Education and Experience:

High school diploma or GED equivalent; AND TWO years work experience in water distribution or related field, including one year experience in Water Quality sampling preferably with the City of Corinth; OR an equivalent combination of related education, experience, or demonstrated abilities or proficiencies that result in a candidate successfully performing the essential functions of the job.

Required Licenses or Certifications:

title: Analytical Development Supervisor
description:
The Analytical Development Supervisor within the ADQC department serves as an operational level member of management within the ADQC laboratory. This role focuses on driving day-to-day lab performance, ensuring consistent cGMP and regulatory compliance and data integrity standards. The role is responsible for executing analytical development activities supporting biologics programs from early phase to pivotal phase, regulatory submission, and commercialization. This role will lead method development, optimization, qualification, validation, method transfer to internal and external laboratories, method lifecycle management, and ensure analytical readiness to support CMC milestones and regulatory submissions.

The incumbent must possess strong scientific judgment, hands-on laboratory expertise, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners in a highly regulated, fast-paced environment.

Some relocation assistance is available for this role.

Duties and Responsibilities (Include but are not limited to):
  • Lead and perform hands-on analytical work including method development, qualification, validation, transfer to internal and external QC labs, lifecycle management, and author associated documentation (method development reports, technical reports, qualification / validation reports, method SOP etc.)
  • Ensure analytical readiness for late‑stage development, PPQ, and commercial launch of SAB-142 polyclonal antibody program.
  • Lead and perform hands-on method troubleshooting, method optimization, method bridging, method performance monitoring, investigations (deviations, system suitability failure, OOT, OOS), CAPA, change control, continuous method improvement initiatives, and author associated documentation.
  • Contribute to qualification and stability monitoring of reference standard, assay control, and critical reagents, qualification and testing of extended characterization assays, and forced degradation/stress sample study.
  • Ensure analytical activities performed internally and at external partners are scientifically rigorous, comply with cGMP, ICH, USP, global regulations, and QbD principles, and align with industry’s best practices and company quality standards.
  • Contribute to specification setting, and regulatory submissions.
  • Manage general laboratory operations, equipment qualification & maintenance, support the scaling of analytical capabilities, establishment of analytical non-GMP development area, and implementing workflows and LIMS.
  • Partner closely with Quality Control and Quality Assurance to establish, maintain, and oversee analytical quality, GMP compliance infrastructure, and inspection readiness for internal and external analytical documents and data.
  • Other duties/responsibilities as assigned.
Supervisory Responsibilities:
This position does not supervise employees at the start. May supervise junior staff as the group expands.
Will have indirect supervisory level responsibilities with external partner/CDMO partnerships, and relationships.

Education/Experience/Skills:
  • Bachelor's degree with 7+ years of progressively responsible and relevant experience in life sciences, Biophysics, Biochemistry or a related discipline in a biotech/pharma environment.. Master’s degree highly desirable.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in A280, HPLC, CE-SDS, cIEF, and LC-MS for biologics. Experience in ELISA, and cell-based potency methods is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of method validation, method transfer, and applicable guidelines (ICH, FDA guidance documents, USP/EP chapters etc.) with deep expertise in cGMP requirements.
  • Experience in reference standard program, critical reagent program, and forced degradation study
  • Utilizes established mathematical and scientific techniques including simple statistical analysis to compile and analyze data. Trend analysis /control charting is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and technical writing skills and the ability to effectively present information in one-on-one, small groups, and departmental/cross functional meetings.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).
Working Environment and Travel:
Duties will be performed in normal office, laboratory and BSL2 laboratory environments.
Travel is not typical for this position.

Physical Requirements:
Ability to regularly move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this individual include close vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee will view a computer monitor for long periods of time.

ADA:
The employer will make reasonable accommodations in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.

title: Bliv elektrikerlærling hos os
description:
Bliv elektrikerlærling hos Thy-Mors Energi og vær med til at forme fremtidens infrastruktur

Opstart januar 2027

Vil du have en læreplads, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med forskellige tekniske anlæg og samtidig bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab?

Hos Thy-Mors Energi arbejder vi med at opbygge, udvide og vedligeholde kritisk infrastruktur. Som lærling hos os arbejder du med andre el-tekniske opgaver, end man normalt vil gøre som installationselektrikerlærling. Du får i stedet indblik i både lav-, mellem- og højspænding, fiber samt tilslutning af vedvarende energianlæg. Du kommer til at arbejde med komplekse installationer og specialiseret udstyr i et arbejdsmiljø, hvor sikkerhed og høj faglighed altid er i fokus.

Du vil få ansvar, udvikle dig fagligt og blive en del af et stærkt fællesskab med en afslappet omgangstone, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og spiller hinanden gode. Samtidig lægger vi vægt på ordentlige rammer og en sund balance mellem arbejde og fritid, så hverdagen hænger sammen gennem hele din læretid.

Vi tager imod både unge og voksne – uanset om du kommer direkte fra skolebænken eller ønsker et karriereskifte ind i el-faget.

Hvad får du som lærling hos os?
Som lærling kommer du rundt i hele koncernen med en turnusordning mellem Netselskabet Elværk, Energrid og Thy-Mors Energi Fibernet. Det giver dig erfaring med forskellige fagområder og hjælper dig med at finde ud af, hvad du bedst kan li’ at arbejde med.

Samtidig bliver du en del af et lærlingefællesskab, hvor I sparrer med hinanden, deler erfaringer og udvikler jer sammen – både fagligt og som hold.

Eksempler på arbejdsopgaver:

  • Koblingsopgaver og arbejde med højspændingsanlæg
  • Kabelarbejde inden for både høj- og lavspænding
  • Opbygning af transformerstationer
  • Montering af kabelskabe
  • Fejlfindingsopgaver i el og fiber
  • Splidsning og installation af fiber hos private og erhverv
  • Arbejde med overvågning, drift og vedligehold af fibernettet
  • Tilslutning af vedvarende energianlæg – herunder solceller, vindmøller og batterier
  • Vedligeholdelse af gadelys

Cirka halvdelen af din læretid vil foregå i Energrid, som løser opgaver i hele landet – en spændende mulighed for at prøve kræfter med projekter uden for lokalområdet, hvor du er væk hjemmefra mandag til torsdag.

Mulighed for udvidet uddannelsesforløb:
Hos os kan du vælge at udvide din 4-årige uddannelse til et 4,5-årigt forløb, hvor du får kompetencer inden for teknisk entreprise- og projektstyring. Kontakt din skole for at høre nærmere.

Hvad tilbyder vi?
Hos Thy-Mors Energi får du:

  • En lærerig og udviklende læretid, hvor du får ansvar
  • Mulighed for at lære mange forskellige fagområder at kende
  • Et stærkt lærlingefællesskab – vi tager imod en ny lærling hvert år og byder dem velkommen i vores lærlinge- og elevfællesskab
  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger, der prioriterer faglighed og sikkerhed højt
  • En arbejdsplads med flad struktur, ordentlighed, handlekraft og fleksibilitet
  • En god balance mellem arbejde og fritid.

Hvem er du?
Du bidrager aktivt til vores arbejdsfællesskab, fordi du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og er ivrig efter at bringe din gode el-tekniske forståelse i spil. Du kan lide at arbejde selvstændigt og værdsætter at levere en høj kvalitet. Du trives med at arbejde ”under åben himmel” hele året rundt og har kørekort (B). Det er et krav, at du har bestået grundforløb 1, når du starter, og det er en fordel, hvis du har bestået grundforløb 2, når du starter.

Vil du vide mere?
Hvis du har spørgsmål eller er i tvivl om noget, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

  • Søren Søndergaard, ENERGRID – tlf. 72 19 88 02, scs@energrid.dk
  • Kasper Holmstrup, Netselskabet Elværk – tlf. 72 19 88 91, kho@elvrk.dk
  • Joakim Schjødt-Pedersen, Thy-Mors Energi Fibernet – tlf. 72 19 88 39, jsp@thymors.dk

Ansøgningsfristen er den 5. oktober 2026, men send gerne din ansøgning allerede nu. Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i oktober.

title: DevOps Engineer Web, Python, CI/CD, cloud environments - factset
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

FactSet's ecosystem spans a wide range of teams and technologies. This role focuses on integrating and supporting a centralized CI/CD pipeline platform that brings consistency and governance to how software is built, tested, and deployed — without slowing teams down.

  • Collaborate directly with application teams to surface requirements and ensure the pipeline fits their needs

  • Must be fluent in English
