  • Deep familiarity with the software packaging lifecycle ecosystem — you understand how these applications are built, tested, and what good looks like across different build toolchains
  • Familiarity with containerized deployments and cloud environments (Kubernetes, AWS, or similar)

title: Jobstudent iOS / React Native Developer / Remote

title: Permanency Specialist
description:
Position: Permanency Specialist
Classification: Full-time, Non-exempt
Reports to: Mentor Program Specialist
Company: Texans Together
Location: Houston, TX

Position Description:
The Permanency Specialist supports children and families throughout the child welfare process by managing cases after children have been removed from their homes and placed in substitute care. This role assesses each child’s needs, coordinates services and evaluations, conducts kinship home studies, and ensures caregivers have the resources and information needed to provide safe, stable care. The Specialist works closely with children, families, foster caregivers, community partners, and legal stakeholders to develop permanency plans, identify permanent living arrangements, facilitate reunification when appropriate, and advocate for the child’s well-being. Responsibilities include monthly child visits, court preparation and testimony, case documentation, and collaboration with community, medical, legal, and law enforcement partners to achieve positive outcomes for children and families.
Permanency Specialists may voluntarily participate in the organization’s mentoring program in accordance with the requirements of the Professional Development training and the federal court litigation. Participation as a mentor is intended to be optional but depending on mentor availability, staff may be assigned a mentoring role as needed to fill Permanency Specialist vacancies.

This position may be filled at the Permanency Specialist I, II, III, or IV level based on the selected candidate's education, relevant experience, demonstrated competencies, and organizational requirements. Placement within a level does not substantially change the position's essential functions.

Primary Responsibilities:
  • Receive cases from investigators after children are removed from their homes and placed in care outside their homes.
  • Determine each child’s needs and ensure that appropriate referrals for testing, evaluations, records, or further assessments are made, ensuring that all services are focused on achieving positive permanency.
  • Work with children, families, and communities to plan for a child's permanency.
  • Identify potential permanency resources for the child through ongoing contact with parents, family members, and other individuals the child and family identify as important to them.
  • Conduct search for potential kinship providers throughout the life of the case. Complete home studies of a child's family members or family friends (kinship providers) who might care for the child.
  • Meet with the parents to assess child safety and risk factors, identify behavioral changes necessary to ensure child safety, connect families/parents to appropriate services and resources to address the identified needs and support toward positive permanency outcome.
  • Meet and participate in case meetings and conferences with children, parents, relatives, family friends, foster families, and other involved parties in homes, community settings, and other appropriate locations accommodating family needs and schedules.
  • Collaborate with the Placement Team, including Kinship staff, to identify, coordinator, and support appropriate placement options for children, as needed.
  • Conduct monthly visits with children to assess their safety and well-being in their current placement, to plan for permanency, and to discuss their needs, wishes, and progress while in care.
  • Attend and participate in court hearings related to children and families, including communicating with relevant parties in the case prior to hearings, preparing court reports and documentation, providing testimony regarding the child’s needs, family progress, case activities, efforts toward achieving permanency.
  • Maintain timely communication with children, parents, caregivers, court-appointed attorneys, and guardian’s ad litem, and other appropriate parties regarding the child’s circumstances, case progress, and significant events.
  • Collaborate with kinship caregivers and foster parents to ensure that have what they need to care for the child or youth placed with them, including providing timely case updates, returning calls, responding to questions and concerns, and in some areas of the state providing after-hours support as required (i.e., being available 24 hours a day/7 day a week at certain times)
  • Transition children home during reunification services and provides support to the family until the legal case is closed.
  • Supervise adoptive placements until the adoption is final or until the case is transferred to an adoption caseworker.
  • Document case records by completing forms, narratives, and reports to form a written record for each client.
  • Develop and maintain effective working relationships between Child Protective Investigations staff and law enforcement officials, judicial officials, legal resources, medical professionals, and other community resources.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelors degree in Social Work, Criminal Justice, Psychology, Human Development and Family Studies, Education, or Public Health.
  • Minimum one (1) year case management experience in CPS, CPI, DFPS.
  • Previous professional or volunteer experience in a government agency, nonprofit, child protection, foster care, juvenile justice, mental health, or substance abuse services.
  • Familiarity with trauma-informed care and/or experience conducting interviews or assessments with children and families.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Previous experience providing mentorship, coaching, or guidance to staff in CPS, CPI, or DFPS roles preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
  • Knowledge of child development and family dynamics.
  • Skilled in effective verbal and written communication.
  • Skilled in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships.
  • Skilled in problem solving techniques to assess situations, identify appropriate solutions, and address case-related challenges.
  • Proficiency in the use of personal computers and standard office software applications.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, community partners, and multidisciplinary professionals.
  • Ability to demonstrate cultural awareness, sensitivity, and respect when working with diverse children, families, caregivers, coworkers, community partners, and other work-related contacts.
  • Ability to use effective time-management skills to make sure all key tasks are done.
  • Ability to travel and attend child and family visits as well as other work-related appointments and meetings after 5pm.
  • Ability to be on-call on a rotating basis and work irregular hours.
  • Ability to work in an emotion-filled environment and which may require conducting home visits in isolated or high crime areas and may involve exposure to substandard and unsanitary living conditions.
Work Conditions:
  • Environment: Home-based
  • Range of Schedule: Mon – Fri, 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.
  • Travel: Frequent (Must have reliable transportation, valid Texas Driver License, and current Auto Insurance)

DePelchin is Proud to be an Equal Opportunity Workplace.

DePelchin is committed to selecting and employing the best and most qualified person available for each job opening without unlawful discrimination of any kind. Additionally, DePelchin is committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation and gender identity), marital or parental status, veteran status, religion, national origin, age, disability, family medical history, genetic information, or political affiliation.

title: Licensing Specialist
description:
Join a high-performing, collaborative team where your attention to detail helps providers get licensed, placed, and caring for patients nationwide.

The Licensing Specialist is part of the Hayes Locums Medical Support Staff (MSS) team and plays a critical role in supporting provider placements by managing the healthcare licensing process for physicians and advanced practice providers nationwide. This position serves as a liaison between providers, state licensing boards, and internal teams to facilitate timely license issuance, maintain regulatory compliance, and support successful provider onboarding.

This role requires strong attention to detail, organization, communication, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment. Research activities may include communication with licensing boards, regulatory agencies, healthcare organizations, and providers through phone, email, fax, and written correspondence. Success in this role is measured by licensing accuracy, productivity, provider satisfaction, regulatory compliance, and timely completion of licensing requirements that support provider start dates.

This position provides exposure to healthcare licensing, regulatory compliance, provider onboarding, and healthcare operations, with opportunities for professional development and career growth within Hayes Locums.

What You Will Do

• Serve as the primary liaison between providers, state licensing boards, and internal stakeholders throughout the licensing process

• Assess state licensing requirements, interpret application requirements, and facilitate timely application completion

• Conduct research and primary source verification of healthcare practitioner information

• Maintain regular communication with providers regarding licensing status, requirements, and application progress

• Partner with internal operations, credentialing, and medical staff services teams to ensure timely completion of licensing requirements

• Collaborate with licensing boards, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders to facilitate application processing, resolve delays, and support timely licensure

• Research and assist in resolving licensing-related issues affecting provider placements

• Monitor application status and proactively follow up on outstanding requirements

• Help ensure providers obtain appropriate licensure before assignment start dates

• Comply with operating policies and procedures including the facilitation of license requests and use of company resources

• Maintain accurate records and documentation within company systems

• Maintain confidentiality of provider information and adhere to company policies and regulatory requirements

• Perform other duties as assigned

Work Schedule

• Your regular work schedule will be 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. or 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, including a one-hour unpaid lunch break each day, for a regular 40-hour work week. Hayes Locums offers schedule flexibility for this position based on business needs and team coverage requirements

• Eligible for one remote workday per week following successful completion of a 90-day training period, subject to maintaining good standing and manager approval.

Compensation

This position offers a base pay of $25.48 per hour. Based on a regular schedule of 40 hours per week, this equates to an estimated annualized compensation of $52,998, assuming full-time employment for 52 weeks per year. Because this is a non-exempt hourly role, actual earnings may vary based on hours worked. Compensation is paid semi-monthly in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices.

In addition to base pay, Licensing Specialists are eligible to participate in a monthly performance-based incentive program. Incentives are designed to reward both productivity and quality outcomes, including the successful completion of provider licensing activities, achievement of performance standards, and maintenance of accuracy and compliance expectations. Incentive payments are based on the prior month's performance and are paid in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree preferred in Health Administration, Healthcare Management, Business, or a related field. An associate degree combined with relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a bachelor's degree.

• 2+ years of administrative, licensing, credentialing, healthcare operations, or comparable professional experience required.

• Strong computer, typing, data entry, and research skills, including proficiency with Microsoft 365 products (Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint).

• Highly organized in managing one’s schedule, duties, workflows, and responsibilities.

• Attention to detail and strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to organize and prioritize work and manage multiple priorities.

• Proofreading skills sufficient for auditing documents.

• Problem-solving, critical thinking, and deductive reasoning skills.

• Ability to identify critical information within verification and licensing documents.

• Ability to maintain production and quality standards, confidentiality, and professionalism when handling sensitive information.

Bonus Points If You Have

• Experience with CRM, licensing, credentialing, provider management, or applicant tracking systems (Salesforce, MD-Staff, or similar platforms).

• Experience in healthcare administration, licensing, credentialing, customer service, operations support, or a similar compliance-based role.

• NAMSS Certification (National Association Medical Staff Services) is a plus.

Additional Benefits Include

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

• 401(k) with Employer Match

• Employee Assistance Programs

• Mental Health Resources

• Learning and Development Courses

• PTO and Paid Holidays

About the Company

Hayes Locums is one of the United States’ leading physician staffing firms, specializing in locum tenens placements for hospitals, clinics, and healthcare organizations nationwide. Our passion is matching physicians and advanced practice clinicians with the right locum tenens opportunities because quality matches lead to quality care.

Founded in 2012, Hayes Locums is trusted by physicians and healthcare partners nationwide for integrity, reliability, and service excellence, and is ranked the 6th largest locum tenens firm by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA).

Culture & Workplace

Hayes Locums fosters a high-performance culture built on collaboration, accountability, and shared success. Our in-office environment is intentionally designed to support focus, connection, and professional growth. You'll join a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment where results, innovation, and continuous development are valued.

Our Fort Lauderdale office features:

• Modern, open office design with glass-walled offices and spacious workstations

• Dedicated lounge areas for collaboration and recharge

• Onsite amenities including ping pong, foosball, and a golf simulator

Equal Opportunity & Accessibility

Hayes Locums is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all qualified individuals are considered. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

title: IT-erityisasiantuntija (kokonaisarkkitehti) | Oikeusrekisterikeskus, Hämeenlinna
description:
**Haluatko edistää Suomen oikeudenhoidon digikehittämistä vankalla arkkitehtuuriosaamisellasi?**

Haemme kasvavaan arkkitehtiporukkaamme 1–2 kokonaisarkkitehtia johtamaan ja suunnittelemaan vaikuttavuudeltaan merkittäviä oikeusministeriön hallinnonalan tietoteknisiä kehityskokonaisuuksia.

Tehtävät keskittyvät oikeusministeriön hallinnonalan tietojärjestelmäkokonaisuuksien arkkitehtuuriohjaamiseen ja -kehittämiseen. Rooli on keskeisessä asemassa hallinnonalan kokonaisarkkitehtuurin kehittämisessä sekä oman vastuualueen johtamisessa.

Kokonaisarkkitehtina omistat sovitun osakokonaisuuden oikeusministeriön hallinnonalan kokonaisarkkitehtuurista. Tehtävänäsi on johtaa oman vastuualueesi kehittämistä sekä ohjata sen parissa työskentelevien teknisten asiantuntijoiden työtä. Varmistat, että vastuualueesi palvelut ja niiden kehitystyö ovat tavoitteellisia, tarkoituksenmukaisia ja noudattavat sovittuja kokonaisarkkitehtuurilinjauksia. Kokonaisarkkitehtina olet keskeinen osa oikeusministeriön hallinnonalan tietohallinnon toimintaa ja vaikutat hallinnonalan IT-kehityksen pitkän aikavälin strategiseen suuntaan.

Työskentelet yhdessä muiden arkkitehtien sekä asiantuntijatiimin kanssa. Lisäksi toimit päivittäin aktiivisessa yhteistyössä asiakkaidemme ja ORK:n kehitys- ja ylläpito-organisaation kanssa. Arvioit ja ohjaat kehitysideoita ja ratkaisuja niiden elinkaaren eri vaiheissa aina ideasta tuotantoon asti. Huolehdit arkkitehtuurin toiminta-, tieto-, tietojärjestelmä- ja teknologianäkökulmien yhteensovittamisesta sekä johdat asiantuntijoiden työtä yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamiseksi. Osana elinkaarisuunnittelua tuotat osa-alueesi kehitykseen liittyviä tiekarttoja ja käynnistät tarvittavia toimenpiteitä yhdessä vastuualueesi muiden teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa.

Roolissasi pääset kehittymään hallinnonalan luotetuksi neuvonantajaksi arkkitehtikillan ja muiden asiantuntijoidemme tukemana. Arkkitehtikilta on arkkitehdeista ja IT-asiantuntijoista koostuva sparraileva verkosto, jossa jaamme osaamista, kehitämme toimintaa ja ratkomme arjen haasteita yhdessä.

Oikeushallinnon palvelut ja niiden innovatiivinen kehittäminen muodostavat työllesi raamit, joiden puitteissa saat soveltaa ja kehittää omaa erityisosaamistasi sekä johtamistaitojasi. Toivomme sinun tuovan ratkaisuihimme teknologian kehityksen uusimpia tuulia sekä strategista arkkitehtuurijohtamista. Tässä strategisesti merkittävässä roolissa pääset vaikuttamaan sekä ORK:n että asiakkaidemme toiminnan ja osaamisen pitkäjänteiseen kehittämiseen.

description:
Company Description

foodora is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.


Mission

The Senior Growth Specialist (f/m/d) plays a central role in driving foodora’s customer acquisition, retention, campaign performance, and overall growth strategy across all business verticals. Acting as a bridge between data, strategy, and decision-making, they turn insight into actionable initiatives that maximize marketing efficiency and impact. They collaborate and initiate projects across functions to ensure alignment and progress for marketing efforts to directly improve business performance.

In short: Turns data and strategy into growth by driving high-impact initiatives, aligning priorities across business verticals, and delivering actionable commercial insights that support growth.


Main tasks

As Senior Growth Specialist (f/m/d), your areas of responsibility include, but are not limited to:

  • Strategic impact: Proactively originate and drive growth marketing initiatives that directly advance company priorities such as increasing active users, order frequency, and revenue across business verticals. Ensure growth initiatives align with long-term commercial goals while independently taking initiative and executing own projects beyond existing frameworks.


  • Operational responsibilities: Plan, execute, and continuously optimize campaigns and growth marketing investments. Translate performance data into project budget and impact modeling, as well as actionable insights related to both marketing and commercial improvements.

  • Collaboration: Work with Head of Marketing, Regional Growth teams, internal stakeholders, and external agencies to ensure alignment and effective execution of growth initiatives.


  • Subject-matter expertise: Apply strong analytical skills, combining quantitative data (incl. marketing, commercial and operational data) and qualitative insights (stakeholder input, market trends) to support decision-making and optimizations for marketing strategies.


  • Project involvement: Lead and coordinate growth initiatives and strategic experiments from planning to execution, ensuring objectives across teams are achieved on time with measurable business impact.


  • Strategic governance: Ensure alignment with group-level frameworks and internal guidelines, while adapting and applying best practices to the market context to achieve business objectives.


  • Data & insights: Own recurring and ad-hoc marketing deep dives enabling the marketing team to track progress on strategic goals and performance. Exercise strong data-based judgment to lead improvements in marketing strategies.


  • Culture & leadership: Act as a change catalyst - challenging the status quo, raising the bar, and embedding Foodora’s leadership principles in strategic projects and everyday work. Support the organization with your unique insights and skillsets on ad-hoc projects outside of the core role responsibilities when required.


​​​​​​What you bring to the table

  • 5+ years of relevant experience within growth marketing, performance marketing, commercial strategy, business analytics, management consulting, or a similar data-driven role.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with proven experience translating complex data into actionable insights, budget models, clear recommendations, and relevant business decisions.
  • Experience working with growth, as well as commercial KPIs, such as customer acquisition, retention, frequency, revenue, ROI/ROAS, CAC, campaign performance, and similar performance metrics.
  • Proven ability to independently lead projects and initiatives from analysis and planning through execution and evaluation, involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience working with budgeting, forecasting, business cases or impact modelling.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data visualization/analytics tools. Experience with SQL, BI tools, experimentation or similar analytical tools is a strong advantage.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Additional Information

What's in it for you?

  • Wellness allowance topped with the opportunity to participate in many work/life balance initiatives at foodora such as free group training at Sats & reduced price on massage.
  • Employee discount at foodora (woho!) and awesome friday breakfasts!
  • Occupational pension, incl. premium exemption insurance, accident insurance and life insurance.
  • foodora Learning - Monthly learning sessions about different topics, such as the q-commerce industry, negotiation techniques and project management combined with a structured onboarding and inspiring courses within our learning tool Sana
  • Great deals at Benify (for e.g. gym membership, e-bikes hotels, audiobooks, streaming services, clothes, kitchen supplies… and so much more!
  • Awesome AW’s and (pink) parties!

title: Sjuksköterska till Företagshälsa
description:

Vi erbjuder dig:

Tjänsten kan innebära resor i närområdet efter verksamhetens behov, vilket innebär att du måste ha B-körkort och gärna tillgång till egen bil.

title: Consultant, AI Enablement
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION OVERVIEW

CREO’s AI Enablement practice helps life sciences, healthcare, and technology organizations unlock the value of AI through strategy, governance, adoption change management, and hands-on training. As a Consultant on this team, you will own client engagements end to end — leading teams to stand up AI Champions programs, launch workshop series, operationalize governance frameworks, and drive measurable adoption at scale.

This role blends deep AI Enablement expertise with the autonomy, leadership, and accountability of a seasoned consultant. You will serve as a trusted advisor to client-side Chief AI Officers, or those delegated to lead AI, and their champion communities, mentor junior staff, shape delivery strategy, and actively grow the offering through business development. You live the CREO values, and you are always learning and always teaching.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead and Deliver AI Enablement Engagements

You will own client AI programs across the full lifecycle — from discovery and planning through delivery, adoption, and ongoing program leadership.

  • Lead and manage client engagements focused on AI readiness assessments, governance frameworks, champion programs, workshop series, and use-case discovery, with significant autonomy over scope, approach, and outcomes.

  • Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of AI enablement projects, from initial assessment and requirements gathering through implementation, adoption, and post-deployment support.

  • Direct discovery and working sessions to identify and assess AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, risk, and adoption readiness, translating client pain points into practical opportunities such as chatbots, workflow automations, knowledge management tools, and analytics assistants.

  • Manage multiple concurrent workstreams and engagement teams, tracking scope, schedule, deliverables, risks, and action items, and serving as the delegated Project Manager where required.

  • Act as a trusted advisor and right hand to client-side AI leaders, program leads, and champion communities — driving decisions, capturing outcomes, and sustaining momentum between sessions.

  • Collaborate with AI engineers and solution architects to translate technical work into narratives that land with executives and end users, and partner with clients and technical teams to deploy specialized AI or machine learning tools into client environments when needed.

  • Support AI solutions in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments by documenting requirements, risks, controls, and user guidance to the quality standard clients expect.

  • Mentor and develop junior staff, ensuring engagements meet client expectations, are completed on time, and align with industry best practices and emerging technologies.

  • Maintain personal billable utilization at the rate of 1700 hours per year.

Develop AI-Focused Client Deliverables

You will produce polished, insight-rich artifacts that make complex AI concepts accessible and actionable for client leadership and end users.

  • Build client-ready PowerPoint decks, workshop materials, playbooks, and written reports that communicate complex AI concepts clearly and compellingly to non-technical audiences.

  • Develop AI strategy documents, adoption roadmaps, solution architectures, and financial models that articulate business value and demonstrate measurable impact.

  • Produce governance artifacts including AI solution intake forms, risk models, use-case inventories, and executive-ready status reports with strong attention to quality and client-readiness.

  • Develop and maintain enablement assets such as dashboards, SharePoint sites, training repositories, champion community hubs, prompt libraries, and intranet content that sustain adoption after each engagement.

Facilitate AI Upskilling, Training, and Champion Programs

You will help non-technical users understand, adopt, and get lasting value from AI tools and solutions.

  • Design and facilitate CREO’s AI Foundations workshops, champion kick-offs, hands-on labs, case contests, and recurring office hours for client teams.

  • Lead AI adoption change management — internal comms, awareness campaigns, and community-building — that turns pilots into organization-wide deployments.

  • Coordinate training logistics and attendee experience across in-person and remote modalities, ensuring every session translates into adoptable use cases.

  • Package lessons learned, reusable templates, and engagement materials into scalable assets for future CREO AI Enablement work.

Drive AI Tool Fluency — Always Learning, Always Teaching

AI is moving fast. You will be expected to stay current and bring what you learn back to clients and colleagues.

  • Continuously evaluate new AI tools, platforms, and agent frameworks, staying current on emerging capabilities relevant to client work.

  • Actively use AI in your own daily work — drafting, summarization, research, deck development, and analysis — demonstrating practical value through what you produce.

  • Share what you learn through internal knowledge shares, client office hours, and champion enablement sessions, helping the rest of the CREO team and our clients get sharper, faster.

Contribute to Business Development

You will help grow the AI Enablement offering and position CREO as a trusted partner and thought leader.

  • Achieve an annual sales target, as communicated separately.

  • Identify AI-driven opportunities within existing client relationships and help acquire new clients, conducting AI readiness assessments and preparing proposals for enablement engagements.

  • Foster relationships with senior executives and champion communities, influencing decision-makers to drive revenue growth and expand CREO’s AI consulting offerings.

Communicate with Clarity and Executive Presence

Strong communication is non-negotiable. You will regularly translate complex work for non-technical audiences and sustain momentum across client teams.

  • Record and summarize technical and executive discussions during client and internal meetings, ensuring decisions and action items are captured and circulated to the right stakeholders.

  • Translate stakeholder interviews, use-case discovery sessions, and workshop outputs into structured written artifacts the client can act on.

  • Communicate clearly, concisely, and confidently in both written and verbal form across technical and non-technical audiences, up to and including executive leadership.
  • Exhibit communication and collaboration best practices including which tool when and adjusting messaging to the audience.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

We hire for expertise, leadership, and the drive to bring others along. If you meet most of these qualifications and are excited about this work, we encourage you to apply.

  • 5+ years of consulting experience or equivalent work experience, including leading engagements and mentoring junior staff.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; master’s or equivalent post-graduate degree (or in process) preferred.

  • Proven ability to design and deliver AI-enabled solutions — tools, automations, chatbots, workflow assistants, analytics tools, or internal productivity applications — that drive adoption and business value.

  • Demonstrated leadership managing project teams and client engagements with significant autonomy and accountability for outcomes.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; attention to detail; able to explain AI concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and present to senior-level stakeholders without sacrificing accuracy.

  • Advanced expertise in PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook, with a portfolio of polished, client-ready deliverables, models, roadmaps, and presentations.

  • Deep working fluency with the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Planner, OneNote).

  • Hands-on experience with generative AI tools (Copilot, Azure Foundry, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and a genuine desire to adopt and teach new AI tools as they emerge.

  • Experience working with cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure and AWS to support AI application deployment, user management, provisioning, and automation tasks.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams on tight deadlines with shifting priorities.

  • Experience contributing to business development, including proposal writing, client relationship management, and identifying new service opportunities.

  • Commitment to CREO’s core values and making a meaningful difference in the world.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in Project, program or change management; PMP or Prosci (in progress or completed) a plus.

  • Experience leading or delivering technical training, or within a Learning and Development function or practice.

  • Experience designing, leading, or facilitating training workshops or enablement programs.

  • Exposure to life sciences, biotech, healthcare, or other regulated industries.

  • Experience with or knowledge of AI or machine learning tools such as AlphaFold, Chai-1, language models, and NLP workflows.

  • Hands-on experience building SharePoint sites, Power Apps, or Power Automate flows.

  • Familiarity with AI governance concepts: responsible AI, risk frameworks, and enterprise AI policies.

  • Experience supporting champion communities, internal enablement groups, or AI adoption programs.

  • Relevant AI certifications such as Generative AI for Everyone (DeepLearning.AI), Microsoft AI Fundamentals, etc.

​​​​​Please note: This application may be reviewed in part by automated systems to help identify qualified candidates.​​​​​​​

title: Samordnare till Öppenvården barn och unga
description:

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

ARBETSUPPGIFTER

Som samordnare inom Öppenvården leder och fördelar du arbete med målet, rätt insats till rätt klient/familj. Du samverkar med myndighet kring ärendeflöde genom veckovisa avstämningar och bistår handläggarna med tankar kring öppenvårdsinsats. Du har ett nära arbete med samordnare på Öppenvården vuxen för att optimera att våra medborgare får bästa möjliga behandlingsinsats. Vidare samordnar du inflödet av IUB med målet att Tranås invånare ska få råd och stöd kring sociala frågor inom området barn och familj. Du har återkommande avstämningar med behandlare där du följer upp behandlingsprocessen och vägleder behandlarna i deras arbete. Du har veckovisa avstämningar med vårt team för intensiv familjebehandling. Tillsammans med samordnare på Öppenvården Vuxen samt enhetschef arbetar ni för en enad Öppenvård i Tranås.

KVALIFIKATIONER

Vi söker dig som är utbildad Socionom eller har likvärdig högskoleutbildning, samt erfarenhet av behandlingsarbete med barn och unga. Steg 1-utbildning är meriterande, liksom erfarenhet av vägledning inom intensivt behandlingsarbete. Du har god digital vana. Körkort är ett krav för tjänsten.

title: Engineering Tools & Licensing Administrator
description:
About Acron Aviation (Avionics – Surveillance):
Acron Aviation designs, engineers, and manufactures certified avionics systems that support safety-critical flight operations across commercial and military aviation. Within Avionics, the Surveillance product line develops and sustains systems that enable aircraft awareness, collision avoidance, and airspace interoperability. Our portfolio includes TCAS, Mode S transponders, ADS-B, and integrated surveillance solutions deployed across commercial, military, and rotorcraft platforms. This work is performed in highly regulated environments and demands deep expertise across systems, hardware, software, and RF throughout the full product lifecycle.

Position Summary:
The Engineering Tools & Licensing Administrator is responsible for the deployment, administration, support, and lifecycle management of engineering software applications used across Hardware, Software, Systems, FPGA, and Mechanical Engineering teams.

This role manages software licensing, license servers, vendor relationships, renewals, budgeting, application deployments, virtual desktop environments, and technical support for critical engineering toolsets. As the primary liaison between Engineering, IT, and software vendors, the position ensures uninterrupted access to business-critical engineering applications while maintaining compliance, cost effectiveness, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Software Licensing & Vendor Management (40%)
  • Manage engineering software licenses, subscriptions, and maintenance agreements.
  • Administer and maintain license servers and license utilization reporting.
  • Coordinate software renewals and negotiate licensing requirements with vendors.
  • Track software usage and identify opportunities for license optimization and cost savings.
  • Ensure compliance with software licensing agreements and audit requirements.
  • Develop relationships with software vendors and serve as the primary point of contact for technical and commercial matters.
  • Support annual budgeting and forecasting activities for engineering software expenditures.
  • Tool Support & Troubleshooting (25%)
  • Provide technical support for engineering applications used across multiple engineering disciplines.
  • Troubleshoot licensing, connectivity, installation, and performance issues.
  • Work directly with engineers, IT teams, and software vendors to resolve application-related problems.
  • Support geographically distributed users through remote support tools and processes.
  • Escalate and coordinate complex issues with vendors as needed.
  • Application Deployment & Virtual Desktop Management (15%)
  • Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain engineering software applications.
  • Support deployment automation and standardization efforts.
  • Manage virtual engineering desktop environments.
  • Ensure tool availability, reliability, and performance across engineering environments.
  • Collaborate with IT infrastructure teams to support application hosting requirements.
  • PLM/PDM Administration (10%)
  • Support administration and maintenance of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Product Data Management (PDM) systems.
  • Manage user access, permissions, and system configurations.
  • Assist with upgrades, integrations, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Support engineering workflows and data management processes.
  • Documentation, Budgeting & Governance (10%)
  • Develop and maintain procedures, user guides, and technical documentation.
  • Create software asset inventories and license tracking records.
  • Support preparation of budget estimates and licensing forecasts.
  • Support governance processes related to software acquisition, deployment, and compliance.
  • Generate reports and metrics related to software utilization and spending.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in IT support, engineering application administration, or a related role.
  • Ability to provide support during core U.S. business hours and collaborate effectively across multiple U.S. time zones to support geographically dispersed engineering teams.
  • Experience administering software licensing systems and license servers.
  • Experience supporting users in geographically distributed or global environments.
  • Experience providing remote technical support and collaborating with vendors.
  • Knowledge of software asset management, licensing models, and vendor management practices.
  • Experience developing software budget estimates and recommending licensing strategies.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting engineering organizations, aerospace/defense companies, or other regulated engineering environments.
  • Experience with engineering software tools
  • Knowledge of software asset management and compliance practices.
  • Experience working with global engineering and IT teams.
  • Experience with project coordination and vendor management skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

title: .NET-utvecklare till komplext bankapplikationsprojekt
description:
Bli en del av ett sammansvetsat team hos vår kund där du arbetar med ett av bankens mest kritiska system. Här får du lösa komplexa utmaningar i en miljö präglad av stark gemenskap, högt engagemang och härliga fredagsfikor.

Om tjänsten

I rollen som utvecklare arbetar du i ett agilt team med att förvalta och vidareutveckla en stor handläggarapplikation som används på bankens alla kontor. Du samarbetar tätt med kollegor i alla åldrar för att lösa komplexa problem och säkerställa hög kodkvalitet. Fokus ligger på din vilja att förstå komplex funktionalitet snarare än att bara använda den senaste tekniken.

Du erbjuds Du erbjuds ett långsiktigt uppdrag i ett engagerat team med stark gemenskap och goda möjligheter till hybridarbete (ca 2 dagar i veckan på distans). Här får du möjlighet att bygga djup domänkunskap och expertis inom komplexa system i en trygg och flexibel arbetsmiljö.

Rollen innebär en varierad vardag med fokus på både nyutveckling och förvaltning av en affärskritisk applikation. Du arbetar i ett agilt team där ni tillsammans löser tekniska utmaningar och förbättrar systemet för bankens användare.

  • Vidareutveckla och förvalta en komplex bankapplikation i en .NET-miljö
  • Felsöka och hantera incidenter i applikationen
  • Skriva ren, modulär och testbar kod med långsiktighet i fokus
  • Analysera och förbättra komplex legacy-kod
  • Samarbeta nära kunden för att förstå deras utmaningar och hitta lösningar
  • Arbeta agilt tillsammans med utvecklare, testare och kravanalytiker

Vi söker dig som

  • Minst tre års erfarenhet som utvecklare
  • Goda kunskaper i systemutveckling inom antingen .NET/C# eller Java
  • Avancerade kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift, då dokumentation och kod är på svenska
  • Förmåga och vilja att sätta dig in i och arbeta med komplexa system och kodbaser
  • God samarbetsförmåga och ett driv att lösa problem tillsammans i team

Det är meriterande om du har

  • Kunskap i VB.NET, WinForms, WPF eller SQL Server

  • Erfarenhet av integrationer via REST eller WSDL

  • Erfarenhet av Azure DevOps

  • Studier inom systemvetenskap eller motsvarande IT-utbildning

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:

  • Optimistisk
  • Hjälpsam
  • Målmedveten
  • Social
  • Energisk
  • Intellektuellt nyfiken

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Security Consultant
description:

title: Child Welfare Specialist I/II/III
description:
This position is located in Hugo, Oklahoma.

Working in Child Welfare for Oklahoma's largest state agency means having the opportunity to positively impact the safety and well-being of children and families for generations to come. If you have a passion for social work and making a difference in your local community, OKDHS has a place for you! Join our team and create pathways to hope for all Oklahomans.

Extensive training will be provided to new employees.

Annual Salary

  • Level I H23A - $37,280.75 + Full State Employee Benefits
  • Level II H23B - $40,077.79 + Full State Employee Benefits
  • Level III H23C - $43,968.62 + Full State Employee Benefits

Applicants who possess a Master's Degree in Social Work will be entitled to a salary incentive of an additional 5%.

On-call positions will receive an additional bonus ranging from $100 to $150 every two weeks, depending on responsibilities.

Hours worked may include on-call, extended and/or weekend hours.

Minimum Qualifications

Child Welfare Specialist, Level I

  • Completion of 90 hours from an accredited college or university;
  • OR 3 years of experience related to child welfare work;
  • OR A combination of education and experience.

Child Welfare Specialist, Level II

  • A bachelor's degree (in any field) to qualify;
  • OR One year of experience as a Child Welfare Specialist.

Child Welfare Specialist, Level III

  • A Master's degree;
  • OR a Bachelors Degree plus one year of experience as a Child Welfare Specialist;
  • OR Two years of experience as a Child Welfare Specialist.

Job Duties

This position job responsibilities may be in one or more of the following, within Child Welfare Programs.

Child Protective Services (CPS)

*Investigates allegations of child abuse or neglect.

*Protects the safety of children and provides services to help families with any barriers that can result in the safety of their children to be at risk.

Family Centered Services (FCS)

*Preserves and strengthen protective capacities of the parents to keep the child in their own home with a focus on increasing safety for the child and family to prevent unnecessary out-of-home placements.

Permanency Planning (PP)

*Provides services to families that include involving family members as participants in their own treatment plan.

*Provides placements for children which will meet their medical, educational, and physical needs.

*Returns children to their own homes as soon as their needs can be met in the home of their parent(s), and arranges a permanent plan when return to the home is not possible.

All New Employees will complete the Child Welfare Core Academy Training Program

  • Learn treatment and preventive services;
  • Visit children in placement and conduct assessments of children and families;
  • Refer families and children to services in the community;
  • Participate in investigations of abuse and neglect of children, and prepare case reports and other documentation;
  • Attends court hearings and provides testimony;
  • Consults with the District Attorney and other attorneys, and tribal partners regarding efforts to protect the child, reunite the family or other permanent plans for the child;
  • Provides direct services to children in placement,
  • And other duties as assigned.

________________________________________________________________
Travel is EXTENSIVE - Must possess a valid driver's license and must maintain required car insurance. State vehicles will be available for use to carry out the duties of the position.

Click here to see what it is like to work in Child Welfare.

If you have questions, please contact DHS.Careers@okdhs.org

OKDHS is a Fair Chance Employer.

We also build housing, develop grassroots leadership, and engage low-income residents and youth. Our employees are passionate about the mission; thrive in a family organizational culture; and embody values of empowerment, teamwork, and compassion. Chinatown CDC serves a diverse population and is committed to hiring practices that provide culturally competent services. We encourage people of color to apply.

General Job Responsibilities:

  • Marketing, Leasing, and Occupancy Management:
    • Working with Compliance Specialists and Property Management, develop and implement marketing plans, including creating advertisements and outreach strategies to attract qualified applicants.
    • As necessary, conduct property tours and show units to prospective residents.
    • Maintain, monitor, and actively work viable waitlists of qualified prospective residents and internal transfer lists to minimize vacancy loss.
    • Conduct phone and on-site interviews with applicants; schedule and conduct initial and follow-up interviews; and move qualified applicants through the pipeline in a timely manner.
    • Approve move-in files prior to third party or manager reviews and approval
    • Collaborate with the maintenance team to support timely unit readiness and resolution of service requests for new move-ins.
  • Resident Relations:
    • Provide exceptional customer service, addressing resident requests and concerns promptly.
    • Assist residents with the move-in process, including unit inspections.
    • Communicate lease and community policies to new and current residents.
  • Occupancy and Compliance Support:
    • Maintain accurate wait and transfer lists, including sending appropriate notices to applicants to add, update, or remove them as necessary.
    • Coordinate recertification appointments and documentation collection in partnership with Property Management and Compliance to support timely completion before required deadlines.
    • Support the distribution of recertification notices, including 120-day notices, and follow up with residents who fail to respond promptly.
    • Review and monitor recertification schedules in Yardi on a monthly basis and escalate timing concerns to Property Management and Compliance.
    • Perform applicant interviews and support adherence to NAU (Next Available Unit) procedures during the leasing process.
    • Collect and organize income and eligibility documentation for review, helping ensure files are complete and compliant with HUD, LIHTC, or other applicable affordable housing requirements.
    • Assist the Property Manager and Compliance team with onboarding or process guidance related to leasing, waitlists, applicant intake, and documentation collection.
  • Property Compliance Support:
    • Process initial, interim, and annual certification documentation by collecting, organizing, and entering required information for review by Compliance staff.
    • Timely calculation/Correction of retroactive lease charges
    • Maintain leasing and marketing reports and assist with preparation of agency reporting materials as assigned, including DAHLIA marketing plans via MOHCD and AFHMP’s with HUD.
  • Administrative Support:
    • Maintain accurate records in Yardi.
    • Prepare and submit leasing, occupancy, and compliance-support reports for management review.
  • General Operations:
    • Support site and office operations as assigned by the manager.

Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

  • Ability to troubleshoot and prioritize work
  • Capacity to work independently and exercise own judgment
  • Knowledge of OSHA and CAL/OSHA and other safety and health code violations
  • Knowledge of all applicable building codes and ability to recognize building code violations
  • Basic computer skills
  • Good problem-solving skills
  • Flexibility to adjust to changing situations and work conditions
  • Ability to work with people of diverse economic, social and ethnic backgrounds
  • Good verbal and written communication skills

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Further education in real estate or property management is a plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Experience in accounting, administrative support, clerical or equivalent work or study

Preferred Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of relevant property management, leasing, occupancy, or affordable housing experience.
  • Knowledge of HUD Section 8, LIHTC, and/or other affordable housing programs preferred; direct affordable housing compliance experience strongly preferred. Candidates expected to handle advanced compliance tasks.
  • Familiarity with MOHCD and DAHLIA processes and regulations.
  • Possession of COS, TCS, or BOS credentials, or willingness to obtain them within six months of hire (training provided).
  • Proficiency in property management software such as Yardi Voyager.
Skills:
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and time-management abilities, especially in managing applicant pipelines, waitlists, deadlines, and documentation, including data entry.
  • Ability to handle pressure and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Attributes:

  • A team player with a positive attitude.
  • Motivated self-starter who thrives on completing goals.
  • Strong commitment to resident satisfaction, occupancy goals, and community success

title: Superintendent

description:
Title: Superintendent - Datacenter

Locations: Jackson, GA

Job Summary:

The Superintendent’s role is to effectively monitor, direct, and coordinate all field operations for a specific area of discipline, a given trade, or an entire project, as assigned. Works with project management and engineers to form an effective management team, overseeing safety, schedule, quality of work and budget for the project. The Superintendent must be an exceptional leader and communicator and will serve as a mentor to junior-level team members.

Primary Duties:

  • Coordinating work with project owner representatives, architects, engineers, inspectors, and site subcontractors and/or directing the work of all trades assigned to a construction work site.
  • Coordinating and scheduling the work activities of tradespeople, professionals, and laborers, communicating to and through project staff to deliver instructions and project assignments as appropriate.
  • Conducting preconstruction meetings with all subcontractors before beginning each phase of work.
  • Planning manpower and personnel needs onsite.
  • Leading toolbox talks/briefings.
  • Providing management of safety, quality, risk, and compliance for the project and team members.
  • Providing oversight on facilitating equipment for the project site (cranes, trailers, trucks, etc.)
  • Overseeing weekly work activities for trade crews.
  • Utilizing project contract documents, specifications, and drawings.
  • Developing and maintaining the site logistics plan for the project.
  • Developing scopes of work for trades.
  • Performing constructability reviews.
  • Evaluating field progress against the “plan,” developing recovery plans, if necessary.
  • Leading preconstruction meetings with all subcontractors before beginning each phase of work.
  • Managing the completion of project close-out.
  • Managing punch list items and procedures.
  • Leading meetings to coordinate work.
  • Participating in owners’ meetings.
  • Participating in the development and management of a CPM schedule to include short-term look ahead to ensure trades are appropriately engaged in project execution.
  • Reviewing and verifying quantity takeoffs and materials management process during the buyout process for specific scopes of work.
  • Tracking project phase completion against milestones.
  • Demonstrate Yates Core Values and Principles.
  • Follow Yates Code of Conduct.

  • Report all incidents, near hits and hazards to management.
  • Required to wear and maintain personal PPE.
  • Advise fellow employees of hazardous situations.
  • Participate in workplace inspections.
  • Comply with statutory requirements, including duty of care.
  • Participate in required and/or assigned training.
  • Provide suggestions to improve Safety.
  • Present a mature approach to working safely.
  • Attend prestart and Safety meetings and contribute.

Qualifications:

  • An undergraduate University degree or higher (preferably in Construction Management, Engineering, or a closely related field) is desirable.
  • Other relevant education, training or work experience may substitute for bachelor’s degree.
  • Minimum of six (6) years’ industry experience.
  • Experience managing a scope of work valued over $1MM.
  • Strong understanding of planning and scheduling.
  • Strong understanding of business and/or financial principles to project and monitor expenses.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite including Word and Excel.
  • Ability to read and understand technical specifications, blueprints, technical manuals, product/material installation instructions and engineering/architectural drawings.

Competencies:

  • Mentoring, management, and timely performance evaluation of Assistant Superintendent(s) and Foremen.
  • Fostering and enhancing owner, architect, subcontractor, and vendor relations.
  • Ensuring strict adherence to ethics and compliance requirements throughout the project.
  • Proficient time management skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Business Acumen
  • Adaptability
  • Critical Thinking
  • Problem Solving
  • Decision Making
  • Strategy
  • Leadership
  • Financial Acumen

This job description reflects an assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Physical requirements for this role may include but not limited to walking, standing, operating tools / equipment, and lifting items (up to 25lbs). Tasks may also be carried out in varying weather conditions and environments as appliable to the position.?

Ranked among the top commercial and industrial construction companies in the country by Engineering News-Record, Yates Construction is family-owned and provides a wide range of construction and building services. Incorporated in 1964 by William G. Yates Jr., we have steadily grown to become one of the top commercial and industrial construction companies in the nation. title: Information Systems Security Officer (Prime)
description:
Make an Impact Where It Matters Most

At Intelliforce, we help mission systems stay secure, compliant, and ready for operational use. In this role, you will support Analytical Application Integration by helping maintain the security posture of mission systems, supporting Information Assurance activities, and ensuring security policies, standards, and procedures are followed throughout the system lifecycle.

You will work alongside systems engineers, software engineers, security professionals, and mission stakeholders to help protect classified information, maintain required documentation, assess security impacts, and support day-to-day security operations.

What Makes This Opportunity Stand Out

This role gives you hands-on exposure to the security side of mission systems. You will work across system security documentation, configuration management, vulnerability and risk assessment, authorization activities, policy compliance, and operational security.

Rather than sitting outside the engineering process, you will work closely with the teams building and sustaining the systems. You will help evaluate changes, understand their security impact, maintain accurate security documentation, and support the controls that keep mission systems authorized and operational.

At Intelliforce, your work is visible and your judgment matters. Because we support prime programs, our teams stay close to meaningful mission work and the people relying on these systems. Because we are a small business, leadership is accessible, communication is direct, and strong performance gets noticed. Add in long-term stability, strong benefits, and a people-first culture, and this is an opportunity to grow your security expertise while supporting real mission systems.

Here’s What Your Day-to-Day Could Include

  • Support the information assurance program for systems and related mission environments
  • Help implement and enforce information systems security policies, standards, and methodologies
  • Maintain the operational security posture of supported systems
  • Perform day-to-day security operations and support system security activities
  • Assist with evaluating security solutions for systems processing classified information
  • Support vulnerability and risk assessment activities
  • Help manage configuration changes and assess the security impact of those changes
  • Maintain configuration management records for security-relevant software, hardware, and firmware
  • Prepare and update System Security Plans, Risk Assessment Reports, C&A packages, and System Requirements Traceability Matrices
  • Support security authorization activities in accordance with NIST RMF
  • Maintain records for workstations, servers, routers, firewalls, switches, and other infrastructure components
  • Support the ISSM and senior ISSOs in maintaining the appropriate operational IA posture
  • Assist with user identification and authentication mechanisms
  • Keep security documentation current as systems evolve

Minimum Qualifications

  • Clearance: Top Secret Clearance with Full Scope Polygraph, must be active. We do not have the ability to sponsor clearances
  • Citizenship: Must be a U.S. Citizen. We cannot sponsor visas
  • Five years of experience as an ISSO on programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity
  • Experience in at least one of the following areas: current security tools, hardware or software security implementation, communication protocols, or encryption techniques and tools
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited college or university
  • Four additional years of ISSO experience may be substituted for the bachelor’s degree
  • DoD 8570 compliance with IAT Level I or higher

Required Skills

  • Experience implementing and enforcing information systems security policies, standards, and methodologies
  • Experience preparing and maintaining security documentation
  • Experience evaluating security solutions for classified information systems
  • Experience with configuration management for security-relevant software, hardware, and firmware
  • Experience maintaining system and infrastructure records
  • Experience supporting Certification and Accreditation activities
  • Knowledge of ODNI and DoD security policies
  • Experience developing or maintaining System Security Plans
  • Experience maintaining operational security posture
  • Experience supporting ISSM and senior ISSO activities
  • Experience performing day-to-day security operations
  • Understanding of user identification and authentication mechanisms
  • Strong documentation and attention-to-detail skills

Desired Skills

  • Experience supporting NIST Risk Management Framework activities
  • Experience preparing Risk Assessment Reports
  • Experience supporting System Requirements Traceability Matrices
  • Experience assessing security impacts associated with system changes
  • Familiarity with vulnerability and risk assessment processes
  • Familiarity with security controls for classified systems
  • Experience supporting secure mission or operational environments

Compensation Range: $135,000.00 - $173,000.00
This salary range reflects our current market estimate for the role. Final compensation will depend on your experience, technical background, overall qualifications, and alignment with the position. We evaluate each candidate thoughtfully, so offers are shaped around the value you bring to the team

Why Intelliforce? Because you matter—your work, your growth, and your well-being.
At Intelliforce, we don’t just push the boundaries of technology—we partner with some of the most mission-driven teams in defense and beyond to solve challenges that truly matter. As a Systems Engineer here, you won’t just contribute to projects—you’ll help shape outcomes that make a real-world impact.
We also know that great work starts with a great environment. That’s why we invest in you:
  • Ample PTO to rest and recharge—plus all federal holidays and your birthday off, just because.
  • Multiple medical plan options, including ones with zero deductible or premium for employees.
  • Generous 401(k) with immediate vesting—because your future matters now.
  • Exciting bonus opportunities, from profit sharing to quarterly awards and President’s Club recognition.
  • A culture of collaboration, connection, and fun, with regular team activities that go beyond the work.
Ready to grow with purpose?
At Intelliforce, your career will flourish in a place where innovation thrives and people come first. Join us—and let’s build something meaningful together. You can reach us at careers@intelliforce-itsg.com or schedule a call with our Director of Recruitment, just visit this link to view their calendar: https://calendly.com/amwolfe-intelliforce-itsg/30min .

title: Teknisk Projekt- og Byggeleder til Kapacitetscenter Svanemøllen, Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen
description:
Er du interesseret i at arbejde med renovering og vedligehold af unikke bygninger og tekniske anlæg inden for Forsvaret?

Vi søger en engageret og fagligt stærk teknisk projekt- og byggeleder til Kapacitetscenter Svanemøllen. Du får mulighed for at arbejde med spændende faciliteter inden for områder som ventilation, CTS, køling og infrastruktur på kaserneniveau – inklusive både almindelige bygninger og særligt indrettede anlæg bag perimeterhegnet.



Om os

Forsvaret er en af Danmarks største ejendomsejere. Vedligeholdelsesafdelingen, herunder Kapacitetscentrene planlægger, koordinerer og udfører de fleste renoverings- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver på bygningsmassen og de tekniske anlæg i Kongeriget.

Kapacitetscenter Svanemøllen er et af 11 kapacitetscentre på landsplan og har ansvar for et geografisk område, der strækker sig fra Gentofte i nord til Roskilde mod vest og Køge i syd. Vi varetager renovering og vedligehold af en bred vifte af faciliteter – fra mindre hjemmeværnsgårde, til store etablissementer som Svanemøllens Kaserne, Marinestation København, Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelsen, samt fredede områder som Frederiksberg Slot, Gothersgade, Nyboder og Kastellet.

Vores bygninger omfatter både traditionelle værksteder, kontorer og indkvarteringsfaciliteter, samt atypiske installationer, herunder specialindrettede anlæg, udendørs faciliteter og landstrømsforsyninger.

Kapacitetscentret består af 3 teams med i alt 11 medarbejdere samt sektionschefen. Vi kendetegnes ved en fri og uformel tone, hvor vidensdeling og gensidig støtte er centralt. Sammen udgør vi et kompetent team bestående af fagligt dygtige kollegaer, med ekspertise inden for hver vores fagområde.



Om stillingen

Energioptimering som dit primære fokusområde

I denne stilling får du en central rolle i Forsvarets arbejde med, at reducere energiforbrug og styrke den grønne omstilling. Du kommer til at planlægge og lede projekter, der bidrager til mere energieffektive bygninger og tekniske løsninger – både gennem analyse, vurderinger og konkrete forbedringstiltag. Opgaverne vil variere i størrelse og kompleksitet, og du bliver det koordinerende bindeled mellem interne fagpersoner, rådgivere og eksterne leverandører. Derudover bliver det en af dine kerneopgaver at udarbejde energioptimeringsplaner for det lokale Kapacitetscenter.

Typiske projekter ligger i størrelsesordenen 100.000–3.000.000 kr. Du deltager i alle projektfaser: fra prioritering i porteføljeplanlægningen, gennem udførelse til aflevering samt 1- og 5-års eftersyn.

Nøgleelementer i rollen inkluderer stærk kommunikation og samarbejde. Du vil indlede dialog med brugerne for at sikre, at projekterne opfylder deres behov og minimerer forstyrrelser i dagligdagen. Du får ansvar for din egen projektportefølje, som tilpasses din erfaring og kompetencer. Vi prioriterer vidensdeling og sparring højt, og samarbejde er afgørende for succes.

Vi tilbyder høj grad af frihed under ansvar. Du planlægger selv din portefølje, og der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde, samt fleksibel arbejdstid med fleksordning – alt sammen med fokus på en god arbejdslivs-balance.

Dit faste arbejdssted bliver Svanemøllens Kaserne, hvorfra du kører ud til projekter inden for centerets geografiske område. Forvent ca. 10-15 rejsedage årligt til projekter, møder eller seminarer i resten af landet.



Om dig

Du har en mellemlang, eller lang videregående uddannelse, som f.eks. maskinmester, bygningskonstruktør, ingeniør eller tilsvarende. Du har kendskab til CTS/EMS og til integration af tekniske anlæg i digitale styringssystemer. Du formulerer dig sikkert på dansk og har delvise formuleringsevner på engelsk.

Erfaring med planlægning og styring af vedligeholdelsesprojekter er essentiel, og kendskab til bygningsreglementet samt AB18 er en fordel.

Personligt har du gennemslagskraft og evne til at lede byggemøder, samt styre projekter sikkert i mål. Du trives med selvstændig planlægning af din arbejdsdag, tager ansvar og bidrager aktivt til opgaverne.

Du værdsætter godt samarbejde, løfter i flok og bidrager med positiv indstilling og godt humør – grundpiller i vores team.

Manglende lovpligtig arbejdsmiljøuddannelse for koordinatorer, kan opnås inden for det første ansættelses år, hvis du ikke besidder denne. Vi tilbyder desuden relevante kurser og uddannelse, til arbejde i Forsvaret. Interesse for løbende kompetenceudvikling er derfor vigtigt. IT er en naturlig del af hverdagen, og kendskab til SAP er en fordel.

Du skal have kørekort kategori B, da kørsel foregår i Forsvarets biler.



Ansættelsesvilkår

Du ansættes i henhold til den enhver tid gældende overenskomst.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er Svanemøllen Kaserne

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.



Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte chef for Kapacitetscenter Svanemøllen, Henrik Jeanty Andersen, på telefon 24 49 60 22 eller e-mail: etk-chkcsvm@mil.dk

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Sofie Gadegaard på telefon 3266 5585.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 15. oktober 20226 og samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 43. Stillingen er til besættelse den 1. december eller efter aftale.

Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.



Om Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen

Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen (ETK) støtter og servicerer militære og civile myndigheder under Forsvarsministeriet. Vores opgave er at levere og udvikle attraktive fysiske rammer, som er nødvendige for deres daglige virke.

Vi bygger nyt, vedligeholder, driver kantiner og gør rent på tjenestesteder i hele landet.

Vi har på vegne af Forsvarsministeriets koncern ansvaret for det grønne område, der blandt andet omfatter miljø, energi og naturpleje.

Vores hovedkontor er i Hjørring, men vi har medarbejdere i hele landet. Vi er i alt 1600 ansatte, der tæller både civilt og militært ansatte. Vi er en organisation baseret på stærke fagfællesskaber, og vi prioriterer det tværgående samarbejde højt.

• Vi har ansvaret for over 600 lokationer spredt ud over hele Danmark.

• Vi administrer over 6000 bygninger og forvalter øvelsesområder, der samlet set er på størrelse med Mors.

• Vi bygger og vedligeholder i år for knap en milliard og er blandt andet bygherre på store projekter som campus til de nye F35-kampfly.

title: Senior SCCM Patch Management Consultant
description:
Position Overview

MetroSys is seeking an experienced Senior SCCM Patch Management Consultant to support a regional credit union in assessing, improving, and modernizing its enterprise patch-management environment.

The consultant will serve as a subject matter expert for Microsoft SCCM / Microsoft Configuration Manager, reviewing the client's current SCCM architecture, patching processes, deployment methodology, reporting, automation, and overall patch compliance.

This role will begin with a comprehensive assessment of the existing environment and progress into recommendations and hands-on improvements. The consultant will identify SCCM configuration gaps, improve patching processes, increase automation, and help establish a more reliable and repeatable enterprise patch-management program.

The environment is primarily Microsoft-based with some Linux infrastructure and supports banking, security, and regulated workloads. The consultant should understand the operational and compliance requirements associated with patching systems within a financial-services environment.

The initial engagement is expected to last approximately three months, with the possibility of extension and/or permanent employment based on project needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform a comprehensive assessment of the existing SCCM / Microsoft Configuration Manager environment and enterprise patch-management process.
  • Review SCCM architecture, site configuration, distribution points, Software Update Points, WSUS integration, client health, boundaries, collections, and overall platform health.
  • Evaluate existing SCCM Software Update Groups, Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs), device collections, maintenance windows, deployment schedules, and reboot policies.
  • Review current Windows Server and endpoint patching processes to identify coverage gaps, failed deployments, configuration issues, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Assess SCCM patch-compliance reporting and develop recommendations for improving visibility into compliant, non-compliant, failed, offline, and pending-reboot systems.
  • Design or improve SCCM patching rings and deployment collections for test, pilot, production, critical infrastructure, and exception groups.
  • Develop and implement SCCM automation to reduce manual patch-management activities and improve consistency.
  • Utilize PowerShell and other automation technologies to improve SCCM administration, reporting, remediation, and patching workflows.
  • Review existing patch testing, approval, deployment, rollback, maintenance-window, and emergency patching procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to automate patch identification, deployment, validation, remediation, and compliance reporting.
  • Evaluate where AI-assisted technologies could provide practical value within patch management, reporting, troubleshooting, vulnerability prioritization, or operational workflows.
  • Work with security and vulnerability-management teams to align SCCM patch deployments with identified vulnerabilities and organizational risk.
  • Support patching requirements across a primarily Microsoft environment, while helping establish appropriate processes for Linux and other infrastructure not directly managed through SCCM.
  • Review patch-management practices against applicable banking, security, PCI, and internal compliance requirements.
  • Troubleshoot SCCM client, deployment, distribution, update, and reporting issues.
  • Create or improve patch-management dashboards, reports, KPIs, and audit documentation.
  • Develop a prioritized SCCM and patch-management improvement roadmap.
  • Implement approved SCCM configuration, automation, reporting, and process improvements during the engagement.
  • Document configurations, procedures, recommendations, and operational standards and provide knowledge transfer to internal teams.

title: Lærer til Juniormesterlære på Hornum Skole – 70 % stilling
description:
Lærer til Juniormesterlære på Hornum Skole – 70 % stilling

Har du lyst til at arbejde med unge, som har brug for en skoledag, hvor undervisning, praksis, relationer og virkelighed hænger tæt sammen?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores JML-afdeling på Hornum Skole.

Vi søger en lærer til en 70 % stilling med mulighed for flere timer. Stillingen indeholder primært undervisning i dansk, matematik og naturfag. Hvis du også kan undervise i engelsk, vil det være en fordel.

I Juniormesterlære 8&9 klasse, arbejder vi med elever i udskolingen, som profiterer af en mere praktisk og anderledes tilgang til skolegangen.

Eleverne skal både blive fagligt dygtigere og opleve, at det, de lærer, giver mening uden for skolen. Derfor arbejder vi tæt sammen omkring eleverne og forsøger at skabe en skoledag med tydelige rammer, gode relationer og plads til forskellighed.

Din profil

Vi søger dig, der:

  • kan undervise i dansk, matematik og naturfag
  • gerne også kan byde ind i engelsk
  • kan gøre undervisningen konkret, praksisnær og overskuelig
  • er relationsstærk og oprigtigt har lyst til at arbejde med vores målgruppe
  • er robust og kan bevare roen, når dagen ikke går helt som planlagt
  • kan være tydelig og samtidig møde eleverne med respekt og forståelse
  • kan se muligheder og ressourcer hos unge, som ikke nødvendigvis har haft de bedste erfaringer med skole
  • trives i et tæt samarbejde med kolleger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • har erhvervserfaring


Afdelingen

Om Hornum Skole og Juniormesterlære

Hornum Skole er en skole med fokus på faglighed, fællesskab og praksisnær undervisning, hvor eleverne møder læring både i og uden for klasselokalet. Skolens motto er “Indsigt, udsyn og det store fællesskab”.

På Hornum Skole har vi desuden Juniormesterlære (JML) for elever i 8. og 9. klasse. Her kombineres undervisning på skolen med praktiske forløb på erhvervsskole eller i lokale virksomheder. Eleverne er tre dage om ugen på Hornum Skole og to dage i praktik eller på HEG i Aars.

I JML arbejder vi målrettet med at skabe en praktisk, motiverende og erhvervsrettet skolegang, hvor eleverne får mulighed for at opleve deres faglige kompetencer i en konkret sammenhæng og samtidig bliver klogere på deres fremtidige uddannelsesmuligheder.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du:

  • en spændende og anderledes læreropgave
  • mulighed for at arbejde mere praksisorienteret med fagene
  • stor indflydelse på tilrettelæggelsen af undervisningen
  • tæt samarbejde omkring eleverne
  • sjove kolleger, der arbejder for at skabe en skolegang, der giver mening for den enkelte unge
  • en 710 % stilling med mulighed for et højere timetal


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Gældende overenskomst

Yderligere oplysninger

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, at du passer ind i en bestemt kasse. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til vores elever, kan skabe gode relationer og samtidig kan stå tydeligt som voksen.
