title: Mortgage Loan Servicer
description:
Role
Perform real estate loan servicing, document preparation, processing, and quality control activities. Prepare and maintain real estate loan servicing documents and escrow accounts, ensure the accuracy and integrity of loan data, process mortgage assistance and loan modification requests, manage insurance claims related to mortgage loans, and perform HMDA reporting and compliance activities in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, investor requirements, and credit union policies.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

  • Answer members’ questions regarding real estate lending and provide amortization schedules, loan payoffs, loan rates, and other servicing-related information. Explain the disbursement of loan proceeds and review payment schedules to ensure members understand their repayment obligations.
  • Maintain accurate and current real estate escrow records. Ensure the credit union has documentation of paid property taxes and adequate homeowners and flood insurance coverage. Process appropriate real estate tax and insurance payments and conduct annual escrow analyses.
  • Process and monitor insurance claims related to mortgage loans, ensuring timely submission, accurate documentation, appropriate tracking, and follow-up through resolution. Coordinate with members, insurance carriers, vendors, and internal departments as necessary to ensure claims are properly documented and resolved.
  • Process mortgage assistance applications and evaluate required documentation for completeness and accuracy. Identify missing or incomplete information, communicate outstanding requirements, and ensure applications are processed timely in accordance with established procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate and process loan modifications in accordance with established guidelines, policies, investor requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements. Ensure required documentation, approvals, disclosures, and system updates are completed accurately and timely.
  • Process payments to title companies for title searches, legal work, appraisals, and other authorized services related to mortgage loan servicing, ensuring appropriate documentation, authorization, and accurate recording of expenses.
  • Properly maintain loan information in the core system and complete all required follow-up documentation. Process payroll deductions, distributions, allotments, automated payments, payment corrections, payment coupons, late notices, and other loan servicing transactions. Ensure loan information and servicing transactions are accurately and timely processed in the core system.
  • Maintain real estate loan files in accordance with established procedures. Monitor active real estate and interim construction loan files to ensure required documentation is obtained and maintained. Prepare correspondence for real estate loan officers, perform notary public duties, prepare satisfactions of mortgage for paid-off mortgage loans, and ensure paid real estate loan files are cleared and processed timely.
  • Perform HMDA reporting and compliance responsibilities by collecting, reviewing, validating, and accurately reporting required mortgage loan data in accordance with the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) and Regulation C. Ensure HMDA data is entered accurately and timely into approved systems, identify and resolve discrepancies or data exceptions, and maintain the integrity and completeness of HMDA-related information in accordance with applicable reporting requirements and established procedures.
  • Perform quality control activities related to real estate loan servicing, including reviewing loan information and documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established procedures and applicable regulatory requirements. Identify discrepancies and take appropriate action to ensure timely correction.
  • Balance assigned loan servicing general ledger accounts and ensure transactions are accurately recorded and reconciled. Monitor construction loan disbursements, maintain appropriate documentation, and track outstanding requirements through completion.
  • Assist with assignments, special projects, process improvements, and other duties as requested by management.
  • Maintain compliance with all credit union policies and procedures and applicable federal and state laws and regulations, including, but not limited to, the Bank Secrecy Act, USA PATRIOT Act, Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) requirements, HMDA, and Regulation C.

title: Principal Transformation Consultant
description:
About Valiantys

Here at Valiantys, we are one of the world’s largest Atlassian partners, helping organizations work better through scalable, people-centered solutions. As an Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner with a global footprint, we support customers across industries as they adopt ITSM, Agile at Scale, and modern work management practices.

Our teams work at the intersection of strategy and delivery, partnering closely with customers to translate complex business challenges into clear, actionable solutions built on best practices and leading platforms.

Join Valiantys and be part of something extraordinary!

Job summary

The Principal Transformation (TX) Consultant is a senior advisory leader responsible for helping clients define, structure, mobilize, and realize complex business and technology transformations. The role partners with senior business and technology leaders to translate strategic ambition into an executable transformation agenda—including target outcomes, investment priorities, transformation roadmaps, operating models, governance, organizational readiness, and value realization measures.

Operating at the intersection of strategy, portfolio, program, and project management (3PM), organizational change management (OCM), operating-model design, technology-enabled transformation, and value realization, the Principal Consultant brings practical technology and AI fluency to support informed decisions without serving as a technical architect or engineering specialist.

What you'll be working on

Transformation strategy, operating model, and value

  • Assess current-state capabilities and define transformation strategies, target operating models, business cases, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

  • Evaluate options and recommend clear choices based on value, complexity, risk, dependencies, investment, and time to value.

  • Maintain traceability from strategy through delivery, adoption, and realized value; identify reprioritization and recovery needs early.

    • 3PM and transformation governance advisory

    • Design and improve portfolio and program intake, prioritization, planning, funding, governance, and performance management.

    • Facilitate portfolio decisions using strategic alignment, value, cost, risk, dependencies, and available capacity.

    • Define decision rights, governance models, performance measures, and operating cadences.

    • Identify systemic execution barriers and recommend practical improvements to portfolio and transformation performance.

      • Organizational change management and adoption

      • Assess change impacts, stakeholder needs, leadership alignment, organizational readiness, and capacity for change.

      • Define integrated OCM strategies covering sponsorship, communications, capability building, adoption, reinforcement, and measurable readiness.

      • Engage change-management specialists when required and ensure adoption considerations are embedded in transformation design.

        • Executive, stakeholder, and AI-enabled advisory

        • Facilitate executive workshops, steering committees, and governance forums.

        • Translate complex issues into decision-ready narratives and pre-wire key trade-offs with senior stakeholders.

        • Build trusted-advisor relationships across business and technology functions while navigating competing priorities toward enterprise outcomes.

        • Maintain practical AI fluency and advise clients on relevant use cases and implications for operating model, workforce, governance, risk, and adoption.

          • Commercial, practice, and people leadership

          • Shape pursuits and advisory propositions, including problem framing, approaches, outcomes, assumptions, risks, and expansion opportunities.

          • Monitor scope, engagement economics, and changing client expectations; surface commercial impacts early.

          • Coach consultants and strengthen the Transformation practice through quality reviews, reusable methods, offerings, intellectual property, thought leadership, and talent development.

Do you have what it takes to be our new Principal Transformation (TX) Consultant?

  • 10+ years of experience in management, technology, or transformation consulting, with substantial senior client-facing leadership; bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

  • Proven leadership of complex business or technology transformations from strategy through execution, adoption, and value realization.

  • Strong consulting capabilities in structured problem solving, analysis, business cases, roadmaps, workshops, executive storytelling, and recommendations.

  • Demonstrated expertise in 3PM, including prioritization, investment decisions, governance, capacity, sequencing, portfolio performance, and execution.

  • Practical operating-model and OCM experience, with the ability to connect business strategy to technology-enabled transformation and AI implications.

  • Executive-grade communication, sound judgment in ambiguity, team leadership, commercial awareness, and experience contributing to pursuits.

    • Experience with AI-enabled transformation, consulting offerings, intellectual property, or thought leadership.

Our team members are our greatest asset, and we work hard to ensure that Valiantys is not only a great place to work, but also a platform for you to grow.

title: Cookie Crew
description:

Not only are you the point person at the front of the store for interacting with our customers, but you also get to bake all of our awesome Warm and Delicious cookies as well! Check out some of our content vids below to learn more: Who We Are! Insomnia Cookies Timeline Core Values SOME OF OUR SWEET COOKIE CREW PERKS: · Flexible part-time work schedules · Pay-on-Demand (no longer do you have to wait until the end of the week. Get paid daily for your total shift earnings from the day before!) · Paid vacation and sick time off · Pet insurance for your furry loved ones · Interactive training & mentorship · Job stability with a rapidly growing and reputable company · Achievable growth/promotion opportunities · You get to work in a fun, exciting team environment · Employee discount and FREE COOKIES with every shift! WHAT ELSE WILL I DO AS A MEMBER OF THE COOKIE CREW? · Promptly greet guests entering the store and take their orders according to procedure · Help customers understand menu items, answer clarifying questions, and repeat orders for accuracy · Give each customer a warm experience with a smile in person & over the phone · Bake our delicious cookies to perfection & a scoop of ice cream · Ensure fast, warm, and correct delivery orders are packaged and sent out · Handle cash and payments accurately and have no shortages or overages · Cleaning, sanitizing, and maintaining the bakery DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE: · At least 6 months of experience in a customer service focused role - preferred · Personable, genuine, outgoing demeanor · Customer service focused and a willingness to exceed guest expectations · Great communication, organizational and math skills · Must be able to lift up to 40 lb boxes of product · Must be 18 years or older to be employed · Must be able to work nights, weekends and holidays · Legally eligible to work in the United States

At Insomnia Cookies, warm cookies are just the beginning.

As a Cookie Crew Member, you're part baker, part hospitality expert, and part late-night hero. Whether you're welcoming guests into the bakery, pulling a fresh tray of cookies from the oven, or packing the perfect delivery order, you'll help create the experience that keeps our fans coming back night after night.

Our bakeries move fast, especially after the rest of the world has called it a night. Every shift is a team effort, and every warm cookie, friendly interaction, and perfectly packed order matters.

If you enjoy working with great people, thrive in an energetic environment, and love making someone's day just a little sweeter, you'll fit right in.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Every shift is a little different, but you can expect to:

  • Welcome every guest with genuine hospitality and make every interaction memorable.
  • Prepare, bake, and package our warm cookies, brownies, ice cream, and other treats to Insomnia's quality standards.
  • Accurately prepare in-store, pickup, delivery, and online orders.
  • Operate the register and process guest transactions.
  • Keep the bakery clean, stocked, organized, and food-safe throughout every shift.
  • Jump in wherever your team needs you, whether that's restocking supplies, helping a teammate, or keeping the line moving.
  • Resolve guest concerns with empathy and urgency, partnering with your Shift Leader when needed.
  • Deliver the kind of experience that turns first-time guests into lifelong Insomniacs.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Physical Requirements

This position regularly requires the ability to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
  • Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
  • Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
  • Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
  • Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point-of-sale system.
  • Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
  • Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
  • Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
  • Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment

This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.

Schedule Expectations

Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Insomnia Cookies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Reasonable Accommodation

If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Additional Information

Employment with Insomnia Cookies is contingent upon successful completion of any background checks, employment verification, and other pre-employment requirements applicable to the position and permitted by law.

Ready to Join the Cookie Crew?

title: Lejre Kommune søger en juridisk konsulent
description:
Vi søger en juridisk konsulent og kollega i Fællessekretariatet for Job & Social • Familier, Unge & Tidlig Indsats

Er du skarp på forvaltningsret, lovgivning og styring, så er det måske dig vi søger som juridisk konsulent i fællessekretariatet for Job & Social og Familie, Unge & Tidlig Indsats. Du vil få en central funktion med tæt samarbejde og sparring med ledelse, kollegaer i afdelingerne på det specialiserede voksenområde, det specialiserede børneområde samt beskæftigelsesområdet og ikke mindst gode kolleger i sekretariatet.

Vi har klare ambitioner om, at vores myndighedsarbejde skal være tilrettelagt på en måde, så vi sikrer borgerens retssikkerhed og samtidig yder den nødvendige hjælp indenfor lovens rammer - vi skal gøre det rigtige, rigtigt. Deler du denne ambition, kan du spille en vigtig rolle i vores sekretariat.

Synes du, at forvaltningsret, sagsbehandlingsprocesser, opfølgning og styring, tilrettelæggelse af fælles faglige standarder med mere – er både spændende og vigtigt og har du lyst til at bruge dine juridiske kompetencer til sparring med andre faggrupper, så læs videre.

Om os

Sekretariatet består af 10 medarbejdere, der tilsammen løser en bred række af administrative, understøttende og udviklende opgaver på tværs af det specialiserede voksenområde, det specialiserede børneområde samt beskæftigelsesområdet. I sekretariatet vægter vi det gode kollegaskab højt og tonen er uformel og venlig.

Vi prioriterer faglig sparring og videndeling og vi hjælper hinanden i den fælles opgaver vi har med at understøtte drift og udvikling i centrene.

Dine primære opgaver
  • Selvstændig udarbejdelse af skriftlige juridiske produkter, herunder notater, udkast til afgørelser og praksisbeskrivelser, som kan anvendes direkte i organisationen
  • Styrende og koordinerende rolle ift. ledelsestilsyn og den sociale revision. Opgaven består af kvalitetssikring af ledelsestilsyn og koordinering ift. ekstern revision
  • Tovholder i kommunens pensionsudvalg
  • Håndtering af komplicerede aktindsigter og klagesager
  • Bidrage til udvikling af praksis, arbejdsgange og beslutningsgrundlag
  • Opsøge og videreformidle ny lovgivning, der har betydning for vores opgaver samt faglige dybdedyk når der opstår særlige behov for indsats, f.eks. i form af sagsgennemgange, ekstraordinært ledelsestilsyn eller andet.

Og hvis du er interesseret i en bredere og varieret portefølje, så er der mulighed for gode samarbejde omkring både projekt- og procesledelse.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Har en relevant juridisk uddannelse
  • Har solid erfaring med social- og forvaltningsret, gerne fra en kommunal kontekst
  • Trives i en rådgivende og understøttende rolle uden formelt ledelsesansvar
  • Kan formidle kompleks jura klart og praksisnært – både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • Har blik for organisatorisk læring og udvikling
  • Har en udpræget sans for systematik og styring og en evne til at fastholde fokus – både eget og andres – på opgaveløsningen
  • Har forståelse for at arbejde i en politisk styret organisation

Du skal trives med at arbejde selvstændigt, skabe overblik og fremdrift i samarbejdet med forskellige faggrupper.

Vi tilbyder:
  • En meningsfuld stilling med faglig tyngde, hvor din viden bliver brugt af alle i organisationen
  • Mulighed for at blive en del af et velfungerende netværk af jurister i Lejre Kommune
  • Tæt samarbejde med centerchefer, øvrige ledere og dygtige fagprofessionelle
  • Et arbejdsmiljø med høj faglighed, åbenhed og respekt
  • Høj grad af fleksibilitet i både rammer og opgaveløsning

Det er vigtigt for os, at du har de nødvendige personlige og faglige kompetencer, men har du brug for faglig opkvalificering på enkelte områder, så tilbyder vi dig også det.

Det praktiske
  • Du skal helst begynde den 1. december 2026
  • Du vil blive ansat efter gældende overenskomst og principperne om Ny Løn
  • Den gennemsnitlige arbejdstid er 37 timer ugentlig
  • Frist for ansøgninger d. 18. oktober 2026
  • Ansættelsesudvalget mødes d. 21. oktober og udvælger kandidater til første samtalerunde. Du vil høre fra os d. 21. oktober, hvis du er udvalgt
  • Vi holder 1. samtalerunde d. 22. oktober og 2. samtaler d. 26. oktober 2026.

Vil du høre mere om stillingen og afdelingen, har du spørgsmål til jobbet, så kan du kontakte Sekretariatsleder, Louise Brønholm på 2349 5083

Lejre Kommune er et fællesskab af 49 små byer og landsbyer. Her bor lige under 30.000 mennesker, og stadig flere kommer til. Som kommune arbejder vi for at skabe det gode liv på landet, nu og for fremtidige generationer. Det handler om at tænke naturen ind i alt, hvad vi laver. At finde løsningerne i fællesskab og fællesskaber, og at skabe frirum, hvor borgere, foreninger og virksomheder kan udfolde sig.

Vi har i alt omkring 2000 medarbejdere, som arbejder for at skabe velfærd i et nært samarbejde med alle dem, som indsatsen har betydning for.

Det er derfor, vi kalder Lejre Kommune for Vores Sted.

I Lejre Kommune er der røgfri arbejdstid.

I Lejre Kommune indhenter vi straffeattester og børneattester til en række stillinger. Vær derfor opmærksom på, at du kan blive bedt om at give tilladelse til indhentning af disse, i de stillinger hvor det er relevant.

title: Staff Systems Engineer (R5982)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:
As a Staff Systems Engineer on Shield AI’s next gen UAS program, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and integrating cutting-edge autonomous aircraft systems for national defense. You will lead the technical execution of system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission-critical systems.
This position requires a deep understanding of aerospace systems engineering, autonomy, and complex system integration. You will work cross-functionally with teams in hardware, software, autonomy, flight operations, and manufacturing to develop a scalable, mission-ready platform capable of operating in contested environments.
Your expertise will be critical in defining system requirements and architectures through model-based systems engineering, conducting trade studies, ensuring compliance with military and aviation standards, and supporting the aircraft through flight testing and operational deployment.

What You'll Do:

  • Perform System Architecture & Design: Develop and refine the system architecture for the next gen UAS, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission systems.
  • Define and document system-level behavior, including modes, states, transitions, and fault responses
  • Support safety analyses (FHA, FMEA, FTA) by defining behavior under fault conditions
  • Define and Manage System Requirements: Establish top-level requirements, decompose them into subsystems, and maintain traceability across the development lifecycle.
  • Autonomy & AI Integration: Work closely with autonomy and software teams to integrate AI-driven flight control, decision-making, and mission execution capabilities.
  • Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE): Utilize SysML, DOORS, or other MBSE tools to create digital system models, conduct trade studies, and optimize system performance.
  • Risk Management & Trade Studies: Conduct trade studies to evaluate design alternatives, assess technical risks, and ensure the best engineering solutions for mission effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement: Work closely with DoD stakeholders, industry partners, and government agencies to align system capabilities with operational requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, autonomy, software, propulsion, and flight operations teams to drive seamless system integration and rapid development cycles.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in systems engineering for aerospace, defense, or autonomous aircraft systems.
  • Demonstrated experience defining system behavior logic and operational modes
  • Deep expertise in system architecture, avionics integration, and autonomy-driven flight systems.
  • Proficiency in MBSE, DOORS, SysML, CAMEO, or similar system modeling tools for complex systems design and analysis.
  • Experience with Group 4 or Group 5 UAS, military aircraft, or autonomous airborne platforms.
  • Strong background in flight testing, system integration, and performance validation.
  • Knowledge of DoD acquisition processes, MIL-STDs, FAA airworthiness certification, and airborne system safety standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex projects to successful completion.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with shifting priorities.
  • Worked on developmental program from clean sheet to first flight
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing AI-driven autonomy for unmanned aircraft.
  • Expertise in ISR, EW, and advanced sensor integration for airborne platforms.
  • Familiarity with modular open system architectures (MOSA) and Government Reference Architectures (GRA) for defense applications.
  • Prior experience working with defense primes, DoD stakeholders, or government R&D programs.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

title: Weekend Sign Installer - Salisbury, NC
description:
Artisan Direct is seeking an independent contractor to place and pick up temporary weekend signs in the Salisbury, NC area in the community Winecoff.

The contractor will be responsible for installing signs between Friday at 5:00 PM and Saturday at 10:00 AM. The same signs must be picked up between Sunday at 6:00 PM and Monday at 8:00 AM. The work may be performed at any time within those windows, as long as all signs are placed by Saturday at 10:00 AM and removed by Monday at 8:00 AM.

The signs are lightweight corrugated plastic, and are installed on wooden stakes. Artisan Direct provides the signs and stakes and provides replacement inventory as needed.

Job Duties:

  • Use Artisan Direct's mobile application to report installation and pickup of signs at specific locations
  • Install signs every weekend between Friday 5 PM and Saturday 10 AM
  • Pickup the same signs between Sunday 6 PM and Monday 8 AM
  • Store signs and extra stakes safely during the week
  • Submit a weekly invoice and order replacement inventory after completing pick up- using our website
Pay Information:
  • Starting compensation is $135 per weekend
  • Pay is issued via direct deposit every two weeks
  • $20.00 Signing bonus
  • $100.00 bonus after 4 weeks of completed work

Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license and current auto insurance
  • 18+ years old
  • Reliable vehicle with enough space to transport 30+ signs
  • A smartphone (Android or iPhone), roughly four years old or newer, capable of running our mobile app
  • Ability to lift and place signs and work outdoors
  • Ability to hammer stakes 6–8 inches into the ground during the first weekend only
  • Dependable and able to complete routes within the required time windows each weekend

Independent Contractor Notice

This is a 1099 independent contractor position. Contractors are not employees of Artisan Direct and are responsible for their own fuel, expenses, taxes and insurance. Contractors determine their own driving order, provide their own vehicle and mobile device, and complete the work within the placement and pickup windows provided. No benefits, minimum hours, or employment guarantees are offered. Contractors may accept or decline routes but must complete any route they commit to.

Additional Information

The starting pay is for the current work available in this location. As more work comes available our contractor support team will offer additional work to increase earnings. This role is a great fit for delivery and rideshare drivers, couriers, retirees, veterans, or anyone looking for flexible supplemental income. The work is straightforward, independent, and recurring each weekend. Contractors who enjoy driving, being outdoors, and working solo tend to enjoy this role and find it a dependable way to earn extra income on their own schedule.

title: Vision Software Engineer
description:
LMI Technologies, recognized as one of Canada’s Best Workplaces, is a medium-sized technology company built on a culture of openness, respect and professional excellence. At LMI our staff work passionately toward the common goal of designing and delivering innovative 3D machine vision solutions to OEMs and System Integrators working in industrial factory automation around the world. The result of this teamwork is high-performance, easy-to-implement and cost-effective 3D sensor technologies that deliver the best results in even the most challenging 3D inline inspection applications.

What will you do as a Vision Software Engineer?

You will apply your machine vision and data processing knowledge to create proof-of-concept, prototype or final 3D measurement tools and inspection applications. The successful candidate will have a proven ability to extract application requirements from customers and develop complete high-performance inspection applications using the company’s 3D smart sensor hardware and software tools - from measurement algorithms to an HMI interface.

This position is expected to be an intermediate level where independent skill and company knowledge are applied to meet well established project deliverables. The Vision Software Developer routinely applies their skills to design, develop, test, document, and deliver against requirements and specifications.


You will be reporting to Senior Vision Engineering Team Lead.

  • Develop algorithms to solve generic and specific inspection applications.
  • Meets tight delivery expectations against key project milestones.
  • Produces required technical reports and documentation.
  • Produces task lists to breakdown project assignments into appropriate level of detail.
  • Participates in regular design reviews and demonstrates strong adherence to checklist requirements.
  • Understands and utilizes the tools and processes defined by the group to effectively carry out project work.
  • Follows clearly established standards and guidelines as provided by the Team Leader.
  • Works closely with their team mitigating issues with solutions.
  • Travel and on-site customer visits required to assess sample parts, formulate solutions, and deliver prototype systems.
  • Proactively contributes to and implements continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Adheres to LMI Employee Policy Manual.

What do you need to be successful?

  • Bachelor of Computer Science or Computer Engineering degree or equivalent. Master degree in related fields is a strong plus.
  • 3+ years experience in software and algorithm design for real-time 2D or 3D inspection applications. Expertise in areas such as pre-processing, filtering, segmentation, feature extraction and measurement computation.
  • Proven knowledge of machine vision and image processing.
  • Strong C/C++ programming skills with a good mathematical background.
  • Knowledge of 3D and/or sensor design is a strong plus.
  • Knowledge of OpenCV, Cognex Vision Pro, Keyence, Halcon, Point Cloud Library (PCL), Matrox, etc.
  • Excellent problem solving skills applied to machine vision challenges.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills. Produces clearly written reports summarizing analytical results and proposing solutions to customers.
  • Solid interpersonal skills are required to function appropriately in a team or an independent environment and to build up good customer relationships.
  • A valid passport and the ability to travel domestically or internationally.

Why being inclusive is important to us?

At LMI Technologies, we are an Equal Opportunity employer and we value the diversity of the people we hire and serve. We strive to build and grow our team that fosters variety in backgrounds, perspectives, experiences and skills. We embrace inclusiveness in our workplace, so we can utilize each person’s talents and strengths.

If you are interested in working for a fast-growing global technology company with an inspiring and engaging workplace environment, we invite you to apply and talk about the possibilities of beginning a rewarding new chapter of your career.

We assure you, once you complete your application, your information is safe with us. To learn more about how we use your personal data, please review our Privacy Policy (https://lmi3d.com/privacy-policy).

title: Senior Infrastructure Architect
description:

Job description:

The Infrastructure Architect is responsible for designing and overseeing enterprise infrastructure solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role covers compute, storage, virtualization, networking, workplace infrastructure, identity, and core infrastructure services, ensuring that solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with the organization's technology strategy.

The Infrastructure Architect will work closely with application, security, network, workplace, and cloud teams, as well as business stakeholders and external vendors, to translate business and application requirements into robust infrastructure solutions.

Key ResponsibilitiesInfrastructure Architecture & Design

  • Design and develop enterprise infrastructure architectures across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

  • Define infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps.

  • Design solutions covering compute, storage, virtualization, backup, disaster recovery, identity, and core infrastructure services.

  • Ensure infrastructure solutions meet requirements for security, availability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.

  • Produce High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), architecture diagrams, and technical documentation.

  • Assess existing environments and identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for standardization and modernization.

  • Provide technical direction during infrastructure transformation, migration, and integration projects.

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Infrastructure - you don’t need to have experience with D365 for this role

  • Provide infrastructure architecture support for Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementations and rollouts.

  • Assess and define the infrastructure requirements and dependencies for D365 deployments.

  • Work with D365 application and functional teams to ensure infrastructure, identity, network, security, and integration requirements are understood and delivered.

  • Design connectivity between D365 services and on-premises, Azure, and other enterprise environments where required.

  • Support the definition of environments, connectivity, authentication, security, and integration requirements for D365.

  • Assess network latency, bandwidth, firewall, DNS, proxy, and identity dependencies that may impact D365 implementations.

  • Ensure infrastructure readiness ahead of D365 deployment and business go-live.

  • Support technical troubleshooting and resolution of infrastructure-related issues during D365 rollouts and hypercare.

  • Ensure D365 infrastructure requirements are incorporated into enterprise architecture standards and operational models.

Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure

  • Design and oversee hybrid infrastructure solutions across public cloud and on-premises environments.

  • Lead infrastructure design activities for Azure and other cloud platforms where applicable.

  • Define connectivity and integration between cloud and on-premises environments.

  • Evaluate cloud adoption, migration, and modernization opportunities.

  • Ensure cloud infrastructure follows enterprise security, governance, resilience, and cost-optimization principles.

Infrastructure Transformation & Migration

  • Provide architecture leadership for infrastructure migrations, consolidations, carve-outs, and M&A integration activities.

  • Assess existing infrastructure environments and develop transition and migration strategies.

  • Define target-state infrastructure architectures and migration roadmaps.

  • Identify technical dependencies, risks, and constraints affecting migration activities.

  • Work with project and transition teams to ensure infrastructure designs are successfully implemented.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with network, workplace, security, cloud, application, and service management teams.

  • Translate business and application requirements into practical infrastructure solutions.

  • Provide technical guidance to project managers, engineers, and implementation teams.

  • Communicate complex infrastructure concepts and risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Participate in architecture governance and design review processes.

Key Qualifications & ExperienceRequired Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in infrastructure architecture, engineering, or senior infrastructure roles.

  • Strong experience designing enterprise infrastructure solutions across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Proven experience across multiple infrastructure domains, including:

    • Compute and server infrastructure

    • Storage

    • Virtualization

    • Backup and disaster recovery

    • Identity and directory services

    • Networking and connectivity

    • Cloud infrastructure

    • Workplace/end-user infrastructure

  • Experience working on large-scale infrastructure transformation, migration, or integration projects.

  • Experience working in complex enterprise environments with multiple locations, business units, and technology platforms.

  • Experience producing architecture documentation, HLDs/LLDs, infrastructure assessments, and technical roadmaps.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure architecture and design principles.

  • Strong understanding of Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including Active Directory, Entra ID, DNS, DHCP, and Microsoft 365.

  • Experience with Azure infrastructure and hybrid cloud architectures.

  • Strong understanding of networking, security, and connectivity dependencies.

  • Knowledge of virtualization technologies such as VMware.

  • Knowledge of enterprise storage and backup technologies.

  • Understanding of disaster recovery and business continuity architectures.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code concepts.

  • Understanding of IT service management and operational requirements.

Preferred Certifications (optional)

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert

  • VMware certification

  • TOGAF or equivalent architecture certification

  • ITIL Foundation

  • Relevant cloud or infrastructure certifications

Key Competencies

  • Strong architectural and analytical mindset.

  • Ability to understand complex environments and identify dependencies and risks.

  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

  • Ability to balance technical requirements with business needs, cost, and delivery timelines.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to work across multiple technology domains and lead technical discussions.

  • Comfortable working in transformation, M&A, migration, and integration environments.

  • Ability to operate at both strategic and detailed technical levels.

title: Tilbudsberegner
description:
Komplekse projekttilbud – AI – Sydjylland

Vil du kombinere teknisk tilbudsarbejde, kundedialog og AI-understøttet tilbudsgivning i en branche med stor betydning for den grønne omstilling? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.


Jobbet

Med reference til CCO og med base i Brørup, bliver du en del af mere end bare en produktionsvirksomhed. Hos Aquagain Folding Smed A/S bliver gode idéer hurtigt omsat til handling. Du kommer tæt på kunderne, projekterne og de kolleger, der får løsningerne til at fungere i praksis.

Som tilbudsberegner får du en central rolle i at udarbejde konkurrencedygtige projekttilbud, ofte via udbudsportaler, primært til det danske og norske marked. Du skal kunne forstå kundens behov, omsætte teknisk viden til værdiskabende løsninger og skabe tillid gennem faglighed, ordentlighed og stærke relationer.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Udarbejde og følge op på komplekse projekttilbud.
  • Gennemgå udbudsmateriale, kravspecifikationer og teknisk dokumentation.
  • Indhente og evaluere tilbud fra leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Fastlægge tekniske løsninger i samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af organisationen.
  • Deltage i kundedialog, tilbudspræsentationer og kontraktforhandlinger.
  • Sikre en god overdragelse af solgte projekter til projektledelsen.
  • Bidrage til udvikling af salgs- og tilbudsprocesser – blandt andet med digitale værktøjer og AI.

Aquagain ser AI som et værktøj, der kan understøtte kvalitet, overblik og effektivitet i tilbudsarbejdet. Det kan for eksempel være til at strukturere udbudsmateriale, kvalitetssikre tilbudstekster, opsummere teknisk dokumentation eller skabe bedre overblik i en kompleks tilbudsproces.


Kvalifikationer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en teknisk baggrund som eksempelvis ingeniør, maskinmester, produktionsteknolog eller lignende kombineret med en solid erfaring med tilbud, teknisk projektsalg, procesanlæg, maskinsalg eller tilsvarende.

Du er vant til at arbejde med komplekse tekniske projekter, hvor økonomi, kvalitet, dokumentation, ressourcer og kundens behov skal gå op i en højere enhed. Du motiveres af at skabe gennemarbejdede tilbud, der kan omsættes til konkrete ordrer. Således evner du at kombinere teknisk og kommerciel forståelse.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Arbejder struktureret, analytisk og kvalitetsbevidst.
  • Har god teknisk, kommerciel og økonomisk forståelse.
  • Har erfaring med tilbudskalkulation på større tekniske projekter – gerne op til ca. DKK 100 mio.
  • Kan vurdere ressourcer, tidsplaner og projektgennemførelse.
  • Kan skabe tillid og langsigtede kunderelationer.
  • Har stærke IT-kompetencer og er nysgerrig på digitale værktøjer og AI.
  • Behersker dansk og engelsk på forhandlingsniveau.

Du behøver ikke være AI-specialist. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig på mulighederne og udviklingen af mere effektive arbejdsgange i salgsorganisationen.

Har du erfaring fra vand- og spildevandsbranchen, er det en klar fordel. Det samme gælder erfaring med AB18/ABT18, NS8405/NS8507, større projektkalkulationer eller AI-understøttet tilbudsgivning.


Du tilbydes

Du får en alsidig og fleksibel hverdag med stor frihed under ansvar. Din arbejdsdag vil være præget af spændende projekter, faglige udfordringer og tæt dialog med kunder, leverandører og kolleger. Du får stor indflydelse på både indholdet af dit arbejde og måden, du løser opgaverne på.

Hos Aquagain er fleksibilitet og frihed en tillidssag. Der er tillid til medarbejderne, og der fokuseres på resultater frem for kontrol.

Du lander i en ambitiøs og uformel virksomhed med korte beslutningsveje, høj faglighed og hjælpsomme kolleger. Ligeledes bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt og velfungerende team, hvor godt kollegaskab, samarbejde og arbejdsglæde er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Samtidig er der gode muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling i et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med højt til loftet, engagerede kolleger og plads til at være sig selv. Aquagain lægger vægt på trivsel, udvikling og stærkt samarbejde kombineret med ordnede forhold og en attraktiv hverdag.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår står i forhold til de stillede krav.


Virksomheden

erwin andersen a/s søger for Aquagain Folding Smed A/S, som er en seriøs nordisk teknologipartner med stærke faglige rødder. Virksomheden har eksisteret i 70 år og udvikler, producerer, monterer og servicerer tekniske løsninger til vand- og spildevandsbranchen – primært i Danmark og Norge. Kunderne vælger Aquagain, fordi virksomheden kan kombinere specialiseret viden, praktisk erfaring og en løsningsorienteret tilgang til komplekse projekter.


Ansøg

Har du de rette kompetencer og en solid motivation for denne opgave, skal du mærke din ansøgning og dit detaljerede CV stillingsnummer ”02.09.80” og uploade den her på siden.

Du behøver ikke komme med en lang titel i bagagen. Kan du se dig selv i rollen, og har du teknisk forståelse, struktur og lyst til at arbejde med komplekse tilbud, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

Al henvendelse bliver naturligvis behandlet fortroligt.

Vi har ikke ansøgningsfrist på vores stillingsannoncer, idet vi indkalder kandidater successivt under rekrutteringsforløbet.

Bemærk: Jobannoncen genindrykkes løbende på diverse jobportaler. Dette er ikke et udtryk for, at rekrutteringsprocessen er startet forfra.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Assistant Vice President of Programs and Delivery
description:
Position Summary

The Assistant Vice President of Programs & Delivery serves as the Vice President’s operational deputy and Chief of Staff for the Programs & Delivery organization. This role ensures that VP priorities are translated into action, executive decisions are followed through, portfolio risks and commitments are tracked, and cross-functional support moves efficiently across the company.

Primary Mission

Serve as the VP’s Chief of Staff and operational deputy, ensuring execution across the portfolio while driving cross-functional coordination.

Key Responsibilities

VP Execution Support

  • Translate VP priorities into clear action plans and coordinated execution.
  • Drive follow-through on executive decisions and monitor completion of commitments.
  • Track strategic initiatives, milestones, risks, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate deliverables for executive meetings and prepare briefing materials and portfolio analyses.
  • Ensure the VP has timely, accurate information needed for portfolio-level decisions.

Program & Contract Support

  • Partner with Program Managers and Program Directors on staffing challenges and recruitment needs.
  • Support coordination around performance concerns and related documentation.
  • Assist with contract modifications, surge support requirements, risk-mitigation plans, program startups, and transitions.
  • Help resolve execution barriers that cross functional or program boundaries.
  • Escalate material financial, contractual, customer, or organizational issues to the VP as appropriate.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the primary Programs & Delivery liaison to People Operations, Finance, Contracts & Compliance, Growth, Recruiting, and IT.
  • Ensure support requests move efficiently across departments and do not stall between functions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional owners, deadlines, and follow-up for delivery-related issues.
  • Help clarify priorities when multiple programs compete for shared resources.

Shared Services & Portfolio Projects

  • Own or coordinate initiatives that impact multiple contracts, including recruiting campaigns and resource-sharing models.
  • Lead quality-improvement initiatives, training programs, SOP development, and lessons-learned efforts.
  • Support workforce planning and reporting standardization across the portfolio.
  • Drive consistency in operating practices while allowing appropriate flexibility for contract-specific requirements.

Personnel Engagement

  • Support Program Directors and Program Managers with coaching and staffing plans.
  • Coordinate employee-relations matters with People Operations and appropriate program leadership.
  • Support retention efforts, succession planning, and performance documentation.
  • Help leaders prepare for difficult performance or staffing conversations and ensure agreed actions are executed.
  • The AVP does not own final performance decisions but coordinates and supports their execution.

Operational Governance

  • Run portfolio review meetings and ensure the right information is available for decision-making.
  • Track portfolio risks, action items, and delivery commitments.
  • Maintain executive dashboards and portfolio reporting.
  • Follow up on open commitments and ensure responsible owners complete agreed actions.
  • Promote consistency across contracts and identify recurring operational issues that require broader solutions.

Qualifications

Required

  • Progressive leadership experience in program delivery, operations, PMO, or portfolio management, preferably in government contracting.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple programs, leaders, and functional stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of staffing, recruiting, performance management coordination, risk management, and program transitions.
  • Experience preparing executive briefings, dashboards, analyses, and decision-support materials.
  • Strong organizational discipline and proven ability to drive follow-through across teams.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Sound judgment regarding when to resolve issues directly and when to escalate to executive leadership.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting federal healthcare, health and human services, CMS, HHS, or related government programs.
  • Experience with portfolio reviews, PMO operations, shared-services initiatives, or cross-functional transformation efforts.
  • Experience supporting recruiting campaigns, workforce planning, quality improvement, SOP development, and reporting standardization.

Leadership Characteristics

  • Execution oriented - turns priorities and decisions into clear actions and measurable follow-through.
  • Highly organized - can manage multiple workstreams without losing visibility into risks or commitments.
  • Collaborative - works effectively across Programs & Delivery and corporate shared services.
  • Practical and solutions focused - removes barriers and keeps work moving.
  • Comfortable operating as a deputy - exercises independent judgment while keeping the VP appropriately informed.

Alignment with J29 Core Values

  • Employee Centric - Support leaders and employees with clarity, responsiveness, and appropriate coordination.
  • One J29 - Break down silos and make sure shared-service functions and programs work together effectively.
  • Mission Inspired - Keep delivery commitments and customer impact at the center of execution.
  • Not Bound by Convention - Improve processes, standardize where helpful, and challenge inefficient ways of working.

Measures of Success

  • VP priorities and executive decisions are consistently translated into completed actions.
  • Portfolio risks, staffing needs, and delivery commitments are visible and actively managed.
  • Cross-functional support requests move efficiently and have clear owners and deadlines.
  • Portfolio reviews, dashboards, and executive reporting are timely, accurate, and decision useful.
  • Program Directors and Program Managers receive effective operational support without unnecessary escalation.
  • Improved consistency in SOPs, reporting, training, quality practices, and workforce planning across contracts.

title: Facilities Maintenance - Closing September 30, 2026
description:
Port Hope is a uniquely attractive place to work, highlighted by the potential future development of the world's largest nuclear plant, which promises cutting-edge infrastructure and economic stability. This potential diversification into nuclear energy complements the area's strong economic base in agriculture and manufacturing, securing a stable job market. Employees will engage with advanced technology and industry experts, enhancing professional development. The community's warmth promotes work-life balance, supported by cultural festivals and heritage sites. Proximity to Toronto/GTA provides urban access, while the area's natural beauty invites outdoor recreation. High-quality education and healthcare, low crime rates, and a commitment to environmental sustainability make Port Hope an exceptional place to live and work, fostering both professional and personal growth.

Part Time Facilities Maintenance is responsible to clean and maintain various recreational facilities for the department of Parks, Recreation and Culture and perform Facilities Operator duties as required. They are responsible to address and respond to inquiries from staff, the public and facility users and to ensure compliance with health and safety requirements in all aspects of their work.

This position is specifically for night-shift cleaning. The successful candidate must be available and willing to work overnight hours, with shifts typically scheduled outside regular daytime operations. Flexibility to work evenings, nights, weekends, and statutory holidays may be required to meet operational needs.

Benefits and Perks
  • Optional OMERS Pension Plan from the date of hire
  • Work-life Balance Initiatives
  • Wellness, Social and Staff Ambassador Committees
  • Employee and Family Assistance Plan
  • Perks and Savings Partnerships

Compensation

$20.82 per hour, eligible for annual wage step increase and minimum wage adjustments.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma required; specialized courses in custodial or building maintenance programs would be an asset.
  • Training in Emergency Procedures, First Aid, WHMIS and/or willingness to attain training on the job.
  • Ontario Recreation Facilities Association arena/pool/building related courses or equivalent would be an asset.
  • One (1) to two (2) year experience in a related position.
Working Conditions
  • Primarily works indoors. Work in varied temperatures from cold in the arena in the winter season to warm temperatures in the pool area may occur on a less frequent basis.
  • Exposure to hazardous chemicals and fumes.
  • Required to push, pull and lift heavy objects on a regular basis.
  • Variety of walking, sitting and standing required.
Responsibilities
  • Provide daily general housekeeping duties for all facilities including but not limited to: sweeping and mopping of floors; cleaning of washrooms and change rooms (toilets, sinks, urinals, showers, mirrors); vacuuming; cleaning of walls and glass; taking out garbage; cleaning kitchen facilities and offices.
  • Responsible to maintain an inventory of cleaning supplies and maintenance related items i.e. tools, for facilities under their care. Advise the Supervisor, Facilities of required supplies in a timely manner to address operational needs.
  • Provide periodic cleaning services for all facilities, including but not limited to: cleaning the air ducts; cleaning the grease trap; stripping and waxing floors; minor drywall repairs; painting; exterior building cleaning (siding, eavestrough); cleaning and replacing light lenses; cleaning ovens/stoves and exterior windows; and carpet shampooing.
  • Perform building maintenance duties for all facilities, including but not limited to: basic carpentry; changing light bulbs; minor repairs and building related requests; repair ceiling tiles; minor plumbing repairs; shovel snow from sidewalks, entrances and exits and salt as required.
  • Perform the duties of the Facilities Operator on an ‘as needed’ basis including but not limited to: ice resurfacing; recording compressor checks; skate sharpening services; responding to customer inquiries and concerns; and pool maintenance.
  • Receive and respond to inquiries from the public and users of the facilities and assist with resolution of the query or direct them accordingly.
  • Comply with all Health and Safety regulations, procedures and security measures while undertaking their duties and ensure the public are aware of guidelines where infractions are observed or as required to follow emergency procedures.
  • Clean the department vehicle and advise the Supervisor, Facilities of any maintenance requirements and complete the vehicle inspection checklist daily.
  • Open and secure facilities as required for public access. Prepare facilities for programs or special events including setup and taking down of tables and chairs on an ‘as needed’ basis.
  • Read the communications log daily at each facility and for specific daily directions/requests and perform same. Log and record all custodial and maintenance activities completed at each facility and advise Supervisor, Facilities of any deficiencies requiring attention.
  • Adhere to high standards of ethical behaviour and demonstrate their understanding that their personal actions impact the public’s perception of the Municipality.

Submit an Application

Please submit your cover letter and resume online at Careers - Municipality of Port Hope by September 30, 2026. Interviews may be scheduled in advance of the closing date. We are hiring for approximately 2-3 vacancies.

Recruitment Process

The Municipality of Port Hope is a progressive employer who believes a diverse and inclusive workplace strengthens the team and fosters an environment where everyone feels as though they belong and their dignity, beliefs and identity are respected.

We are committed to creating and sustaining an environment that provides a supportive workplace and equal opportunity for all employees. Accommodations can be requested throughout the recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act.

Applications will be reviewed, and interviews may be scheduled prior to the job posting closing date. All applicants will receive an automated email confirming the submission of their application, but only those candidates selected for an interview will be further contacted by Human Resources.

Personal information is collected under the authority of the Municipal Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act and the Municipal Act, as amended.

title: Catalyst Organizer
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

As a Catalyst Organizer, you will (1) support the start-up, launch, and/or development of an active community park group in up to 4 community park sites, and (2) support the leadership development of local partners as ongoing, sustainable green space stewards. Through asset mapping and onsite/neighborhood outreach, events, and other activations, the Organizer will identify stakeholders interested in caring for their park and community, facilitate communication and collaboration among interested partners, support the leadership development of local partners as programmers and stewards of their parks, and guide the group as they develop into an independent, sustainable “Friends of” group. Typical project timelines for our work as we support and help groups develop is 18 - 30 months.

The Catalyst Organizer will be required to conduct in-person work in Manhattan and other boroughs as directed, in parks, community settings, and NYC Parks offices. Ability to work on location in Manhattan and other boroughs as needed on weekdays, nights, and weekends is required.

COMPENSATION: $50 - 60,000 per year

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Outreach & Facilitation
    • Develop a thorough understanding of assigned Catalyst parks and local issues, demographics and opportunities
    • Conduct onsite/neighborhood outreach to identify stakeholders interested in caring for their park and community
    • Conduct outreach, canvassing, flyering and door knocking in the park and surrounding neighborhood
    • Coordinate and facilitate public & community group meetings
    • Facilitate communication and collaboration among interested partners
  • Relationship Building
    • Build consistent, effective, and collaborative relationships with key stakeholder groups, starting with these core groups: Community members/partners; Partnerships for Parks team members; and City Parks Foundation and NYC Parks agency staff members.
    • Build community connections to Partnerships for Parks and other hands-on park projects, events, skill building, and engagement opportunities
    • Connect and leverage local and regional resources to support and amplify community partner efforts
    • Serve as a visible, in-community and park presence, acting as an effective liaison between community partners and NYC Parks, CPF and other organizations, mindful of the needs and interests all all parties
  • Programming & Events
    • Encourage and support community members with planning and execution of stewardship events in the park including It’s My Parks clean-ups and plantings
    • Support community members with planning community events like health fairs, mutual aid, yoga classes, and art classes that reflect their vision of thriving activity for the park and neighborhood.
  • Leadership Development, Group Development & Coaching
    • Support the leadership development of local partners as ongoing, sustainable park and waterfront stewards
    • Conduct ongoing coaching for partners in alignment with Catalyst goals
  • Data & Reporting
    • Track Catalyst work in database - maintain individual and organizational records, input outcomes and other important details as determined by the Catalyst Director and develop internal and external reports as needed
  • Program Strategy
    • Participate in work plan development and strategic planning
    • Work closely with Catalyst Director and CPF fundraising team to inform fundraising plans and reporting
    • Support ongoing Partnerships for Parks/City Parks Foundation/NYC Parks initiatives as needed, working collaboratively and effectively as needed. Tasks and assignments will come from all three areas of our organization. Catalyst team members are accountable to and receive direction/assignments from each area of our public/private program

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Motivated, resourceful, and creative self-starter with a passion for sustainable community engagement who is confident working both individually and as part of a team
  • Experienced in community organizing, coalition-building, public service/administration, and/or programming - degree in related field helpful and preferred, but not required
  • Experienced in outreach, flyering, and / or door knocking
  • Experienced in planning community-led events and/or collaborative projects that feature multiple stakeholders and interests
  • Experienced with qualitative and quantitative data collection
  • Demonstrable ability to work with diverse constituencies
  • Strong public speaking, writing, and listening skills
  • Comfort and facility with office software and Google apps
  • Responsible, detail-oriented, and strong project management skills
  • Adaptable and flexible
  • Understanding and ability to effectively represent and advance NYC government programs and policies. Clarity at all times we are working with and at the behest of NYC Parks and NYC government
  • Catalyst is traditionally a place-based, on-the-ground engagement effort and requires:
    • Willingness and ability to consistently engage with stakeholders through in-person and digital engagements, including frequent travel around NYC and regular, on-site work.
    • Flexibility to work significant hours during evenings and weekends in addition to regular business hours
  • Physical ability to lift up to 40lbs and participate in physical activities required in the job. This includes the ability to provide direct support in leading stewardship, landscaping and beautification projects in parks plus a range of community and park events, including transporting, setup and breakdown of event materials
  • Driver’s license required
  • Bi or multilingual strongly preferred

ABOUT CITY PARKS FOUNDATION

At City Parks Foundation (CPF), we are dedicated to invigorating and transforming New York City parks into dynamic, vibrant centers of urban life through arts, environmental education, sports, and community building programs for all New Yorkers. Our ethos is simple: we believe thriving parks mean thriving communities.

Community engagement includes Partnerships for Parks, a public-private program of City Parks Foundation and NYC Parks, which supports and champions a growing network of community leaders who care and advocate for the transformation of our neighborhood parks and the Parks and Open Space Partners-NYC coalition of conservancies and alliances. We also administer the NYC Green Fund, a regranting program for parks and open space nonprofits and grassroots organizations.

We produce SummerStage, the iconic free, outdoor performing arts festival in NYC, presenting world-class artists from across the globe and our own neighborhoods on our mainstage in Central Park and in local parks in all five boroughs, and our Swedish Cottage Marionette Theatre and roving PuppetMobile present marionette puppet theater throughout New York City.

We connect youngsters to nature in the urban environment through progressive, experiential teaching. Using parks as classrooms, we provide learning experiences and hands-on activities in urban forests, coastal areas, and gardens.

Free golf, tennis, track & field, soccer, and fitness programs bring high-quality instruction and equipment into areas where few organized athletic opportunities exist. We offer leveled training, year-round scholarship coaching, and special pro events.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. City Parks Foundation does not offer visa sponsorship.

title: Last Mile  Senior Hub Coordinator ( Madinaty  )
description:
About Bosta:
Launched in 2017, Bosta is an overnight delivery provider for E-commerce companies in Egypt. Leveraging technology to empower businesses is what we do best. Our goal is to disrupt the logistics industry by bringing technology and experience all together to provide a one-stop-shop for delivery solutions.
We rely on advanced technology to deliver orders to our customers in a fast way. Businesses can track and connect with couriers and follow up on their orders - all in one system.
About The Role :
Responsible for managing daily hub operations, coordinating shipments, tracking KPIs, and ensuring smooth workflow and service quality in line with Bosta’s standards.
Job Code :
Incremental 2026OPER-012

Job Responsibilities

  • 1. Receive the new pickups closed in bosta flyers.
  • 2. Ensure that the tracking number was written correctly on the flyer with the marker by the couriers.
  • 3. Receive the shipments(new pickups) on the system and add the tracking numbers on the “Receiving Pickups” sheet.
  • 4. Arrange day-to-day dispatch of the shipments and sort shipments based on delivery addresses.
  • 5. Add the cash collection and Refund shipments to the courier’s routes. Send the routes directly to the stars’ App.
  • 6. Receive the undelivered shipments on the system and the productivity sheet as well.
  • 7. Get the receiver’s signature and IDs# on delivered shipments with Zero Cod.
  • 8. Get hard copies of returned shipments signed by the business.
  • 9. Monitor the Stars Wallets and ensure that they are depositing the same collected CODs amount on a daily basis.
  • 10. Make a verification call on the undelivered shipments or” Canceled” shipments on a daily basis.
  • 11. Cancel the refused shipments on the system.
  • 12. Transfer the canceled orders after exceeding holding period at the hub”24 hours” to sorting facility team through” Transfer to Hub”
  • 13. Send handover mails to the sorting facility team including the total number of transferred shipments, seal number and the tracking numbers subject with the status of the shipments.
  • 14. Performs related duties as required.

Job Qualifications

  • - 6 months to 1 year of experience in logistics field, in e-commerce or shipping industry.
  • - Only graduates are eligible for this role.

title: Infrastructure & Capital Projects - Construction Scheduler, ANS
description:
You’ve Never Been Satisfied with "Good Enough."
You want to make an impact, not just manage projects, but change how the world gets built. At Accenture Infrastructure & Capital Projects, you’ll do exactly that. You’ll help develop and deliver the factories, grids, transit systems, and public infrastructure that keep communities moving - and do it smarter, safer, and more sustainably than ever before.
You’ll work alongside people who think big and act bold - project managers, engineers, technologists, and strategists who blend real-world experience with digital innovation and AI. Together, we’re transforming how capital projects are planned, managed, and executed, creating a better way to build for the future.
Because “good enough” builds the past. You’re here to build what’s next, on a team that outperforms every norm.
Visit us here to learn more about ​Accenture Infrastructure & Capital Projects
As Accenture continues to grow, you may see a variety of new career opportunities, and depending on the role and location you may be directed to apply through Accenture Infrastructure and Capital Projects LLP or one of our other legal entities - Accenture Infrastructure and Capital Projects, LLC or Accenture Infrastructure and Capital Projects Inc., with benefits varying by country and role, so please check with your recruiter for details.

THE WORK:

  • You'll lead integrated planning and scheduling support for large-scale data center construction projects.
  • You'll develop, maintain, and improve detailed schedules, milestone tracking, dependencies, resource assumptions, and schedule reporting outputs.
  • You'll apply Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling techniques to assess schedule logic, identify trends, communicate risks, and recommend mitigation and recovery strategies.
  • You'll partner with client teams, project stakeholders, delivery partners, contractors, and consultants to align planning outputs with project execution needs.
  • You'll manage multiple project schedules simultaneously, maintaining accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting.
  • You'll coordinate schedule inputs across project controls, cost management, risk management, change management, and project delivery teams.
  • You'll evaluate schedule performance, identify delivery gaps, dependencies, and emerging issues, and drive corrective actions.
  • You'll prepare clear schedule updates, executive-level dashboards, governance materials, and leadership-ready reporting tailored to the audience.
  • You'll support integrated project controls activities by linking schedule performance to cost, risk, and change impacts.
  • You'll facilitate planning workshops, schedule reviews, and stakeholder alignment sessions to drive project success.
  • You'll escalate schedule risks, critical path concerns, and execution blockers while driving accountable resolution.
    • Flexible: The work location for this role will include a mix of working remotely, onsite at a client or in an Accenture office or center.

    With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning, and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • 7+ years of expert-level planning and scheduling experience using Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project.
  • Experience supporting design and construction project management for medium-to-large capital programs.
  • Background planning capital projects in the $500M to $2B+ range, preferably within data center construction or similar process-intensive industries.
  • Strong knowledge of Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling, schedule health analysis, schedule risk analysis, and schedule recovery planning.
  • Ability to analyze EPC plans and schedules, identify trends, assess impacts, and clearly communicate mitigation strategies.
  • Experience supporting integrated project controls functions, including cost, risk, change management, governance, and reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to self-direct, solve problems, and operate effectively in a fast-paced project environment.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to present detailed schedule data in concise leadership-ready summaries.
  • Experience coordinating stakeholders across project teams, contractors, consultants, and client organizations.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

  • Data center design and construction delivery experience.
  • Schedule risk analysis experience and familiarity with related planning and risk management tools.
  • Experience supporting executive reporting, recovery planning, or schedule governance in complex capital programs.
  • Experience developing integrated project controls reporting that connects schedule, cost, risk, and change performance.
  • Experience facilitating schedule workshops, forensic schedule reviews, or critical path assessments on large-scale construction programs.
  • Knowledge of Power BI, Primavera Analytics, or other schedule visualization and reporting platforms.
