title: Data Engineer
description:
Get to Know Us:
CG Infinity, Inc. is a technology consulting firm that was founded in 1998. We offer solutions that are tailored to the needs of each individual client that we work with instead of offering standard, run-of-the-mill solutions to everyone. We work closely with our clients throughout the entire process and offer solutions for a myriad of challenges.

Our Culture:
Our people-first approach to technology offers best-in-class service and customer success rates. Here are some of the main services that we offer at CG Infinity: Salesforce Implementations, Customer Experience & CRM, Application Development & Integration, Production Support & QA, and Data Analytics & AI.

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Design and develop the solution architecture for cloud data-enabled solutions and analytical platforms.
  • Research, analyze, and recommend technical approaches for solving our clients' complex data-related development and integration problems.
  • Engage effectively with client stakeholders and delivery teams to align technical solutions to the desired client outcomes.
  • Assist in designing multi-phased cloud data strategies, including crafting multi-phased implementation roadmaps.
  • Design and develop scalable data ingestion frameworks to transform a variety of datasets.
  • Gather technical requirements, assess client capabilities, and analyze findings to provide appropriate cloud solution recommendations and adoption strategy.
  • Deeply involved in designing and deploying end-to-end solutions with a cloud platform’s analytic services.
  • Conduct and participate in white-boarding sessions, workshops, and project meetings in support of data-enabled solutions.
  • Design & develop data models in support of BI/Analytics solutions.

Qualifications:
  • 2 to 6+ years of data engineering and/or data warehousing experience.
  • Oil & Gas or Retail Energy industry experience highly preferred.
  • Experience building cloud data solutions (Azure, AWS, GCP, Snowflake) and migrating from on-prem to cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with big data application development and/or with cloud data warehousing (e.g., Spark, Redshift, Snowflake, Azure SQL DW, Big Query)
  • Hands-on experience with BI solutions (e.g., PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, or other format for reporting)
  • Experience implementing a variety of data warehousing concepts, methodologies, & best practices (e.g., Incremental, SCD, Star Schema, etc.)
  • Proficient in a relevant programming language for cloud platform e.g., Python/Java/C#/Unix as well as SQL
  • Working experience with version control platforms e.g., Git
  • Strong communication skills and a working knowledge of agile development, including DevOps concepts.

What Can We Offer You?
CG Infinity, Inc. offers an exceptionally strong benefits package that compares favorably with those offered by Fortune 500 companies. CG Infinity, Inc. has teamed with a highly regarded ASO to ensure a great choice for our benefits package. CG Infinity, Inc. employees have the flexibility to select benefits based on such factors as their personal preference, family situation, and financial objectives, along with our voluntary packages, such as additional Life as well as FSAs.

CG Infinity, Inc. also offers an excellent Safe Harbor 401k plan. Upon eligibility, CG Infinity, Inc. contributes an employer match of 100% of the first three percent and 50% of the fourth and fifth percent. All employees enrolled in the 401k retirement plan are 100% vested immediately.

title: Delprojektledare / Projektstöd inom HR, Lärande & Säljutveckling
description:
Vill du ta en central roll i ett spännande utvecklingsprojekt inom finans- och försäkringsbranschens ? Vi söker nu en engagerad och strukturerad konsult som vill agera projektledarens "högra hand" i uppbyggnaden av en ny Sälj- & Affärsakademi.

Om tjänsten

För kunds räkning söker vi nu en senior delprojektledare / projektstöd till ett omfattande och strategiskt förändringsprojekt. Vår kund är en stor och väletablerad aktör inom bank, pension och försäkring med stark lokal förankring i hela Sverige.

Projektet syftar till att etablera en ny gemensam Sälj- & Affärsakademi för att driva kompetensutveckling och transformera säljorganisationen mot ökad affärsnytta. Initiativet har ett starkt fokus på HR, lärande och pedagogik och innebär en viktig förankringsresa gentemot lokala bolag och intressenter.

Som projektstöd arbetar du mycket nära projektledaren under den avgörande slutfasen av förstudiearbetet samt den kommande paketeringen. Du blir en nyckelperson i att konkretisera plattform, kostnader och upplägg inför kommande beslut samt säkerställa att konceptet tas emot väl i organisationen.

Praktisk information:

  • Omfattning: Heltid (konsultuppdrag)
  • Start: Omgående / Enligt överenskommelse
  • Varaktighet: Inledningsvis till årsskiftet, med goda möjligheter till förlängning i nästa projektfas
  • Placering: Stockholm (arbete på plats hos kunden)

Arbetsuppgifter

I denna roll ingår du i en proaktiv arbetsgrupp där du har ett nära samarbete med interna intressenter, externa utbildningsleverantörer och lokala bolagsrepresentanter.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

  • Projektstöd & Beslutsunderlag: Stötta projektledaren i att ta fram, paketera och kvalitetssäkra besluts- och presentationsunderlag inför ledningsgrupper, styrgrupper och VD-samråd.
  • Koordinering & Samordning: Samordna insatser från arbetsgruppen, konsulter och externa utbildningsbolag.
  • Möten & Workshops: Förbereda, planera, underlätta och följa upp workshops samt intressentdialoger.
  • Utbildning & Plattform: Bidra till framtagandet av struktur och innehåll för utbildningsinsatser samt förståelse för digitala lärplattformar.
  • Uppföljning & Förankring: Skapa struktur och uppföljningsmodeller anpassade efter bolagens behov, samt aktivt bidra till förankrings- och förändringsarbetet.

Vi söker dig som har

  • Flerårig erfarenhet som delprojektledare eller senior projektstöd/projektkoordinator i större organisationer.
  • Bakgrund eller stark förståelse inom HR, lärande, pedagogik eller kompetensutveckling.
  • God förståelse för säljorganisationer och vad som driver affärsmässighet och förändrade beteenden hos säljare.
  • Dokumenterad vana av att skapa pedagogiska, professionella och välpaketerade besluts- och presentationsunderlag för styrgrupper och ledningsfora.
  • Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga i svensk skrift och tal.

Det är meriterande om du har

  • Erfarenhet av arbete inom försäkrings-, bank- eller finansiell sektor (gärna inom Länsförsäkringsgruppen eller liknande federativa/medlemsägda organisationer).
  • Erfarenhet från säljutveckling, affärsutveckling eller förändringsledning.
  • Erfarenhet av samarbete med och kravställning mot externa utbildningsleverantörer.

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som har en stark proaktivitet, struktur och energi. Du trivs i en konsultroll där du snabbt sätter dig in i komplexa sammanhang och tar ägandeskap över leveranser.

Som person är du:

  • Kommunikativ & Pedagogisk: Du kan förklara och paketera komplexa budskap på ett enkelt och säljande sätt.
  • Samarbetsorienterad & Relationsbyggande: Du har lätt för att skapa förtroende och dialog med olika typer av intressenter – från externa leverantörer till lokala bolagschefer.
  • Flexibel & Lösningsfokuserad: Du hanterar ändrade förutsättningar med ett positivt förhållningssätt och drivs av att skapa framåtdrift.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Fleet Laboratories
Data Analyst
Lynchburg, VA

About Fleet Laboratories
For over 150 years, Fleet Laboratories' success has come from adapting to a changing world with creative thinking and innovative product development. We've grown into a global leader of over 100 personal health and beauty products. As the world keeps evolving, so will we — with unique new technologies and products that help our customers look and feel their best.
At Fleet Laboratories, the future is bright and our commitment to quality and innovation has never been stronger. Working here at our location in Lynchburg, VA, you will feel part of a team that works together to meet our consumer needs.

Occupational Summary
The Data Analyst is responsible for interpreting data, analyzing results, and providing actionable insights to drive informed decision-making and generate process improvements across the business. Performance of duties has an impact on regulatory compliance.

Accountabilities
  • Accountable for managing all routine and ad hoc reports that drive regulatory, quality and marketing decisions.
  • Accountable for signal detection and analysis that drive product safety decisions as related to risk management, risk minimization and risk/benefit analysis.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment in evaluating situations and in making decisions.
  • Supports audits and inspections by providing immediate data as requested.
  • Works closely with stakeholders to understand data needs, develop analytical solutions, and present findings in a clear and concise manner.
  • Staying abreast of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in data analytics.
Responsibilities
  • Provides regular reports and ad hoc reports on a timely basis with a high level of accuracy.
  • Develops and implements necessary queries that produce accurate and reproducible results.
  • Supports Medical Writing by providing accurate line listings for PSURs, PADERs and other safety reports; analyzes the line listings for trends and potential signals.
  • Gatekeeper for all data.
  • Perform User Acceptance Tests for system implementation and upgrades.
  • Performs exploratory data analysis to uncover trends, patterns, and anomalies.
  • Validate data accuracy, completeness, and integrity.
  • Identify and address data quality issues and discrepancies.
  • Extraction and transformation of data from various sources.
  • Perform other duties as required.
Qualifications
  • BA/BS degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficient experience/understanding of Microsoft Office Systems with advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience in data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g., SQL, Python, etc.).
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
  • Experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or related roles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of relational databases is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
Accountability
Sr. Manager, Medical Affairs Systems and PV/Data Teams

What We Offer
Here at Fleet, you can have a good job that can grow into a great career.
  • The start of a great career working with a diverse group of great people.
  • The health and safety of every employee... our top priority.
  • A clean, air-conditioned cGMP environment.
  • Top notch benefits — paid time off, 401(K) retirement savings with company match, medical, dental and vision, pay annual targeted bonus, competitive pay, life insurance, flexible spending account, and tuition reimbursement.
  • Stability — a record of strong financial performance and part of a growing $1 billion company.
  • A business supporting the Lynchburg community for over 150 years.
No Sponsorship: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation Range: $58,757 – $76,000

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Location: Quanah, TX (rotational and local candidates considered)

Department: DEPCON

The Opportunity

As a Senior Project Manager, you will spearhead high-impact commercial data center construction projects from inception to completion, ensuring alignment with our clients’ strategic goals, timeline, and budget. This role requires a deep blend of leadership, strategic thinking, and hands-on project management to drive operational success and foster collaboration among stakeholders.

What you will do?

  • Develop and manage detailed project schedules using scheduling software Primavera P6.

  • Collaborate with project managers, product managers, subcontractors, and stakeholders to create and manage project workflow.

  • Analyze project progress and identify any potential delays or issues, recommending solutions to maintain project schedules.

  • Conduct regular status meetings to monitor project timelines and update stakeholders on progress.

  • Prepare reports to communicate project scheduling status to management and team members.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, industry standards, and project specifications in all scheduling processes.

  • Coordinate with procurement and resource management to ensure timely availability of materials and labor.

  • Continuously evaluate scheduling processes and implement improvements for efficiency.

  • Act as the main point of contact for scheduling-related inquiries and concerns.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree four-year college or university; or 10+ years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Proven experience as a construction scheduler or in a similar role within the construction industry.

  • Strong knowledge of construction processes, project management principles, and scheduling techniques.

  • Proficient in scheduling software (e.g., Primavera, MS Project) and Microsoft Office Suite.

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

How we support you

We believe your best work happens when you feel supported - professionally, personally, and financially. That’s why we offer a range of benefits designed to help you thrive, stay healthy, and plan for the future.

  • Performance-driven rewards – Competitive pay with incentive opportunities that recognize your results and contributions.
  • Comprehensive healthcare – Medical, dental, and vision coverage that supports you and your family’s total well-being.
  • Security and peace of mind – Life and disability insurance programs that provide protection when it matters most.
  • Flexible benefits options – A variety of voluntary benefits so you can personalize coverage to fit your needs.
  • Time to recharge – Generous paid time off to relax, travel, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • Investing in your growth – Education assistance and tuition support to help you build skills and advance your career.
  • Planning for the future – Retirement and savings programs that help you achieve long-term financial confidence.

Come build with us

At Integra, we’re driven by a vision to transform the data center industry. We specialize in delivering optimized turnkey solutions that bring together speed, quality, and reliability - helping our clients build and operate the mission-critical infrastructure that powers today’s digital world. Integra is a vertically integrated company - owning and managing every phase of the process from site selection and design to manufacturing, procurement, commissioning, and warranty. This approach allows us to move faster, solve challenges more efficiently, and deliver exceptional outcomes for our partners.

What truly sets Integra apart is our people. We are a team of problem-solvers, engineers, builders, and operators who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering results. Our culture values collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement - because in a rapidly evolving digital landscape, excellence and adaptability matter.

Joining Integra means being part of a company that is shaping the future of data center infrastructure. If you’re passionate about innovation, impact, and building systems the world depends on, you’ll find the opportunity to grow and make a difference here.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Integra provides equal employment opportunities for all people. No employee or applicant for employment will be discriminated against because of race, creed, origin, marital status, sexual orientation, age, otherwise qualified disabled or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. If you are a qualified applicant who requires reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact talent_acquisition@integra.com

title: Compensation Analyst
description:
The Compensation Analyst plays a critical role in advancing OCHIN's compensation philosophy by providing market intelligence, compensation analysis, workforce insights, and data-driven recommendations that support equitable and competitive pay practices. This position administers compensation programs, conduct market benchmarking, support compensation planning, and ensure compliance with applicable regulations and organizational policies.The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and passionate about using data to drive informed compensation decisions that support talent attraction, retention, internal equity, and organizational growth.

Essential Functions:


Compensation Program Administration

  • Administer and maintain compensation programs, salary structures, pay ranges, and job evaluation processes.
  • Support annual compensation planning activities, including merit, market, and promotional increase reviews.
  • Partner with leaders to evaluate compensation recommendations and ensure alignment with compensation philosophy and budget guidelines.
  • Assist with spot awards, bonus program administration, and other recognition programs.

Market Analysis & Benchmarking

  • Conduct market pricing and benchmarking using compensation surveys and external labor market data.
  • Analyze market competitiveness and provide recommendations regarding pay positioning.
  • Support development and maintenance of salary ranges and compensation structures.

Compliance & Governance

  • Support compliance with federal, state, and local pay regulations.
  • Assist with audits and compensation-related reporting requirements.
  • Maintain compensation documentation, procedures, and governance practices.

Partnership & Consultation

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to People & Culture partners and business leaders regarding compensation matters.
  • Provide guidance on job evaluations, internal equity considerations, and compensation practices.
  • Support organizational design and workforce planning initiatives through compensation analysis.

title: Software Engineer, DevOps
description:
About Atria:

The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. We bring together a multidisciplinary team of renowned physicians to provide proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.

Our mission is to make healthspan and lifespan equal for all by translating science into medicine in real-time, all while bringing humanity back into health care. Delivering such robust, personalized, and preventive health care is complex and requires a team-wide dedication to excellence.

After successfully opening our flagship Institute in New York in 2022 and expanding to South Florida in 2024, we are now bringing the Atria experience to the West Coast with the launch of our Los Angeles Institute in late spring 2026.

Atria Health is seeking a Software Engineer for our DevOps team to help build and operate the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and observability that the rest of engineering relies on every day.

This is an individual contributor role focused on:

  • Building and maintaining cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation that let product teams ship safely and quickly
  • Keeping our systems reliable and observable, and helping the team respond when things break
  • Reducing operational toil through tooling, automation, and good documentation

You’ll work alongside the Tech Lead and other DevOps engineers to improve and maintain infrastructure-as-code, improve our build and release process, and strengthen our monitoring and security posture. You’ll partner with the Platform, Data Engineering, and domain product teams (Clinical Experience, Member Experience, and Care Delivery) to understand their needs and make their path to production smoother. You’ll care deeply about both how we build and what we achieve, while working to accelerate the work of our client teams.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure & Automation

  • Build and maintain cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform using Terraform, following the patterns and standards set by the team.
  • Implement and improve CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions to make deployments fast, safe, and repeatable.
  • Automate manual and repetitive operational work with scripts and tooling to reduce toil across engineering.

Reliability & Observability

  • Instrument services and infrastructure with meaningful monitoring, dashboards, and alerting in Datadog, and help cut down on alert noise.
  • Participate in the on‑call rotation, respond to incidents, and work to ensure uptime for our applications.
  • Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for our core infrastructure and build systems.

Developer Enablement

  • Support product engineering teams with deployment pipelines, environment issues, and build troubleshooting.
  • Help maintain preview and staging environments, including reliable data sync, masking, and cleanup routines so teams can test against realistic data.
  • Improve developer experience through better tooling, clear runbooks, and documentation.

Quality & Collaboration

  • Write well‑tested, well‑reviewed infrastructure code, and participate in design reviews and RFCs with a pragmatic, operations‑focused perspective.
  • Design systems and changes to meet the team’s goals.
  • Give and receive thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge through pairing and documentation.

Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python, Bash
  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Terraform, Cloudflare
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  • Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis
  • Observability & Incident Management: Datadog, Sentry, Rootly
  • Integrations: Athena EMR, wearable platforms, third‑party healthcare APIs

Core Experience

  • ~3 - 4 years of professional experience in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure, or backend engineering in production environments.
  • Hands‑on experience provisioning and operating infrastructure in at least one cloud provider (ideally Google Cloud Platform).
  • Track record of shipping automation, pipelines, or infrastructure that made a team more productive or reliable.
  • An enthusiasm for developer productivity and making our teams as impactful as possible.

Technical Skills

  • Comfortable with infrastructure‑as‑code (ideally Terraform) and building CI/CD pipelines (ideally GitHub Actions).
  • Proficient software engineering skills, and comfortable working in Linux.
  • Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tooling, and solid debugging instincts across logs, traces, and metrics.
  • Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and containerized workloads.
  • Solid grounding in reliability, performance, and security fundamentals.

At Atria, we are proud to offer every member of the Atria team:

  • Excellent health and wellness benefits, fully covered by Atria, effective date of hire
  • OneMedical membership for employees & dependents, giving access to 24/7 virtual care
  • Fertility & family planning
  • Company‑covered preventive health screenings through partner hospitals (calcium score)
  • Fitness Perks, including Wellhub +
  • 401k contributions and 4% match starting after 6 months
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Continuing medical education (CME) and CEU support for professional licensure

title: Senior Data Engineer (Contract)
description:
Who We Are

At Concurrency, we embody innovation. We're not just tech consultants; we are forward thinkers with a purpose. Our team thrives on disrupting the norm, constantly seeking the next challenge and pushing boundaries to redefine what's achievable. Recognized as a Microsoft Gold Partner and recipient of multiple Partner of the Year awards, Concurrency is synonymous with excellence. If you're fueled by the desire to transform technology into real-world solutions, join us and unleash your potential as a change catalyst.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re excited to add a Data Engineer to our Cloud, Data & AI Solutions Team. In this role, you’ll work with a team of customer-focused professionals who are committed to defining technical strategy, architecting, designing, and delivering end-to-end digital transformation. You'll demonstrate strong technical competence and business acumen through engaging in senior-level technology decision-making discussions related to agility, business value, data warehousing, and cloud-oriented data solutions.

At Concurrency, we believe in living out our core values every day. These principles guide our actions, decisions, and interactions:

Be Yourself: Be the best version of your whole self. Your authenticity matters.

Be Bold: Bravely and respectfully take risks and challenge the norm.

Have a Growth Mindset: Be open to learning and apply your expertise.

Be the Difference: Ensure that every interaction with your colleagues, clients and community improves their lives. Pay it forward.

Assume Positive Intent: Lead with giving the benefit of the doubt.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and modern cloud data platform technologies.

  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical designs, data models, and implementation plans.

  • Develop and maintain Fabric Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, notebooks, and orchestration processes for reliable data ingestion and transformation.

  • Build and support Lakehouse architectures leveraging Bronze, Silver, and Gold (Medallion) layers to improve data quality, governance, and analytics readiness.

  • Develop ELT/ETL solutions using SQL, PySpark, Python, and Fabric notebooks to transform and enrich enterprise data.

  • Create and optimize data models that support reporting, self-service analytics, AI, and machine learning initiatives.

  • Support migrations from legacy data platforms, on-premises databases, and third-party systems into Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services.

  • Implement data quality, monitoring, security, and governance practices that align with enterprise standards.

What You'll Need

  • Over 2 years of experience designing and delivering modern data solutions on Microsoft Azure and/or Microsoft Fabric.

  • Experience developing and supporting Microsoft Fabric workloads including Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Notebooks, or Real-Time Analytics.

  • Understanding of Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and modern data engineering best practices.

  • Experience building ELT/ETL pipelines using SQL, Python, PySpark, Data Factory, or similar cloud-native technologies.

  • Strong SQL development skills, including stored procedures, data transformation logic, and performance optimization.

  • Knowledge of dimensional modeling, star schemas, Data Vault, and other analytical data modeling techniques.

  • Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into source-to-target mappings, data models, and technical solutions.

  • Experience developing semantic models, reports, and dashboards using Power BI.

  • Understanding of data governance, data quality, security, and performance considerations within cloud data platforms.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Knowledge of OneLake, shortcuts, semantic models, and Fabric-native architecture patterns.

  • Experience supporting AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics workloads.

  • Familiarity with Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage, and related Azure data services.

  • Experience with DevOps practices including Git, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation.

  • Consulting or professional services experience with direct client engagement and solution delivery.

Concurrency is committed to revolutionizing consulting by embracing diverse perspectives, fostering collaboration, and promoting resilience. Our workplace is both innovation-driven and enjoyable. We provide flexible work schedules, competitive compensation, and comprehensive benefits for our employees and their families. Additionally, all team members have access to recognition programs, comprehensive training opportunities to thrive both professionally and personally.

title: Lokalvård
description:

title: Retention Team Leader
description:
One Group | One Energy

Merrimack Services is a people-first company that leads door-to-door voter mobilization programs across the country, and is working with Progressive Turnout Project, the largest voter contact organization in the country, specifically dedicated to mobilizing the Democratic Party and defending democracy.

Do you want to make a difference in your community? We are seeking enthusiastic Door Knockers to help get out the vote for Democrats in the upcoming midterm elections! Door knockers will have conversations with voters at their homes and talk to them about the importance of making their voices heard.

As independent contractors, door knockers may complete every part of the program on their own schedule, and have the flexibility to knock on doors and talk to voters when and where they choose–no schedule or time commitment is required.   • Door Knocking can be done all at once or over multiple periods of time.

Här har du stora möjligheter att växa och utvecklas inom ditt kompetensområde och du kommer att ingå i ett team med andra duktiga utvecklare. Här får du arbeta brett i hela teknikstacken, från arkitektur till drift, tillsammans med kollegor som brinner för utveckling, innovation och ständig förbättring. Rollen erbjuder spännande tekniska utmaningar och en tydlig utvecklingsresa mot en central roll.

”På Visionera bygger vi produkter som gör verklig skillnad, och vi gör det tillsammans. Som fullstackutvecklare får du stort ansvar, direkt påverkan och möjlighet att jobba med moderna tekniker i ett team där idéer snabbt blir verklighet. Du kommer att arbeta med kunniga och engagerade kollegor som brinner för kodkvalitet, smarta lösningar och att ligga i teknisk framkant. Vi tror på transparens, nyfikenhet och att utvecklas kontinuerligt, både som bolag och individer.”– Jonas Fagerström, VD & grundare

Om tjänsten

På Visionera har de höga mål och stora hjärtan. De tror på att arbeta hårt samtidigt som att ha en bra balans till fritid och att ha roligt på jobbet. På Visionera har du nära till beslutsfattarna och de har alltid stora saker på gång. Deras kunder finns över hela världen och bidrar till deras stimulerande företagskultur. Visionera är i en expansiv fas och växer organiskt kontinuerligt. Om du vill vara med på en spännande resa och gillar en miljö fylld med innovation, energi och utmaningar då är Visionera platsen för dig. Tjänsten är en direktrekrytering vilket innebär att rekryteringsprocessen sker genom Academic Work men dukommer anställas direkt hos Visionera.

Du erbjudsVisionera investerar i sina medarbetare och erbjuder möjligheter att växa mot roller som Senior utvecklare, Tech lead eller Lead developer.

Arbetsuppgifter

Hos Visionera får du inte bara utvecklas som fullstackutvecklare, du får också möjlighet att bidra till deras produkt VisionFlow, som används av kunder världen över. Detta system används både av dem själva samt av deras kunder i deras arbetsprocesser. VisionFlow effektiviserar verksamheter och förenklar kommunikationen mellan avdelningar och team i ett gemensamt system. Det är ett omfattande och flexibelt system som anpassas till kundernas behov. Det kan även integreras med andra system vilket gör det ännu mer kraftfullt. Då systemet är så pass stort så kommer du som utvecklare sällan känna att du gör samma sak om och om igen trots att du arbetar med samma produkt. Exempel på saker du skulle kunna få jobba med är:

  • Fullstackutveckling i frontend, backend, databaser, mobilapp och externa/interna integrationer
  • Arbeta med infrastruktur, plattform och applikationsdrift
  • Delta i utveckling av nya funktioner och vidareutveckling av befintliga moduler
  • Agera bollplank gentemot produktägare, driftpersonal, krav och test teamet och kundsupport i tekniska frågor
  • Samarbeta nära med kunder och bidra till teknisk problemlösning
  • Arbeta nära kunder, både på på distans och även ibland ute hos kund
  • Delta i QA och testarbete
  • Delta i support enligt rullande schema (cirka var 5–6 dag)
  • Delta i beredskap enligt rullande schema (cirka var 5–6 vecka)

Om du visar framfötterna så är möjligheterna oändliga! Här kan du växa som person och i din roll. Visionera säljer sin egen produkt vilket innebär att säljare och supporten sitter bredvid dig och därmed är du nära kunderna och ser produkten leva.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har en avslutad akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis datateknik eller motsvarande
  • Har några års arbetserfarenhet vid sidan av studierna eller efter examen
  • Har goda kunskaper i Java och objektorienterad JavaScript
  • Har erfarenhet av HTML, CSS, REST, SQL samt databaser som MS SQL Server eller MySQL
  • Erfarenhet av Windows, Linux och Git
  • Har förståelse för systemdesign, arkitektur och säkerhet
  • Flytande i svenska och engelska då båda språken används i arbetet

Det är meriterande om du har

  • En avslutad Civilingenjörsubildning
  • Erfarenhet av att integrera AI-tjänster, LLM:er eller AI-assisterad utveckling
  • Erfarenhet av att leda ett team
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta enligt DevOps-principer, inklusive testautomatisering, CI/CD och hantering av molntjänster
  • Erfarenheter av Sencha EXT, Spring, Velocity, Struts, Apache Tomcat, NGINX, Tigase, Centrifugo, Elasticsearch, ehCache, JUnit, Selenium, Jenkins, Ant, IntelliJ IDEA, ehCache eller Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, LangChain4J eller Spring AI
  • Erfarenhet av eventdriven arkitektur, mikrotjänster och system med hög transaktionstäthet
  • Kan visa upp hobbyprojekt
  • Har erfarenhet av Ext JS eller andra JavaScript ramverk

Vår rekryteringsprocess

  • Personlighets- och problemlösningstest
  • Telefonintervju med Academic Work
  • Kodtester i Java
  • Digital evidensbaserad djupintervju med Academic Work
  • Första intervju med Visionera
  • Andra intervju med Visionera
  • Referenser + Beslut

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:

  • Självgående och ansvarstagande

title: ER DU EN STJERNE PÅ GULVET?
description:
Kom og hold nogle af livets bedste fester med os på Skovriderkroen

Vi søger erfarne tjenere, overtjenere og Floor Managers til Skovriderkroen i Charlottenlund.

Hos os holder vi de fester, vores gæster har glædet sig til i månedsvis – og nogle gange i årevis.
Brylluppet, den runde fødselsdag, konfirmationen, firmafesten, julefrokosten og sommerfesten.
Og derudover fylder vi løbende huset med koncerter, musikquizzer, markeder og andre events.

Vi har huset. Vi har udsigten over vandet. Vi har maden, gæsterne og festerne.

Nu leder vi efter flere virkelig dygtige mennesker til at få det hele til at spille.

For vi ved godt, at smukke rammer og god mad ikke gør det alene. Det er menneskerne på gulvet, der får gæsterne til at føle sig velkomne, får aftenen til at glide og er med til at skabe den fest, gæsterne husker bagefter.

Måske er det dig?

Måske er du den erfarne tjener, der elsker at være på gulvet og levere fantastisk service.
Måske er du overtjeneren, der naturligt tager styringen, når der er travlt.
Eller måske er du Floor Manageren, der kan få 150 gæster, køkken, bar og et helt tjenerteam til at spille sammen.

Vi har brug for jer alle.

Fælles for jer er dog én ting: I skal have erfaring.

Vi leder efter mennesker, der allerede kender tjenerfaget og ved, hvad god service kræver. Til vores overtjener- og Floor Manager-roller skal du desuden have erfaring med selskaber og kunne tage ansvar for en afvikling fra start til slut.

Til gengæld behøver dit CV ikke passe ned i en bestemt kasse.

Det vigtigste er, at du kan dit håndværk, kan lide mennesker og har lyst til at være en del af et stærkt hold.

Vil du have ansvar? Så er der masser at tage

Hos os må du gerne ville noget.

Er du erfaren tjener og glad for din rolle på gulvet, er der absolut plads til det.

Men har du lyst til mere, er der også rig mulighed for at tage ansvar, udvikle dig og sætte dit eget præg på den måde, vi gør tingene på.

Som overtjener/Floor Manager får du bl.a. ansvar for at sætte dit team i gang, fordele opgaver, koordinere med køkken og bar, holde tidsplanen og være den, der har overblikket over arrangementet fra start til slut.

Og ser du noget, vi kan gøre bedre? Så sig det.

Vi vil gerne have dygtige mennesker omkring os, som bidrager med deres erfaring og er med til at gøre både vores gæsteoplevelse og vores arbejdsplads endnu bedre.

Et godt hold betyder alt

Du bliver en del af et dedikeret team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har ambitioner om at levere nogle virkelig gode oplevelser for vores gæster.

Og kommer du fra et tidligere sted med en kollega eller to, som du savner at arbejde sammen med?

Så tag dem under armen.

Vi er meget åbne for at få flere gode mennesker ind sammen. Vi ved, hvor meget det betyder på et gulv, når man kender hinanden, stoler på hinanden og spiller hinanden gode.

Få timer, mange timer – eller måske fuldtid

Vi er fleksible i forhold til, hvordan jobbet skal passe ind i dit liv.

Vi søger både timelønnede og deltidsansatte, og for den rette profil kan der også være mulighed for en fuldtidsstilling, hvor selskaber og events kombineres med vagter i vores à la carte-restaurant.

Vi har arrangementer både på hverdage og i weekender, men vores største selskaber ligger naturligt ofte fredag og lørdag.

Du behøver ikke arbejde hver weekend. Det kunne eksempelvis være hver anden weekend kombineret med de øvrige vagter, der passer ind hos dig.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du kommer regelmæssigt nok til at kende huset, holdet og måden, vi arbejder på.

Ansættelse: Timeløn eller mulighed for fleksibel deltid
Løn: Efter kvalifikationer
Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Skal du være med?

Så vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig.

Send et par ord om dig selv og din erfaring til hr@lasseskov.com.

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman. Fortæl mig, hvem du er, hvad du har lavet, og hvorfor du kunne have lyst til at blive en del af Skovriderkroen.

Har du spørgsmål eller vil du bare høre lidt mere om mulighederne, er du meget velkommen til at ringe til Mia Møller Larsen, Head Of Venue på 24 91 91 00.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Daarna implementeer je samen met je team de oplossing, begeleid je ERP- en CAD/CAM-integraties, werk je mee aan machinekoppelingen en datacaptatie en leid je eindgebruikers op met workshops.

Je vormt de brug tussen klant, het projectteam en je developers. Je bewaakt planning en kwaliteit, brengt structuur in complexe trajecten en blijft "eigenaar" tot de oplossing stabiel draait in productie. Vanuit je praktijkervaring in deze projecten denk je mee over de verdere ontwikkeling van hun software.

Je komt terecht in een professionele maar familiale organisatie met korte lijnen, veel ruimte voor initiatief en een duidelijke ambitie om verder te groeien.

title: Talstærk og nysgerrig medarbejder til bekæmpelse af social dumping
description:
Vil du være med til at sikre, at udenlandske virksomheder og arbejdstagere betaler korrekt skat til Danmark? Så læs videre her

Landsdækkende projekt med tværfagligt samarbejde med Arbejdstilsynet og Politiet
Projekt Social Dumping er et landsdækkende projekt, hvor Skattestyrelsen sammen med Arbejdstilsynet og Politiet årligt gennemfører en række landsdækkende og regionale kontrolaktioner, hvor vi kan have mistanke om social dumping og brug af illegal arbejdskraft.

Du får 14 kolleger i vores enhed, heraf er ca. halvdelen tilknyttet Social Dumping-teamet, som du bliver en del af. Dine primære opgaver bliver at deltage i kontrolaktioner og foretage sagsbehandling, som tager udgangspunkt i de oplysninger, du har været med til at indsamle på disse. Kontrolaktionerne gennemføres ca. én gang om måneden.

Sagerne i Projekt Social Dumping er komplekse og sjældent ens. Derfor kommer du til at arbejde med forskellige problemstillinger og som udgangspunkt til at følge sagerne fra start til slut.

Sagsbehandlingen indebærer blandt andet at:

  • indkalde, gennemgå og vurdere virksomheders regnskabsmateriale samt øvrige oplysninger fra bl.a. kontrolaktionerne
  • kontrollere om virksomhederne har indberettet korrekt A-skat/arbejdsudlejeskat for de udenlandske arbejdere virksomhederne anvender
  • udarbejde forslag og efterfølgende afgørelser på A-skat, moms og indkomstskat/selskabsskat
  • indgå i dialog med virksomheder og rådgivere.
Du får ansvar for dine egne sager, og du bliver samtidig en del af et team, hvor vi deler viden, sparrer og hjælper hinanden med de komplekse problemstillinger.

Vil du læse mere om opgaven, kan du finde information på vores hjemmeside om social dumping.
Den fælles myndighedsindsats mod social dumping

Vores forventninger til dig
Du har kendskab til regnskab, revision og skatteregler via din uddannelse, fx som professionsbachelor i skat, bachelor- eller kandidatniveau inden for skat, moms, jura, regnskab, revision eller tilsvarende.

Du kan også have tilegnet dig relevante kompetencer gennem erhvervserfaring inden for skat, moms, jura, regnskab eller revision. Det er en fordel, at du har en struktureret arbejdsstil og erfaring med sagsbehandling og eventuelt udgående kontrolaktioner.

Det er en stilling, der kræver et stort engagement, da du skal:

  • trives med dybdegående og kompleks sagsbehandling i et fagligt område, der løbende forandrer sig og som kan tage lang tid
  • skal have fokus på et tillids- og respektfuldt samarbejde med kolleger, som du har gensidig faglig sparring med
  • være imødekommende, lyttende og tålmodig, også når virksomhedernes forhold er komplekse og muligvis ulovlige
  • optræde professionelt i en kontrolsituation, hvor du møder mennesker, der kan være konfronterende
  • trives i direkte dialog med virksomheder og rådgivere, mundtligt såvel som skriftligt.
Din nye arbejdsplads
Vi sørger for at få dig godt ombord i opstartsperioden. Derfor har vi fokus på, at du bliver grundigt introduceret til vores systemer og arbejdsopgaver med udgangspunkt i dine kompetencer og behov. Derudover sikrer vi, at der bliver lavet en plan for løbende kompetenceudvikling, da vi har gode muligheder for efter- eller videreuddannelse.

Du kommer ind i et fagligt stærkt team af gode kolleger med en uhøjtidelig omgangstone. Vi prioriterer et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor dagligdagen er præget af frihed under ansvar, godt humør og en kultur, som understøtter samarbejde, faglig sparring og vidensdeling.

Din hverdag bliver spændende og afvekslende, og fleksibilitet medvirker til at dit arbejds- og familieliv hænger sammen. De udgående kontrolaktioner planlægges, så du i god tid ved, hvornår du skal deltage.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis bedes sendt via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest den 30. september 2026.

Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte funktionsleder Monica Hauge Johannesen på telefon 72378582, eller af din måske nye kollega, specialkonsulent Camilla Krog Thomsen på telefon 72372886.

Vi har planlagt at holde første samtaler 5. og 6. oktober samt eventuelt anden samtaler d. 13. og 14. oktober. Der vil muligvis indgå en personanalyse i ansættelsesforløbet, hvorfor du skal afsætte tid til dette mellem første og anden samtale.

Forud for ansættelsen indhenter vi straffeattest og referencer.

Tiltrædelse den 1. december 2026 eller efter aftale.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer (HK) eller overenskomst for Fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

Hvis du går videre til ansættelse i rekrutteringsforløbet, skal du være opmærksom på, at vi foretager en undersøgelse af, om du har gæld, der er sendt til inddrivelse hos det offentlige. Vi undersøger ligeledes, om du har afgjorte kontrol- og/eller straffesager på skatte- og afgiftsområdet. Din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at vi ikke finder oplysninger om dig, der er uforenelige med en ansættelse i Skatte- og Vækstministeriets koncern.

Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Arbejdsstedet er Brovej 20, 8800 Viborg.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace.

PORTO
Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals.

TECHNOLOGY
The Technology team builds end-to-end products and solutions that power our marketplace, delivering an incredible experience for customers globally. From understanding customer and partner needs to designing and testing innovative hypotheses, we create industry-leading experiences for luxury customers everywhere.

THE ROLE
Reporting to the Engineering Lead, you will be responsible for improving and maintaining our project portfolio. As a Software Engineer, your duties will include developing end-to-end solutions, reviewing initiatives prior to their deployment and subsequent maintenance phase addressing any arising issues, and developing enhancements based on our business teams requirements. You will ensure that all developments undergo rigorous testing and review. Effective communication is crucial in this role, as you will frequently interact with issue reporters to thoroughly understand problems and convey clear solutions. You will be working in a very friendly environment and be part of a well-motivated, talented and growing team. If you love to learn, if you are willing to share knowledge and would love to be part of the building process to reach the top, using the latest technology stack and having fun doing it, this is an opportunity you can’t miss.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, implement, and optimize solutions to improve operational efficiency
  • Ensure outstanding engineering practices when building these solutions
  • Expand our modular architecture, creating new libraries
  • Provide technical support and expertise to resolve issues and improve system performance
  • Collaborate effectively within an agile environment
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high-quality software delivery
  • Evolve your technical capabilities to the next level while using state-of-the-art technologies.

WHO YOU ARE

  • An expert in object oriented languages (C#)
  • Knowledgeable of unit tests and/or integration tests
  • Passionate about code quality
  • Stay on top of all of all best practices of modern software development
  • Knowledgeable of SQL and experience using relational databases
  • Knowledgeable of REST APIs
  • A professional with experience working with agile methodologies is also a plus
  • Autonomous and able to make important technical decisions that will have a positive impact on our platform
  • Interested in large-scale systems

- Health insurance for the whole family, flexible working environment and well-being support and tools;
- Extra days off, sabbatical program and days for you to give back for the community;
- Training opportunities and free access to LinkedIn Learning;
- Flexible benefits program.

We are determined that no applicant experiences discrimination on the basis of sex, race, ethnicity, religion or belief, disability, age, gender identity, ancestry, sexual orientation, veteran status, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

title: Business Relationship & Service Coordinator
description:
ABOUT CENTRAL BANK OF ST. LOUIS

Central Bank of St. Louis is a community-focused financial institution committed to building strong relationships and delivering exceptional service. We take pride in supporting the financial success of individuals and businesses throughout the St. Louis region by combining personalized service with a full range of banking solutions.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Business Relationship & Service Coordinator serves as the dedicated retail banking partner to the Commercial Lending team, providing exceptional service and seamless support to commercial clients and business partners. This role combines customer relationship management, operational support, sales coordination, onboarding, and cross-functional problem resolution to deliver seamless client experience throughout the business customer lifecycle. The individual acts as a central point of contact for business clients, assisting with deposit accounts, commercial loans, cash management services, treasury products, payment solutions, and ongoing account maintenance. The role works closely with Commercial Loan Officers, Cash Management Officers, Retail teams, and other bank departments to identify customer needs, coordinate solutions, deepen relationships, and ensure legendary customer experience. Conducts relationships and activities consistent with established Bank policies, procedures and systems, the corporate code of conduct, Bank Secrecy Act and all applicable State and Federal laws and regulations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Serve as a primary service contact for business customers, building and maintaining strong client relationships while acting as a liaison between customers and internal bank departments.
  • Maintain regular communication with commercial and small business clients regarding account, loan, treasury management, and other banking needs.
  • Resolve customer service issues proactively and professionally, identifying opportunities to strengthen relationships and enhance client retention.
  • Open and maintain business deposit accounts, process account changes and service requests, and assist customers with deposits, payments, transfers, and other account servicing needs.
  • Identify customer needs and recommend appropriate banking products and solutions that support their financial goals.
  • Support relationship managers and lenders in business development efforts by generating referrals and promoting commercial, treasury, deposit, and other bank products and services.
  • Participate in client meetings, onboarding sessions, and presentations, and assist in preparing sales proposals, relationship reviews, and related materials.
  • Ensure account documentation, customer files, records, and correspondence are accurate, complete, and compliant with applicable requirements.
  • Support branch operations and assist with audits, annual reviews, due diligence processes, compliance monitoring, and reporting activities.
  • Ensure adherence to all bank policies, procedures, BSA requirements, customer identification standards, and other regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain the confidentiality and security of customer and bank information.

CORE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong understanding of business banking products and services.
  • Knowledge of commercial loans, deposit accounts, and cash management solutions.
  • Excellent customer relationship and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination abilities.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high accuracy.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and bank operating systems.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across departments.

title: Network / Systems Analyst II or III -- NEOMIN
description:
Position:

  • Network / Systems Analyst II or III

Location:

  • NEOMIN

Reports to:

  • Director of Technology

Overview:

  • NEOMIN is seeking an experienced Network / Systems Analyst II or III to support the daily operation of the NEOMIN technology environment and provide advanced technical support to our member school districts.
  • This position requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, sound judgment, initiative, and the ability to independently investigate and resolve issues across network, server, virtualization, communications, security, and application environments. The position works closely with NEOMIN staff, school district technology personnel, and vendors to implement solutions, resolve complex problems, and support technology projects.
  • The Analyst II or III classification will be determined based on experience, demonstrated technical depth, independence, project ownership, and ability to provide technical leadership and guidance.

What We're Looking For:

  • NEOMIN's member school districts rely on our technical team for assistance with systems and problems that may extend beyond routine end-user support. This position requires an experienced technical professional who can encounter an unfamiliar problem, gather relevant information, analyze logs and system behavior, develop and test possible causes, research unfamiliar technologies, and work toward a reliable resolution.
  • Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology used by NEOMIN. Strong troubleshooting fundamentals, technical curiosity, accuracy, ownership, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems are particularly important.
  • Analyst II candidates should demonstrate a high degree of technical independence and ownership. Analyst III candidates should additionally demonstrate subject-matter expertise, technical leadership, mentorship, and the ability to manage complex systems and projects with minimal oversight.

Experience & Capabilities:

  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills across network, server, application, and infrastructure environments, including the ability to investigate unfamiliar problems through logs, testing, documentation, and research.
  • Experience administering primarily Windows Server environments and related infrastructure services; Linux experience is beneficial.
  • Experience with Microsoft Active Directory, PowerShell, identity management, MFA, and modern authentication technologies such as SAML and OIDC.
  • Experience administering VMware vSphere or comparable enterprise virtualization environments, including virtual machine lifecycle, snapshots, backup/recovery, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Google Workspace administration preferred; Microsoft 365 experience is also valuable.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, including DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, NAT, firewalls, VPNs, and enterprise wireless networking.
  • Experience with enterprise network and firewall technologies; Arista networking and Palo Alto firewalls experience is beneficial.
  • Experience with VoIP/SIP technologies and enterprise phone systems; 3CX experience is beneficial. This may include provisioning, call routing, IVRs, queues, SIP trunks, SBCs, and related network/firewall troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, endpoint, and security platforms such as MSP360, ManageEngine Endpoint Central and Log360, ESET EDR, and web-filtering systems, including reviewing alerts, troubleshooting agents and services, managing configurations, and analyzing logs.
  • Ability to plan and carry technical projects through implementation, testing, documentation, and completion while coordinating effectively with customers, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  • Ability to create clear, accurate, and maintainable technical documentation.
  • Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and professionally to technical and nontechnical audiences and provide strong customer service to member school districts.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance and expertise to other areas of the organization, while collaborating with, supporting, and mentoring other members of the technology team.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity practices and frameworks, including NIST security controls, is beneficial.
  • Experience providing technology training or knowledge transfer is beneficial.

Compensation:

  • Commensurate with education, experience, and position classification.

Application Process:

  • Please submit a letter of interest and resume to: brian.greathouse@neomin.org

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
The NEOMIN Governing Board does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, religion, age, disability, or genetic information in employment or the provision of services.

title: Service Assistant
description:
Palmer Johnson is looking for a Service Assistant to join our team in Burnaby. This is a great entry-level opportunity for someone who enjoys hands-on work, has mechanical aptitude, and wants to gain experience working alongside skilled technicians.

As a Service Assistant, you'll support our service department by assisting with shop operations, preparing equipment for repair and shipment, and helping maintain an organized, safe, and efficient work environment. The role also includes some warehouse and inventory responsibilities to keep the service team running smoothly.

Palmer Johnson is a dynamic industry leader committed to providing superior customer service. What You'll Do

  • Clean, prepare, paint, test, and stage components and equipment for repair or shipment.
  • Receive, organize parts and help maintain an accurate inventory.

  • Load and unload customer equipment and freight.

What We're Looking For

title: Senior Digital Designer
description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.

From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.


What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a systems-minded, digitally fluent Senior Designer to build the visual foundations that make Insider One unmistakable and scalable. Working with the Creative Director, Website Development Team, and other designers, you’ll own brand systems and web design from concept to production-ready execution, creating the components, templates, and page experiences that help global marketing move faster without sacrificing quality.

This hands-on senior individual-contributor role is for someone who thinks beyond one-off assets. You’ll translate brand and business goals into responsive websites, landing pages, campaign systems, and reusable frameworks; partner with developers through handoff and QA; and use Claude and MCP-enabled tools to accelerate exploration, prototyping, documentation, and production. You’ll thrive in ambiguity and own the work until it is live.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with the Creative Director to evolve Insider One’s visual identity and turn brand strategy into distinctive, high-performing digital experiences.

  • Build and document scalable brand systems in Figma, including components, variables, grids, templates, iconography, illustration, typography, and image treatments.

  • Own website pages, landing pages, launch experiences, and microsites from information structure and wireframes to responsive, developer-ready design.

  • Work closely with the Website Development Team on interactions, feasibility, accessibility, performance, handoff, and detailed design QA before launch.

  • Design for WordPress confidently, understanding templates, reusable modules, CMS constraints, and responsive behavior; Elementor is a strong advantage.

  • Turn ambiguous briefs and complex B2B technology into clear design directions, prototypes, and visual stories, presenting and defending the rationale.

  • Create reusable templates and self-service systems that help designers and global marketing teams produce consistent, on-brand work at speed.

  • Use Claude, Adobe AI tools, and Model Context Protocol-enabled workflows to research, ideate, prototype, automate repetitive work, and improve developer handoff.

  • Review live implementation and other designers’ work, giving precise feedback that protects the brand, raises craft, and develops the wider team.

  • Manage multiple projects with strong file hygiene, version control, documentation, and prioritization, using performance feedback to improve future work.

What You Will Need

  • 6+ years of experience in brand, visual, digital, or web design within fast-growth B2B SaaS, technology, a design studio, or an agency.

  • A standout portfolio showing sophisticated brand systems, responsive web design, digital campaigns, and clear technology storytelling.

  • Expert Figma skills, including Auto Layout, components, variants, variables, libraries, prototyping, responsive systems, and developer handoff.

  • High professional proficiency across Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Acrobat, After Effects, and Premiere Pro.

  • Exceptional visual craft across typography, layout, composition, grids, hierarchy, color, image selection, and digital art direction.

  • Strong systems thinking, with proven experience turning visual identity into reusable components, templates, guidelines, and frameworks.

  • Strong knowledge of web and UX principles, including responsive behavior, accessibility, conversion, performance, interaction, and technical constraints.

  • Working knowledge of WordPress from a designer’s perspective, including CMS constraints and implementation validation; Elementor is a plus.

  • Experience collaborating with developers, preparing clear specifications, resolving implementation questions, and completing meticulous QA.

  • Practical, daily use of AI tools such as Claude and Adobe Firefly for research, concepting, iteration, production, and documentation.

  • Hands-on familiarity with Model Context Protocol workflows connecting Figma to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar environments.

  • Comfort with speed and ambiguity, defining problems, proposing direction, managing feedback, and owning work through delivery.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence explaining decisions and working directly with senior stakeholders.

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach, with the ability to strengthen other designers’ work and contribute across global teams.

Was this role made for you?

Let’s talk! We’re curious beings and can’t wait to get to know you.

We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not only welcome but also embrace everyone, regardless of sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

What We Offer

  • Enjoy a monthly meal allowance designed to enhance your daily routine.

  • Access comprehensive private health insurance.

  • Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and Neoskola, and CloudGuru.

  • Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.

  • Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets, where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.

  • Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.

  • Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.

  • Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.

  • From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.

  • Get inspired by the greatest minds in the tech industry through events like our Tech & Dev Talks.

We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.


To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.

If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.


We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!

title: Child Watch
company: Armed Services YMCA of The U S A
description:
Armed Services YMCA of ALASKA

Job Title: Child Watch

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Status: Part Time, Permanent

Reports to: Education Director

Hourly Pay: $17.03 – $21.05

POSITION SUMMARY:

This position supports the work of the Armed Services YMCA, a leading nonprofit committed to strengthening the military community through youth development, healthy living and social responsibility. The Child Watch position ensures the safety of children who are checked into the CWR program while their parents/legal guardian are being seen in an approved, on site clinic for themselves or other immediate household family member. This program aids in fulfilling our mission of enhancing the lives of military members and their families in spirit, mind and body through programs relevant to the unique challenges of military life.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  1. Ensures a safe and clean environment and provides activities for participants.
  2. Opens and closes CWR and/or Childwatch room as needed.
  3. Maintains appointments and reservations for CWR and/or Childwatch during operating hours.
  4. Reviews and maintains proper registration forms, vaccination records and intake forms for each child.
  5. Checks participants in and out of the CWR and/or Childwatch program; ensures parents sign the in/out logs.
  6. Provides customer service via phone, in-person and electronic communications (e-mail) to parents regarding program information or reservations.
  7. Interacts and plays with children on their level, as age appropriate.
  8. Models appropriate behavior for children.
  9. Provides a kind, nurturing environment that welcomes all participants.
  10. Provides assistance to children in restroom/diapering and changing clothes as needed in accordance with the ASYMCA of Alaska’s Diapering and Restroom Policy.
  11. Informs parents of any behavioral issues from their child’s time at CWR and/or Childwatch.
  12. Addresses any parent concerns with the program and refer unresolved issues to the Program Director.
  13. Reports unsafe conditions to supervisor & immediately corrects condition, if possible.
  14. Coordinates all repair and maintenance needs with the Program Director or Associate Executive Director in the Program Director’s absence.
  15. Informs the Program Director of any reoccurring requirements for supplies.
  16. Tracks program usage and statistics on a shared document and reports monthly statistics to the Program Director.
