Otter Co-op is a diverse and growing organization, serving the Lower Mainland, Fraser Valley and BC Interior since 1922. With over 103 years in business and over 600 in our team, we are proud to be a locally owned and community minded member of the neighbourhoods we live, work and play in. We operate three food and pharmacy stores (including one with a fashion and hardware department), thirty Angry Otter liquor stores, one feed mill, two bulk petroleum facilities, the Highwayman Pub in Abbotsford, and multiple gas station/convenience stores. To learn more about who we are and how you can help bring our brand to life, visit us at .

Why it matters:

Our team provides a range of products and services to support our member-owners. Through the work that we do, we help to build, fuel, feed and grow Western Canadian communities together.

Who you are:

You are looking for a career in Retail Store Operations and:

  • Previous Baking experience preferred
  • Previous Retail / Customer Service an asset
  • Previous experience handling food along with a food safe certification is an asset
  • Must have excellent communication skills, be able to work efficiently in a team setting as well as independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Must have a strong work ethic

  • Must be committed to a SAFE working environment
  • The ideal candidate will have open availability to work a variety of shifts, 7 days a week from 5:00 AM to 9:00 PM

What’s in it for you:

  • Competitive Wages
  • Wage increases based on hours worked & meeting expectations in the position
  • Annual bonus program for all eligible team members
  • For eligible positions: comprehensive benefits package and an employer matched pension plan
  • Team discount on Gas, Liquor, Food, Fashion, Hardware, Feed & Restaurant purchases
  • Co-op Membership with an annual dividend payment on qualified purchases
  • Education Assistance Program
  • Learning opportunities, to grow and develop and to foster a culture of teamwork and innovation

Otter Co-op is committed to a diverse and supportive working environment based on our Core Company Values of Integrity, Community and Excellence. We embrace diversity and inclusion, and we’re working to create a workplace that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We support and provide an environment that allows all to bring their whole selves to work.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected to continue in the recruitment process will be contacted.

title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
description:
About Fusemachines

Founded in 2013, Fusemachines is a global provider of enterprise AI products and services, on a mission to democratize AI. Fusemachines continues to actively pursue the mission of democratizing AI for the masses by providing high-quality AI education in underserved communities and helping organizations achieve their full potential with AI.

Type: Full-time

Key Objective:

The Sr. UX/UI Designer sits on a product team and owns the design of a product area, connecting real user needs with business goals. This designer thinks like a product owner and understands how the product earns its keep. Craft and research fundamentals stay non negotiable, and AI is the working partner that makes it possible to explore more options and prove ideas faster.Key Objective:

Qualifications and Experience:

  • At least 5 years of UX/UI design experience, with a portfolio of products that shipped.

  • Demonstrated use of AI in real design work, with examples of what it changed.

Required skills/competencies:

AI fluency and vibe design

  • Fluent with current AI design, prototyping, and coding tools such as Figma Make, Claude, Cursor, v0, or Lovable, and quick to learn the next ones.

  • Vibe designs with intent, going from rough idea to working prototype in hours by steering AI with a trained eye.

  • Treats a prompt like a design brief, giving AI the context, constraints, and design system rules it needs.

  • Uses AI across the process, from research synthesis and UX copy to edge cases, accessibility checks, and QA.

  • Can tell a fast AI output from a good one, and sets the tool aside when doing it by hand is better.

Designing AI products

  • Designs for systems that do not give the same answer twice, handling uncertainty, wrong answers, and partial results without losing the user's trust.

  • Understands how models and agents behave well enough to set honest expectations and place human review where being wrong is costly.

  • Thinks past the chat box, designing agentic and assisted workflows rather than defaulting to conversation.

Product and business thinking

  • Knows how the product makes money, who it serves, and what the success metrics and constraints are, and designs with that in view.

  • Weighs desirability, feasibility, and viability, and can say no to an idea that is not worth what it costs.

  • Argues design decisions in terms stakeholders care about, such as conversion, retention, or time to ship.

Design fundamentals

  • Strong visual and interaction craft in Figma, and the judgment to run a design system rather than only work inside one.

  • Research and usability testing that ends in decisions, not decks.

  • Enough code literacy to read a component, change it, and steer an AI coding tool.

  • Clear communication in English, able to explain and defend decisions to non designers.

  • Owns the process end to end, scoping, prioritizing, and delivering independently.

Good to have

  • A degree in design, computer science, information technology, or a related field.

  • Production front end experience with HTML, CSS, SASS, or React.

  • Prompt libraries or reusable AI workflows built for a team.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the design of a product area end to end, partnering with product and engineering on the goals and constraints behind the roadmap.

  • Take ideas to clickable prototypes quickly, and use them to drive decisions instead of slides.

  • Run research and usability testing, and bring the findings to the people making the calls.

  • Stay with the work after release, watching how it performs and iterating.

  • Maintain and extend the design system so people and AI tools produce on brand, accessible output by default.

  • Share prompts, workflows, and failed experiments to raise the team's AI fluency.

  • Own the quality of everything you deliver. Nothing ships without a designer's review, AI assisted or not.

title: Mobile Health Technician
description:
Are you passionate about helping people achieve their health goals but tired of the typical grind or sales-based roles? As a Mobile Health Technician, you'll focus on what you love, one-on-one interaction and making a real difference, without the pressures of building a client base. You'll be at the heart of numerous health journeys, celebrating successes and offering support in a role that's as rewarding as it is dynamic.

First-year fully licensed hourly-wage technicians can earn upwards of $66,929 annually, including bonuses and overtime.

You'll Love This Job If You Have:

  • Passion for Preventive Health: You believe health is about more than treating illness, you want to help people understand their bodies and reach their goals.
  • Customer Service Instincts: You love one-on-one interaction and creating great experiences. You're warm, professional, and can make anyone feel comfortable, without the pressure of building your own book of business.
  • Startup Energy: You're energized by variety and building something new. Traditional healthcare feels slow and bureaucratic to you. You want to be part of a small, dynamic team where your work actually matters.
  • Grit and Flexibility: You don't mind early mornings or getting your hands dirty. You're resourceful, when something's broken, you fix it or propose solutions instead of waiting for someone else.

Many of our Mobile Health Technicians are former personal trainers, health coaches, fitness trainers, and nutritionists. Many have backgrounds in kinesiology, exercise science, nutrition, or other related fields.

However, if you're in a client-focused role today, and health and wellness is your passion but you've never had professional experience before, this is a great place to pursue your passion while making a difference.

What Will You Do?

  • Work in our storefronts or directly in the community, driving our mobile scan vans to community centers, gyms, workplaces, health fairs, clinics, and other locations.
  • Perform DEXA scans and get best-in-class training, including a week in Austin, TX, and fully covered DEXA technician licensing costs.
  • Take ownership of your events from setup to tear down, exemplifying excellence in service delivery and customer service, all while making a genuinely positive impact on dozens of people each day.
  • General administrative and maintenance-related duties related to our storefront, machines, vans, and equipment.
  • Assist with other duties as assigned by the Leadership Team.

Requirements

  • We are looking for someone in this position to work a Friday-through-Tuesday or Thursday-through-Monday schedule on a consistent basis. This schedule includes both weekend days every week, qualifying techs for the weekend bonus described below.
  • Standardized Test Scores: If you've taken any standardized tests such as the SAT, ACT, ASVAB, or others, we request you to share your scores. This is not a requirement and will not be a sole determining factor for hiring decisions, but it helps us learn more about our candidates since we do not conduct pre-employment testing.
  • Each shift is 8 hours, but event start and end times typically vary between the hours of 7am - 8pm, depending on location. Earlier start times may be required to accommodate drive time to the location so that you are at the event at 7am and ready to accept clients. We try to keep event start times as consistent as possible, but there will be some variation.
  • Must be able to lift/carry up to 50 lbs.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and driving record in good standing.

Compensation

First-year fully licensed hourly-wage techs can earn upwards of $66,929 annually, including bonuses and overtime.

  • Hourly Rate: $25.04/hour ($52,083 annualized at 40 hrs/week)
  • Performance Bonus: Up to 7% of base annually ($3,646), half paid in cash ($1,823), half in stock options
  • Team Revenue Bonus: $500/month when we hit monthly goals ($6,000 annually, we hit our goals 9 out of 12 months in 2025)
  • Weekend Bonus: $100/week for working both Saturday and Sunday ($5,200 annually)
  • Total Cash Compensation: Up to $66,929
  • Equity: Stock options through performance bonus and additional grants based on performance

Benefits

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Paid time off
  • Sick leave
  • $75/month commute reimbursement
  • $10/shift meal stipend
  • Company-wide peer bonus program for recognizing excellent teamwork
  • Employee assistance program
  • Regular team events (both virtual and in-person)

title: Senior Interaction Designer, Google Health
description:
At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Our Interaction Designers transform complex tasks into intuitive, easy-to-use experiences for billions of people. From creating user flows and wireframes to building mockups and prototypes, you will envision and bring product experiences to life with an inspired, refined, and magical feel. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, leveraging user insights to create industry-leading products.

As an Interaction Designer, you'll apply user-centered design methods to craft industry-leading user experiences from concept to execution, working with design partners to evolve the Google design language to build beautiful, innovative products.

In this role, you will design intuitive, trustworthy, and impactful experiences for emerging areas of Google Health that are essential to deliver proactive, personalized coaching that bridges everyday habits with longitudinal medical care.

You will lead end-to-end user experience design projects within our three core consumer health pillars: Adaptive Lifestyle Coaching (nutrition, women’s health), Personalized Health Companion (Personal Health Records, lab results, immunization data, and clinical visit prep), and Proactive Health Guardian (passive vitals baselines, irregular rhythm notifications, continuous glucose monitoring, and early health risks).

Serving as a critical bridge between UX, Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and Clinical Research, you will translate complex physiological signals into clear, actionable, medically sound and emotionally resonant user experiences.

Google for Health is a company-wide effort to help billions of people be healthier. We work toward this vision by meeting people in their everyday moments and empowering them to stay healthy and partnering with care teams to provide more accurate and accessible care. Our teams are applying our expertise and technology to improve health outcomes globally – with high-quality information and tools to help people manage their health and wellbeing, solutions to transform care delivery, research to catalyze the use of artificial intelligence for the screening and diagnosis of disease, and data and insights to the public health community.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements, and provide creative, thoughtful solutions.
  • Communicate the user experience at various stages of the design process with wireframes, flow diagrams, storyboards, mockups, or high fidelity prototypes.
  • Integrate user feedback and business requirements into ongoing product experience updates.
  • Advocate for the prioritization of design centered changes, refinements, and improvements.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of interaction design experience in product design or UX design.

Preferred qualifications:

title: Udekørende sælger til Jylland og Fyn
description:
Bliv en central del af Dansk Plejetekniks videre vækstrejse

Dansk Plejeteknik A/S søger en stærk udekørende sælger med base i eller omkring Trekantområdet, som skal være vores kommercielle ansigt udadtil i Jylland og dele af Fyn.

Vi arbejder med produkter, serviceydelser og løsninger til pleje- og sundhedssektoren — blandt andet plejesenge, personløftere, loftlifte, vekseltryksmadrasser, reservedele, udlejning, service og specialløsninger. Vores kunder er typisk kommuner, regioner, plejecentre, sygehuse, institutioner, depoter og private aktører, hvor tillid, faglighed og nærvær er afgørende.

Vi leder efter dig, der trives med at være ude hos kunderne. Dig, der forstår værdien af fysisk tilstedeværelse, stærke relationer og vedholdende opfølgning. Du skal ikke blot “sælge produkter” — du skal forstå kundens hverdag, afdække behov og skabe løsninger, der gør en forskel.

Rollen

Som udekørende sælger får du ansvaret for at vedligeholde, udvikle og udbygge vores kundemasse i Jylland og på dele af Fyn.

Du vil få en vigtig rolle i at styrke vores position hos eksisterende kunder, men også i at åbne nye døre og bearbejde relevante kundeemner. Rollen kræver, at du er struktureret, selvkørende og naturligt opsøgende — men samtidig god til at samarbejde tæt med vores interne salgsfunktion, service, logistik og ledelse.

Din succes skabes i høj grad gennem face-to-face kundekontakt, hvor du bygger relationer, skaber tillid og omsætter dialog til konkrete salgsmuligheder.

Dine primære opgaver

Du får ansvar for at:

· Planlægge og gennemføre kundebesøg hos eksisterende og potentielle kunder.

· Vedligeholde og udvikle relationer til kommuner, regioner, plejecentre, depoter og øvrige relevante kunder.

· Identificere kundebehov inden for produkter, reservedele, service, udlejning og projektsalg.

· Skabe nye salgsmuligheder gennem opsøgende salgsarbejde.

· Følge op på tilbud, igangværende dialoger og åbne muligheder.

· Præsentere Dansk Plejetekniks løsninger professionelt og værdiskabende.

· Indsamle markedsviden om kunder, konkurrenter og tendenser.

· Sikre klar overlevering til backoffice, så tilbud, ordrebehandling og opfølgning sker effektivt.

· Bidrage med input til kampagner, produktfokus og markedsaktiviteter.

· Deltage aktivt i udviklingen af Team Salg og vores kommercielle indsats.

Vi forestiller os, at du

Du har erfaring med B2B-salg og trives med en hverdag, hvor du er meget ude hos kunderne. Den rette kandidat må meget gerne have brancheerfaring fra pleje-, sundheds- eller hjælpemiddelområdet, men

det er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rigtige salgsprofil, energi og evne til at skabe tillid hos kunderne.

Du er typen, der følger op, holder fast og får ting til at ske. Du forstår, at stærkt salg i vores branche handler om relationer, timing, behovsforståelse og troværdighed.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

· Har erfaring med opsøgende B2B-salg.

· Gerne har brancheerfaring fra pleje-, sundheds- eller hjælpemiddelområdet.

· Er stærk i relations salg og fysisk kundedialog.

· Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og målrettet.

· Er god til at følge op og få ting til at ske.

· Har kommerciel forståelse og kan se muligheder hos kunden.

· Kommunikerer professionelt både mundtligt og skriftligt.

· Trives med samarbejde på tværs af salg, backoffice, service og ledelse.

· Har bopæl i eller omkring Trekantsområdet.

· Har kørekort B.

Team Salg består af både udekørende salg og backoffice. Vi arbejder målrettet på at styrke vores kommercielle struktur, kundetilgang, synlighed og opfølgning.

Du bliver derfor ikke alene en sælger med eget distrikt — du bliver en vigtig del af et team, hvor vi sammen skal løfte Dansk Plejetekniks position i markedet.

Backoffice understøtter dig med tilbud, ordrebehandling, udlejning, salgsopfølgning, kampagner og materialer, så du kan bruge mest mulig tid dér, hvor du skaber størst værdi: ude hos kunderne.

Vi tilbyder

title: Partner Forward Deployed Engineer III, GenAI, Google Cloud
location: New York, NY, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA
description:
As a Generative AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded innovator-builder moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke, scalable agentic solutions directly with strategic partners inside customer environments. In this role, you will bridge the gap between frontier AI prototypes and production-grade reality, resolving integration complexities, data readiness challenges, and state-management bottlenecks that prevent systems from reaching enterprise maturity. You will also provide white-glove deployments and establish a critical feedback loop to Google, transforming field insights into future product roadmap enhancements alongside partner engineering teams.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Serve as a tech lead and developer with AI partners for complex AI applications, working with partner teams to transition from rapid prototypes to production-grade, replicable agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure partner developed agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable partner and field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
  • Co-build with a AI partner’s forward deployed engineering team to instill Google-grade development best practices.
  • Help partners to build their own agentic delivery capabilities to set them up for long term success, focusing on the ROI at customer engagements ensuring customer activation.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.
  • Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
  • Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch for customers.
  • Experience guiding technical discovery sessions with customers.
  • Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Knowledge of Large Language Model (LLM) native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

About The Role
The Reporting & Reconciliation Specialist will be required to support the manager responsible for the financial reconciliation of projects and ensure that all reconciliation and HCP Transfer of Value (ToV) reporting requirements (Sunshine Act and EFPIA) are completed accurately, within required deadlines and to required standard.

This role will support the Reporting & Reconciliations Lead in the training of junior colleagues including the the delivery of best practice, and the draft of processes and procedures across client accounts.

What You'll Do

  • Cross-check Third Party Cost (TPC) report(s) thoroughly, identifying discrepancies and/or omissions
  • Chase or source outstanding TPCs in a timely manner
  • Collate back-up for reconciliation folder and clearly mark up TPC invoices
  • Analyse TPCs in accordance with budget breakdowns and accurately enter into final reconciliation budget
  • Produce clear and logical audit trail spreadsheet showing how analysed TPCs were derived
  • Set-up and lead timely reconciliation review meeting for final review and agreement
  • Prepare clear and consistent reconciliation backup bundle of compliance and TPC documents in accordance with clients’ requirements
  • Establish reporting deadlines and requirements per project
  • Produce clear and logical audit trail spreadsheet showing how analysed reporting figures were derived
  • Produce accurate clients' reporting spreadsheets specific to their requirements
  • Timely send/upload to client's portal of templates and supporting compliance and TPC documentation.
  • Prepare clear and consistent separate reporting bundle per client for audit purposes
  • Participate in clients’ compliance training including use of clients' reporting portals where applicable
  • Understand and implement Sunshine Act and EFPIA requirements
  • Timely distribution of purchase invoices for checking and approval, ensuring accuracy and correct application to projects
  • Efficient R&R team mailbox admin and housekeeping
  • Accurate foreign currency distribution and admin
  • Undertakes, where necessary, client’s reporting training programmes
  • Regularly review and update client compliance guidelines across accounts, referring team and project leads to checklists and updates to guidelines

About You

  • Minimum 1 year in a role within a finance environment
  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • Excel including formulas, vlookup and pivot tables
  • Comfortable working to deadlines
  • Self-motivated, methodical and detail-oriented, with a desire to continuously learn
  • Is a reliable and dependable contributor to the team’s goals; actively collaborates with the team and supports other team members as needed
  • Works well with others; values suggestions and constructive feedback
  • Communicates with team members in a respectful manner
What we can offer

You'll receive up to a 7% pension contribution, life insurance, income protection, and private medical insurance for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including flexible hybrid working, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 25 days of annual leave plus two personal well-being days, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.

Access free counselling through our employee assistance program, as well as personalized health support. Enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey, as well as on-demand support from our partner Peppy. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Part-time Wireless Telecommunications Researcher
description:
Corner Alliance is a dynamic, growing consulting firm that devotes itself to providing an enriching employee experience while working in meaningful ways to create results for the government. We are currently seeking a Telecommunications Researcher with 10+ years of experience required to join our team and fully embrace our commitment to deliver, grow and thrive.

About the Role:

As a Telecommunications Researcher supporting our federal government client, you will be trusted to provide senior-level telecommunications oversight and technical expertise across a myriad of Wireless Communications R&D topics. This role requires a seasoned leader with deep knowledge of the wireless telecommunications industry, strong familiarity with the research community, and established relationships across government, industry, academia, and other key stakeholders. The ideal candidate will bring an appreciation for both foundational research and practical technology transition.

Key Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Advise on the technical framing of workshops, webinars, panels, and demonstration events across the portfolio
  • Translate foundational research results toward development, demonstration, and translation outcomes, particularly for verticals-driven projects
  • Identify translation opportunities and connect research teams with relevant industry partners and vertical-market stakeholders
  • Support recurring progress meetings with funded teams and with NSF Program Directors
  • Serve as a liaison to related organizations and initiatives, including research testbeds, standards bodies, and industry alliances
  • Contribute technical perspective to collaboration and teaming activities that bring research teams together
  • Advise the Virtual Office on where the global telecommunications landscape is moving and where the program should concentrate
  • Provide input to program reporting, annual lessons learned, and the improvement process

Location:

You will work as part of a primarily remote team, with two semi-annual meetings at locations in the United States.

Experience/Skills:

  • 10+ years of experience in wireless telecommunications, networking, or a related field, including substantial experience in wireless telecommunications research and development.
  • A background in academic research, or a demonstrated track record of collaborating with academic researchers, sufficient to earn the confidence of university research teams
  • Demonstrated technology translation experience, moving research results toward commercialization, standards, open source, or operational deployment
  • Deep understanding of the global wireless telecommunications industry landscape, including key technology trends, stakeholders, and innovation pathways
  • Working knowledge of emerging wireless vertical industries such as manufacturing, transportation, energy, healthcare, and public safety
  • Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with senior leaders across government, industry, academia, and research organizations
  • A working understanding of the National Science Foundation's role across fundamental research and translation, including the Directorate for Technology, Innovation and Partnerships
  • Established relationships across the telecommunications stakeholder community
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical writing skills.
  • US citizenship or permanent resident and the ability to pass public trust clearance or suitability

Preferred Experience/Skills:

  • Experience supporting federal research, innovation, or technology transition programs.
  • Established relationships across the wireless telecommunications, networking, and innovation ecosystem.
  • Experience working with research testbeds, public-private partnerships, standards bodies, or technology transition initiatives.

Don’t think you have everything for this role but are still very interested? Please don’t hold back from applying because you may not have it all. You can learn and grow with us. Corner Alliance is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable law. We are dedicated to building a talented workforce that reflects the strength of our society and our shared commitment to excellence. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position with Corner Alliance please call (202) 754-8120 or email recruiting@corneralliance.com. Corner Alliance participates in the E-verify program and will provide the Federal Government with Form I-9 information to confirm work authorization in the U.S.

Visit us at to learn more.

Securing Your Data:

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Corner Alliance’s name. Corner Alliance will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Corner Alliance ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). title: Operativ Säljchef till Spares Nordic AB
description:
Om Spares

Spares Nordic AB är ett entreprenörsdrivet tillväxtbolag inom B2B-handel av reservdelar och tillbehör för elektronikmarknaden. Bolaget grundades för cirka 13 år sedan och har vuxit både organiskt och genom förvärv.

Verksamheten omsätter över 1 miljard kronor, varav B2B-affären står för cirka 400 miljoner kronor. Bolaget har sitt säte i Malmö och ingår i en större koncern med starka ägare i ryggen, men drivs fortsatt självständigt med korta beslutsvägar och stor handlingsfrihet.

Spares kombinerar ett brett sortiment, snabb leverans och starka leverantörsavtal. Från lagret i Malmö hanteras omkring 37 000 SKU:er för kunder i stora delar av Europa – från mindre reparationsbutiker till större återförsäljare och e-handelsaktörer. Systemintegrationer via feeds och tekniska kopplingar skapar långsiktiga och lönsamma kundrelationer.

Marknadsläge

Spares verkar i en attraktiv marknad där efterfrågan på reservdelar, tillbehör och effektiva B2B-flöden inom elektronik fortsatt är stark. Fler återförsäljare vill erbjuda ett brett sortiment utan att själva bära hela lagerkostnaden, vilket gynnar leverantörer med hög tillgänglighet, produktbredd och effektiv logistik.

Bolaget får ett löpande inflöde av cirka 2–4 företagsförfrågningar per dag via sina B2B-sajter och har cirka 400–500 aktiva kunder som handlar minst månadsvis. Nästa tillväxtsteg ligger särskilt i den skalbara integrationsaffären mot större europeiska återförsäljare och e-handlare.

Aktuell position

Spares söker en Säljchef till B2B-teamet i Malmö. Teamet består av fyra säljare och har en stark affär att bygga vidare på, samtidigt som arbetet behöver stärkas med tydligare struktur, coachning och uppföljning.

Rollen är operativ och ledande: cirka 40 procent av tiden läggs på egen försäljning, medan resterande del ägnas åt att leda, utveckla och följa upp teamet.

Säljchefen får ett nyckelansvar för att etablera CRM-stöd, tydliga KPI:er och ett arbetssätt som följer upp aktiviteter, inbound, kundutveckling och tappade affärer.

Det är en roll med stort mandat att skapa riktning och kommersiell skärpa. För rätt person finns goda möjligheter att växa med verksamheten på vägen mot målet om 2 miljarder kronor i omsättning till 2030.

Profil

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara en affärsdriven säljledare som trivs nära kund, team och resultat. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning och har redan börjat leda, coacha eller utveckla andra säljare – exempelvis som team leader, säljledare eller försäljningschef.

  • Några års framgångsrik B2B-försäljning med tydliga resultat.
  • Erfarenhet av att leda, coacha eller utveckla säljare.
  • Förmåga att kombinera egen försäljning med struktur, uppföljning och kravställning.
  • Teknik- och systemförståelse; erfarenhet av e-handel, feeds eller integrationer är meriterande.
  • Pragmatiskt, lösningsorienterat arbetssätt och driv att bygga, förbättra och påverka.
  • Tydligt, närvarande ledarskap som skapar respekt genom arbetsinsats och resultat.
  • Mycket god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift; tyska, franska eller spanska är meriterande.
  • Möjlighet och vilja att arbeta nära verksamheten från Malmökontoret.

Spares söker inte i första hand marknadens mest seniora ledare, utan en person på väg upp som har fått smak för ledarskap och fortsatt vill vara nära affären. Du trivs i en miljö med högt tempo, korta beslutsvägar och tydliga förväntningar på eget initiativ.

Lön och förmåner

Villkoren presenteras vid ett första möte med Closers.

Rollen omfattar relevanta standardförmåner, pension, friskvård och 30 dagars semester.

Varför Spares

Detta är ett naturligt nästa steg för dig som vill kombinera försäljning, ledarskap och verksamhetsutveckling i ett bolag med tydlig tillväxtambition. Du får mandat att bygga struktur, utveckla ett team och forma hur B2B-försäljningen ska arbeta framåt – i en platt, entreprenöriell organisation med korta beslutsvägar.

  • Ett bolag som har vuxit från 0 till över 1 miljard kronor i omsättning.
  • En B2B-verksamhet om cirka 400 miljoner kronor med tydlig uppsida.
  • Starka leverantörsavtal och ett tydligt kommersiellt försprång.
  • En roll där du bygger struktur, utvecklar team och påverkar framtidens säljfunktion.
  • En tillväxtresa mot 2 miljarder kronor i omsättning till 2030.

Headhuntinguppdraget genomförs av Closers AB.

Ansvarig headhunter är Alexander Goharialexander.gohari@closers.se

title: Lärling till bilglastekniker – TC Glas
description:
Vill du lära dig ett riktigt hantverk och bygga en framtid inom bilglasbranschen? Hos TC Glas får du chansen att utbilda dig till bilglastekniker på riktigt – under handledning av erfarna kollegor, i ett team där samarbete och kvalitet är i fokus.

Vi söker nu en lärling till vår verkstad. Du behöver ingen tidigare erfarenhet av bilglas – vi lär dig allt du behöver, steg för steg, med en tydlig utbildningsplan och en mentor vid din sida.

Ditt jobb hos oss

Krav: inget tidigare krav på erfarenhet. B-körkort är ett krav.

Som lärling arbetar du praktiskt i verkstaden tillsammans med en erfaren tekniker och lär dig successivt hela yrket. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att vara:

• Assistera vid reparation av stenskott och byte av bilrutor

• Successivt lära dig kalibrering av förarstödssystem (ADAS) i samband med rutbyte

• Arbeta praktiskt i verkstaden med bilglasrelaterade uppdrag

• Ta emot och hjälpa kunder i kundmottagningen

• Lära dig administrativa uppgifter kopplade till kundärenden

Arbete på annan ort eller verkstad kan förekomma.

Om TC Glas

TC Glas har djupa rötter i branschen – vår historia går tillbaka till 1981 och ett familjeföretag inom bilglas. Genom generationer och gedigen erfarenhet från några av branschens största aktörer har den kunskapen förts vidare, och sedan 2020 driver vi verksamheten tillsammans under namnet TC Glas, med verkstäder i både Trosa och Södertälje. Det är en lång tradition av hantverk och service vi tar med oss in i varje kundmöte – och vi ser fram emot att hjälpa dig med allt du kan tänka dig inom glas!

Vem är du?

Du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och vill lära dig ett hantverk från grunden. Du gillar att jobba praktiskt lika mycket som att ha kontakt med människor. Ingen erfarenhet krävs – vi värdesätter driv och vilja att lära.

Vad vi erbjuder

En strukturerad upplärning med mentor, kollektivavtal enligt Glasmästeriavtalet, ett sammansvetsat team – och goda möjligheter till fast anställning som bilglastekniker efter avslutad lärlingsperiod.

title: Managed Services Operations Lead - FinOps
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

The Managed Services Operations Lead, FinOps is the senior technical authority for AHEAD’s Cloud FinOps service, serving as thought leader and subject matter expert for clients, partners, and internal delivery teams. The role leads the development, design, and implementation of FinOps solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and is accountable for the technical quality, consistency, and maturity of FinOps delivery across the managed services client portfolio.

Operating as a principal-level practitioner, this role owns the most complex client scenarios, serves as the primary technical escalation point for Cloud FinOps Engineers, and sets the standards, data models, automation, and reusable assets that the practice delivers against. The role also defines and drives the AI and automation roadmap for the FinOps practice, translating advanced analytics and machine learning capabilities into productized, explainable, and trusted service offerings. This is an individual contributor role that provides technical leadership, mentorship, and coordination across delivery resources without direct personnel-management responsibility.

The role requires a strategic mindset, mature executive communication skills, and commercial awareness, engaging client senior leadership, finance and procurement stakeholders, service and process owners, AHEAD service leadership, and sales teams directly. The role is performed remotely within the United States and includes up to 15 percent domestic travel, along with occasional after-hours or weekend support during major incidents, reporting deadlines, approved change windows, or other activities required by contracted service commitments.

Duties / Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Solution Design

• Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Cloud FinOps Engineers supporting client engagements, resolving the most complex technical and financial analysis scenarios.
• Act as principal engineer for high-complexity client situations requiring advanced cloud engineering, financial modeling, and cross-domain judgment.
• Lead the development, design, and implementation of complex, mission-critical, enterprise-grade FinOps solutions, including AI-enabled capabilities where they deliver measurable client value.
• Ensure FinOps services and deliverables are provided on time and at the highest quality standards while meeting or exceeding client expectations and contracted service commitments.
• Develop and maintain technical roadmaps and innovation plans for supported FinOps solutions and services.
• Establish project estimates and plans, identify risks and mitigations, and oversee the development and delivery of technical FinOps solutions.
• Provide technical leadership and coordinate technical delivery resources across skillsets, including cross-practice work and deliverables, without direct personnel-management responsibility.
• Provide credible time and effort estimates based on available information, and initiate and author project change requests when additional work is identified beyond agreed scope.

Cloud Cost Analysis and Optimization

• Lead deep-dive investigations into cloud spend drivers, billing anomalies, optimization opportunities, and cost visibility gaps across AWS, Azure, and GCP using native tooling and approved third-party FinOps platforms.
• Define the methodology by which the practice identifies, quantifies, prioritizes, and drives optimization opportunities including rightsizing, idle resource cleanup, storage and data transfer optimization, licensing alignment, and scheduling strategies.
• Own the framework for tracking optimization opportunities through identified, recommended, approved, implemented, and realized states, ensuring financial outcomes are validated and unrealized savings are not double-counted or misattributed.
• Set the approach for cost visibility and allocation in containerized and Kubernetes workloads, including shared cluster cost distribution, namespace and label-based allocation, and idle capacity analysis.
• Lead analysis and optimization of AI and GPU-related spend, including accelerated compute utilization, model training and inference costs, and consumption of managed AI and machine learning services.
• Extend cost analysis and governance to SaaS, software licensing, and marketplace spend where these fall within the agreed scope of the engagement.
• Define and oversee best-practices reviews that combine cost analysis with operational excellence analysis, using cloud-native and approved AHEAD tooling.

Allocation, Unit Economics, and Reporting Architecture

• Lead the design and implementation of scalable approaches for cost allocation, tagging strategy, showback, chargeback, budgeting, forecasting, and optimization across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
• Define unit economics and cost-per-unit metric frameworks that tie cloud spend to business drivers such as customers, transactions, environments, products, or workloads.
• Own the architecture of dashboards, reports, budgets, forecasts, executive summaries, and recurring service review content, and set quality standards for what the practice produces.
• Define data validation and reconciliation standards across billing exports, connectors, cost datasets, and reporting models to improve trust in reported values, including adoption of standardized billing data formats such as FOCUS.
• Establish continuous tagging governance through cloud-native policy enforcement, policy-as-code, and automated remediation, refining coverage as untagged or non-compliant resources are identified.
• Set standards for client-facing FinOps tooling and portals, ensuring predictive analytics, multi-account views, and resource, configuration, and environment change reporting remain current and accurate.

Commitment and Rate Strategy

• Own the commitment strategy across the client portfolio, including reserved capacity and savings plan modeling, purchase governance, coverage and utilization targets, expiration and renewal planning, and savings realization tracking.
• Lead support of enterprise agreement, private pricing, and committed-spend discussions by providing consumption analysis, commitment scenarios, and drawdown forecasts to client and AHEAD stakeholders.
• Approve or review commitment recommendations produced by the team before they are presented to clients, ensuring financial assumptions and risk exposure are sound.

Client Advisory, Growth, and Communication

• Build and maintain strong client relationships, drive business growth, and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling FinOps and adjacent AHEAD services.
• Collaborate with clients to understand their technical, operational, and financial challenges and develop tailored FinOps solutions to address their needs.
• Create and present solution designs, options, ideas, and innovations to clients’ senior leadership teams, and help client leadership set strategic direction beyond individual tactics.
• Advise clients on FinOps best practices, governance models, operating models, and maturity improvements, including organizational adoption approaches such as crawl-walk-run.
• Develop high-quality deliverables and presentations for client engineering teams, finance and procurement stakeholders, and senior leaders, including both technical and non-technical documentation.
• Lead recurring client advisory and service review discussions covering cost and billing changes, optimization progress, roadmap items, migration candidates, and feedback on AHEAD’s service delivery performance.
• Partner with CloudOps, DevOps, platform, application, finance, procurement, and client stakeholders to support implementation of recommendations and validate realized outcomes.
• Maintain timely ticket updates, work documentation, meeting follow-ups, and internal and customer communications in accordance with service delivery expectations.
• Support pre-sales, solutioning, scoping, positioning, and service maturation efforts by providing subject matter expertise, effort input, and delivery perspective, and identify and escalate new client opportunities.

AI, Automation, and Practice Engineering

• Define and drive the AI and automation roadmap for the FinOps practice, including use cases such as anomaly detection, rightsizing recommendations, commitment optimization, and intelligent budgeting and forecasting.
• Evaluate and productize capabilities from FinOps platforms and cloud-native machine learning services into standard AHEAD offerings, including build-versus-buy recommendations and platform selection guidance.
• Define the data quality, tagging, and metadata standards required for reliable AI-driven insights and automation of FinOps workflows.
• Establish processes for monitoring and tuning models used for forecasting, anomaly detection, and optimization, ensuring transparency, explainability, and stakeholder trust in the outputs.
• Collaborate with AHEAD’s AI, machine learning, and platform engineering teams to co-innovate joint FinOps solutions and reference architectures.
• Build and oversee queries, data transformations, and automation using SQL and scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash, including event-driven and API-based integrations across FinOps platforms, ITSM tools, and cloud-native services.
• Direct the integration of third-party tools, billing data sources, and reporting platforms into approved FinOps tooling and governance structures, including onboarding of new clients, accounts, subscriptions, and projects.
• Oversee execution of approved remediation activities, including workload resizing, workload deletion, and commitment implementation, ensuring client change-control procedures and permission models are followed.

Mentorship and Practice Development

• Provide mentorship, coaching, and professional development opportunities to Cloud FinOps Engineers and other team members, empowering them to grow and excel in their roles.
• Review team deliverables and analyses for technical accuracy, financial soundness, and presentation quality, elevating team capability and consistency.
• Develop and maintain standards, procedures, data models, playbooks, work instructions, automation, and reusable assets that improve the maturity, consistency, and scalability of the FinOps practice.
• Build team fluency in AI-assisted and automated workflows so engineers and analysts apply these tools effectively and with appropriate judgment in daily delivery.
• Actively lead collaboration within AHEAD’s technical communities and influence team members, the broader internal organization, and external customers to adopt new concepts, best practices, and approaches.
• Partner with Delivery Managers and service leadership to identify delivery risks, technical gaps, resourcing needs, and improvement opportunities across the FinOps practice.
• Monitor delivery hours against contracted monthly allocations across the portfolio, flagging utilization trends and coordinating any approved overage or rescoping through the change-request process.
• Serve as a reliable resource for thought leadership content, workshops, industry conferences, and webinars representing the practice.
• Deliver FinOps and tooling education and training for client teams to build internal cost-management capability, in addition to mentoring within the AHEAD practice.

General

• Maintain availability during the assigned team’s standard business hours, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate recurring client meetings and service reviews across United States time zones.
• Participate in and provide senior escalation support for the team’s on-call or escalation rotation where applicable to the assigned account portfolio.
• Stay current on cloud pricing models, FinOps best practices, emerging AI and analytics capabilities, and service provider roadmaps while helping refine how AHEAD delivers cloud cost optimization and advisory services.
• Provide occasional after-hours support for client meetings, reporting deadlines, change windows, critical incidents, or urgent cost-related issues when required.
• Maintain relevant professional and cloud certifications consistent with role, practice, and individual development requirements, and meet or exceed individual goal objectives.
• Other job duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

Minimum Required –

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, finance, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
• 10+ years of information technology experience, including 5+ years focused on FinOps, cloud cost management, cloud governance, or related cloud engineering.
• 5+ years in a customer-facing, stakeholder-facing, consulting, or service delivery role with responsibility for presenting findings, solution designs, and recommendations to technical, financial, and executive audiences.
• 2+ years using and administering FinOps and cloud management platforms such as Harness CCM, Cloudability, CloudHealth, CloudZero, native cloud cost management tools, or similar solutions.
• Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, or operating large-scale, multi-account, multi-subscription, or enterprise cloud environments.
• Subject matter expertise in at least one major public cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) with working depth in a second; strong Azure or AWS experience preferred.
• Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery, serving as an escalation point, and reviewing the work of other engineers for quality and consistency.
• Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash, sufficient to build and maintain cost data transformations, automation, and recurring reporting.
• Multiple relevant certifications such as FinOps Certified Practitioner, FinOps Certified Professional, AWS Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, Google Cloud certifications, or similar.
• Demonstrated experience integrating third-party tools, billing data sources, and reporting platforms.
• Strong analytical, financial modeling, spreadsheet, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a shared services or multi-client environment.
• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
• Ability to successfully complete AHEAD and client-required background screening; certain client environments may require additional vetting or clearance.

Preferred Experience

Experience working in a managed services, consulting, or outsourced service delivery environment.
• Experience building or maturing a FinOps practice, service offering, or center of excellence, including standards, playbooks, and reusable assets.
• Hands-on experience with cloud data and analytics platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks for aggregating and analyzing cloud cost and usage data.
• Familiarity with machine learning and advanced analytics concepts such as time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and clustering, and how they apply to cloud cost optimization and capacity planning.
• Experience integrating FinOps platforms with automation, orchestration, and AI services to build end-to-end workflows and recommendations.
• Experience with policy-as-code and cloud governance tooling such as Terraform with Sentinel, Open Policy Agent, Azure Policy, or AWS Config to operationalize FinOps guardrails.
• Experience with forecasting, budgeting, allocation methodologies, showback or chargeback models, commitment planning, and savings realization tracking.
• Familiarity with the FinOps Framework and with standardized billing data formats such as FOCUS.
• Experience with Kubernetes or container cost allocation, and with AI or GPU cost management.
• Experience with reporting and visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau.
• Familiarity with ticketing and workflow platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar tools.
• Experience contributing to pre-sales activities, including scoping, positioning, proposal support, and technology adoption.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Expert-level understanding of cloud billing constructs including on-demand usage, reserved capacity, savings plans or commitments, amortization, allocation methods, and forecasting drivers.
• Expert-level experience analyzing cloud billing data, usage trends, tagging compliance, and optimization opportunities across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
• Hands-on experience designing and implementing FinOps capabilities around cost visibility, allocation, governance, optimization, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
• Experience with enterprise cloud platforms and services across compute, storage, networking, databases, containers, security, and identity, with the ability to connect technical design decisions to financial outcomes.
• Knowledge of enterprise FinOps principles including crawl-walk-run adoption models, cloud-native cost optimization strategies, governance frameworks, infrastructure as code, and cloud operating models.
• Working knowledge of unit economics concepts and the ability to connect infrastructure consumption to business and product metrics.
• Understanding of cost behavior in containerized, serverless, data platform, and accelerated computing environments.
• Understanding of performance, scaling, and functional characteristics of cloud and open-source technologies, with the ability to recommend standard design patterns and best practices.
• Experience driving organizational adoption of transformational initiatives such as FinOps, cloud governance, cost accountability, showback, chargeback, and operational maturity improvement.
• Knowledge of enterprise organizations across multiple industries and internal IT functions such as enterprise architecture, operations, finance, procurement, and security.
• Strong consulting and business acumen, with the ability to translate technical, automation, and AI capabilities into clear business value, return on investment, and executive-ready narratives.
• Ability to work through a solution live with a client, including whiteboarding a FinOps approach to a business, financial, or technology challenge without prior preparation.
• Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with a professional customer-facing presence and the ability to lead executive-level advisory discussions.
• Ability to communicate technical and financial concepts clearly to technical, operational, procurement, finance, and executive audiences.
• Ability to lead work independently in the highest-complexity situations while collaborating effectively across distributed teams, time zones, and functions.
• Strong documentation, organization, and time management skills with consistent follow-through and attention to detail.
• Demonstrated ownership mindset with the ability to balance competing priorities in a fast-paced multi-client environment while maintaining service quality.
• Continuous improvement mindset with an interest in automation, standardization, methodology refinement, and scalable service delivery.
• Ability to mentor others, improve team capability, and contribute positively to practice development and knowledge sharing.
• Strong project and situational awareness, with the judgment to escalate appropriately and accept responsibility for individual and team outcomes.

Culture and Expectations

Support initiatives beyond immediate area of responsibility and encourage cross-team interaction.
• Motivate people to think creatively and achieve success through others rather than through individual action alone.
• Consistently pursue self-development and advance the AHEAD delivery model for self and teammates.
• Operate as a self-starter who identifies needed work proactively rather than waiting for direction.
• Earn and maintain the respect of engineering peers, delivery leadership, and the sales organization.
• Bring a positive, team-oriented attitude toward AHEAD, its clients, and its partners, including willingness to extend effort beyond normal working hours for short intervals to support a client initiative or production rollout.

Work Environment: Ability to perform job duties in primarily remote, office, client site, or technical environments, which may include:

• Extended periods of sitting, typing, and working at a computer or in virtual meetings.
• Occasional standing, walking, bending, and lifting or moving laptops, monitors, or small equipment, generally up to twenty (20) pounds.
• Occasional exposure to client or production environments that may include higher noise levels, bright lighting, varying airflow, and changing temperatures.

Manual Dexterity: Ability to use hands and fingers to handle, feel, or operate objects, tools, or controls, and reach with hands and arms, as needed.

title: Civil Construction Commercial Claims & Change Coordinator
description:
About Atlas

Atlas is a trusted leader in environmental and infrastructure consulting services; we provide services that enable communities to flourish and thrive. With a team of 3,500 employees and offices throughout the US, we combine local expertise and a network of relationships to deliver solutions to both public and private clients. Our services help improve the quality of life in the communities where we live and work. We always aim for smart, safe, and sustainable results. At Atlas we understand that our future is everyone’s responsibility, and we create a better experience at every stage of a project.

Job Description

Commercial Claims & Changes Coordinator - This position provides assessment, coordinating and preparation of change orders on a major commuter rail infrastructure expansion project in the NYC metro area. As the claims and changes coordinator, the candidate will provide the Metropolitan Transportation Authority Construction & Development project team with critical services to assess and advance change orders on this $1.8B design-build project.

Core Responsibilities

  • Reviewing contract language and researching contract plans and documents in order to identify eligibility and merit for potential changes orders
  • Assisting in preparation of correspondence that lays out contractual positions of MTA
  • Assisting in preparation of request for change proposals
  • Assisting in preparation of change orders
  • Updating the Change Log, tracking of issue status (estimates, change summaries, etc.)
  • Provide detailed reports to Senior Management on change management status,
  • Providing contract research on issues requiring clarification
  • Maintain change order tracker
  • Assessment of contractor-provided time and materials records for payment eligibility

You’ll thrive here if you have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • 0 to 2 years of experience in a Change Order, Office Engineer, or similar construction/project support role.
  • Experience working with New York State capital construction agencies is preferred; experience with the Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) is highly desirable.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction plans, drawings, and specifications.
  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to prepare clear, accurate, and professional documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize, maintain, and manage large volumes of project data and documentation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and record-keeping skills.

What you can expect from us

The A-Team Experience is our employee program focused on helping our people thrive professionally, personally and as part of a community. We trust our people to do great work and live fulfilling lives, and we provide resources that care for our people, both at work and in life:

  • Health & Wellness: We offer medical, dental and vision coverage with multiple plan options, including no-cost employee-only medical coverage.

  • Time Off & Family Support: We offer vacation time, paid holidays, sick & safety leave (SSL) and paid parental leave

  • Retirement: We help employees plan for the future with a 401(k) and company match.

  • Insurance: To provide protection and peace of mind, we offer Life, AD&D (Accidental Death & Dismemberment) and Disability insurance.

  • Safety Program: We are committed to safety as part of our ‘quality of life’ core value, and we provide approved PPE at no cost and reimbursement for prescription safety glasses and protective footwear.

  • Learning & Development: We provide clear career paths, learning resources and development programs allowing you to see how you can grow and advance within the company. We offer internal certifications on specific skills and support external credentials through tuition reimbursement.

  • Belonging: We support Employee Communities (ECs), voluntary, employee-led groups that create connections, belonging and shared purposes.

  • Flexibility: May vary by project demands and regional workloads, but we are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to help employees manage their personal and professional responsibilities.

Our people and our culture are central to our work. Our values bring us together, create a sense of belonging and give us purpose. They guide how we make decisions, how we work as a team and how we serve our clients.

  • Life: We enhance the quality of life. We value people and safety above all else.

  • Heart: As our hallmark, we act with compassion, empathy, and respect.

  • Trust: We work together as partners, doing what we say with full accountability.

  • Mastery: Always striving for the highest quality, greatness inspires our work.

About the Job

  • Employment Type: Full-time

title: Fuel Systems Technician
description:
Join the TAIT Team – Build a Career with Purpose
Why TAIT?
Build a Career – Grow your electrical experience in a specialized fuel systems environment.
Advance Into Leadership – This role offers a pathway into a Construction Foreman position.
Expand Your Skills – Gain hands-on experience with testing, repairs, & construction.
Work With an Experienced Team – Learn from skilled professionals across a variety of projects.
Make an Impact – Help keep critical fuel systems safe, reliable, and compliant.
Ready to grow your electrical career in a specialized field? Join TAIT and build what’s next.

About the Role
The Fuel Systems Technician performs electrical, construction, maintenance, testing, and repair work on commercial fuel systems. This field-based role includes wiring and conduit installation, equipment diagnostics, compliance testing, construction support, and service calls, with a pathway into a Construction Foreman role.

What You’ll Do
  • Install and terminate conduit and wiring for fuel system components and emergency generator equipment.
  • Test, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair UST/AST systems and related electrical/electro-mechanical equipment.
  • Perform monitoring, secondary containment, spill bucket, and vapor recovery testing.
  • Support construction/repair projects and respond to maintenance and service calls.
  • Complete daily logs and progress reports; meet project deadlines.

title: RES Aggregation Analyst
description:

We are Enerwave, member of HELLENiQ ENERGY and a leader in providing outstanding and innovative energy solutions. Join our dynamic RES/DER Aggregation team and play a key role in shaping the future of renewable energy. We are to maintain the trust of our customers. We should make sure that while their vehicle is in our shop, we are careful to maintain the integrity of that vehicle. Make sure that doors are locked, windows rolled up, and parked in a secure area.

  • Ensure the parking lot remains organized
  • Assist technicians with parking and bringing vehicles in for service.
  • Ensure vehicles on the service drive are parked in a prompt manner.
  • Bring vehicles from the parking lot to the service drive for customer delivery.
  • Assist with pick-up and delivery of customer vehicles to and from the facility
  • Ensure the shop and parking lot remain clean

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to understand and follow directions
  • Skill and ability to organize and prioritize work
  • Be able to perform in a calm manner when under pressure
  • Ability to effectively establish rapport, present information, and respond to questions from managers and team members.
  • Ability to solve practical problems
  • Excellent oral communication skills are required.
  • Must be able to operate a forklift

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Must be able to drive and operate a motor vehicle.
  • Must be able to hear and speak clearly to communicate with others.
  • Must be able to ascend and descend a step ladder.
  • Must be able to stand, kneel, or crouch for extended periods of time.
  • Must be able to regularly lift and exert up to 50 pounds of force in order to carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects.
  • Must be able to climb into and out of medium-duty trucks
  • Must be able to perform job functions outside when it rains

WORKING CONDITIONS:

The successful candidate will be a highly motivated and organized individual. They will be able to work well in a family atmosphere and will take great pride in producing outstanding results and unparalleled quality with a sense of urgency

THE LOCATION:

Chastang Ford is located in Houston, TX approximately one-mile East of I-69 on the 610 North Loop East.

WHY SHOULD YOU APPLY:

  • Very competitive pay plans
  • 401k plan with company matching
  • Dealer-covered Health Saving Account
  • Dealer covered short-term and long-term disability, life insurance competitive pay plan
  • Paid Holidays Off
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
  • Employee discounts on vehicles, parts, and service work
  • Training and advancement opportunity
  • Drug-free work environment

title: Service Supervisor
description:
Discover a career at Depot Connect International (DCI), a global leader in the Tank/ISO Tank Container Services and Tank Trailer Parts industry. We're more than just a service provider; we're a unified team combining the expertise of industry leaders Quala, Boasso Global, and PSC. Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, with over 160 locations worldwide, our team of over 3,500 employees excels in offering a multitude of mission-critical services.

We are searching for a Service Supervisor to manage internal personnel and operations in a manner that provides for the optimization of resources and delivers world class customer service, resulting in the achievement of branch performance goals. This is a working Supervisor position.

Essential Job functions:

  • Interact with customers, assessing their service needs and quoting work as requested
  • Delegate workloads and actively support growth.
  • Oversee the open order aging report ensuring final invoices are presented timely with every repair.
  • Oversee the scheduling and work flow through the shop.
  • Ensure employees are qualified to perform the work being assigned
  • Interpret and insure that all NTTC, ASME/National Board and CFR regulations are followed.
  • Develop and maintain a high level of product knowledge within your staff.
  • Evaluate employee’s skills and recommend training as required.
  • Review and present requisitions when additional tooling is required.
  • Maintain appropriate departmental staffing in balance with branches requirements.
  • Provide daily reporting and all other duties assigned by the Branch Manage.
  • Advise and assist in the hiring process for department staff.

Skill Requirements:

  • Highly analytical and well organized, proficient with the use of computers and related software, customer service oriented; and
