title: Head of GTM Systems & AI
description:
Introduction to the Team & Role

What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
  • Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
  • Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
  • Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
  • Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
  • Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep-or-kill review, and renewals.
  • Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
  • Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.

What You'll Do

Within 1 month, you will:
  • Know the team, the stack, and the cross-functional leaders and teams you’ll partner with
  • Understand the main business challenges and opportunities for each GTM function
  • Own the team's current quarterly objectives and the routines that keep them visible.

Within 3 months, you will:
  • Have taken one major cross-functional change from plan to done
  • Own the full vendor-renewal cycle across the commercial stack
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.

Within 6 months, you will:
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.
  • Have shipped at least one AI agent that watches business data and reaches people on its own, with a named business owner and outcome measures agreed before launch.
  • Have a 12-18 month roadmap, setting the high-level vision across our systems infrastructure, ways of working, and AI portfolio

Within 12 months, you will:
  • Show, in numbers, the capacity the commercial organization reinvested because of what the team built.
  • Have a development path agreed with each member of the team.
  • Have the team recognized as the company's reference for AI-native operations

The Skill Set

  • 5+ years across GTM systems, agentic/AI workflow products, revenue technology, enterprise SaaS — or an adjacent path like technical product management or consulting where you designed and shipped real systems with a strong AI mandate.
  • Turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable tooling — you read a process, tell whether it's any good, spot where AI creates value, and judge when to automate (and when not to), across the full revenue engine.
  • Have fluency in modern GTM systems: Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, routing, attribution, lead-to-quote, billing or customer lifecycle tools. Deep Salesforce fluency is a strong plus.
  • Have built with modern AI tooling: agents, plugins or skills on top of LLMs, connectors to business systems, and evals that tell you whether an agent is good.
  • You define KPIs, run experiments, and use data to prioritize where to invest and to measure real impact on pipeline, conversion, efficiency and revenue.
  • You drive strategic alignment and executive communication — conclusion first, tradeoffs named, complex topics made simple — and you drive change through to adoption.
  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the first version of the strategy has to be shaped, tested and improved quickly.
  • Run vendor evaluations end to end
  • Set and hold standards for documentation, testing and deployment without slowing the team down, and coach senior ICs with care.
  • Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR).
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here:

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary and a variable component 📈
  • Benefits: Work From Home allowance, social security, health insurance, unemployment insurance, common contingency, salary guarantee fund. Leave requests are subject to local policies.
  • Balance: Flexible hours, Total work from home possible anywhere in Spain 🏠
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

title: MEP Project Manager
company: W. G. Yates & Sons Construction Company
description:
Position: MEP Project Manager - Data Center

Location: Jackson, GA

Job Overview:
The MEP Project Manager oversees the mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems for construction projects, ensuring the timely installation, testing, commissioning, and integration of these systems within budget and schedule. This role involves coordinating with architects, engineers, subcontractors, and other stakeholders to ensure compliance with project specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements.

With extensive knowledge of MEP systems, building codes, and regulations, the MEP Project Manager leads a team of engineers and subcontractors, manages project risks, resolves technical issues, and ensures successful project delivery. The role demands strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills, with a focus on delivering projects that meet or exceed client expectations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the planning and coordination of all MEP systems installation and integration throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Review and analyze project plans, specifications, and contracts to fully understand MEP requirements and project goals.
  • Develop and manage the MEP portion of the project schedule, ensuring the timely completion of all tasks and deliverables.
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers, and other construction managers to ensure seamless integration of MEP systems into the overall project design and construction schedule.
  • Oversee the procurement and delivery of materials and equipment for MEP systems, ensuring timely availability.
  • Manage subcontractors to ensure cost-effective and efficient execution of MEP work within the project timeline.
  • Supervise MEP teams, subcontractors, and field staff, providing leadership and guidance to ensure work is completed to high standards and in accordance with project specifications.
  • Assign tasks, monitor progress, and provide guidance and support to maintain project momentum and ensure timely completion of MEP systems.
  • Foster a collaborative work environment, ensuring effective communication and coordination between all project stakeholders, including design, construction, and subcontractor teams.
  • Mentor and develop MEP engineers, field staff, and subcontractors, ensuring they have the necessary resources, training, and direction to perform their tasks effectively.
  • Conduct regular team meetings, providing feedback and resolving any conflicts or issues that may arise during project execution.
  • Ensure all team members adhere to project safety standards, quality requirements, and company policies.
  • Develop, monitor, and control MEP project budgets, ensuring projects stay within financial constraints.
  • Track labor, material, and equipment costs related to the MEP systems, ensuring efficient use of resources.
  • Prepare cost estimates and manage change orders, ensuring that project changes are documented and communicated.
  • Ensure MEP systems are installed according to project specifications, codes, and industry standards.
  • Conduct regular inspections of MEP systems and components to verify that all work meets quality standards and is in compliance with safety regulations.
  • Manage testing and commissioning of MEP systems to ensure proper functionality and compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Address and resolve any issues with MEP installations, including non-compliance with specifications or delays.
  • Enforce safety protocols and ensure a safe work environment for all personnel, maintaining compliance with OSHA standards, local building codes, fire codes, environmental regulations, and company policies.
  • Conduct regular safety audits, inspections, and toolbox talks to identify hazards, assess risks, and ensure adherence to safety guidelines across all MEP activities.
  • Monitor MEP system installations, testing, and commissioning to ensure safe operations, providing guidance and corrective actions where necessary.
  • Ensure all team members, including subcontractors, are trained in safety protocols and the proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Investigate any accidents, near-misses, or safety incidents, conducting root cause analyses and implementing corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Maintain accurate safety records and documentation in compliance with all applicable legal, regulatory, and company requirements.
  • Foster a culture of safety by encouraging proactive reporting of hazards and ensuring immediate corrective actions are taken.
  • Ensure all MEP work is performed in accordance with company safety standards and policies, contributing to a zero-incident work environment.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MEP-related issues with clients, contractors, and other stakeholders.
  • Prepare and deliver regular project updates and reports to senior management, clients, and other stakeholders, outlining progress, challenges, and risks.
  • Participate in project meetings and provide input on MEP design, scheduling, and implementation.
  • Proactively identify and assess risks to MEP system installation, such as schedule delays, budget overruns, and technical challenges, and develop strategies to mitigate them.
  • Monitor project progress and adjust plans as necessary to minimize risks and keep a project on track.
  • Collaborate with the project team to resolve technical issues, address conflicts, and rectify design discrepancies, ensuring timely resolution and alignment with project objectives.
  • Resolve technical and logistical challenges by finding innovative solutions in collaboration with stakeholders, keeping the project moving smoothly.
  • Manage scope changes related to MEP systems, evaluating and integrating them into the project plan with minimal disruption to the timeline or budget.
  • Implement corrective actions for delays or issues, maintaining clear communication with the team and tracking progress on resolutions.
  • Provide troubleshooting and problem-solving support to the MEP team and subcontractors, ensuring solutions comply with industry standards and regulations.
  • Monitor field risks by continuously assessing safety, quality, and environmental concerns, taking proactive action when necessary.
  • Report and manage risks to senior management, recommending risk mitigation plans and alternatives for any project challenges.

Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field is required.

Experience:

  • 5-10 years of experience in managing MEP projects within the construction industry, with a focus on large commercial or industrial projects.
  • Proven track record of managing MEP systems installation and integration in complex construction environments.
  • Proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams and coordinating with subcontractors, engineers, and architects.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time, within budget, and to safety and quality standards.
  • In-depth knowledge of building codes, safety regulations, and industry standards for MEP systems.
  • Proficiency with construction management software (e.g., Procore) and technical drawings.

Skills:

  • Extensive knowledge of MEP systems, including mechanical, electrical, and plumbing design and installation processes.
  • Strong understanding of building codes, regulations, and industry standards (e.g., NEC, ASHRAE, NFPA).
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical drawings.
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in project management software and tools, including Procore, and Primavera.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to visit and work in construction site environments, including standing, walking, and lifting up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work in all weather conditions, at heights, or in confined spaces as required.

Working Conditions:

  • Work will be performed in both office and construction site environments.
  • May require working extended hours, including nights and weekends, to meet project deadlines and resolve urgent on-site issues.
  • Frequent travel to and from job sites may be required.

About Yates Construction

Ranked among the top commercial and industrial construction companies in the country by Engineering News-Record, Yates Construction is family-owned and provides a wide range of construction and building services. Incorporated in 1964 by William G. Yates Jr., we have steadily grown to become one of the top commercial and industrial construction companies in the nation. We are financially sound with a significant bonding capacity as well as vast personnel and equipment resources.

title: Scrum master till Transportstyrelsen
description:
Vi får samhället att fungera för människor på väg, på spår, i luften och på sjön. Därför behöver vi den bästa kompetensen. Vårt uppdrag är viktigt och har betydelse i vardagen – både för privatpersoner och företag. Hos oss tar vi ansvar, behandlar alla på ett bra sätt och har respekt för olikheter. Som medarbetare bidrar du till en hållbar framtid.

Om jobbet

När team fungerar som bäst händer det något – idéer blir lösningar, hinder blir möjligheter och värde skapas snabbare. Vill du vara med och få det att hända?

Som scrum master har du uppgiften att främja samarbete och kommunikation i och utanför utvecklingsteamen med ett agilt förhållningssätt som grund. Med ett kommunikativt och coachande förhållningssätt ledsagar du teamen i att driva på mot att leverera värde utifrån de gemensamma regler ni har satt upp. Tillsammans strävar ni för att ständigt förbättra arbetet med att nå teamens mål, utveckla med rätt kvalitet och hålla en kontinuerlig och uthållig flödestakt.

Du stöttar produktägarna i att hantera backloggen och kan också fungera som teamens talesperson i olika nätverk. I rollen som scrum master bistår du teamen med att identifiera hinder och undanröja dessa. Du kommer även att hjälpa till med mer it-inriktade frågor och arbetsuppgifter, t ex releaseplanera, planera uppgraderingar och beställa förutsättningar för drift.

Hos oss är du viktig

Gillar du att jobba tillsammans med andra och vill du utvecklas i din yrkesroll? Hos oss kan du förvänta dig karriärsutveckling, ett förtroendefullt chefs- och medarbetarskap och ett hållbart arbetsliv. Vi är en trygg arbetsgivare som månar om din hälsa med tid för friskvård på arbetstid, flexibla arbetstider, väl tilltaget antal semesterdagar och lediga klämdagar.

Läs mer om hur det är att jobba på Transportstyrelsen

Du kommer att

  • hjälpa teamen att utveckla arbetssätt, upprätthålla en hållbar leveranstakt och arbeta med ständiga förbättringar
  • stödja produktområdet i it-relaterade frågor
  • samordna operativa/taktiska frågeställningar med andra produktområden, it:s linjeverksamhet och driftleverantören.

Du måste ha

  • akademisk utbildning inom ett för tjänsten relevant område eller motsvarande kunskap förvärvad på annat sätt som Transportstyrelsen bedömer likvärdig
  • flerårig aktuell erfarenhet av att arbeta som scrum master, vilket innebär att du bland annat arbetat med att leda och coacha team, samarbetat med produktägare, identifierat och undanröjt hinder
  • mycket goda kunskaper om scrum, agila värderingar och principer inom området
  • goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du också har

  • erfarenhet av coachande och kommunikativt ledarskap
  • arbetat i Azure DevOps Server
  • erfarenhet av förändringsarbete
  • erfarenhet av att arbeta med decentraliserade team, där teammedlemmar finns placerade på olika orter
  • erfarenhet av test och/eller kravarbete
  • arbetat med IMGD modellen för grupputveckling.

Vi vill att du

  • anammar vår värdegrund som visar att vi är möjliggörare, vi är modiga och tar ansvar och vi är hjälpsamma
  • är självgående och tar ansvar för din uppgift, strukturerar själv ditt angreppssätt och driver dina processer vidare
  • har en god samarbetsförmåga där du anpassar dig efter omgivningen och har ett prestigelöst fokus på det gemensamma målet
  • har en god kommunikationsförmåga, är lyhörd, ödmjuk och anpassar dig efter såväl mottagare som situation för att skapa bra relationer samt arbetsklimat
  • är analytisk och löser problem utan att missa de långsiktiga strategierna, du ser logik och samband i komplex information eller miljö.

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Mer information

Anställningen är tillsvidare med placering i Örebro eller Stockholm. Om du blir placerad i Stockholm behöver du vara inställd på regelbunden närvaro i Örebro då stora delar av teamen är placerade där. Tillsättning enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar normalt provanställning. Möjlighet till distansarbete finns utifrån verksamhetens behov. En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.

Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta sektionschef Stig-Erik Persson, 010-495 35 11, stig-erik.persson@transportstyrelsen.se

ST, Mikaela Schmidt och Saco-S, Benedicte Johansson nås via vår växel på 0771-503 503.

Vi vill inte att annonsörer och bemanningsföretag kontaktar oss.

Ansök

Ansök via vår webbplats och bifoga ett komplett CV samt ett personligt brev märkt med referensnummer TSG 2026-8320. Vi behöver din ansökan senast den 2026-10-09. Har du skyddade personuppgifter, kontakta rekryterande chef för information om hur du går tillväga. I dina ansökningshandlingar behöver du beskriva på vilket sätt du uppfyller efterfrågade kvalifikationer och meriter kopplat till aktuell rekrytering. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid utbildnings-/examensbevis samt tjänstgöringsintyg som styrker de kunskaper och erfarenheter som är relevanta för tjänsten uppvisas.

Välkommen att bli vår nya kollega!

Kort om Transportstyrelsen

Transportstyrelsen arbetar för att uppnå god tillgänglighet, hög kvalitet, säkra och miljöanpassade transporter inom järnväg, luftfart, sjöfart och väg. Vi tar fram regler, ger tillstånd och följer upp hur de efterlevs. Med hjälp av våra register arbetar vi bland annat med avgifter, tillstånd och ägarbyten.

Läs mer om Transportstyrelsen

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Founded in 2020 and based in the heart of Paris, C12’s mission is to be at the center of one of the biggest technological breakthroughs of the century and change the course of history by building a universal quantum computer.
At C12, we believe that achieving a true breakthrough in quantum computing requires rethinking the fundamentals. That’s why our founders—deeply rooted in academic and engineering excellence—have chosen carbon nanotubes as the building blocks of our quantum processors. This ultra-pure material dramatically reduces error rates, boosts performance, and minimizes hardware overhead—key ingredients for scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computing. By crafting a unique approach that scales, we aim to revolutionize quantum computing just as silicon transformed classical computing.
Since our founding, we’ve raised over €25 million in funding, published 11 scientific papers, and secured 8 patents. Today, our fast-growing team of 80+, including 25 PhDs, has over 26 nationalities represented. We have our own cutting-edge lab spaces in Paris' historic Panthéon district, where scientists, engineers, and innovators work side-by-side to tackle some of the most exciting technical challenges of our time.
If you're passionate about shaping the future of quantum technology and want to make a real impact, C12 offers a unique environment to grow, learn, and innovate.

Your role at C12 Quantum Electronics:

The Software team is here to assist and facilitate the work of the research teams towards building a quantum computer.
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be at the forefront of shaping the future of quantum measurement and help build the framework that runs experiments on quantum computers. Your expertise will drive the development and innovative solution that bridges the gaps between our R&D and engineering, enabling breakthrough in quantum technology.
Key responsibilities:
  • Lead the design and development of our core quantum measurement software framework, ensuring high performance and long-term maintainability
  • Partner with our R&D and other engineering teams at C12 to translate complex experimental requirements into robust, scalable software solutions
  • Define and document the unified architecture for instrument control, high-throughput data storage, and measurement orchestration to support framework growth
  • Champion rigorous software practices, including comprehensive code reviews, proactive design discussions, and robust CI/CD and automated testing pipelines
  • Take ownership of the full software lifecycle, delivering robust, secure, and scalable solutions that meet the rigorous demands of quantum R&D
  • Cultivate a culture of continuous learning by mentoring junior engineers and leading by example in code quality and system design

About you:

  • You have 5+ years of experience building robust backend systems or data-intensive applications
  • You are comfortable working with Python as a primary language; if coming from another background, you are eager to master the ecosystem
  • You’re familiar or comfortable working with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, ZeroMQ, Kafka) and relational databases (PostgreSQL), SQLAlchemy, etc
  • Prior experience with orchestration tools like Prefect or Airflow is a strong plus
  • A background in physics, engineering, or another quantitative field is a strong plus
  • You are curious, adaptable, ready to discover new languages/frameworks/apis
  • A problem solver that tries to use the best tool for the job
  • You communicate clearly in English and work well in collaborative development environments
What we offer:
  • 60,000 euros - 78,000 euros yearly base salary
  • Stock options for every employee (BSPCE/ESOP)
  • Sponsored trip to conferences around the world
  • A highly dynamic international team
  • Swile meal vouchers
  • Mental health support with
  • Training budget/ Annual Learning & Development Allowance
  • Sabbatical leave (after 2 years in the company)
  • Vibrant office culture (two office spaces in the heart of Paris, team lunches, offsite events, Friday breakfasts..)

You should join us if...

  • You like hands-on work and technology
  • You want to contribute to achieving landmark results in quantum computing, making a difference in the emerging quantum technologies
  • You want to work within a team of 80+ people with various backgrounds in nanofabrication, quantum electronics, and carbon nanotube science to create a revolutionary quantum computing processor
  • You want to thrive in an exceptional scientific environment with several industrial and academic partners
  • You share our values (excellence, scientific integrity, diversity, curiosity, and care) and want to help us define our product-focused culture and ambition to accelerate
We still encourage even if you don’t meet all the requirements. Rest assured, we are committed to finding the right fit for our team and are open to adjusting compensations based on skills and experiences.
Applications from women are especially welcomed!

  • Identify technical risks, design constraints, and opportunities for improvement and develop appropriate solutions.

Multidisciplinary Coordination
  • Coordinate structural engineering activities with civil, mechanical, electrical, architectural, process, and other project disciplines.

Mentoring & Knowledge Development
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and intermediate structural engineers and designers.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience with steel, reinforced concrete, foundations, and other structural systems relevant to energy and infrastructure projects.
  • Ability to interpret and develop engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, reports, and technical documentation.
  • Experience coordinating structural designs with multiple engineering disciplines and project stakeholders.
  • Strong technical judgment, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, technical deliverables, and project deadlines.

title: Healthcare Claims Processor
description:
Position: Healthcare Claims Processor
Location: Remote, Eastern Standard Time (EST) based in the Continental United States.
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt, Full-Time
Reports To: Claims Supervisor

Overview:
J29 is an employee centered health and human service management consulting company that specializes in processing, reviewing, and analyzing claims, records, disputes, and audits. Established in 2017, J29 prides itself on its employee centric culture and high employee retention rates that allow us to ensure that we are creating a working environment that prioritizes the employee experience. Our team brings corporate performance where we provide our clinical, healthcare policy, and compliance expertise through our support to health and human service programs.

J29 is seeking a Junior Healthcare Claims Analyst/Adjudicator to support healthcare claims operations. This entry-level to early-career position is responsible for reviewing and processing healthcare claims in accordance with established procedures, benefit requirements, system rules, and quality standards.

The Junior Healthcare Claims Analyst/Adjudicator will complete routine claims processing activities, verify claim and member information, review claims for completeness and accuracy, apply documented processing rules, and escalate exceptions or complex issues to senior team members. The position does not require supervisory, leadership, or client-facing experience. The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, dependable, comfortable working in a structured production environment, and willing to learn specialized benefit and claims processing requirements.

Duties:

Claims Review and Adjudication
  • Review professional, institutional, and other healthcare claims for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with established procedures.
  • Verify member eligibility, dates of service, provider information, billed services, authorization information, and other required claim data.
  • Apply documented benefit rules, reimbursement guidelines, system edits, and processing instructions to adjudicate claims accurately.
  • Process routine claims, adjustments, corrections, pends, denials, and rejections within assigned authority and training.
  • Identify missing, conflicting, or incomplete information and follow established procedures to resolve or escalate the issue.
  • Review claim history and available supporting documentation before making or recommending a processing decision.
  • Document claim actions, research, and processing decisions clearly in the applicable system.

Claims Research and Issue Resolution
  • Research routine claim edits, payment questions, duplicate claims, eligibility issues, authorization requirements, and coding-related discrepancies.
  • Compare claim information with available benefit, eligibility, authorization, provider, and payment records.
  • Use desk guides, standard operating procedures, system references, and other approved resources to resolve assigned claims.
  • Escalate complex claims, unclear requirements, unusual billing situations, and potential system defects to senior analysts or supervisors.
  • Respond promptly to requests for additional information or correction of processing errors.
  • Support claim reprocessing activities when corrections or adjustments are required.

Quality, Accuracy, and Productivity
  • Meet established expectations for claim accuracy, productivity, timeliness, and documentation.
  • Review work carefully before finalizing claim decisions.
  • Participate in quality reviews, feedback sessions, refresher training, and corrective action activities.
  • Apply feedback from quality reviewers, trainers, and supervisors to improve individual performance.
  • Notify the supervisor or lead when recurring issues, unclear instructions, or potential process gaps are identified.
  • Maintain accurate records of assigned work and completed activities.

Training and Operational Support
  • Complete required claims processing, system, privacy, security, and program-specific training.
  • Learn and consistently follow standard operating procedures, desk guides, job aids, and escalation protocols.
  • Participate in claims scenarios, system testing, workflow exercises, and readiness activities when requested.
  • Ask questions and seek guidance when processing requirements are unclear.
  • Maintain current knowledge of procedural and system updates communicated by management.
  • Support team workload priorities and assist with additional claims-related assignments as needed.

Compliance and Information Protection
  • Protect confidential member, patient, provider, and claims information.
  • Follow applicable privacy, security, records-management, and information-handling requirements.
  • Process claims objectively and consistently using approved procedures and available documentation.
  • Immediately report suspected privacy incidents, data concerns, payment discrepancies, or potential fraud, waste, or abuse through established channels.
  • Maintain a secure and professional remote work environment.

Experience:
  • One to three years of experience in healthcare claims processing, medical billing, provider billing, health insurance operations, healthcare administration, data entry, customer service, or a related field is preferred.
  • Previous healthcare claims adjudication experience is helpful but not required for candidates with relevant healthcare operations or medical billing experience.
  • Basic understanding of the healthcare claims lifecycle, including claim submission, review, payment, denial, rejection, adjustment, and escalation.
  • Ability to follow detailed written procedures and apply established rules consistently.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate data entry and documentation.
  • Ability to identify incomplete or inconsistent information and escalate questions appropriately.
  • Basic analytical, research, organization, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently after training while remaining receptive to guidance and quality feedback.
  • Ability to manage assigned work and meet production and turnaround-time expectations in a remote environment.
  • Clear written communication skills for documenting claim actions and questions.
  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Teams, Outlook, and other computer-based systems.
  • Ability to learn healthcare claims systems and work efficiently across multiple screens or applications.
  • No supervisory, team-lead, or formal client-facing experience is required.

Preferred Experience
  • Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, third-party administrator, workers’ compensation, occupational health, or specialized health benefit claims.
  • Familiarity with professional or institutional healthcare claims.
  • General knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, revenue codes, modifiers, and medical billing terminology.
  • Familiarity with eligibility verification, prior authorization, referrals, coordination of benefits, or provider reimbursement.
  • Experience using a healthcare claims processing, medical billing, electronic health record, workflow, or case-management system.
  • Familiarity with electronic healthcare transactions, including 835 and 837 files.
  • Experience reviewing medical bills, explanations of benefits, remittance information, or claim status information.
  • Healthcare claims, medical billing, coding, health information management, or related training or certification.

Education:
  • High school diploma or equivalent is required.
  • Associate degree, bachelor’s degree, or coursework in healthcare administration, business administration, medical billing, health information management, or a related field is preferred.
  • Relevant healthcare claims, billing, coding, or insurance experience may substitute for postsecondary education.
  • Claims-related certification or training is preferred but not required.

title: Shipper Receiver - 2nd shift
description:
Powering Operational Excellence Through Reliable Shipping & Receiving Support!

MEPPI’s Switchgear Division (SWGD) is seeking a detail-oriented and safety-focused Shipper Receiver to support critical warehouse, inventory, and logistics operations. In this role, you will ensure the accurate receiving, stocking, tracking, and shipment of materials, parts, supplies, and equipment that support SWGD manufacturing operations. You’ll help maintain inventory accuracy, coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, and support efficient material flow throughout the facility.

What You'll Do

Manage Inventory Transactions: Utilize the business system to process purchase order data, verify inventory locations, review on-hand quantities, and perform location transfers as needed.

Support Shipping & Receiving Operations: Process shipping and receiving transactions within the business system, including scanning packing slips and documentation, printing labels, and ensuring inbound materials are properly identified.

Verify Customer Shipments: Review Customer Order Pick Lists and shipping documents for accuracy; identify discrepancies, coordinate corrections with production, obtain required approvals, and ensure proper documentation accompanies shipments.

Coordinate Transportation Activities: Communicate and coordinate with truck drivers to facilitate safe and efficient loading and unloading activities.

Train & Support Shipping Functions: Assist with shipping coordination and train team members on shipping procedures while safely utilizing hand tools, power tools, forklifts, and cranes.

Receive & Process Incoming Materials: Receive deliveries, verify shipments against purchase orders, uncrate materials, and move inventory to designated storage locations.

Prepare & Load Shipments: Package components for shipment and load circuit breakers, parts, and associated materials onto trucks in accordance with shipping requirements.

Maintain Storage Areas: Organize and maintain storage areas for materials and parts associated with switchgear shipments.

Verify Deliveries & Resolve Discrepancies: Count and verify received materials against supplier packing lists and work with Buyers to resolve discrepancies.

Support Quality Standards: Inspect incoming materials and packaging for damage and immediately report issues to Quality Control, Purchasing, and Supervisors.

Manage Shipping Documentation: Review bills of lading, shipping paperwork, and packing lists to ensure accuracy and completeness.

Prevent Short Shipments: Investigate and locate missing materials to ensure shipments are complete and customer commitments are met.

Prepare Supplier Shipments: Package and prepare auxiliary switches and related materials for shipment to panel suppliers.

Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Follow C-TPAT, JSOX, MSDS, and company procedures while ensuring all required transactions are properly documented.

Support Department Leadership: Assist Supervisors and team members with daily operational requirements.

Promote Division Excellence: Further the positive and professional image of SWGD through effective interaction with internal departments, customers, and vendors.

Champion Safety & Quality: Maintain a strong understanding of MEPPI’s Quality, Safety, and Environmental policies and apply them consistently in daily work.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Maintain tools, equipment, and work areas in a clean and organized manner.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You Bring

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Minimum of 2 years of warehousing experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Technical Skills

  • Experience operating forklifts, cranes, and other warehouse equipment
  • Intermediate computer skills with Microsoft Office and ERP/MRP systems
  • Ability to safely use hand tools, power tools, and measurement devices

Skills & Attributes

  • Strong attention to detail and organization
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and customer service

Physical & Work Requirements

  • Ability to safely use hand tools, power tools, and measurement devices
  • Ability to perform computer-based data entry activities
  • Ability to read, write, and follow instructions
  • Ability to perform basic arithmetic and understand metric measurements
  • Ability to operate powered equipment, including forklifts and cranes
  • Ability to stand, sit, crawl, squat, kneel, twist, bend, and reach overhead as required
  • Ability to work indoors and outdoors for extended periods
  • Ability to lift up to 35 pounds regularly and 50 pounds occasionally
  • Ability to pass a medical examination for Commercial Driver Fitness Determination to operate company vehicles
  • Valid driver’s license required

What’s in It for You?

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: MEPPI pays 90% of the cost for medical, dental, and vision plans
  • Retirement Plans: 401(k) with company match up to 4%
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Vacation eligibility after 90 days, plus 12 paid holidays annually
  • Career Development: Training programs, skill development opportunities, and educational assistance
  • Exclusive Employee Perks: Profit sharing, access to our 24/7 fitness center in Warrendale, PA, and participation in MEPPI’s Wellness Program

Why MEPPI

At MEPPI, shipping and receiving operations play a critical role in supporting the delivery of high-quality switchgear products that power essential infrastructure across North America. As a Shipper Receiver, you'll contribute directly to operational success while working in a collaborative environment focused on safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

About Us

Mitsubishi Electric Power Products, Inc. is a leader in power systems, rail transportation, and switchgear technologies across North America. The Switchgear Division supports reliable electrical infrastructure through innovative engineering, advanced manufacturing, and world-class customer support.

Equal Opportunity Employer

MEPPI is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and ensure fair and equitable consideration for all candidates.

Notice to Agencies and Search Firms

MEPPI does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms. Any resume submitted without a signed agreement becomes the property of MEPPI, and no fee will be paid if a candidate is hired as a result of an unsolicited referral.

title: Servicetekniker Brand till Nordic LEVEL
description:
Brinner du för brandteknik och vill ta dig an branschens mest avancerade anläggningar? Nordic LEVEL växer och söker nu en erfaren Servicetekniker inom Brand som vill arbeta med komplexa system hos kunder där kraven på kompetens, kvalitet och dokumentation är som allra högst.

Om Bolaget

Hos Nordic LEVEL Technology utvecklar man framtidens säkerhetslösningar – varje dag. Här skyddar man människor, fastigheter och samhällsviktiga funktioner med teknik i framkant och stark lokal närvaro. Med spetskompetens inom Brandsäkerhet, Hospitality & Care, Rental samt det flexibla konceptet Security as a Service erbjuder bolaget skräddarsydda helhetslösningar som gör verklig skillnad. Nordic LEVEL är ett växande bolag där engagemang, innovation och trygghet genomsyrar allt man gör – både för kunderna och medarbetarna.

Nordic LEVEL är ett förvärvsdrivet och börsnoterat bolag och nu växer man kraftigt; de senaste åren har man gått från 140 till 400 miljoner i omsättning. I och med denna framgångsresa välkomnar man nu dig och ger dig chansen att bli en del av det vassa serviceteamet i Sundbyberg.

Här är företagskulturen öppen och trevlig och genomsyras av en affärsdriven atmosfär med utrymme för både individuell utveckling och team-spirit. Som kvitto på detta har Nordic LEVEL utmärkelsen "Great Place to Work". Till skillnad från många konkurrenter i branschen kan du här avnjuta en icke-hierarkisk miljö där cheferna är nära och beslutsvägarna korta. Du tillhör ett sammansvetsat serviceteam med både tekniker och servicekoordinatorer, du har en flexibel vardag och mycket frihet under ansvar. Dessutom ingår såklart förmånsbil i tjänsten. Detta vill du inte missa!

Om rollen

Som Servicetekniker inom Brand på Nordic LEVEL blir du en nyckelperson i bolagets serviceteam med fokus på brand. Du arbetar med service, felsökning, driftsättning och underhåll av brandlarmsanläggningar – och ansvarar för årsrevisioner och årsprover hos kund.

Det här är en roll för dig som verkligen kan ditt område. Du kommer främst att arbeta mot bolagets större anläggningar, bland annat datacenter och andra samhällsviktiga verksamheter, där kraven på specifik kompetens och hög kvalitet är omfattande. Det är ett segment Nordic LEVEL satsar på, och du blir en av dem som bär det framåt.

Rollen innebär mycket kundkontakt där du fungerar som både teknisk expert och rådgivare. Du planerar dina egna prover och revisioner, medan servicekoordinatorerna planerar in de akuta besöken. I rollen kan du även komma i kontakt med bolagets övriga teknikområden, som larm, passersystem och CCTV. Har du erfarenhet även därifrån ser vi det som meriterande.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

• Installera, konfigurera och driftsätta av brandlarmsanläggningar

• Utföra service, underhåll och felsökning & genomföra revisioner

• Arbeta med aspirationssystem och högkänsliga detektorer

• Säkerställa att anläggningar följer gällande regelverk och säkerhetsstandarder

• Ge teknisk rådgivning och support till kunder

• Dokumentera och rapportera utfört arbete

• Samarbeta med kollegor och bidra till ständiga förbättringar

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har gedigen och specifik erfarenhet inom brand. Du trivs i en varierad roll där du får kombinera teknik med kundkontakt och problemlösning, och du är trygg nog att kliva in på anläggningar där det inte finns utrymme för gissningar.

Våra skallkrav:

• Minst 5 års erfarenhet av installation och underhåll av brandlarm

• Erfarenhet av att arbeta med aspirationssystem

• God förståelse för IP-baserade system och nätverksteknik

• B-körkort samt mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

Meriterande:

• Erfarenhet av system från Honeywell, Securifire eller Schneider

• Erfarenhet av datacenter eller andra anläggningar med höga säkerhetskrav

• Erfarenhet av våra andra teknikområden larm, passersystem och CCTV

• Certifieringar inom brand och UTM

Som person är du socialt skicklig och lösningsorienterad i dit arbete, kunderna i det här segmentet ställer krav, och du är den som löser situationen. Du är självgående, noggrann och har ett affärsmässigt förhållningssätt. Du är en trygg representant för företaget ute hos kund och trivs i ett team med hög kompetens och stark gemenskap.

Nordic LEVEL erbjuder

På Nordic LEVEL får du möjlighet att utvecklas i en innovativ miljö med både teknisk spets och starkt kundfokus.

Du erbjuds:

• En dynamisk arbetsmiljö med stora utvecklingsmöjligheter

• Tydlig karriärplan

• Interna och externa utbildningar

• Tjänstebil/förmånsbil

• Kollektivavtal, Sjukvårdsförsäkring och maximal friskvård

• Marknadsmässig lön och provision

• Möjlighet att arbeta med några av landets mest avancerade brandlarmsanläggningar

Övrig information

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare med inledande provanställning Start: Enligt överenskommelse med hänsyn till uppsägningstid Omfattning: Heltid, måndag-fredag, 7-16. Plats: Stockholm, Västerås, Eskilstuna, Katrineholm

Den här rekryteringsprocessen hanteras av A-hub, och mail angående tjänsten går genom A-hub. Ansök genom att klicka på "Ansök" nedan. Tänk på att vi lägger stor vikt vid din motivation och intresse för tjänsten. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mejl, men om du har specifika frågor om tjänsten kommer ansvarig rekryterare att svara på dem.

Rekryteringsprocess

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar Nordic LEVEL med A-hub. Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: [India] Lead - Data Scientist
description:

title: Director, Analytical Development
description:
The Director Analytical Development, ADQC is a leadership position within Analytical Development and Quality Control (ADQC) department, responsible for providing strategic and technical leadership for analytical development activities supporting biologics programs from early phase to pivotal phase, BLA/MAA submission, and commercialization. This role will lead phase appropriate analytical control strategy, method development, qualification/validation, method transfer to internal and external laboratories, method lifecycle management, and ensure analytical readiness to support CMC milestones and regulatory submissions.
The incumbent will work closely with Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Process Development, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, and external partners to establish robust scientifically sound, phase -appropriate analytical strategies.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring strong scientific judgement, hands-on laboratory expertise, and the ability to effectively develop junior staff and manage external partners in a highly regulated, fast-paced environment.

Duties and Responsibilities (Responsibilities include but are not limited to):
  • Provide strategic and technical leadership for analytical development activities for biologics, including phase appropriate analytical control strategies, late stage/commercial assay reduction strategy, method development, validation, transfer to internal and external QC labs, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure analytical readiness for late‑stage development, PPQ, and commercial launch of SAB-142 polyclonal antibody program.
  • Oversee and perform hands-on analytical work at SAB’s development and GMP labs.
  • Provide hands-on and supervisory support to method troubleshooting, method optimization, method bridging, method performance monitoring, investigations (deviations, system suitability failure, OOT, OOS), CAPA, change control, and continuous method improvement initiatives.
  • Lead and manage reference standard program, critical reagent program, extended characterization strategies and testing, forced degradation/stress sample study, comparability, and specification setting.
  • Ensure analytical activities performed internally and at external partners are scientifically rigorous, comply with cGMP, ICH, USP, global regulations, and QbD principles, and align with industry’s best practices and company quality standards.
  • Authoring and ownership of regulatory CMC analytical sections, as well as the ability to provide technical input across all CMC-related sections.
  • Scale analytical capabilities, oversee equipment qualification and maintenance, implement workflows and LIMS, and design/establish non-GMP development lab area.
  • Signature authority for all analytical documents and data.
  • Partner closely with Quality Control and Quality Assurance to establish, maintain, and oversee analytical quality, GMP compliance infrastructure, and inspection readiness for internal and external analytical documents and data.
  • Other duties/responsibilities as assigned.
Supervisory Responsibilities:
This position has supervisory responsibilities.

Education/Experience/Skills:
  • Advanced degree (PhD preferred) in Biochemistry, Biophysics or a related discipline, with 8+ years of biopharma industry experience, of which at-least 4 years in management role, in analytical development for biologics.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in A280, HPLC, CE, LC-MS, ELISA, and cell-based potency methods for biologics. Experience in flow cytometry desired.
  • Proficient in trend analysis and simple statistical analysis.
  • Strong understanding of phase‑appropriate analytical control strategies, method validation, method transfer and applicable guidelines (ICHQ2R2, ICH Q14, FDA guidance documents, USP chapters etc.) with deep expertise in cGMP requirements.
  • Experience in reference standard program, critical reagent program, and forced degradation study
  • Demonstrated success supporting regulatory submissions (IND/IMPD, BLA/MAA).
  • Proven experience managing external partners and driving outsourced analytical activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, small biotech/pharma environment with experience in late-phase pre-commercial biotech/pharma particularly desirable.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and technical writing skills and the ability to effectively present information in one-on-one, departmental, and cross-functional meetings.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).
Working Environment and Travel:
Duties will be performed in normal office, laboratory and BSL2 laboratory environments.
Travel is not typical for this position.

Physical Requirements:
Ability to regularly move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this individual include close vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee will view a computer monitor for long periods of time.

title: Logistics Associate
description:
Are you detail-oriented, able to multitask, and thrive when working independently? At Omega Bio-tek, we’re looking for a Logistics Associate to join our team and play a crucial role in the distribution, storage, delivery, inventory control, and inspection of incoming and outgoing products. If you’re someone who’s reliable, energetic, not afraid to hustle and get the job done right we’re looking for you!

What You'll Do

  • Accurately pick, pack and ship orders by following standard operating procedure
  • Receive incoming shipments from vendors – rejects damaged items, records shortages and corresponds with shipper to rectify damages and shortages
  • Operate forklift and pallet jack to move materials to and from loading docks, delivery trucks, storage areas and manufacturing areas
  • Perform physical inventory of raw materials, work in progress and finished goods through cycle counts on a timely basis
  • Contact freight carriers to schedule pick-up of goods and prepare BOL for shipments
  • Scan all shipped orders into the database and update information in a timely manner
  • Communicate any shipping delays or product shortages
  • Maintain the work area in a clean and orderly condition and follows all company safety regulations
  • Follow established company SOP and ISO Guidelines
  • Other duties as assigned

What You'll Bring

  • At least 1-2 years of shipping and receiving experience in a manufacturing environment
  • Experience working with any Warehouse management software or ERP system
  • Experience with DOT and IATA regulations for hazardous shipments
  • Prior experience with freight forwarders for organizing and scheduling international shipment
  • Experience with Microsoft Office – Outlook, Excel, and Word
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Effective communication skills

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 100% employer paid short term and long-term disability & life insurance
  • Generous PTO package
  • Paid day off to celebrate your birthday!
  • Quarterly and yearly bonus incentives
  • Up to 4% match for 401k and Roth
  • Pet insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee Discount Program
  • And much more!

What Else You Need To Know

  • Location: Norcross, GA
  • Pay: $18.50/hr
  • Hours: Monday – Friday, Flexible start time to be determined with your manager, between 7 AM –9 AM

ABOUT OMEGA BIO-TEK

OUR HISTORY
Since its founding in 1998, Omega Bio-tek has been at the forefront of nucleic acid purification by offering products for clinical and basic research, biotechnology, and agricultural applications. DNA and RNA extraction is the first step for so many downstream analyses, and efficient and clean nucleic isolation is crucial. Our goal is to offer high-quality products to help you improve your workflows.

For the best option for all of your extraction needs, we offer multiple nucleic acid extraction chemistries including magnetic beads, silica membranes, and salting out. These three different methods are available in a wide range of different kits and configurations for a total of over 900 products.

Omega Bio-tek’s headquarters are located in Norcross, Georgia, about 25 miles outside of downtown Atlanta. We own and operate a 38,000 ft2 facility. We offer products for manual and automated processing, and we support our customers by having Hamilton Microlab® STAR™, Beckman Coulter Biomek® FX, and Thermo KingFisher® instruments in-house.

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact at a growing biotechnology company, apply to the Logistics Associate position at Omega Bio-tek today!

This growing company needs a full-time, roll-up-your-sleeves pro with a diverse background in B2B SaaS demand generation. title: Talent & People Experience Specialist
description:
Talent & People Experience Specialist

The Talent & People Experience Specialist owns full-cycle talent acquisition for Direct Agents: sourcing, screening, and shepherding candidates through a seamless hiring experience, while also serving as a flexible extension of the People & Culture team. This person is equal parts recruiter and operator: comfortable owning a pipeline one moment and jumping into broader people ops support the next, with a positive and solutions oriented demeanor.

Compensation: This is a Full-Time, on-site, NYC role with salary ranging $75,000 - $80,000 dependent on experience.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition

  • Sourcing & Screening | Source and engage passive candidates, build strong pipelines, and evaluate applicants for skills, experience, and cultural add.
  • Interview & Candidate Experience | Coordinate interviews and manage every candidate touchpoint end-to-end, delivering a seamless, high-quality experience for candidates and hiring managers alike.
  • ATS & Job Posting Management | Maintain accurate ATS records and manage job postings across all platforms for all stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder Partnership | Partner with hiring managers and leadership to stay aligned on evolving hiring needs and priorities.
  • Reporting & Insights | Track recruitment data, deliver regular updates on candidate and role status, and use insights to continuously refine sourcing and hiring strategies.

People Experience

  • As part of the People & Culture team, help provide best-in-class HR support to team members across Direct Agents.
  • Support the SVP of HR across a diverse set of company-wide HR functions and initiatives.
  • Ensure all HR information is handled with a high degree of confidentiality and integrity.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of recruiting experience within a digital marketing and/or tech environment
  • Positive, relationship-oriented team player who collaborates effectively across all departments and levels
  • Deadline-driven and proactive, with strong follow-up instincts, a sense of urgency, and the ability to identify and resolve obstacles quickly
  • Thrives in high-growth, fast-changing environments
  • Exceptional organizational and prioritization skills with keen attention to detail
  • Knows when to be resourceful and when it's time to escalate
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills across multiple platforms (Zoom, email, Slack)
  • Self-motivated with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

Who We Are

Direct Agents is not a traditional agency. We are an elite team of builders and operators, growth strategists, media architects, and creative thinkers, who partner with ambitious brands to drive measurable revenue growth. Backed by Kanopy AI, our proprietary intelligence platform, and exclusive partnerships with tech and media platforms, we deliver the kind of unfair advantage that helps clients dominate, not just compete.

We operate at the intersection of technology, media, and strategy, where AI meets human expertise to produce outcomes that neither can achieve alone. Our client roster includes brands like Tennis Channel, Marvel, NYSE, Morgan Stanley, Prologis, and DistroKid.

What Sets Us Apart

Direct Agents isn't for everyone, and that's by design. We're building something different.

  • Proprietary AI That Actually Works: Kanopy AI is our custom-built intelligence platform, real-time campaign optimization, media mix modeling, natural language analytics, and algorithm enrichment that gives our clients (and our team) a genuine edge. This isn't a buzzword; it's operational.
  • Exclusive Platform Access: Direct partnerships across Google AI Search, Meta, TikTok, Amazon, Freewheel, Teads, Stackadapt, and best-in-class tech and media partners.
  • An Elite, Not Bloated, Team: 100+ operators who move fast, think deeply, and ship work that matters. No layers of bureaucracy. Direct access to senior leadership and the executives building the strategy.
  • AI Integration Across Everything: Claude, ChatGPT, and proprietary AI tools are embedded in our workflows, from data analysis and creative versioning to strategic planning and client intelligence.
  • 8x Crain's Best Places to Work: A people-first culture with a 12-month average time to promotion, a 4-day workweek, and genuine investment in career development.
  • Certified Minority-Owned Business: 48% BIPOC representation across the agency, 60% female representation, a team that reflects the diverse markets we serve.

Benefits

  • Regular performance reviews with quarterly growth path check-ins
  • Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and mental health benefits (One Medical, Talkspace, KindBody, Health Advocate)
  • 15–24 days PTO/year depending on seniority, plus birthday off, 7 sick/safe days, and up to 12 weeks paid parental leave
  • New MacBook Pro and access to cutting-edge AI tools across the agency
  • Sun-drenched penthouse Acceleration Hub on 5th Avenue in Flatiron—with commuter benefits and Citibike membership
  • Dog-friendly office, regular team events (Field Day, Ski Club, Golf League, holiday celebrations), and a culture built around ownership and ambition

Location: This role is based in our NYC headquarters. You must reside or be willing to relocate within commuting distance.

title: Part-Time eCommerce Intern
description:
About Scale

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

The Role

Scale Media's e-commerce team is looking for a part-time intern to support our team. Your first long term project would be to build out, test, and QA upsell funnels across our brands (1MD, Live Conscious, Essential Elements). You'll work hands-on in Shopify Plus, helping turn funnel ideas into live, working experiences. Then you’ll make sure they run flawlessly and convert as expected.

What You'll Do

  • Build and configure upsell funnel flows (post-purchase, in-cart, checkout upsells) in Shopify Plus
  • Set up and launch A/B tests on upsell offers, sequencing, and creative
  • QA new funnels end-to-end before launch — checking logic, tracking, pricing, and mobile/desktop rendering
  • Validate that funnel data (conversion events, revenue attribution) is flowing correctly into reporting/analytics tools
  • Document funnel setups, test results, and known issues
  • Flag bugs or edge cases to the CRO/analytics team and help triage fixes

What We're Looking For

  • Current student or recent graduate with a degree in marketing, business, math, computer science, data, or a related field
  • Detail-oriented - Able to methodically test and QA a live funnel step by step
  • Comfortable navigating web apps/platforms (Shopify experience a plus, not required)
  • Basic understanding of A/B testing concepts (control vs. variant; statistical significance is a bonus, not required)
  • Interest in e-commerce and growth/CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization)
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently on defined tasks

Details

  • $25/hr part-time (10-29 hours per week, flexible. Fully Remote)
  • Reports to the e-commerce team

What We Offer

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Fully remote, full-time position
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend
  • Generous paid time off program
  • Discounted products
  • An amazing team to work alongside

description:

Bliv en del af vinterens hyggeligste arbejdsplads i hjertet af Aarhus!

- Salg af klippekort og billetter
- Modtagelse af skoler, klubber og foreninger med bookede arrangementer
- Let rengøring og løbende oprydning og organisering
- Åbning og lukning af skøjteudlejningen
- Hjælpe gæster med spørgsmål og praktiske udfordringer
- Skabe en positiv og imødekommende stemning for både gæster og kollegaer

Vagterne er fordelt over dagvagter, aftenvagter og weekendvagt

Vi søger medarbejdere med færdigheder inden for flere områder:

• Kunne gøre sig forståelig på dansk og engelsk.
• Omstillingsparat og fleksibel.
• Imødekommende og opmærksom på at levere en god service.
• Løsningsorienteret og kan arbejde selvstændigt.
• Trives i et travlt miljø med mange forskellige mennesker.

Derfor skal du vælge os:

Vi søger medarbejdere, der vil være med til at give vores gæster gode oplevelser, samtidig med at vi også dyrker et godt kollegialt fællesskab og det gode arbejdsmiljø. Til gengæld tilbyder vi et spændende og afvekslende job med masser af liv og aktivitet.

Information om organisationen, værdisæt med mere findes på vores hjemmeside.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Stine Seneca telefon 29209012

title: Er du klar til at lege med? Så bliv en del af Idrætsbørnehuset Hoppeland. Vi søger en pædagogmedhjælper til vores vuggestue pr. 1/10-26 på 37 t/u – eller hurtigst herefter
description:
Om jobbet:
Vi leder efter et menneske, der har lyst til at være en vigtig del af de allermindstes hverdag – og som kan være med til at skabe en vuggestue, hvor børnene mødes med nærvær, tryghed, leg, omsorg og masser af grin.



Hos os handler det om at være rigtigt sammen med børnene! At sætte sig på gulvet, følge deres initiativer, synge den samme sang for tiende gang, tumle på madrassen, læse en bog, trøste et barn på en svær morgen eller gå på opdagelse i en vandpyt.



Det kræver også robusthed og ro. Vuggestuelivet kan være intenst, uforudsigeligt og fyldt med mange behov på én gang. Derfor har vi brug for en kollega, der kan bevare overblikket, stå roligt i det, der larmer, og samtidig være nærværende og omsorgsfuld. En, der kan finde balancen mellem at være tæt på børnene, tage ansvar og kunne rumme, at ikke alle dage går helt efter planen.



Hos os er leg ikke en pause fra læring – legen er læringen.

Vi er et idrætscertificeret børnehus, men lad dig ikke narre af ordet idræt. Hos os handler det ikke om at være hurtigst eller dygtigst. Det handler om at bruge kroppen, sanserne og bevægelsen som en naturlig del af børnenes udvikling.



I vuggestuen kan det være at kravle over en pude, trille på gulvet, danse til musik, gå på opdagelse på legepladsen, gynge, mærke græsset under bare fødder eller øve sig i at balancere. Men det kan også være at sidde helt tæt og kigge på en mariehøne eller fordybe sig i en lille leg med en bil.



Vi tror på, at børn udvikler sig gennem det, de oplever sammen med andre – og gennem de relationer, de er en del af. Derfor møder vi børnene med nysgerrighed, omsorg og troen på, at de gør det bedste, de kan.

Vi arbejder med blik for det enkelte barn og for fællesskabet omkring det. For os er det vigtigt, at alle børn oplever, at de hører til, bliver set og har en betydningsfuld plads i fællesskabet.



Din profil:

  • Du elsker at være sammen med børn – rigtigt sammen med dem.
  • Du har lyst til at lege, tumle, synge, bevæge dig og være aktivt deltagende både inde og ude sammen med børnene.
  • Du har blik for de små signaler og kan være nysgerrig på, hvad barnet forsøger at fortælle dig.
  • Du møder børnene med varme, ro, smil og omsorg og kan skabe tryghed gennem dine relationer til både børn, forældre og kollegaer.
  • Du kan være en tryg base for børnene – også når de er kede af det, trætte eller har brug for et ekstra kram.
  • Du kan bevare ro og overblik – også når hverdagen summer af små mennesker, høje lyde, følelser og liv.
  • Du har lyst til at tage del i leg, rutiner, måltider, putning, bleskift og alt det midt imellem.
  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt, og du er ansvarsbevidst, mødestabil og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.
  • Du er engageret og fleksibel, og du kan arbejde indenfor dagtilbuddets åbningstid, som er kl. 6.30-17.00
Kan du spille et instrument eller elsker du musik, er det et ekstra plus – men ikke et krav.





Hos os får du:

  • Et vuggestuemiljø, hvor tryghed, nærvær, leg og relationer er omdrejningspunktet for vores hverdag.
  • Kollegaer, der møder hinanden med varme, nysgerrighed og hjælpsomhed – og som tror på, at vi lykkes bedst sammen.
  • Et fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi tør stille spørgsmål, dele idéer og være nysgerrige på vores egen praksis.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til initiativ, kreativitet og nye perspektiver.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor forskelligheder ses som en styrke, og hvor der er plads til at være menneske.
  • En synlig, nærværende og tydelig leder, som tror på tillid, dialog og fælles retning.
  • Et tæt og tillidsfuldt samarbejde med engagerede forældre, der er en vigtig del af børnenes hverdag.

Aarhus Kommune er Jyllands største arbejdsplads. 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer arbejder hver dag for, at vi er en god by for alle. Som ansat i Aarhus Kommune gør du visioner til virkelighed og skaber udvikling, fællesskab og trivsel. Her er der respekt for faglighed, plads til mangfoldighed og mulighed for udfoldelse. title: Compliance Specialist - New York, NY
description:
Beware of Recruitment Fraud: We are committed to protecting job seekers from recruitment fraud. Please be aware that all official communication regarding opportunities with our firm will come exclusively from an email address ending in @RoseNYC.com. We will never request payment, financial information, or sensitive personal documentation during the application process, and we will never extend a job offer without first conducting a formal in-person interview. If you receive a message that appears suspicious or does not originate from this domain, please mark it as spam or phishing and report it to us directly at recruiting@rosenyc.com.

Overview

Rose Associates is your gateway to an exhilarating realm of real estate innovation. Our dynamic services platform spans development, management, leasing, and marketing, catering to private and institutional property owners globally. In the unparalleled market of New York City, where unique needs and challenges abound, we've solidified our position as the go-to industry leader.

Established in 1925, Rose Associates boasts almost a century of New York real estate expertise, continuously expanding across the tri-state area. Join us on the forefront of innovation and growth – Rose Associates is where excitement meets opportunity.

We're on the lookout for a passionate and driven individual to join our team as a Senior Compliance Specialist. In this crucial position, you will play a key role in influencing the progress, oversight, and coordination of our affordable housing programs. Your dedication will directly contribute to ensuring residents have access to safe, high-quality homes that align with their financial means. Join us in making a meaningful impact on communities by fostering sustainable and accessible housing solutions!

Essential Job Functions
  • The Senior Compliance Specialist will be primarily responsible for overseeing the recertification process, ensuring its timeliness, approving and verifying that all move in files adhere to compliance regulations set by state and local programs, but not limited to tax credits, HPD, HFA, Section 8, HCR and SOTA.
  • Supervise and guide Affordable Housing Associates.
  • Maintain and manage applicant waiting list.
  • Maintaining the recertification tracker to ensure timely completion of all assigned and certifications.
  • Running Yardi Annual recertification reports and developing a plan of action with the team on proactively organizing and completing certifications.
  • Ensure utility allowances, LIHTC and HUD increases are filed timely and correct data is being used throughout portfolio.
  • Lead and direct team to meet all compliance needs, including recertifications, rent registrations and lease renewals.
  • Meet with team on weekly basis to discuss needs for the department and conduct trainings.
  • Ensure accurate lease information, including rates, agency details, apartment specs, and financial terms.
  • Prepare subsidy paperwork and input initial leases, renewals, and credits (e.g., SCRIE, DRIE, Section 8) in Yardi.
  • Assist team in interviewing applicants, assess income requirements and document external income sources.
  • Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual report preparation for government agencies.
  • Take charge of preparing for any state agency or Syndicator audits that may occur.
  • Conduct regular audits, ensuring compliance with income restrictions, guidelines, and government housing programs, while staying informed to maintain audit-ready files and acting as a liaison between ownership, state agencies, and managers.
  • Address tenant inquiries promptly and compassionately, building positive resident relationships while adhering to fair-housing laws and regulations.
  • Must be present on-site, with the ability to move throughout the office, ensuring effective communication with tenants, staff, and visitors.
  • Position may be required to perform duties outside their normal responsibilities as needed.

Qualifications
  • A minimum of 3 years of work experience in affordable housing including LIHTC, local programs and rent stabilization.
  • Proficiency in navigating computers and property management software to include Microsoft Office Suite and On-Site.
  • Previous supervisory experience, a plus.
  • Extensive experience with Yardi software including Rent Café Affordable Housing and managing Section-8 compliance.
  • Possess fundamental math skills, along with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, coupled with practical experience in data entry.
  • Valid NYS real estate license or ability to obtain one within the first 120 days of employment. All active license holders must register their license with Rose Associates upon hire.
  • LIHTC certification (must be obtained within the first year of employment and maintained).
  • Work authorization (required)
In addition to base compensation, significant incentive pay and full benefits packages are available.

Annual Salary Range: $73,000 - $78,000
